**Customer Name:** Wella

**Job Description:**  

The SAP SuccessFactors Time Management Lead Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, integrating, and supporting Employee Central Time Off, Time Sheet, work schedules, holiday calendars, time valuations, approvals, and payroll/time\-system interfaces. The role leads offshore delivery and ensures compliant, accurate, and user\-friendly time processes across countries and employee groups.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
1\. Lead configuration of Time Off, Time Sheet, time types, time accounts, accruals, work schedules, holiday calendars, clock\-time rules, and approvals.
  
2\. Design time valuations, overtime, premiums, flex\-time, allowances, absence counting, and country\-specific time policies.
  
3\. Integrate Time Management with Employee Central, payroll, Kronos/WFM, clock systems, identity services, and third\-party applications.
  
4\. Own requirements, solution design, data migration, testing, reconciliation, releases, defect resolution, and production support.
  
5\. Lead offshore estimation, planning, work allocation, reviews, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and risk escalation.
  
6\. Drive compliance, controls, reporting, documentation, automation, performance improvement, and user adoption.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
1\. Strong hands\-on expertise in Employee Central Time Off, Time Sheet, time profiles, time accounts, accrual rules, work schedules, time valuations, and role\-based permissions.
  
2\. Experience with global time policies, overtime, premiums, absences, flex\-time, localization, payroll replication, and workforce\-management integration.
  
3\. Knowledge of MDF, business rules, Integration Center, OData APIs, SAP Cloud Integration, reporting, and data migration.
  
4\. Proven lead experience in offshore delivery, solution governance, estimation, mentoring, and stakeholder management.
  
5\. Excellent analytical, reconciliation, documentation, communication, and production\-support skills.

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience in architecture, design, verification, implementation, or validation across 7 chip development cycles.
* Experience with managing technical cross\-functional projects.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, or a related field.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience as an engineer or manager in developing hardware or software systems around the chips.
* Experience with two or more chip cycles in a project management role with execution within resource and schedule constraints.
* Knowledge of data centers and cloud markets, technological and business trends, requirements, and ecosystem partners.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Justify, plan, coordinate, and deliver custom silicon products.
* Generate task lists, build project timeline and work with the teams to make it reality.
* Lead the creation of data\-motivated schedules and milestones, track the progress, identify potential future tests, and identify mitigations with the multiple team leaders.
* Drive technical, budgetary, and schedule trade\-off discussions with cross\-functional teams.
* Manage project execution and issues as they arise through design, development, test, manufacturing, deployment and sustaining activities for silicon and hardware products.

 It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

**What We Offer:** 
 At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well\-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
   

  

**Job Description \- Project Manager**
 As a TaskUs Project Manager, you will be the architect and catalyst of AI\-integrated project delivery and operational transformation. Your mission is to transcend traditional project roadmapping by driving human\-AI collaboration, deep process mapping, and technology\-driven problem solving to accelerate client implementations and internal digital transformations.
   

  

 You'll manage complex initiatives ranging from client launches and site builds to strategic AI\-driven process improvements, with success measured by the transformative outcomes and operational visibility you deliver.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include**
* Engaging with key stakeholders and sponsors throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring scope, cost, and timelines are met.
* Conducting deep\-dive meetings with stakeholders, documenting actions, and creating timelines for resolution.
* Validating workflows and processes for new opportunities.
* Acting as the communication hub for project stakeholders, managing competing priorities and expectations.
* Being adaptable and solution\-minded, navigating changes with resilience and a focus on positive outcomes.
* Managing client relationships and expectations throughout the project cycle.
* Contributing to the closure process and organization\-wide improvements based on lessons learned.
* Reporting to cross\-geo managers and aligning with diverse teams across multiple regions.
* AI\-Enhanced Documentation \& Planning: Proactively incorporate generative AI tools (e.g., Google Workspace with Gemini) or likes to streamline the creation of project documentation, including initial project plans, executive reports, and proposals.
* Developing comprehensive project plans using standardized documentation (WBS, agendas, action trackers) and proactively incorporating generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini) to streamline communication flows, risk tracking, updates, etc.
* Collaborating with internal and external teams across multiple geographies, driving process improvements, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining strong relationships with global partners while leveraging AI to support these improvements.
* Leading weekly syncs, tracking milestones, action items, and escalation points utilizing AI capabilities within tools to organize project data, create custom tables such as task trackers, and automate manual text processing tasks.
* Process Automation \& Improvement: Identify opportunities to leverage AI for process improvements, including automating routine project tasks using tools like Workspace Studio, or utilizing AI for deep research and comprehensive reporting on complex project topics.
* Developing comprehensive project plans using standardized documentation (WBS, agendas, action trackers).
* End\-to\-End Process Mapping: Independently map end\-to\-end operational workflows, process flows, and exception paths (utilizing process mapping/mining tools) to identify exact points where automation, robotics, Agentic AI, or AutoQA can be injected.
* AI Solution Consultation \& Client Pitching: Partner with internal digital and transformation teams to construct data\-driven business cases and visual process proposals ("Human\-in\-the\-Loop" architecture) to pitch AI and technology adoption to external client executives.
* Day\-1 Reporting Guardrails: Guarantee 100% Day\-1 reporting readiness (automated dashboards or standardized manual trackers) for all account launches and transitions, maintaining strict operational visibility from day one.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent business/project management experience. 3\-5 years of project management experience.
* 2\+ years in operations/account management, working directly with clients.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional problem\-solving ability and attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively with teams across different geographies, manage cross\-functional teams respectfully, and report to cross\-geo managers.
* A solution\-oriented mindset, comfortable with change and evolving business needs.
* Openness to working in multiple time zones, usually aligning with client or project team's working hours.
* Demonstrated understanding of core generative AI principles and their practical application in project planning, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Proven ability to craft clear, specific, and effective prompts to guide AI tools in generating accurate and useful outputs, such as drafting summaries, creating content, or refining ideas.
* Proactive AI \& Tech Passion: Demonstrated passion and a proactive track record of experimenting with, deploying, or driving technology and AI\-driven solutions to solve real\-world business problems.
* Process Mapping Capability: Proven ability to map complex operational process flows, identify inefficiencies, and design optimized workflows.
* Executive Presentation Skills: Ability to articulate complex operational workflows and pitch tech/AI concepts clearly to senior C\-suite client stakeholders.
* Shift Flexibility: Willingness and open availability to work US operational hours / night shifts as needed to align with global account demands.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, Agile, and/or Lean Six Sigma certifications
* Google Workspace with Gemini feature set (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Gmail) and experience leveraging these or other AI tools to accelerate project workflows and content creation.

About Bijliride

Bijliride is a fast\-growing electric mobility company focused on building sustainable, affordable, and convenient mobility solutions through electric two\-wheeler rentals, B2B fleet solutions, 3PL services, battery swapping, and EV mobility solutions.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Program Manager who will be responsible for building and managing structured programs across business operations, franchise expansion, and cross\-functional teams.

The role will focus on team alignment, organizational matrices, SOPs and documentation, reporting systems, franchise reporting, and execution of franchise/business expansion projects.

The ideal candidate should be highly organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of working across multiple teams to ensure programs are executed effectively and business objectives are achieved.

* Plan, execute, and monitor strategic business and operational programs.
* Manage end\-to\-end franchise projects, from planning and setup to execution and performance monitoring.

* Track project progress and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Identify operational challenges and drive timely resolution.

* Support the development and execution of franchise expansion projects.

* Develop and maintain franchise reporting systems and dashboards.
* Track franchise\-wise KPIs, revenue, fleet performance, utilization, operational performance, and other business metrics.
* Coordinate with franchise partners and internal teams to ensure alignment.
* Identify gaps in franchise operations and drive corrective actions.
* Support new franchise launches and ensure readiness across operations, people, assets, and processes.

3\. Team Alignment \& Team Matrix

* Build and maintain team structures and responsibility matrices.

* Consolidate operational and business data for leadership review.

* Create, standardize, and maintain SOPs, process documents, checklists, and operational guidelines.

* Work with functional teams to identify process gaps and improve existing SOPs.

* Regularly review and update SOPs based on operational requirements.

6\. Process Improvement

* Identify inefficiencies across existing processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop systems and frameworks to improve operational efficiency.
* Standardize processes across teams and franchise locations.
* Monitor implementation and measure the impact of process improvements.
* Drive accountability through clear KPIs, ownership, and reporting mechanisms.

7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Act as a central point of coordination between different business functions.
* Work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Technology, Marketing, and leadership teams.
* Ensure dependencies between teams are identified and managed.
* Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate critical issues to leadership with clear analysis and recommended solutions.

* Experience in building MIS, dashboards, reporting structures, and performance matrices.
* Strong documentation and SOP creation skills.
* Excellent Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

description:
**Description**
 ou are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a complex cross\-functional program with considerable impact. Your program may focus on a single process path in a critical business area or you may work more broadly, managing larger initiatives that span organizations or geographies in support of a significant business objective. You may also be responsible for the delivery of large and complex projects that are not tied to any program. You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to OP1/OP2 narratives, and/or ownership of one or more organizational goals. You are accountable for overall program strategy as well as tactically driving teams in and outside your organization to deliver. You are able to define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. You understand the significant business problems in your program space, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind leadership decisions (Q: Why did we deliver X? What business goal does it solve? Do we need to deliver something else\-\- if so why, and what? ).
   

  

 To ensure stakeholder needs are aligned, you drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions. You provide a long\-term perspective, context (past, current, and future) for business and technology (at a high level) choices. You partner with customers, internal/external teams, and/or engineering teams to determine what projects move forward and in what priority order. You use your judgment to question proposals and test assumptions (Q. Do we need to deliver this at all?). You enlist senior individual contributors and leaders to ensure solutions scale (or will scale). You make smart trade\-offs (e.g., time vs. effort vs. deliverables). You create plans that have clear, measurable success criteria. You clearly communicate progress and outcomes. You oversee the gap between teams, processes, and systems. You help teams and/or your organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood or documented, ineffective cross\-team collaboration, long\-term impact(s) from third\-party solutions, security not considered, insufficient stakeholder review, etc.). You are able to solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships). You are data\-driven. You regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility. You ensure your program stays aligned with organizational objectives.
   

  

 You understand and share program\-management best practices. You may be asked to use your knowledge to assess processes, program plans, and operational requirements. You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery. You streamline and/or eliminate excess process. You influence teams to decouple from dependencies and eliminate problems that stifle innovation or cause user dissatisfaction. You are an excellent communicator. You write effective narratives (e.g., Amazon 6\-pager, PR/FAQ, reporting, etc.) and present them effectively to directors and VPs. You routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. When confronted with discordant views, you are able to find the best way forward and influence others to follow that path (build consensus). You actively recruit and develop others by mentoring in your organization and/or at your location. You provide constructive peer feedback and promotion assessments for lower level PMs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Generally works within a VP org. Influences large customer segments, technology decisions, external entity interaction, etc. Actively mentors and develops others.
   

  

 Work is tactical and strategic. Owns a large program. Manages the lifecycle of complex initiatives. Unblocks teams and increases the speed of delivery. Negotiates resources and priorities. Learning to force multiply . Escalates effectively. Able to find a path forward in difficult situations. Makes trade\-offs between short\-term needs vs. long\-term needs.
   

  

 High impact on. Org goals, and program\-related metrics. May have cross\- region impact
   

  

 Improves, streamlines, and/or eliminates excess process. Drives efficiencies. Creates predictable process paths.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

**Project Cost Control:**
* Ensure alignment with client expectations and deadlines while coordinating with billing, finance, and project teams to manage accounts receivable, timesheets, expenses, and invoice\-related queries.
* Prepare billing drafts, compile and verify monthly invoices, and ensure accurate manual data entry and mapping to final invoice sheets.

* Act as liaison between GCC India and US teams for project setup, billing, and timesheet coding, while supporting the E\&E PMO team in portfolio monitoring.
* Conduct data integrity checks, audits, and maintain project documentation including lessons\-learned databases and meeting records.
* Should have extensive knowledge of working with ERP for project creation and maintenance.

**Project Scheduling:**

* Develop activity lists, identify critical paths, and notify teams of key activities and schedule risks.
* Monitor project progress, detect deviations, and support recovery planning and schedule forecasting.
* Assess and report impacts of changes to baseline schedules and milestones, ensuring timely updates and resolution tracking.
* Support bids and proposals by preparing preliminary schedules and timelines.
* Use Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems to analyze and report project performance and KPIs.

 :

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and manage complex projects within our organization. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget while ensuring high\-quality standards. You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of project management, from initiation to closure, and will work closely with cross\-functional teams to achieve project objectives.

* **Role: Project Manager**
* **Location: Bengaluru**
* **Experience: Above 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead project planning sessions to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
* Coordinate and manage project teams, ensuring effective communication and collaboration among team members.
* Monitor project progress and performance, identifying and mitigating risks and issues as they arise.
* Prepare and present project status reports to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with project goals.
* Implement project management methodologies and best practices to enhance project delivery.
* Facilitate project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, and retrospectives.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and standards throughout the project lifecycle.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Proven experience in project management with a focus on delivering complex projects.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Scrum).
* Excellent leadership and team management skills.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA, Trello).
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience in managing projects in a technology\-driven environment.
* Familiarity with budgeting and financial management in projects.
* Experience with stakeholder management and engagement strategies.
* Knowledge of change management principles and practices.
* The successful candidate will bring a wealth of experience in project management, demonstrating a strong ability to lead teams and drive projects to successful completion.
* You will have a strategic mindset, with the ability to align project goals with organizational objectives.
* Your expertise in managing risks, stakeholder expectations, and project resources will be critical to your success in this role.
* If you are a results\-oriented project manager with a passion for excellence and a commitment to delivering high\-quality outcomes, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
* Educational background: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Project management and oversight of construction related activities for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budgets.
   

  

 Driving costs down and schedules shorter while maintaining quality.
   

  

 Provide Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
   

  

 Review of constructability of electrical and mechanical system and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
   

  

 Creation of project scope and equipment requirements, assist with request for proposals, and capital requests. \- Total project quality including the assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing and oversight of the execution of the project.
   

  

 Management of multiple stakeholders and driving the project from starting to successful handing over.
   

  

 Issue/Manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers
   

  

 Recording and reporting key metrics to team members and management.
   

  

 Concurrently managing multiple projects including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
   

  

 Operational support of installed facilities including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
   

  

 Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
   

  

 Travel to data center sites for electrical systems audits, mechanical system reviews, construct ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Title And Summary**
 Lead Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

**Overview**
 The Identity Solution team is looking for a Lead Technical Program Manager to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset
   

  

 As part of an exciting, fast paced environment developing payment authentication and security solutions at Mastercard , this position will provide projects and initiatives delivery management within the development lifecycle for Mastercard ecommerce payment authentication platform.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Using SAFE Agile process, facilitate agile ceremonies / meetings to ensure SCRUM teams remain on track for their committed deliverable for sprints / PI / quarter.
* Facilitate status presentations and reporting to program leadership.
* Coordinates with other teams and participates in the scrum of scrum / Release meetings with Program/Release Train Engineer (RTE).
* This coordinator will work with a cross functional team of technical and business owners to deliver world class solutions to business problems.
* This role is responsible for communication and coordination support to facilitate a self\-organizing and self\-managing teams who can deliver via effective Agile Practices. Help to complete any tasks required to remove impediments for the team and provide coaching and leadership support that make development deliverable possible.
* Agile experience is mandatory. SAFE agile exposure is further preferred.
* Helps highlight and manage risk and dependencies at the initiative / service / portfolio / program level.

* Proactively monitoring project health and quality, provides input to RTE and Management.
* Ensure timely and accurate communication with program leadership throughout the life cycle of the project.
* Act as liaison between various stake holders and ensure dependencies to other shared technical teams in Mastercard are prioritized and delivered on time.
* Coordinate and assist in the implementation and monitoring of existing and/or revised management directions and policies. Effectively and constructively deals with challenges.

* Strong communication, both verbal and written, with strong relationship, collaborative, and organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. title: Project Manager CPMO tools & AI enablement
description:
**Job title** 
 :
 **Project Manager CPMO tools \& AI enablement**
* Location: Ind\- Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by
 **making self\-care as simple as it should be** 
 . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our
 **100 loved brands** 
 , our
 **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** 
 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets** 
 , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Opella Digital is executing a multi\-year transformation program (Butterfly: 56 programs, 205\+ projects) supported by an integrated PMO \& OCM unit. The tooling landscape underpinning this transformation — Planisware, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, and the ELITEA, OpellaGPT AI platforms — has been designed and initially built by our implementation partner EPAM.
   

  

 We are now internalizing this capability. The PMO \& CMO Tools and Enablement Lead will act as the Product Owner and Project Manager of the full tooling ecosystem. You will not build the tools yourself — dedicated tech teams handle Planisware, Jira/Confluence, PowerBI, and OpellaGPT implementation. Your job is to gather requirements from all stakeholders across the Digital organization, translate them into actionable specifications, prioritize them, and project\-manage their implementation by the right tech teams.
   

  

 You are the bridge between business needs (what PMO, programme streams, OCM, and project teams need to see and do) and the technical teams that make it happen. You need a strong understanding of the underlying technology — not to code, but to know what’s possible, what’s feasible, and how systems connect. You think in data flows, integration patterns, and user requirements — then you drive delivery.
   

  

 A defining requirement of this role is to be an AI champion. Beyond running the tooling ecosystem, you are expected to actively drive the conversion of manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool ways of working toward AI\-assisted and automated workflows — using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected platforms — and to make AI and automation the default way the PMO and OCM operate. This expectation is weighted heavily in the recruitment process: candidates without a demonstrable AI\-automation track record are not a fit.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Requirements Gathering \& Product Ownership
* Act as the single Product Owner for the PMO \& CMO tooling ecosystem — own the backlog, prioritize features, and define what gets built and in what order
* Gather and consolidate requirements from multiple stakeholder layers: PMO dashboards, Butterfly stream dashboards, OCM/change management needs, project\-level dashboards, programme\-level reporting, DLT/SteerCo views
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and user stories that tech teams can implement
* Manage the requirements lifecycle: elicitation, documentation, validation, prioritization, change control
* Facilitate workshops and requirement sessions with stakeholders across PMO, OCM, programme streams, and leadership to understand their reporting, tracking, and tooling needs
* Maintain a prioritized product backlog for the tooling ecosystem — balancing competing demands from PMO, OCM, and programme stakeholders
* Define acceptance criteria and validate delivered solutions against requirements before release
* AI Enablement \& Automation (Core Mandate)
* Champion AI and automation across the PMO and OCM — set the ambition, build momentum, demonstrate quick wins, and convert sceptics into adopters.
* Audit current ways of working and identify manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool processes that are candidates for automation.
* Drive the conversion of those processes to AI\-assisted and automated workflows using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected tooling — automated reporting and status roll\-ups, AI\-enabled change analytics, document and template generation.
* Embed AI into standard operating practice rather than leaving it as an optional add\-on; make automation the default, not the exception.
* Define and track AI\-adoption and conversion metrics (e.g. share of manual reports automated, hours saved, adoption rates) and report progress to the Head of PM Practice.
* Stay ahead of emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, ELITEA, PowerBI AI features) and translate them into practical improvements for the delivery and change teams.
* Project Management of Tooling Implementations
* Project\-manage the implementation of requirements across multiple tech teams: Planisware team, Jira/Confluence team, PowerBI team, OpellaGPT/ELITEA team, and any future platform teams
* Coordinate delivery across tech teams — manage dependencies, timelines, and integration points between platforms
* Track delivery progress, manage risks and issues, escalate blockers, and ensure on\-time delivery of tooling features
* Own the release management process — coordinate deployments across platforms, ensure regression testing, and manage rollout communication
* Manage the phased evolution of the reporting pipeline: from Phase 1 (manual) to Phase 2 (MCP/OpenAPI connectors) to Phase 3 (Planisware\-Jira synchronization)
* Coordinate with the Solution Architect on technical feasibility, platform evolution roadmap, and integration architecture
* Data Architecture Understanding \& Integration Design
* Understand where every datapoint lives across the ecosystem — Planisware (portfolio, schedules, budgets), Jira (project tracking, status), Confluence (governance), Snowflake (analytics), LMS (training completion), Veeva (content), knowledge platforms
* Design integration requirements: specify what data needs to flow between systems, in what direction, at what frequency, and in what format — then hand off to tech teams for implementation
* Understand the three\-layer reporting architecture: Data Layer → Orchestration Layer (ELITEA/OpellaGPT) → Presentation Layer (dashboards, PowerBI, Confluence) — and ensure requirements are correctly placed in the right layer
* Define data quality requirements and validation rules for the tooling ecosystem — ensure a consistent data baseline across the global portfolio
* Evaluate and recommend integration patterns (MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL) based on technical feasibility and business priority
* Ensure portability of data pipelines and workflows to future platforms (OpellaGPT) as those platforms mature
* CMO Tooling — Requirements \& Delivery
* Gather requirements from the OCM/Change team for the CMO tooling layer — understand what they need for change readiness tracking, adoption measurement, training management, and stakeholder engagement
* Understand enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms at a functional level — know what data they produce and how to specify integrations with the reporting ecosystem
* Translate CMO requirements into specifications for the relevant tech teams (PowerBI for dashboards, Confluence for templates, OpellaGPT for AI\-enabled change analytics)
* Project\-manage the build of CMO tools: change saturation heatmaps, adoption dashboards, training completion tracking, readiness assessments — as specified by the Central Change Manager
* Ensure CMO data feeds into the existing PMO dashboards — change readiness metrics, training completion, and adoption data visible alongside delivery data
* Unlock the benefits of AI solutions for OCM (OpellaGPT) — gather requirements for AI\-enabled change enablement, reporting, and analytics
* Stakeholder Management \& Training
* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders (PMO, OCM, programme streams, PMs) and the tech teams that implement tooling solutions
* Manage expectations across stakeholders — communicate priorities, timelines, trade\-offs, and delivery status
* Train project teams on how to use PMO and CMO tools — where to find them, how to use them, how to submit data at stage gates (the OCM team owns the content; this role owns the tooling how\-to)
* Develop self\-service training materials: guides, video walkthroughs, quick\-reference cards for both PMO and CMO tools
* Lead Communities of Practice sessions focused on tooling best practices and adoption
* Support new PM onboarding with tooling setup and orientation (coordinated with the Delivery Facilitation Lead)
* Continuous Improvement
* Continuously improve the tooling landscape based on user feedback, emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, PowerBI, ELITEA), and evolving programme needs
* Monitor tool adoption rates and flag under\-utilization to the Head of PM Practice
* Conduct periodic reviews of the tooling ecosystem with key stakeholders to identify gaps, redundancies, and improvement opportunities


**Technical Environment**
**This Role Requires Understanding Of The Following Platforms**
**Portfolio Management**
 Planisware (schedules, budgets, dependencies, milestones) — dedicated Planisware team implements
   

  

**Project Tracking**
 Jira Cloud Enterprise (epics, stories, status, RAG) — dedicated Jira/Confluence team implements
   

  

**Collaboration \& Docs**
 Confluence Cloud (governance pages, templates, documentation)
   

  

**Data Warehouse**
 Snowflake (analytical data, portfolio ingestion)
   

  

**AI / Orchestration**
 ELITEA Platform, OpellaGPT — dedicated AI team implements
   

  

**Reporting / BI**
 PowerBI, self\-contained HTML dashboards, Confluence publishing — dedicated BI team implements
   

  

**CMO / Change Platforms**
 LMS (Learning Management Systems), Veeva, knowledge platforms — data integration, not content creation
   

  

**Integration Patterns**
 MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL — understand and specify, tech teams implement
   

  

**About You**
* 6\+ years of experience in business analysis, project management, or product ownership in an enterprise IT/Digital environment
* Demonstrable track record of driving AI and automation adoption — converting manual, template\-based, or legacy\-tool processes into AI\-assisted or automated workflows, with evidence of results. This is an essential, defining requirement of the role.
* Proven ability to gather, translate, and prioritize requirements from multiple business stakeholders with competing needs
* Experience project\-managing implementations across multiple technical teams working on different platforms simultaneously
* Strong understanding of enterprise project/portfolio management tools (Planisware, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) — not as a developer, but as someone who understands their capabilities, data models, and integration possibilities
* Ability to think in data flows and system integration — understand where datapoints live, how systems connect, and what’s technically feasible without being the one who codes it
* Good understanding of enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms — at a functional level, not as a content creator
* Experience with reporting and BI tools (PowerBI, HTML dashboards, or similar) — understand what’s possible and specify requirements for BI teams
* Experience writing functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills — ability to facilitate workshops, manage expectations, and communicate trade\-offs across business and technical audiences
* Ability to train non\-technical users on enterprise tools — create training materials, deliver sessions, provide ongoing support
* Comfortable working across time zones with distributed teams (India, Paris, Barcelona, global)
* Fluent English (written and spoken) — all documentation and training materials are in English


**Preferred**
* Experience working as Product Owner for an enterprise tooling or platform team
* Understanding of AI/ML platforms or agentic AI frameworks (OpellaGPT, LangChain, ELITEA, or equivalent) — at a functional level
* Experience specifying data integration requirements (MCP, OpenAPI, ETL, webhooks) for technical teams to implement
* Experience with Planisware\-Jira integration or cross\-platform synchronization projects
* Experience with Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or similar life sciences platforms


**Transition \& Onboarding**
 This role internalizes capability currently delivered by EPAM. The onboarding plan includes:
   

  

* Weeks 1\-4: Shadow period with EPAM team — understand the current tooling landscape, data flows, platform capabilities, and stakeholder requirements
* Weeks 3\-6: Begin gathering requirements independently; start building the product backlog; establish relationships with all tech teams
* Weeks 5\-8: Take over project management of ongoing tooling implementations; begin CMO tooling requirements gathering with Brent (OCM Lead)
* Month 3\+: Full autonomous ownership of the tooling backlog and delivery roadmap. EPAM engagement ends for tooling scope.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Butterfly program is one of the largest digital transformations in the FMCH industry — 56 programs, 205\+ projects. Every Program Manager, every SteerCo, and every leadership review depends on the dashboards and reporting this role delivers. On the change side, the tools you specify and drive to implementation will determine whether OCM is embedded in how projects are actually run, or stays as a theoretical framework.
   

  

 You will own the infrastructure that makes delivery visible and change trackable — with direct impact on global decision\-making.
   

  

 Why us?
   

  

 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced program manager to join our GAITech team at our firm’s office in Hyderabad or Bengaluru. You will be responsible for program management across all sub\-teams within GAITech and collaborate with various HC functions to run a GAI learning plan for the entire India firm’s staff. The GAITech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI\-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of GAITech will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU\-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAITech's role focuses on user education and promoting interdepartmental collaboration. The mission of GAITech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development. This includes AI\-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAITech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready\-to\-use applications for developers. Embracing open\-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAITech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:
   

  

 In this position, you will be responsible for coordinating user\-facing projects across all sub\-teams in GAITech, including project prioritization and keeping stakeholders abreast of project progress with periodic communications on timelines and progress. Another major responsibility is to work with the Talent Development team to run the GAI learning plan, with the goal of upskilling staff and creating awareness about GAI tools. Additionally, you will have product management opportunities, including gathering and prioritizing product/feature requirements and specifications, defining the product vision, and working closely with various teams.
   

  

 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field with 3 to 8 years of technical program management experience and at least 1 year of software development experience in any language
* Exposure to GAI projects
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills
* Excellent communication skills


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Program Management related academic qualifications (e.g. MBA, PMP)


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrMgrSrMemGAITechApr26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers.

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
   

  

 For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.
   

  

**Job Description –Project Manager – Applied (Chillers)**
**Grade:** 
 169/170
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Senior Project Manager – Applied Projects
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for managing the execution of multiple HVAC and chiller projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery in line with customer requirements, contractual commitments, and company objectives. The role will focus on project planning, coordination, schedule management, commercial follow\-up, and driving projects through defined toll gates from HOTO to closure.
   

  

 The incumbent will work closely with customers, vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Execution \& Coordination**
* Manage HVAC/chiller old, ongoing and new projects at different stages of execution.
* Ensure projects are executed as per approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, factories, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Track project milestones and drive closure of pending activities.


**Schedule Management**
* Prepare and maintain project schedules in coordination with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Obtain customer approval for schedule baselines during HOTO.
* Monitor progress against planned schedules and initiate corrective actions for delays.
* Drive timely completion of project milestones and support toll gate movement.


**Commercial \& Financial Management**
* Monitor project costs, committed costs, and revenue realization.
* Support achievement of forecasted revenue for assigned projects.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices as per contractual milestones.
* Follow up with customers for payment collections and resolution of commercial issues.
* Maintain Unbilled Revenue (UBR) within prescribed limits.


**Risk \& Issue Management**
* Identify project risks and implementation challenges at an early stage.
* Maintain project risk and issue logs.
* Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner.
* Work with stakeholders to implement mitigation and recovery plans.


**Customer Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned projects.
* Maintain regular communication with customers regarding project status, schedules, deliveries, and outstanding actions.
* Address customer concerns promptly and coordinate internal support for resolution.
* Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.


**Material \& Resource Coordination**
* Coordinate with procurement, logistics, factory, and service teams to ensure timely deliveries.
* Track material availability and installation readiness.
* Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites.


**Reporting \& Governance**
* Update project status, forecasts, and financial metrics regularly.
* Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates.
* Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements.
* Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure.


**Desired Skills \& Competencies**
* Good understanding of HVAC systems, chillers, and applied projects.
* Knowledge of project management fundamentals including:
+ Planning and Scheduling
+ Cost Monitoring
+ Risk Management
+ Quality Compliance
+ Customer Management

* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, ERP, and project tracking tools.
* Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* PMP/Project Management certification would be an added advantage.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* On\-time achievement of project milestones.
* Successful movement of projects through toll gates.
* Revenue realization against forecast.
* Timely invoicing and collection performance.
* UBR maintained within target limits.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Schedule adherence.
* Quality and safety compliance.
* Timely closure of project risks and issues.

description:
**Description**
 We are building Amazon's first horizontal self\-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule\-based systems into outcome\-learning, context\-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each requiring structured onboarding, cross\-org coordination, and production launch governance.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to own tenant onboarding execution end\-to\-end — from first contact through production launch and steady\-state operations. This role operates at the intersection of platform product, tenant engineering, and business stakeholders — orchestrating complex multi\-party programs where each tenant brings a different tech stack, org structure, data readiness level, and decision type.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Tenant Onboarding Execution
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding lifecycle — contract → data readiness → prototyping → shadow mode → production launch.
* Manage parallel tracks across multiple tenants simultaneously at different stages.
* Drive timelines against committed milestones, identify blockers early, and escalate decisively across cross\-org dependencies.


 Cross\-Org Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Navigate multi\-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries.
* Coordinate across platform engineering, applied science, BA/RA teams, and tenant\-side engineering.
* Serve as the single\-threaded owner tenant leadership engages with throughout onboarding.


 Process Design \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Design and iterate on scalable onboarding processes — playbooks, health dashboards, RACI matrices, milestone trackers.
* Drive process improvements as the platform moves from bespoke onboarding to self\-serve at scale.


 Data Readiness \& Pre\-flight
   

  

* Drive data readiness (the \#1 time sink) by providing clear requirements, checklists, and embedded support.
* Coordinate pre\-flight validation: data quality gates, signal checks, and integration testing.
* Ensure contract commitments are met before prototype begins.


 Governance \& Launch Readiness
   

  

* Coordinate shadow mode, launch readiness reviews (circuit breakers, fail\-safes, RACI sign\-off), and transition to steady\-state operations with support handoff and monitoring.


 Pipeline \& Reporting
   

  

* Maintain full pipeline visibility. Report program health with actionable metrics: onboarding velocity, time\-to\-production, blocker resolution.
* Partner with GTM to convert qualified demand into onboarding\-ready tenants.


**About The Team**
 We operate at the intersection of product, science, and GTM — building a platform that connects decision systems across Amazon so that one signal makes all of them smarter. The platform is live with founding tenants, scaling to broad GA, and building pipeline for pan\-Amazon adoption. This role is critical to ensuring that every tenant that enters the funnel moves through onboarding with velocity, quality, and trust.
   

  

 You will work directly with platform leadership, applied science, engineering, BA/RAs, and tenant\-side stakeholders to drive the operational machinery that turns platform readiness into production impact — one tenant at a time, then many in parallel.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years in program management, technical program management, or platform operations roles
* Experience managing multi\-party programs with cross\-organizational dependencies and competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to drive programs in environments with ambiguity — where processes don't exist yet and must be built while executing
* Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and escalating decisively when programs are at risk
* Track record of managing parallel workstreams (5\+ concurrent programs) with clear milestone tracking and proactive risk management
* Excellent written communication — able to produce clear program documents, status reports, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Experience in platform onboarding, developer ecosystem programs, or internal tooling adoption at large\-scale technology organizations
* Familiarity with data platform or ML/AI product ecosystems — comfortable navigating conversations about data readiness, model validation, and production governance
* Background in building scalable onboarding processes that reduce per\-tenant effort over time (self\-serve model design)
* Experience with change management in multi\-org environments — driving adoption where commitment requires budget, headcount, and cross\-functional alignment

**Job Title**
 Assistant Project Manager
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 The role will require close coordination with the Client, PMC, consultants, contractors, design teams, procurement teams and site execution teams to ensure that project milestones are achieved within the approved project schedule. Having strong hands\-on expertise in Primavera P6, construction sequencing, progress measurement, critical path analysis, delay analysis and schedule reporting.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About The Role:**
* We are looking for an experienced Planning Engineer with around 10 years of experience in construction planning and project controls to be based in Bangalore.
* The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining and controlling project schedules, monitoring contractor performance, identifying schedule risks and delays, and providing timely recommendations for corrective and recovery measures.
* Develop and maintain the Project Master Schedule in Primavera P6\.
* Establish appropriate WBS, activity coding, calendars, relationships, milestones and critical path.
* Develop baseline, detailed execution, procurement, design and commissioning schedules.
* Integrate design, approvals, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
* Review contractor baseline schedules for logic, sequencing, durations, resources and achievability.
* Ensure alignment of contractor schedules with overall project milestones.
* Develop detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules as required by the project.
* Prepare and maintain 2\-week, 4\-week and monthly look\-ahead schedules.
* Identify interface activities and constraints affecting project progress.
* Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline schedule.
* Collect and validate progress information from site teams and contractors.
* Carry out weekly and monthly schedule updates.
* Analyse planned vs. actual progress and identify slippages.
* Track critical and near\-critical activities.
* Monitor key project milestones and sectional completion dates.
* Identify potential delays at an early stage and escalate them to the Project Manager.
* Ensure that reported progress is supported by actual site achievement.
* Prepare and monitor manpower histograms and resource loading.
* Review contractor manpower and equipment deployment against planned requirements.
* Monitor productivity against planned norms.
* Identify resource shortages affecting critical activities.
* Prepare resource\-based recovery plans where required.
* Monitor material and equipment requirements against project milestones.
* Coordinate with design consultants to track drawing and document deliverables.
* Monitor design approvals against construction requirements.
* Integrate procurement schedules with the construction programme.
* Track long\-lead items and ensure delivery dates are aligned with site requirements.
* Highlight delays in design approvals, material procurement and statutory approvals that may impact the programme.
* Review and comment on contractor schedules and programmes.
* Conduct regular planning meetings with contractors and site teams.
* Challenge unrealistic activity durations, sequencing and progress claims.
* Ensure contractors submit updated schedules and recovery programmes on time.
* Monitor contractor commitments against agreed action plans.
* Provide planning inputs during commercial and contractual discussions.
* Maintain a clear record of delay events, instructions, approvals and their schedule impact.
* Maintain a schedule risk and constraint register.
* Identify activities with potential impact on project completion.
* Carry out schedule risk assessments and mitigation planning.
* Support cost and commercial teams by providing schedule information for forecasting and change management.
* Analyse the schedule impact of variations and change orders.
* Support project forecasting and expected completion\-date assessments.
* Ensure schedule changes are properly documented and traceable.


**About You**
* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
* Post Graduate qualification in Construction Management / Project Management will be an advantage.
* Primavera P6 certification will be preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in construction planning/project controls.
* Should have substantial experience in preparing and managing construction programmes rather than only updating schedules.
* Experience with a PMC/Client/Consultant organisation will be preferred.
* Experience in reviewing contractor programmes and delay claims will be an advantage.
* The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on construction planning professional, not merely a Primavera operator. He/she should be capable of independently analysing a project programme, identifying why the project is slipping, determining the impact on the critical path, developing recovery options and presenting clear recommendations to the Project Manager/Client.
* Experience with major contractors such as L\&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons, Brigade, Prestige or similar organisations, or experience with a reputed PMC/consultancy, will be preferred.


**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**
 As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;
   

  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


 We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
   

  

 We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.
   

  

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**
*That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.*
*We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community \- it means we go way beyond than just talking about it \- we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.*

**About The Job**
 Sanofi is an innovative global healthcare company headquartered in Paris, France with one purpose: Chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve, and we accomplish our goals through world\-class research and with the compassion and commitment of our employees.
   

  

 The company is focused on accelerating development to deliver breakthrough medicines and vaccines to patients, delivering excellence though Diversity.
   

  

 Sanofi operates in 90 countries with 91 000 employees worldwide, working in 59 manufacturing and 20 Research \& Development (R\&D) sites. In 2022 business net income was €10\.3 Billion, delivered by 4 Global Business Units: Specialty care, Consumer Healthcare, Vaccines \& General Medicines.
   

  

 Sanofi covers major therapeutic areas, including immunology, cardiovascular, diabetes, oncology, rare diseases, etc.
   

  

 Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) is designed to centralize processes and activities to support global medical business units and medical office.
   

  

 The Sanofi Business Operations is built to reduce reliance on external services providers and facilitate the development of internal expertise. The Sanofi Business Operations will leverage untapped combination of talent pool.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
*The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:*
*Project Specialist will be responsible for processing contracts and related documents, connecting with stakeholders, and tracking ongoing work.*
* Production: Support scientific events activities \& external expert engagements. Process contract and related documents within defined timelines. Check country specificities and handle queries received from country approver and/or external experts. Timely follow\-ups with event leads, country approvers, and external experts
* Project Planning: Ensure delivery of ongoing projects as per agreed timelines. Ensure to follow defined/agreed quality parameters before sending out deliverables to the stakeholders
* Track ongoing projects on regular basis and take required actions. Support adherence to associated compliance related activities and approvals (taking accountability for compliance with internal customer)
* Stakeholder Management: Maintain effective working relationship with stakeholders and work with them to provide solutions on ongoing issues/problems. Regular connects with event leads, project requestors, and End\-to\-End contracting leads. Mentor the team on day to day as well exceptional cases, situations. Managing complex projects and interacting with local affiliate/country approvers/BU to discuss over the hospitality. Training management on overall E2E activities (Whenever required). Driving the meetings with stakeholders and providing the project status. Manage challenges related to contracting tools (Vendor onboarding, OneCRM Profile creations (US), other technical issues in tools)
* Events: Partner directly or indirectly, through third party agencies, with transversal brand teams, creative agencies, HCOs, Associations, and exhibit vendors for the best end\-to\-end experience at every event that meets/exceeds the expectations of our internal and external stakeholders. Adhere to company policies, particularly those related to transparency and compliance. Coordinate hotel accommodations and services, transportation, communications and facilities support, program functions and related activities, either directly or indirectly through a third\-party agency. Plan and monitor different types of meetings, identify risks early in the process and set up a risk mitigation plan. Oversee all program logistics, including attendee registration and data management, food and beverage selection, speaker communications, audiovisual needs, and off\-site venues, and on occasion provide hands\-on program management. Ensure budget management, financial reconciliation and post\-meeting reporting to identify synergies and cost\-efficiencies achieved. Serve as the subject\-matter expert for the implementation \& training of technology solutions, and analysis of attendee data. * Experience: Post Graduate degree in any work stream with \>4 years of experience, life sciences degree is preferred

* Technical skills: Proficient with Microsoft Office (i.e., Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Experience of the Veeva Vault CRM Events Management platform, including report generation and event monitoring. Meeting planning and project management experience is an advantage.

**Standing at the forefront of project delivery**
 As the person in charge, you’ll assemble and lead various project teams, and establish effective organisational structure and working procedures for the teams. This role demands efficient project management skills, which you’ll exhibit by identifying the projects’ objectives and allotting sufficient budget, to achieve optimal results and meet the company’s target profits.
   

  

 Likewise, you’ll be in charge of managing and monitoring the different stages of the projects—from their pre\-design phase up to their completion. Furthermore, your proven track record in project management will come in handy, as you’ll be in charge of facilitating negotiations, analyses and meetings with authorities.

 This role asks the question “How can I contribute even more to the company’s growth?” You’ll do this by establishing strong business relationships with our clients. To build lasting connection with our clients, you’ll identify and work around their needs and constraints. You’ll also represent their interests effectively throughout the whole project duration. Additionally, you’ll be in charge of retaining new business contacts and repeat businesses from new investors or landlord clients within an agreed time period.

 Will you act as the face of our business? If so, we’d be happy to take you on board. In this role, you’ll see to it that our company is represented throughout the project. You’ll do this by promoting our business offerings to new prospects, key local landlord clients, business investor networks and industry landlord associations.

* Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their perspective.
* Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
* Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
* Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
* Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
