description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
   

  

 You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in\-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Project Leadership: Spearhead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, expansions, and special projects.
   

  

 Financial Management: Direct multi\-million\-dollar security project lifecycles including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budgeting, change orders, and documentation.
   

  

 Technology Innovation: Apply knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to enhance the AWS physical security program.
   

  

 Strategic Advisory: Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) guidance to leadership for technology and procedural decisions.
   

  

 Operational Excellence: Prioritize tasks effectively and operate seamlessly across organizational boundaries
   

  

 Maintenance Oversight: Execute and coordinate preventative maintenance and repairs for security system equipment
   

  

 Compliance Assurance: Ensure adherence to physical security standards, project scopes, budgets, and timelines
   

  

 Solution Development: Design and implement solutions for system installations, upgrades, repairs, and change management
   

  

 Quality Control: Support security system commissioning, testing, acceptance, and project handoff
   

  

 Knowledge Transfer: Develop and deploy comprehensive training programs for all physical security system users.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Mission: Deliver physical security infrastructure by working vigorously and collaborating with various stakeholders to earn and keep customer trust; providing a safe and secure environment for our people, assets, and customer data.
   

  

 Vision: Develop exceptional security infrastructure delivery professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Unlike broader corporate delivery tracks, this position has direct ownership of enterprise implementations from initiation to completion, serving as the bridge between cutting\-edge AI product performance and enterprise execution.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are seeking an Technical Project Manager to fully own the end\-to\-end execution, delivery processes, and client communication for our CQA product line. In this role, you will step into a key leadership position within the pod, managing all technical communication with incoming enterprise customers, translating their expectations into functional workflows, and driving internal execution.
 



 As the delivery lead, you will have direct ownership of the project lifecycle. You will balance high\-stakes stakeholder management with a deep technical understanding of cloud telecom ecosystems and frontier AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Delivery Ownership \& Team Leadership** 



* Take absolute end\-to\-end ownership of the CQA product delivery process, relieving leadership from daily execution tasks.
* Establish, optimize, and enforce robust project management processes tailored for large, complex enterprise clients.



**2\. Client \& Technical Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the primary, front\-facing technical interface for onboarding enterprise clients.
* Lead client discover sessions to extract, understand, and document technical requirements from a product standpoint.

**3\. Technical Project Execution**

**What We’re Looking For**




**Experience \& Core Competencies** 



* 5 to 8 years of solid project management experience, explicitly within software, SaaS, or deep technical product delivery.
* Proven track record of managing and delivery implementations for large enterprise customers.



**Technical Skillset** 



* AI \& Frontier Tech: Strong familiarity with AI/ML, NLP, conversational AI concepts, and hands\-on exposure to GenAI (prompt engineering, LLM applications).
* Integrations \& Infrastructure: Deep understanding of integration methods for CRMs, APIs, cloud systems, architecture, and deployment methodologies.
* Systems Knowledge: Comfortable understanding what works and what doesn't across Linux, networking, databases, message queues, and caching.



**Soft Skills \& Process Drive** 



* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills—capable of driving technical discussions with enterprise executives and internal engineers alike.
* High level of accountability, organizational rigor, and time management.
* A proactive, customer\-focused approach to problem\-solving and risk mitigation.

 to drive global marketing execution with absolute precision, speed, and total clarity.

You thrive on structure, sweat every minor detail, and hold Directly Responsible Individuals (DRIs) relentlessly accountable across global functions and time zones.
 



 Crucially, you don't just rely on legacy project management habits. You actively leverage AI tools and automation to eliminate friction, optimize workflows, predict bottlenecks, and keep our marketing machine running at full velocity. You own the timelines, the tools, and the operating rhythm, constantly refining them to set a new standard of operational excellence.

 Operational Rigor \& Accountability
 


* **Set the Tempo \& Own DRIs:** 
 Establish a clear, high\-velocity operational rhythm. Track every action item to its owner and hold DRIs accountable for milestones and deliverables across global marketing functions, including Creative, Social, PR, Retail, Influencer, Digital, and Regional teams.
* **Obsessive Precision \& Execution:** 
 Build and maintain comprehensive launch calendars, detailed workback plans, status trackers, and dependency maps to ensure flawless execution.

* **AI\-Powered Operations:** 
 Identify, implement, and scale AI\-powered solutions for automated reporting, meeting summaries, predictive scheduling, task routing, and workflow optimization to improve operational efficiency.
* **Systems \& Process Architecture:** 
 Develop standardized ways of working, reusable frameworks, and comprehensive documentation, including project kickoffs, scope documents, execution playbooks, and post\-launch reviews.
* **Tool Mastery:** 
 Serve as the subject matter expert for project management platforms such as Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, and Gantt tools, while driving adoption and best practices across teams.



 Global Alignment \& Continuous Improvement
 


* **Global\-Local Coordination:** 
 Partner closely with regional teams to ensure launch readiness, local market adaptation, and seamless execution across multiple geographies and time zones.
* **Post\-Mortems \& Optimization:** 
 Lead launch retrospectives, document key learnings, refine operational playbooks, and continuously improve future execution standards.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* **7\+ years** 
 of experience managing large\-scale, cross\-functional marketing projects or complex product launches, preferably within technology, mobile, consumer electronics, or other fast\-paced consumer brands.

 to automate project management activities, streamline documentation, summarize meetings, identify risks, and improve operational efficiency.

* Advanced proficiency with modern project management platforms such as
 **Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Jira** 
 , and workflow automation tools such as
 **Zapier** 
 and
 **Make** 
 .
* Proven experience managing global stakeholders and coordinating projects across multiple regions and time zones.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and effectively in a fast\-paced global environment.

**Company Description**
**About QAD Redzone**
 Redzone helps manufacturers make more stuff for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4\.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected worker.” We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 22% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.
   

  

 With over 1000 customers, 1200 plants and 325,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 with a bold vision to transform manufacturing performance, while bringing dignity back to the frontline worker. Redzone provides the tools that enable the self\-organizing adaptive behavior of the front\-line manufacturing team to win the productivity game, avoiding downtime, or quality losses.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Under the leadership of Coaching Director, the Project Manager is responsible for management and oversight of Redzone’s project implementation.
   

  

 This position is Full Time, Remote and required to travel 40% of the time.

* Facilitate and lead the customer journey for 6\-12 weeks after each new customer is added until we go onsite to coach.

* Ensure signals are connected and tested prior to onsite coaching.

* Support on\-site Continuous Improvement Coaches and customers with configuration, expansion, and automation requests.

* Understand the shop floor environment, workflow, and processes in Food \& Beverage and Consumer Packaged Goods’ for a variety of industries with the necessary depth to foster confidence and to support the client during the project.
* Sound judgement and excellent assessment skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Understand escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could cause a delay or unsatisfactory project result.
* Experience working with project management, ideally in software or systems deployments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing or supporting software projects of different sizes, complexity and contractual types.
* Proven ability to cut through barriers to accomplish tasks.
* Confident with MS Office Suite, Windows operating systems and Apple hardware/operating systems.
* Ability to plan, organize, and function effectively in a dynamic environment, addressing multiple demands of internal teams and clients. Manage multiple deadlines and tasks.
* Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with clients as well as internal teams.
* Ability to self\-manage and prioritize tasks across active projects to meet critical path deadlines.
* Able to work in a high paced, high growth environment.
* Tech friendly \& comfortable communicating technical requirements regarding networking, wireless, and software information.
* Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) experience and familiarity is a plus, but not required


**Education/Experience**
* BA or BS – Relevant fields of study can include and are not limited to: Engineering, Manufacturing, Organizational Leadership/Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Management.
* 4\+ years in a similar position\-providing direct coaching to business clients.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.

Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.

In doing this, Amazon Shipping is deeply studying customer shipping needs and building innovative, market\-leading solutions that will organically attract customers towards our services. To help us succeed in this large endeavor, we are looking for dynamic, self\-starting and entrepreneurial individual who will organize, execute and deliver key features to the Amazon Shipping portfolio.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define, design, launch and manage new products and programs for improving experience and reducing reimbursements within the Amazon Shipping program and thereby enabling scale.
* Gather requirements and conceptualize solutions to solve a business and shipper problems and work with key stake holders across various functions to define and launch the product/program.

Work extensively on industry bench marking, do shipper studies and work with Commercial team to understand the requirements of our prospective Shippers and work on building these capabilities.

 A day in the life
   

  

 This role will require exceptional communication and influencing skills, and will work to influence stakeholders across shippers, Business, Operations, Sales and Tech teams. This role will require the ability to work effectively in a fast paced, startup environment, partnering with others as needed, and the ability to exercise sound judgment solving novel problems without clear direction from leadership. The successful candidate has demonstrated the ability to solve complex logistics challenges and possesses bias for action and deliver results in the role.
   

  

**About The Team**

**Internal Job Description**
 Basic qualifications

description:
**Associate — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 1–4 years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

You will be responsible for programs including technical, financial, and organizational elements.

+ Portfolio Backlog management; PI Requirements Management and Fulfillment; Planning / Estimation, including resource, material, capital, and other needs
+ Scheduling, including resource\-loading and critical path analysis for any assigned projects

+ Reporting / Reviews, and Communications;

* Collaboration … capability to work across and influence multiple groups;
* Facilitate forecasting and capacity analysis related to delivery requirements

* Consistently present programmatic details, requirements, actions, and status to (senior) leadership, technical, and functional audiences

**Qualifications**

 WE VALUE

description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and maintenance of new and existing artifacts focused on analysis of requirements, metrics, and reporting dashboards.
* Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
* Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

 No other single team in Amazon provide exposure to end to end life cycle of e\-commerce: Welcome to World Wide Returns, and Re\-commerce (WWR\&R). We redefines e\-commerce and start where the typical e\-commerce supply chain stops. We innovate to support net\-zero carbon, Amazon climate pledge and works backwards from there. In most cases, our work starts even before customer purchases: in providing information about return policies on detail page/search \& during check\-out. and developing products to support end to end post purchase support needs. We support all post purchase customer needs starting from product usage troubleshooting support to return experience, transportation, reverse\-fulfillment, reverse supply chain and reselling. We provide returns as a service to for WW Amazon business across all channels (Retail, FBA, Merchant Fulfillment) and subsidiaries (Zappos, Woot), Customer Service applications and Amazon physical stores.
   

  

 Amazon Returns policies \& experience are foundational to Amazon’s e\-Commerce and one of the primary reasons why customers love shopping on Amazon. Returns policy communication on the detail page is among the top detail\-page features that increases Customer confidence and the Customer Trust Perception Index (CTPI) for purchase decision. This team has revolutionized the returns for customers through simplest possible experience with no need to print label \& do packaging and quickest refund time. Providing Great Returns Experience is complex due to negative customer sentiments while returning the product. Our team has been very successful in ensuring the lowest return rates and best in class return experience for Amazon as against other E\-commerce competitors.
   

  

 Below are some of the videos explaining the journey and CX of our team :
   

  

* Main Video (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415554\) (6m 40s): Overview of R\&R Business
* Introduction to Seller options (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415558\) (1m 44s): Overview of Seller Return \& Recovery options
* Introduction to LFBF (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/416088\) (1m 46s): Introduction to Label\-Free/Box\-Free returns


 The team is expanding its charter and is going to hire 50\+ employees in 2022 across all tech roles to define returns \& recovery options as a service for its merchant, FBA, bulk and Amazon business customers and to solve hard technical problems related to optimization of reverse supply chain channel. As a member of this team, your mission will be to evolve returns \& re\-commerce systems as highly modular \& customizable multi\-tenet platform to enable growth of e\-commerce business \& volumes and not only reduce cost of reverse supply chain but to even make it profitable business. You will be using wide range of AWS services, Java, object\-oriented design patterns, and latest storage, workflow, orchestration and UI technologies to build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving re\-commerce business requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for software engineers with 3\+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
   

  

 Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns, \& ReCommerce team!
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and evaluating system\-level technical design


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
   

  

 For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering IBMS and security system projects in Mumbai. This role requires a balance of project management discipline and practical execution experience across installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead project execution for IBMS, CCTV, ACS, and related security systems from kickoff through handover.
* Plan project schedules, monitor progress, and ensure milestones are achieved on time.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams to support smooth delivery.
* Oversee installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and final acceptance activities at site.
* Track project quality, safety, documentation, and compliance with agreed specifications and standards.
* Prepare and review project reports, commissioning records, handover documents, and site progress updates.
* Identify project risks and support timely issue resolution to keep execution on track.
* Support customer communication throughout the project lifecycle and ensure a professional handover experience.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* Own your projects with accountability, a strong safety mindset, and attention to detail from planning through handover.
* Stay close to the site work and customer expectations so issues are identified early and resolved quickly.
* Work transparently with customers, vendors, and internal teams to remove obstacles and keep delivery moving.
* Use clear reporting, practical problem\-solving, and regular follow\-up to improve execution every day.
* Build trust through collaboration, dependable communication, and a shared focus on successful outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience in project execution or project management within IBMS, ELV, or security systems.
* Hands\-on experience with CCTV, Access Control Systems (ACS), IBMS, and related security products.
* Experience in installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project handover activities.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and site activities independently.
* Good understanding of project documentation, progress tracking, and site execution practices.
* Strong communication skills and a customer\-focused approach.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with ELV system integration and building automation environments.
* Exposure to larger commercial, industrial, or infrastructure project sites.
* Knowledge of BMS protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.
* Experience in preparing detailed commissioning and handover documentation.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will be part of a team focused on delivering meaningful outcomes for customers through building technology and security solutions. You will work in an environment that values teamwork, practical problem\-solving, and continuous learning while contributing to projects that make spaces safer and more effective.
   

  

 If you have the project execution experience and technical background we are looking for, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and share your resume to explore this opportunity in Mumbai.

**Main Responsibilities**
*The main responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to, the following:*
**RIM Delivery Ownership**
* Lead and coordinate daily RIM execution for the assigned region, ensuring timely and accurate new product creation and product updates/enrichment in PIM.
* Plan and assign daily work, balance workloads, and ensure smooth operational flow across workstreams, including new product setup, enrichment requests, document updates, quality checks, and stakeholder queries.
* Work closely with the Team Lead to manage day\-to\-day operations seamlessly, maintain delivery discipline, and ensure prioritization, continuity, and escalation are handled effectively.
* Ensure consistent adherence to approved work instructions, checklists, approval steps, and escalation pathways to maintain stable and repeatable delivery.


**Data Quality, Documentation \& Compliance Controls**
* Maintain high data integrity across product records, ensuring completeness, traceability, and audit readiness in PIM and connected systems.
* Ensure product records are enriched with current regulatory and technical documentation (e.g., regulatory, compliance statements, specifications, technical data sheets, declarations/attestations as applicable) with disciplined version control.
* Enforce quality review controls (peer review/sampling checks/validation steps), drive correction of deviations, and strengthen “first‑time‑right” outcomes.


**Regulatory Change Adoption \& Process Control**
* Ensure process steps are applied in line with relevant regulatory expectations, including GHS, CLP, transport regulations, and applicable regional requirements across EMEA, APAC, and AMER.
* Aligning with PSRA Specialists to confirm regulatory and compliance checks are correctly reflected in RIM/PIM workflows, product records, and supporting documentation.
* Drive adoption of regulatory and process changes impacting product records, ensuring updates are implemented in systems, work steps, checklists, and supporting documentation.


**Request Management, Backlog Control \& Stakeholder Support**
* Manage request intake and assignment discipline, ensuring clear ownership, prioritization, and timely progression against agreed turnaround expectations.
* Monitor backlog health and proactively address bottlenecks, ageing items, and priority requests; escalate risks early with clear context and recommended actions.
* Resolve stakeholder queries within scope and ensure structured handling of ad‑hoc requests through clear prioritization and escalation.


**Performance Management, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**
* Track throughput, backlog, SLA/TAT, and quality trends; provide concise reporting and insights to the Team Lead/Manager with actions and closure tracking.
* Support end‑to‑end delivery for integration/regulatory projects (planning \+ execution), including defining weekly targets, removing bottlenecks, and managing risks and scope changes.
* Drive continuous improvement across RIM execution (cycle time, standardization, rework reduction, data quality uplift) and support system improvements in coordination with digital projects teams.

**Job Summary**

 Apply WFM knowledge and skills across HC planning, Scheduling and Real Time management.

title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high\-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.*
**How You Will Impact Skylo**
 You will own end\-to\-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the
 **packet core** 
 , the
 **signalling plane** 
 , and
 **billing \& settlement** 
 . You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on\-time technical delivery.
   

  

 This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch\-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the MNO technical onboarding program end\-to\-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
* Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP\-over\-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS\-over\-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
* Coordinate billing \& settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
* Program\-manage the multi\-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel\-run and rollback planning, and de\-risking the transition away from single\-supplier dependency.
* Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross\-functional launch\-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
* Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing\-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
* Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.


**Sound like you? You bring:**
 You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi\-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.
   

  

* 8\+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands\-on time in the signalling plane
* Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
+ NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
+ DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy \& topology
+ A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).

* NB\-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control\-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel\-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
* Hands\-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per\-partner signalling readiness.
* Working understanding of billing \& settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57\), RAP (TD.32\), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
* Demonstrated track record shipping cross\-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.

Principal Technical Program Manager, Prime Video Commerce Tech
description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees \- every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal \- is a set of world\-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.
   

  

 We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to \- what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture \- evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade\-off decisions, unblocking cross\-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi\-org programs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility \- international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross\-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade\-offs.
   

  

 Cross\-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi\-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.
   

  

 Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi\-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.
   

  

 Operational Cadence \& Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.
   

  

 Capacity \& Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade\-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Efficiency \& Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi\-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.
   

  

 Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no\-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re\-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade\-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru \- engineers and program managers across all levels who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We operate as a worldwide team with genuine empathy across time zones. Inclusivity is how we work \- we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

title: Sr R&D Project Manager
description:
**Work Schedule**
 First Shift (Days)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

**Department**
 The Project Management team is part of the Global Life Sciences Portfolio team within the Research \& Development organization. Our mission is to develop innovative technologies, modules, and software solutions that help deliver world\-class products for demanding global markets and customers.
   

  

 As technology and industry expectations continue to evolve, the performance requirements for our systems, subsystems, and software platforms are constantly increasing. In close collaboration with Advanced Technology Development teams, global R\&D groups, and selected external partners, our Life Sciences organization converts the most promising technological concepts into reliable products that enable our customers to make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer.
   

  

**Team**
 As Senior Project Manager / Senior Product Owner, you will be a key individual contributor responsible for driving software delivery and strengthening project execution capability across Life Sciences product development.
   

  

 This role is especially important in building and scaling software delivery competence in India. You will work closely with global teams in Brno, Czech Republic, Eindhoven, the Netherlands, and other international R\&D locations to ensure strong alignment, predictable execution, and effective collaboration across sites.
   

  

 You will operate in a scaled software delivery environment where multiple teams, product areas, and sometimes multiple Agile Release Trains contribute to the overall delivery of complex Life Sciences solutions. Success in this role requires strong coordination skills, clear understanding of dependencies, and the ability to connect team\-level execution with program, portfolio, and product milestones.
   

  

 You will act as a senior delivery lead and trusted partner to global R\&D stakeholders, helping define and embed consistent ways of working for software development, project management, and product ownership across local, offshore, and global teams.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
* As Senior Project Manager / Senior Product Owner, you will be responsible for:
* Driving end\-to\-end delivery of software and module development projects across Life Sciences products, from requirements and planning through execution, validation, release, and sustaining.
* Acting as the responsible delivery lead for software workstreams, ensuring scope clarity, planning discipline, stakeholder alignment, risk management, dependency management, and high\-quality execution.
* Demonstrating strong agency by proactively identifying delivery paths, clarifying ambiguity, removing blockers, and creating practical options when teams face uncertainty, constraints, or cross\-functional complexity.
* Managing dependencies across teams, functions, sites, suppliers, and, where applicable, Agile Release Trains to ensure that integrated delivery plans remain realistic, visible, and actively governed.
* Contributing to the build\-up of software delivery competence in India by helping define delivery practices, project governance, tools, templates, and collaboration models.
* Aligning offshore delivery teams with global R\&D teams to ensure clear ownership, effective communication, predictable delivery, and strong integration with overall product development plans.
* Serving as a senior Project Manager or Product Owner for complex, multidisciplinary development initiatives involving software, systems, electronics, mechanical, and hardware engineering teams.
* Translating business, customer, and product needs into clear priorities, delivery plans, backlog structures, milestones, and execution roadmaps.
* Facilitating planning, prioritization, review, and decision\-making forums with engineering teams, architects, product managers, project leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Monitoring delivery progress, identifying risks and impediments, and driving timely resolution in collaboration with project teams and leadership.
* Supporting effort estimation, capacity planning, dependency tracking, and resource alignment for assigned projects or software workstreams.
* Using AI\-enabled ways of working to improve delivery quality, speed, and clarity, for example in planning analysis, dependency mapping, risk identification, meeting preparation, backlog refinement, documentation, stakeholder communication, and decision support.
* Promoting consistent ways of working across projects, including Agile, Scrum, SAFe, hybrid project delivery, or other structured development methodologies.
* Coaching and mentoring project team members, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and engineering stakeholders on effective delivery practices, without direct people management responsibility.
* Contributing to continuous improvement of project execution, product ownership, software delivery maturity, AI\-enabled productivity, and cross\-site collaboration.
* Building strong working relationships with global R\&D leaders, portfolio teams, business unit stakeholders, suppliers, and peer teams.
* Connecting with internal knowledge centers, universities, technology partners, industrial collaborators, and AI\-enabled delivery communities to explore and apply state\-of\-the\-art approaches in software, hardware, system development, and project execution.


**Qualifications**
* We are looking for candidates with strong conceptual thinking, execution focus, and the ability to lead through influence in a multidisciplinary, highly technical global environment. The ideal candidate enjoys driving complex software and product development, building alignment across teams, and enabling high\-quality delivery without relying on formal authority.
* Required qualifications:
* A university degree, preferably MSc, MTech, PhD, or equivalent, in Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of Proven experience in project management, product ownership, software delivery, technical program management, or complex product development.
* Experience contributing to at least two to three full product or software development cycles, from requirements and design through implementation, validation, release, and sustaining.
* Strong understanding of software development ways of working, including Agile, Scrum, hybrid project delivery, or comparable methodologies.
* Experience working in, or strong ability to operate within, scaled software delivery environments where multiple teams or trains contribute to one integrated product, platform, or release.
* Ability to coordinate and influence multidisciplinary teams across software, systems, mechanical, electrical, and hardware engineering.
* Experience working with offshore, distributed, or global engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders, global teams, customers, suppliers, and technical experts.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, influencing, coaching, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to operate in a global matrix organization and build trusted relationships across cultures, locations, and functions.
* Practical AI literacy and a demonstrated ability to use AI tools responsibly to improve personal effectiveness, delivery quality, analysis, communication, and team productivity.


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Experience in highly complex technology industries such as life sciences, semiconductor equipment, medical devices, analytical instruments, industrial automation, aerospace, automotive, or advanced manufacturing.
* Experience with SAFe or another scaled agile methodology is highly beneficial, especially in environments with multiple teams, complex dependencies, shared milestones, and integrated release planning.
* Knowledge of Design for Six Sigma, first\-time\-right development, quality\-by\-design, or other structured development and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience supporting the setup or scaling of software delivery capability in an offshore or global capability center environment.
* Experience using AI coworking, code\-assist, knowledge\-management, or automation tools beyond basic chat\-based prompting, with clear use cases relevant to project management, product ownership, or scaled software delivery.
* Knowledge of Electron Microscopy or other advanced scientific instrumentation is an advantage, but not mandatory.


**Personal Attributes**
* You are a senior, hands\-on delivery professional who leads through expertise, ownership, collaboration, and influence. You are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving execution in a complex global R\&D environment.
* You show strong agency: you do not wait passively for perfect inputs, but proactively find the next useful step, clarify options, connect the right people, and help teams move forward with discipline and transparency.
* You combine strategic thinking with practical delivery discipline and are motivated by building strong ways of working that help teams succeed.
* You have a modern AI mindset. You understand AI as a practical coworker for improving thinking, execution, and communication, not only as a chat tool. You can identify meaningful AI use cases, apply AI responsibly, validate outputs, protect sensitive information, and use AI to increase the quality and efficiency of project management, product ownership, and scaled delivery.
* We value colleagues who demonstrate integrity, intensity, innovation, and involvement. Diversity in our teams is essential to creating an effective, inclusive, and challenging working environment where people can grow and deliver their best work.


**Why Join Us**
 This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in building and shaping software delivery competence in India while working closely with talented global teams. You will contribute to advanced Life Sciences technologies and help deliver solutions that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer.

title: Senior Project Management Analyst
description:
**About us**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**Overview about Target In India**  

  

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**Pyramid Overview**


Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the design, products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights, and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our guests, guest segments and behaviors, business objectives, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Our commitment to partnering both internally and with external agencies gives us a wide range of capabilities, from award\-winning creative work to exciting and unique promotional marketing. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.


Target in India Marketing delivers differentiating yet relevant marketing communication solutions across channels operating as an integrated ONE global team and it strives to bring excellence every time in how they create, connect and collaborate.


A role with **Target in India Marketing** is an opportunity to work with some of the best in the business for marketing, creative, strategy \& digital and you’d lead/contribute to work that connects to millions of guests. Your influence will drive sales and grow brand love through work that’s guest\-centric, on brand, category relevant and channel focused.

**Target Creative’s Brand Design Lab** is the in\-house creative/design team dedicated to bringing some of the world’s most beloved and recognizable owned brands to life. Our mission is to inspire a sense of joy, wonder and excitement, and to take our guests—and ourselves—somewhere new. Some of the brands we have built are Good \& Gather, Favorite Day, Ever Spring, Hearth \& Hand, Cat \& Jack, Goodfellow \& Co. Operating as one fully integrated team in both the U.S. and India, the team comprises the best and brightest talent to execute market\-leading creative strategy, packaging design \& brand building.


As a Sr. Project Management Analyst, Marketing, Brand Design Lab you will operate at the intersection of your creative team and the business. At the core you are expected to lead projects at category level or deliver to business objectives working alongside with your team.


You will be helping further Target’s strategies in playing a key role with great execution. You will be performing your role with minimal direction. You are expected to have a very good understanding of your functional area and design “how” creative work is accomplished by planning, organizing, managing and executing project plans/processes in addition to serving as the single point of contact \& relationship manager for cross\-functional teams (CFT).


As a Sr. Project Management Analyst, Marketing, Brand Design Lab you will:

* Project manage packaging design projects throughout the creative strategy\- execution lifecycle. Act as the single\-point\-of\-contact between Target HQ partners, Creative team \& Target in India CFT teams (*copywriters, photographers, illustrators, art directors, production designers and creative managers)* and lead projects through the entire concept \& activation phase
* Having a developed sense of design, a strong understanding of Brand Building, Packaging Design, and Design systems. Being meticulous and have an excellent eye for detail and brand consistency. Understanding /awareness of the global culture. Keeps abreast of current design trends
* Excellent ability to communicate design thinking and effective presentation skills. Communicate design strategy to various audiences in a strategic manner
* Lead creative project management process optimization, documentation of processes, standards, and guidelines. Organize and plan details for multiple projects and make timely and quick decisions to meet project deadlines
* Create and maintain appropriate documentation, prepare and share status reports / dashboards to appropriate stakeholders at set intervals
* The ability to see projects through from inception to production. Having strong printing and prepress knowledge
* Plan and conduct design research
* Lead /assist with special projects which could either be self\-identified or assigned

**About you:**

* Graduate in any discipline (preferably Brand Management) or equivalent
* 10\+ years total experience in Design or Advertising Agencies with 5\+ years as Design Manager, Creative Project Manager / Account Manager / Client Servicing in the Packaging / Design agency with ability to manage and execute multiple projects
* Ability to manage and execute multiple projects at the same time
* Exceptional communication skills across all settings, ability to tailor message as appropriate
* Resourceful and able to work independently on filling in gaps of information
* Able to demonstrate flexibility in approach and adapt to changing priorities and requirements
* Has curiosity and drive for seeking and promoting new ideas, in combination with solid business judgment

description:
Avance Clinical is a Contract Research Organisation which offers specialised services supporting drug development for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry.
   

  

 The Project Manager \- EPMO will be responsible for managing the planning and execution of internal projects assigned within Avance Clinical's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Operating within the EPMO's tiered governance model, the Project Manager will be allocated projects from Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build), or Tier 3 (Transform) relative to their experience, certifications and demonstrated delivery capability — scaling responsibility as they grow within the function. The role applies established project management principles to ensure consistent, disciplined delivery across the portfolio, and contributes to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework to help measure and report the return on investment of internal initiatives.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Lead allocated EPMO projects — Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build) or Tier 3 (Transform) — based on experience and demonstrated capability. This includes development and execution of scope, schedule, budget, resource, risk, change, communications and stakeholder management plans, applied proportionate to project tier and complexity.
* Apply consistent project management principles across all allocated projects, working within the EPMO's flexible delivery framework and adhering to its intake, scoring, governance, reporting and closeout standards.
* For Tier 2 initiatives, partner with the nominated business sponsor to develop and refine concise business cases, ensuring scope, rationale, cost, effort and expected return on investment are clearly articulated and aligned with EPMO scoring criteria.
* For Tier 3 initiatives, deliver under the strategic oversight of the EPMO Director, ensuring full governance is observed and that the named ELT sponsor is appropriately engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework — capturing baseline measures at planning, tracking realised benefits through delivery, and providing inputs to the EPMO's ROI and outcomes reporting back to ELT.
* Maintain accurate, current project records in the EPMO portfolio dashboard, including status, resourcing, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes and benefits\-tracking data.
* Facilitate the requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, training and change management activities required for successful project delivery, working collaboratively with subject matter experts and vendors.
* Identify and escalate emerging risks, scope changes or threshold breaches (effort, cost, dependency) that may trigger tier escalation, in line with the EPMO operating model.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.
* Manage external vendors associated with project deliverables, ensuring scope, schedule and contractual obligations are met.
* Provide regular project status updates and portfolio inputs to the EPMO Director, and contribute to monthly ELT portfolio reporting packs.
* Support continuous improvement of the EPMO's tools, templates, processes and benefits\-tracking methods through feedback, adoption discipline and lessons learned.
* Other duties as directed by Line Management or delegate in line with skills, experience and/or qualifications. Qualifications, Skills and Experience
+ Ordinary degree or equivalent in an appropriate discipline and appropriate industry experience.
+ Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Computer Science or other relevant discipline, and/or recognised project management certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum). Higher tier projects will typically require more advanced qualifications and demonstrated delivery track record.
+ Demonstrated project management experience scaled to the tier of project to be managed:
+ Tier 1 (Explore): early\-career project management experience or relevant transferable experience supporting small, single\-team initiatives.
+ Tier 2 (Build): a minimum of 3 years managing cross\-functional internal projects with named sponsors and defined business cases.
+ Tier 3 (Transform): a minimum of 5 years managing strategic, multi\-stream or transformation projects with executive\-level reporting and accountability for benefits delivery.
+ Experience contributing to benefits realisation, ROI measurement or outcomes reporting frameworks is highly desirable.
+ Experience managing technology, systems integration, ERP, CRM or business process transformation projects will be highly regarded given Avance's current strategic roadmap.
+ Strong working knowledge of established project management methodologies (waterfall, agile and hybrid) and the judgment to apply them proportionate to project size and complexity.

description:
**Company Description** 




 A subsidiary of Messe Frankfurt Exhibition GmbH, Messe Frankfurt Trade Fairs India Pvt Ltd is a leading organizer in the exhibition and conference industry with over 25 years of experience in India. With offices in Mumbai and Delhi, the company serves the B2B markets of the Indian sub\-continent with a dedicated workforce of over 100 professionals. Known for its expertise in trade\-fair marketing, it promotes Indian brands globally through outbound trade shows in various verticals such as automotive, textiles, lighting, technology, entertainment, media, consumer goods, and environment technology.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time on\-site role located at Jasola, New Delhi for a Conference Producer.
 



 The Conference Producer is responsible for the development of timely and relevant conferences in the marketplace. This will mainly encompass industry research, content (programme) development, speaker acquisition, managing sales team, managing conference budget and event execution. 
 



  





**Job Descriptions:** 



* Research and analyze the feasibility of developing potential conference topics into commercially viable events. In case of flagship Conference brands with several past editions already held – having a thorough market intelligence and updated awareness of the key developments in the concerned industry sector, pertinent to the business, ability to research, consult advisors (industry experts) and draft a conference agenda validated by external advisors (industry experts) and/or “Knowledge Partner”, such that the event would garner maximum delegate registrations and sponsor participation.
* Communicate over phone and email with key industry figures to determine the validity of proposed topic, sub\-themes, timing and location
* Prepare the conference programme (agenda), invite and confirm speakers without incurring any cost (travel, accommodation etc.); liaise with speakers to ensure attendance, organize or assist in the organizing of the event, as the case may be and to attend to all matters relating to and/or ancillary to the successful conducting of the event
* Co\-ordinate with the operations department to finalise the venue of the conference followed by other operational requirement of the conference
* To liaise with marketing department to organize event marketing, promotion, publicity, sales and related campaigns. Provide relevant content for the event collaterals, event website and on\- going marketing activities
* Supervise direct sales for attendance of delegates \& for potential sponsors
* Hold regular weekly meetings with the conference sales team consisting of delegate and sponsorship sales team members to review weekly target achievement progress, and set the target for the next week’s sales revenue
* Manage pre\-conference, on\-site \& post conference tasks
* Communicate key conference information to the team members, Immediate Reporting/Line manager and Head of the Division
* Manage conference budget, financial and cash for the conference

* Excellent communication skills in English – both verbal and written
