title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job Title Senior Project Manager Job Description Summary We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side.
 
The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead, providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction.
 
The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets.
 
The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements.
 
The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client. Job Description 1. Position Overview We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side. The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead , providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction . The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets. The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements . The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . 2. Primary Role Client Representative The PMC Project Manager shall function as the single-point project delivery lead for the PMC , representing the Client''s interests at site. Key responsibilities include: Provide overall leadership to the PMC project team. Act as the primary interface between the Client, PMC, consultants and contractors. Establish project management and governance systems. Ensure that project objectives are clearly communicated to all stakeholders. Monitor and control contractor performance against contractual obligations. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Provide independent advice to the Client on project progress, risks, costs, delays and contractual matters. Ensure that all major project decisions are supported by appropriate technical, commercial and schedule analysis. Maintain complete transparency in reporting project status to the Client. Ensure that the Client''s interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle. 3. Project Planning & Schedule Management The Project Manager shall provide overall leadership for project planning and programme control. Responsibilities include: Review and approve the overall Project Master Programme prepared by the Planning team. Review contractor baseline programmes and detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules. Ensure alignment between design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning schedules. Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline. Identify critical path and near-critical activities. Monitor achievement of contractual and project milestones. Review contractor look-ahead programmes and recovery schedules. Challenge unrealistic contractor programmes and claimed progress. Review the impact of design changes, approvals, procurement and site constraints on the programme. Ensure timely implementation of recovery and mitigation measures. Review and advise the Client on potential Extension of Time claims. Coordinate delay analysis and schedule impact assessments. Ensure that project completion forecasts are realistic and evidence-based. 4. Construction Management Provide overall supervision and management of construction activities through the PMC team. Ensure that contractors execute works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements and contracts. Monitor construction methodology and sequencing. Ensure adequate deployment of manpower, plant, equipment and materials. Monitor productivity and identify underperformance. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, faade, interiors, landscape and external development works. Manage interfaces between various contractors and packages. Identify construction constraints and coordinate timely resolution. Ensure that site activities are properly coordinated to avoid rework and disruption. Monitor construction quality and progress through regular site inspections and reviews. Ensure timely escalation of critical issues to the Client. 5. Contractor Management A key responsibility of the PMC Project Manager will be to manage and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . The candidate shall: Review contractor mobilisation and resource deployment. Monitor manpower, plant, equipment and material availability. Assess contractor productivity and performance. Conduct regular contractor performance reviews. Establish clear performance expectations and corrective actions. Issue/coordinate appropriate contractual communications through the PMC. Challenge contractor delays, inadequate resources and poor productivity. Review contractor recovery plans. Monitor compliance with contractual milestones. Recommend appropriate contractual remedies in case of persistent underperformance. Ensure that contractor commitments made during progress meetings are tracked and closed. Maintain proper records of contractor performance, delays and non-compliances. 6. Contract Administration & Claims Management The Project Manager shall provide strong oversight of contract administration and claims. Responsibilities include: Review construction contracts and understand key commercial and contractual obligations. Ensure that PMC teams monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements. Review contractor notices, claims, variations and EOT submissions. Coordinate with the QS/Commercial Manager for evaluation of variations and claims. Ensure timely assessment of additional cost and time implications. Review contractual entitlement and supporting documentation. Ensure proper recording of delay events and Client/contractor responsibilities. Coordinate preparation of recommendations to the Client. Protect the Client from unjustified claims and cost escalation. Ensure that contractual correspondence is properly documented. Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution. Working knowledge of FIDIC, EPC, Design & Build and Item Rate contracts is preferred. 7. Cost Management The PMC Project Manager shall provide overall oversight of project cost control. Responsibilities include: Monitor project cost against the approved budget. Review cost reports prepared by the commercial/QS team. Monitor committed, certified, actual and forecast expenditure. Review variations and change orders. Assess cost impact of design changes and Client instructions. Monitor potential cost overruns. Review contractor claims and commercial submissions. Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for variations. Monitor project contingency and risk allowances. Provide the Client with an independent assessment of the forecast final cost. Ensure cost and programme implications are considered before recommending major changes. 8. Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and specialist consultants. Monitor design deliverables against the construction programme. Ensure timely release of Good for Construction drawings. Identify design gaps and interface issues. Ensure timely closure of RFIs and technical queries. Coordinate design reviews and constructability reviews. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and programme. Coordinate BIM/clash detection processes where applicable. Ensure that construction does not proceed based on incomplete or unapproved information. Maintain a design deliverables and approval tracker. 9. Procurement Management Review and monitor the project procurement strategy. Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with the master programme. Monitor long-lead items and critical equipment. Review vendor approval and material submittal processes. Monitor procurement risks and potential delays. Ensure timely release of purchase orders and subcontract packages. Coordinate procurement with design and construction requirements. Escalate procurement issues that could affect project milestones. Monitor delivery of critical materials and equipment to site. 10. Quality Management The PMC Project Manager shall ensure that the Client''s quality objectives are achieved. Responsibilities include: Implement and monitor the Project Quality Management Plan. Review contractor quality plans and inspection procedures. Monitor compliance with project specifications and approved materials. Ensure inspection and testing procedures are followed. Review quality audits and inspection reports. Monitor NCRs, observations and corrective actions. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. Ensure appropriate mock-ups and benchmark samples are approved. Monitor workmanship and finishing standards. Ensure quality documentation is complete for project handover. 11. Health, Safety & Environment Provide leadership to ensure a strong project safety culture. Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements. Review contractor HSE plans and performance. Ensure regular safety audits and inspections. Monitor high-risk construction activities. Ensure timely closure of safety observations. Escalate serious safety violations to the Client. Promote a zero-incident / zero-tolerance approach to unsafe practices . Ensure environmental and statutory requirements are complied with. 12. Risk Management The Project Manager shall lead the PMC''s project risk-management process. Responsibilities include: Establish and maintain the Project Risk Register. Identify risks related to: Programme Cost Design Procurement Contractor performance Quality Safety Statutory approvals Contracts and claims Stakeholder interfaces Assess probability and potential impact. Develop mitigation and contingency measures. Monitor implementation of risk mitigation actions. Escalate high-impact risks to the Client. Ensure emerging risks are identified before they become project issues. 13. Project Controls & MIS Ensure that the PMC project controls system provides the Client with an accurate and timely view of project performance. The Project Manager shall review: Master schedule Monthly progress S-curves Critical path Milestone tracking Contractor performance Cost reports Variation/change register Procurement tracker Design tracker Material approval tracker Risk register Issue register NCR/quality tracker HSE performance Manpower and productivity Claims/EOT register Forecast completion dates Forecast final cost The candidate should be capable of interpreting project data and converting it into actionable recommendations , rather than merely reviewing reports. 14. Client Reporting & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary PMC interface with the Client. Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings. Prepare management-level project reports. Present project status, key risks, delays and commercial issues to senior Client management. Provide clear recommendations and alternative solutions. Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions. Manage expectations of Client, consultants and contractors. Maintain transparent and professional communication with all stakeholders. Ensure that decisions and commitments are properly recorded and followed through. 15. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Develop and monitor the overall testing and commissioning strategy. Coordinate commissioning of MEP and specialist systems. Monitor statutory inspections and approvals. Coordinate snagging and de-snagging activities. Monitor completion of all works against the approved scope. Ensure as-built drawings and O&M manuals are completed. Ensure warranties, test certificates and statutory documentation are compiled. Coordinate final handover to the Client. Ensure smooth transition from construction to operations. 16. PMC Team Leadership The Project Manager will lead and coordinate the PMC team, which may include: Planning Engineer Civil/Structural Engineers Architectural/Finishes Engineers MEP Engineers QA/QC Engineers Safety Engineers QS/Commercial Manager Contracts/Claims personnel Procurement specialists Document Controllers Other specialist consultants Responsibilities include: Define roles and responsibilities. Establish reporting structures. Monitor individual and team performance. Ensure adequate staffing against project requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities. Ensure timely reporting and escalation. Build a strong, collaborative PMC team culture. 17. Authority & Decision-Making The candidate should have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved at project level and those requiring Client approval. The Project Manager shall: Provide technical and commercial recommendations to the Client. Recommend acceptance/rejection of contractor submissions. Recommend corrective measures for contractor underperformance. Recommend recovery strategies. Recommend variations and change orders based on technical/commercial evaluation. Recommend contractual action where justified. Escalate matters requiring Client approval with clear options and implications. The role is primarily one of independent review, management and recommendation on behalf of the Client, rather than routine contractor supervision. 18. Educational Qualification Mandatory B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution. Preferred M.Tech / MBA / Post Graduate qualification in Construction or Project Management. PMP / PMI / RICS or equivalent professional certification is an advantage. 19. Experience Requirements 15+ years of total experience in construction/project management. Minimum 810 years in Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Construction Manager / PMC leadership roles preferred. Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale building projects. Strong Client/PMC-side experience preferred. Experience managing multiple contractors and consultants. Experience in large and complex projects with significant civil, architectural, MEP and specialist interfaces. Preferred Project Experience Experience in one or more of the following: High-rise residential developments Commercial developments Super-speciality hospitals Hotels and hospitality Mixed-use developments Institutional projects Large corporate campuses 20. Technical & Professional Competencies Strong working knowledge of: Construction Management Project Management Primavera P6 / MS Project Project Controls Contract Administration FIDIC / EPC / Design & Build / Item Rate Contracts Cost Management Quantity Surveying fundamentals Variations & Change Management Claims & EOT Delay Analysis Quality Management HSE Management Procurement Management Risk Management Design Management MEP Coordination Testing & Commissioning Advanced MS Excel and MS Office BIM coordination awareness Project dashboards/MIS 21. Leadership & Behavioural Competencies The candidate should demonstrate: Strong leadership and people-management skills. Excellent Client and stakeholder-management capability. Strong technical understanding of building construction. Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Ability to challenge contractors objectively and professionally. Excellent negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Ability to make decisions under pressure. Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong presentation skills. High degree of ownership and accountability. Ability to manage multiple priorities and interfaces. Proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation. 22. Timely closure of safety observations. Client Satisfaction Quality and transparency of reporting. Timely resolution of issues. Quality of recommendations. Effective stakeholder coordination. 23. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a senior construction professional with strong PMC/Client-side experience , capable of independently managing the delivery of a major project and providing objective advice to the Client. He/she should be able to move beyond routine supervision and provide strategic project leadership , with a strong understanding of: Programme + Cost + Quality + Safety + Contracts + Claims + Procurement + Design + Construction The candidate should be comfortable challenging major contractors such as L&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons or equivalent , while maintaining a professional and collaborative relationship.  Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking a detail\-oriented MDM QA Engineer with hands\-on experience in Reltio Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Quality Testing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating master data solutions, data quality frameworks, integration workflows, match \& merge configurations, survivorship rules, APIs, and end\-to\-end business processes. This role requires strong analytical skills, expertise in data validation, and experience working within Agile delivery environments.

* **Role: MDM Project Manager**
* **Location: Pune, Bangalore**
* **Experience: 11 to 15 years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Reltio MDM implementation and enhancement projects.
* Define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
* Develop and manage project plans, schedules, resource allocation, and budgets.
* Ensure timely delivery of project milestones while maintaining quality standards.
* Drive project governance, risk management, and escalation management processes.
* Aas the primary point of contact for customers, business stakeholders, and executive leadership.
* Conduct steering committee meetings, project status reviews, and governance forums.
* Stakeholder expectations and facilitate decision\-making.
* Build strong relationships with business, technical, and vendor teams.
* Oversee implementation of Reltio MDM solutions including entity modelling, match \& merge rules, survivorship rules, data stewardship workflows, data governance processes, and reference data management.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solutions.
* Support master data governance and data quality initiatives.
* Lead cross\-functional teams comprising Business Analysts, Reltio Developers, Data Engineers, Integration Engineers, QA Engineers, and Data Stewards.
* Manage resource planning, onboarding, performance tracking, and utilization.
* Mentor project teams and drive delivery excellence.
* Establish project governance frameworks and reporting mechanisms.
* Monitor project KPIs, quality metrics, risks, and dependencies.
* Ensure adherence to SDLC, Agile, and organizational delivery processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across delivery teams.
* Manage large\-scale data migration programs into Reltio.
* Coordinate source system onboarding, data mapping, and validation activities.
* Oversee integration efforts involving APIs, ETL tools, cloud platforms, and downstream systems.
* Ensure successful deployment and production stabilization.
* Identify project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, invoicing, and financial tracking.
* Ensure adherence to contractual obligations and delivery commitments.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8\+ years of overall IT experience with 5\+ years of project management experience delivering enterprise MDM and Reltio implementation programs.
* Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), Data Governance, Data Quality Management, Data Stewardship, Customer 360 / Product 360 concepts, Data Migration, and Enterprise Data Integration.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale Reltio implementations.
* Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.
* Understanding of Reltio MDM Platform, Reltio Integration Hub (RIH), APIs and Integration Architecture.
* Knowledge of ETL/Data Warehouse concepts, SQL, and data analysis concepts.
* Experience with Cloud Platforms such as Azure and AWS.
* Exposure to Snowflake, Databricks, or modern data platforms.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Power BI, and MS Office Suite.
* Domain experience in Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical MDM Programs, Customer Master Data, Product Master Data, Vendor/Supplier Master Data, Retail \& Consumer Goods, or Banking \& Financial Services.
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, Reltio Fundamentals/Technical Consultant Certification, or DAMA Data Management Certification preferred.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, risk management, delivery governance, and team management skills.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

description:
Job Description: Technical Program Manager (Hackathons \& Innovation Challenges)
 



 Position: Program Manager
 



 Location: Noida, UP, India (On\-site)
 



 Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**The role** 




 You are the single point of ownership for every program you run — end to end, from pre\-launch kickoff to the final debrief. Not the coordinator of it: the owner. Scope, the client relationship, and the final call all sit with you.
 



 What makes this role different from a conventional program management role is where the ownership comes from.
 



 You will be the trusted partner for our clients and the central hub for all internal teams, ensuring that every hackathon is delivered flawlessly, on time, and within budget. This role is for a natural leader who thrives on structure, excels at communication, and has a passion for turning ambitious ideas into reality.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Technical program design. Problem statements, evaluation criteria, judging rubrics, and tech\-stack fit. You decide what a good submission looks like and defend that standard to clients and juries.
* End\-to\-end program ownership. Multiple concurrent programs from post\-sales handover through delivery and debrief. Scope, objectives, timelines, and resourcing are yours to define.
* The client relationship, post\-sales. Primary point of contact once sales hands over. You set expectations, manage change, and are the voice on technical scope and feasibility — including on what isn’t deliverable.
* Strategic program architecture. You build the blueprint. Defining objectives, resource allocation, and timelines is your domain. You ensure every component is technically sound and logistically viable before a single line of code is written.
* Internal cross\-functional bridge. You lead the charge across Marketing, Operations, and SME teams. You are the glue that keeps diverse internal stakeholders aligned and focused on delivering a cohesive product.
* Risk and quality gatekeeping. Spotting friction before it happens. You own the mitigation strategies and maintain a relentless standard for the participant experience and final deliverables.
* Scope and fiscal discipline. You hold the line on the budget and the agreed\-upon roadmap. Using rigorous verification, you ensure we deliver exactly what was promised without slippage.
* External partner synchronization. Managing the ecosystem. You direct third\-party vendors and partners to ensure their contributions integrate seamlessly into the live event execution.
* Documentation and executive reporting. Maintaining the narrative of progress. You provide clear, direct visibility on milestones and technical hurdles to both clients and our leadership team.
* Jury and participant experience. Recruiting and briefing evaluators, running the judging process with rigour, and making sure the experience holds up for developers and students who chose to spend a weekend on it.



  





**What you'll need** 



* Deep technical fluency. You can hold an architecture\-level conversation with a client, a jury, or a partner without escalating it. You can read a submission and judge whether it actually works. Hands\-on coding is not required — credible technical judgement is non\-negotiable.
* Experience. 4–7 years in program or project management in a technical environment — technical program management, developer relations, solutions or pre\-sales engineering, or an engineer who moved into program work. Enterprise clients somewhere in that history.
* Domain expertise. Working knowledge of the domains we run challenges in — AI/ML, cloud, and data at minimum. Enough to tell an ambitious problem statement from an unworkable one.
* Enterprise client\-facing strength. Polished, direct, and comfortable holding a line on scope with a senior stakeholder who wants more than was agreed.
* Organisational discipline. Several programs running at once, each with its own client, timeline, and jury. Detail matters and slippage is visible.
* Developer and student community instinct. You understand what makes a hackathon worth entering, and what makes participants disengage.

description:
**Job Description**
 WSP India is seeking to onboard dynamic and versatile Project management Expert with comprehensive experience across Document Control, Project Control, Scheduling, and Procurement to support our growing portfolio of complex engineering projects in Earth and Environment team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Document Control:**
* Oversee creation, organization, and maintenance of project documentation; ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with WSP’s internal audit and quality assurance procedures.
* Work closely with departments, regional leads, and subject matter experts to gather information, manage document workflows, and ensure timely delivery and distribution of project documents.
* Create, edit, and review technical documents, manuals, reports, and drawings; maintain registers and schedules for incoming/ outgoing information.
* Manage physical and digital document storage systems; upload documents to EDMS; monitor and improve documentation workflows and processes.
* Conduct regular audits, check document quality, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards and project procedures.
* Be in continuous touch with the PM to be on top of any internal or external documentation.


**Project Cost Control:**
* Ensure alignment with client expectations and deadlines while coordinating with billing, finance, and project teams to manage accounts receivable, timesheets, expenses, and invoice\-related queries.
* Prepare billing drafts, compile and verify monthly invoices, and ensure accurate manual data entry and mapping to final invoice sheets.
* Manage project setup, budgeting, task assignments, and closeout activities in Oracle Horizon, including maintaining WBS, time transfers, and compliance checks.
* Able to create Opportunity in Oracle based Horizon during proposal/ pre\-proposal and update status based on directions from PM.
* Ensure necessary Risk Assessment procedures are followed while creating the opportunity in Horizon as well as help in preparing RMIS document.
* Support financial analysis and reporting by using financial systems \[excel based Project Cost (PC) Control/ Financial Analysis Report (FAR) tools] to track project performance metrics, generate monthly accruals, and assess impacts of scope changes and forecast deviations.
* Collaborate with design teams to collect engineering progress data for Earned Value (EV) analysis and maintain accurate tracking of planned value, actual cost, and schedule.
* Act as liaison between GCC India and US teams for project setup, billing, and timesheet coding, while supporting the E\&E PMO team in portfolio monitoring.
* Conduct data integrity checks, audits, and maintain project documentation including lessons\-learned databases and meeting records.
* Should have extensive knowledge of working with ERP for project creation and maintenance.
* Should be able to create and track change order and identify, quantify and mitigate risk acting as a buddy to the PM.


**Project Scheduling:**
* Create, update, and maintain resource\- and cost\-loaded project schedules using Microsoft Project (MSP) or Primavera P6, based on stakeholder input, proposals, and scope documents.
* Develop activity lists, identify critical paths, and notify teams of key activities and schedule risks.
* Monitor project progress, detect deviations, and support recovery planning and schedule forecasting.
* Assess and report impacts of changes to baseline schedules and milestones, ensuring timely updates and resolution tracking.
* Support bids and proposals by preparing preliminary schedules and timelines.
* Use Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems to analyze and report project performance and KPIs.

* Collaborate with Project Managers, and Finance to monitor project expenses, resolve contract\-related queries, and ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and regulatory requirements.

* Utilize analytics and forecasting tools to support procurement planning, maintain accurate procurement records in Oracle, and contribute to continuous improvement through industry best practices.


**Key Competencies / Skills:**
* Proficient in MS Office Suite, especially Advanced Excel; experience with Oracle ERP (Horizon/NetSuite), Power BI is a plus.
* Skilled in project scheduling tools like Primavera P6, Microsoft Project (MSP), and SmartSheets.
* Familiar with documentation control platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk, ProjectWise.
* Strong understanding of Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems related to project control.
* Combined minimum 4 years of experience in project scheduling, cost control, documentation, and procurement.
* Experience supporting procurement functions, including vendor coordination and invoice tracking.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities; capable of handling multiple priorities and tight deadlines.

title: Principal Project Manager
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale - across every customer touchpoint. By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team - spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management - enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights. Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide. Job Description Sprinklr is a leading enterprise software company for all customer-facing functions. With advanced AI, Sprinklrs unified customer experience management (Unified-CXM) platform helps companies deliver human experiences to every customer, every time, across any modern channel. Headquartered in New York City with employees around the world, Sprinklr works with more than 1,000 of the world s most valuable enterprises - global brands like Microsoft, P&G, Samsung and more than 50% of the Fortune 100. Learn more about our culture and how we make our employees happier through The Sprinklr Way. Meet our Professional Services Team! Successful value-driven Sprinklr implementations start with us. We re looking for an experienced Global Program Manager to help provide premium services to our global customer base. As a member of our team, you ll support customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate internal consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen. About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Global Program Manager to lead the large-scale, complex global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing global programs, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to drive cross-functional teams towards successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities: Program Leadership: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of the global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives. Stakeholder Management: Engage with key stakeholders, including senior management, clients, and cross-functional teams, to ensure clear communication and alignment on program goals and progress. Resource Management: Allocate, coordinate and manage resources across different regions and functions effectively to ensure timely delivery of program milestones. Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with the program to ensure smooth execution. Performance Tracking: Monitor program performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques; report on progress, issues, and risks to stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program efficiency and effectiveness. Compliance: Ensure all program activities comply with relevant regulations, standards, and organizational policies. Financial Management: Manage program budgets, monitor expenditures, and ensure financial targets are met. Mentorship : Supervise and mentor program teams, providing guidance and support to ensure project success. Experience and Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in business administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Experience: Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in program management, with at least 5 years managing large-scale, global programs. Certifications: PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent program management certification is highly desirable. Technical Skills: Strong understanding of SaaS and CCaaS products & technology. (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Avaya, Cisco, Genysis etc.) Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to various audiences. Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Negotiation & Conflict Management: Experience in negotiation and conflict resolution to manage stakeholder expectations and drive consensus. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): On-Time Delivery: Percentage of program milestones delivered on or before the scheduled date. Budget Adherence: Percentage of program budget adherence, ensuring costs do not exceed allocated budget. Stakeholder Satisfaction: Stakeholder satisfaction scores based on feedback from clients, senior management, and team members. Risk Mitigation: Number of identified risks successfully mitigated or managed without impacting program delivery. Resource Utilization: Efficiency of resource allocation and utilization, ensuring optimal use of available resources. Quality of Deliverables: Quality assessment scores of program deliverables, ensuring they meet or exceed defined standards. Team Performance: Performance metrics for cross-functional teams, including productivity and collaboration effectiveness. Continuous Improvement: Implementation of process improvements and best practices, measured by the number of initiatives successfully adopted. Desired Soft Skills: Emotional Intelligence: Ability to understand and manage your own emotions, and those of others, to foster a positive work environment. Collaboration: Strong team player with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams across different geographies. Conflict Resolution: Skilled in resolving conflicts and negotiating win-win solutions. Time Management: Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines. Critical Thinking: Ability to think critically and creatively to solve complex problems. Resilience: Ability to remain calm and focused under pressure, and to bounce back from setbacks. Cultural Sensitivity: Awareness and respect for cultural differences, with the ability to work effectively in a global context. Why Join Us Opportunity to lead a high-impact global program. Collaborative and inclusive work environment. Competitive salary and benefits package. Professional development and growth opportunities. We focus on our mission : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data - helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things: Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM. Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience. Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability. We believe in our product : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything - and everyone - can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world s leading enterprise brands. We invest in our people : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off - it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus. To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here . To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here . EEO - Our philosophy : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we re more innovative, creative, and successful. Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter. Warning about Recruiting Scams: Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commissions advice to avoid these types of scams. If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Manager PMO
description:
Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced Manager PMO to lead and optimize project management processes, methodologies, and tools across Cyient, Inc. This role is crucial for ensuring efficient project delivery, resource allocation, and adherence to strategic objectives.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop, implement, and maintain PMO processes, standards, and best practices, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and industry benchmarks.
* Oversee a portfolio of projects, providing guidance and support to project managers, and ensuring consistent application of project management methodologies.
* Monitor project performance, identify risks and issues, and implement corrective actions to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality.
* Develop and manage resource allocation strategies across projects, optimizing utilization and identifying potential bottlenecks.
* Establish and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for project and PMO performance, providing regular updates to senior leadership.
* Facilitate communication and collaboration among project teams, stakeholders, and senior management.
* Manage and mentor a team of project managers and PMO staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development.
* Evaluate and recommend project management tools and technologies to enhance PMO efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure compliance with relevant company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years in a PMO management role.
* Proven track record of successfully managing complex programs and portfolios of projects.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and implement PMO processes, policies, and procedures.
* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana) and strong analytical skills.
* Experience in the engineering or technology services industry is highly desirable. 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
Manage all aspects of a large scale and complex project, from start to finish, so that it is completed on time and within budget. Design, communicate, and implement an operational plan for completing a project; monitor progress and performance against the project plan; resolve operational problems, minimize delays. Identify, develop, and gather necessary resources to complete the project. Liaise with other areas in the organization to secure specialized resources and contributions for the project. **Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery across the engineering teams supporting our health plan technology platform, spanning software engineering (Junior through Architect levels, working in Go, Python, Node.js, and AWS\-based distributed systems), Data \& Integration Engineering (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), and DevOps \& Cloud Engineering (AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS/OpenShift). This is a techno\-functional leadership role: you will own the program plan, translate customer and business requirements into clear technical direction, and track delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams and onshore/offshore teams. Just as important, you will be the driving force behind an AI\-first mindset across every team and every solution, setting the expectation that AI\-assisted engineering is the default way of working, not an exception.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end program and project delivery across engineering teams spanning software engineering, data/BI \& integration engineering, and DevOps/cloud engineering

* Proven experience managing programs spanning distributed systems/backend engineering, data engineering/BI, and DevOps/cloud engineering disciplines

**AI\-First Leadership (Required)**

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology\-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.


**About the Brand**

Springer Health\+, part of the Springer Nature Group, is a global leader in healthcare education and communications. We partner with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare organizations to develop evidence\-based scientific communications, medical education initiatives, publications, and strategic Medical Affairs solutions that improve healthcare decision\-making and patient outcomes.


**About the Role**

The Manager \- Scientific Services \- will lead the development and delivery of high\-quality scientific communications and Medical Affairs initiatives for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.


The role requires a blend of scientific expertise, project leadership, stakeholder engagement, and commercial acumen to deliver impactful solutions and support the growth of Springer Health\+'s Scientific Services business in India.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Scientific Content \& Medical Communications**

* Develop evidence\-based scientific content by leveraging strong Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and Product and Service Knowledge to ensure relevance, accuracy, and scientific rigor.
* Review evidence\-based scientific content, ensuring scientific accuracy, quality, compliance, and alignment with client and stakeholder expectations through a Customer\-Focused and Action\-Oriented approach.
* Develop scientific platforms, advisory board materials, slide decks, publications, manuscripts, literature reviews, and medical education assets that effectively support client objectives and therapeutic communication needs.
* Conduct literature searches, evidence assessments, and scientific analyses utilizing deep Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and critical evaluation skills.
* Ensure scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance across deliverables while balancing regulatory requirements, business goals, and stakeholder expectations through effective Stakeholder Management.
* Stay abreast of therapeutic advances, emerging evidence, and industry trends to maintain robust scientific expertise and Product and Service Knowledge.

**Medical Affairs \& Client Engagement**

* Partner with Medical Affairs teams to support strategic scientific objectives while effectively Balancing Stakeholders and fostering cross\-functional collaboration.
* Participate in client meetings, advisory boards, and scientific discussions by applying Consultative Selling techniques and demonstrating strong scientific expertise.
* Provide scientific insights and recommendations that address client needs and support informed decision\-making through a Customer\-Focused and consultative approach.
* Build strong relationships with clients, KOLs, and healthcare professionals, ensuring long\-term engagement, trust, and customer satisfaction.

**KOL Engagement**

* Support identification and engagement of KOLs and external experts by utilizing strong industry networks and Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge.
* Coordinate scientific reviews and expert inputs while effectively balancing diverse stakeholder perspectives and objectives.
* Develop meeting summaries, insight reports, and recommendations that translate expert feedback into actionable scientific and business outcomes.
* Develop national and international medical society and university tie\-ups to strengthen scientific collaborations and create opportunities for strategic partnerships and Business Development.

**Project Leadership**

* Manage multiple projects while ensuring quality, timelines, client satisfaction, and efficient resource utilization, supported by sound Financial Acumen and an Action\-Oriented mindset.
* Collaborate with medical writers, editors, designers, and project teams to deliver high\-quality scientific solutions that meet client requirements.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation plans proactively to ensure successful project execution and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Business Growth**

title: Program Manager
description:
**Position:** 
 Program Manager – Urban Initiative
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation** 




  





**About URBAN Project** 




 India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well\-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services\-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under\-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under\-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest\-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.
 



  





 The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on\-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:
 



  




* **Regional economic and spatial planning:** 
 Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth\-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:** 
 Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:** 
 Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:** 
 Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.



  





 Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better\-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high\-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem\-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral \& written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.
 



  





**Areas of Work:** 




 The Program Manager will:
 


* Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning
* Engage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)
* Develop evidence\-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growth
* Engage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnerships
* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise



  





**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities** 



* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills
* High level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands require
* Ability to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive manner
* Operating style suited to working in a small\-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued



  





**Compensation** 




 Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience
 



  





**Location** 




 New Delhi, India

title: Technology & Security Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 This is a site\-embedded SME role focused on the specific ELV, BMS, and security infrastructure of a designated data centre campus or facility. Unlike the portfolio\-level SME role, this position requires deep, facility\-specific technical knowledge — the as\-built configuration, site\-specific control logic, vendor systems in use, and local operational constraints of the assigned site — to provide hands\-on technical support to site operations, construction, and commissioning teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the on\-site/site\-dedicated technical point of contact for all ELV, BMS, and security system matters at the assigned facility.
* Maintain detailed, current knowledge of the site's as\-built ELV and BMS architecture, including device inventory, network topology, controller configurations, and integration points with EPMS and fire/life\-safety systems.
* Support live\-site troubleshooting of ELV, BMS, and security system faults, coordinating with OEM vendors and facility operations/NOC teams for rapid resolution.
* Review and validate site\-specific change requests (MOPs/EOPs) affecting ELV, BMS, or security systems before implementation.
* Provide technical walkdown support during audits, client inspections, and compliance reviews specific to the site.
* Support site commissioning and re\-commissioning activities for ELV, BMS, and security systems during capacity expansions, retrofits, or system upgrades.
* Maintain and update site\-specific documentation — as\-built drawings, points lists, network diagrams, and system configuration baselines — reflecting all field changes.
* Coordinate with the portfolio\-level ELV \& Security SME on design standard alignment, escalations, and lessons learned across sites.
* Support incident response and root\-cause investigations for site\-specific ELV/BMS/security events, including data gathering, log review, and vendor coordination.
* Train and guide site facility/operations personnel on ELV and BMS system operation, alarm handling, and basic troubleshooting.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 8–12 years of experience in ELV and BMS systems, with demonstrated experience providing hands\-on, site\-level technical support in a live/operational data centre environment.
* Working knowledge of the specific BMS/EPMS platform(s) deployed at the assigned site (e.g., Niagara/Tridium, Schneider EcoStruxure, Siemens Desigo, Honeywell, Johnson Controls Metasys).
* Practical experience with CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, and PA systems as deployed and configured on an operational site.
* Familiarity with MOP/EOP (Method of Procedure / Emergency Operating Procedure) development and change control processes in a live critical facility.
* Ability to interpret as\-built drawings, control narratives, and network diagrams specific to the site, and to identify discrepancies against current field conditions.
* Comfort working in a 24x7 critical facility environment, including responding to on\-call escalations as required.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to work directly with OEM technical support and field service engineers.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation Engineering, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on field experience.
* Site\-specific OEM training/certification on the BMS or security platforms deployed at the facility.
* Prior experience in a site operations, facility engineering, or critical environment support role.



  





**Soft Skills** 




  




* Strong ownership mindset and responsiveness in live\-site, time\-sensitive situations.
* Clear, concise communication with site operations, NOC, and vendor teams during incidents.
* Ability to work independently on site while staying aligned with portfolio\-level design standards and reporting lines.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**About PRAGATI** 




 Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low\-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher\-income economic activity.
 



 PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF\-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:
 


* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non\-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.



 PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands\-on implementation. It identifies high\-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.
 



 PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10\-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro\-processing, labour\-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 PRAGATI is working with the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) to help shape the next phase of rural development — building on MoRD's strong welfare and infrastructure delivery platform to increasingly enable sustained income growth and rural prosperity. The engagement focuses on three pathways: increasing agricultural incomes, creating non\-farm local livelihood opportunities, and enabling skilling for remunerative migration.
 



 The Senior Program Manager – Rural Economic Transformation (MoRD) will lead this engagement on a day\-to\-day basis. The role combines strategy, policy and execution — identifying and structuring complex problems, conducting rigorous analysis, designing practical interventions, building alignment with government and ecosystem stakeholders, and driving initiatives through implementation. The SPM will lead a small team and work closely with senior MoRD officials, PRAGATI leadership, financial institutions, experts and private\-sector partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with MoRD and PRAGATI leadership to identify and prioritise high\-impact opportunities for increasing rural incomes.
* Structure complex problems into clear hypotheses, analytical workstreams and actionable interventions.
* Lead research and analysis across agriculture, rural enterprise, finance, skilling and migration.
* Translate priority opportunities into practical program and policy designs, including implementation models, financing mechanisms and outcome frameworks.
* Build the economic and operational case for new initiatives and government partnerships, working with experts and ecosystem partners to refine solutions.
* Translate ministry priorities into clear workplans, owners, milestones and deliverables, and establish a strong operating rhythm across workstreams.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks, ensuring initiatives move from concept and approval to implementation.
* Build trusted relationships with senior MoRD officials and coordinate across ministries, state governments, public institutions, financial institutions and implementation partners.
* Prepare senior\-level engagements and translate discussions into clear decisions and follow\-up actions.
* Manage and mentor the MoRD PMU team, maintaining a high bar for rigour, ownership and execution.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* 8–10 years of professional experience, ideally in management consulting, strategy, transformation, public policy, economic development or a similar problem\-solving environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own complex programs end\-to\-end, from problem definition and solution design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the maturity to work with senior government officials, business leaders, financial institutions and experts.
* Strong quantitative skills and comfort working across policy, strategy and implementation.
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable working in an early\-stage organisation, with a strong interest in rural economic development and government\-led transformation.
* MBA or postgraduate degree from a leading institution is preferred, but not mandatory.
