**We're looking for a**
**Senior Technical Project Manager \- India**
=============================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office****Senior Technical Project Manager**
  

  

**About the Role**
  

  

We're looking for a **Senior Technical Project Manager** to drive the planning and delivery of our product roadmap. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Customers turning strategic priorities into well\-sequenced execution plans, keeping releases on track, and giving leadership clear visibility into progress and risk. This is a high\-impact role for someone who thrives on structure, loves solving cross\-team coordination problems, and wants their work to directly shape what ships.
  

  

**What You'll Do**
  

  

* Own end\-to\-end planning and delivery for major product initiatives, from roadmap intake through release and post\-release review.

  

* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Leads to translate roadmap priorities into scoped, sequenced execution plans.

  

* Manage sprint/release cadences across multiple engineering pods, ensuring dependencies are identified and resolved early.

  

* Run core agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retros) and continuously tune process to the team's needs.

  

* Track and report progress against the roadmap — timelines, scope changes, risks — to engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.

  

* Work with the customers to ensure we’re meeting the customer timelines.

  

* Coordinate cross\-functional readiness for releases (QA, Design, Docs, Support, Customer facing teams) so releases land smoothly.

  

* Maintain a single source of truth for project status, RAID logs, and release plans.

  

* Identify systemic bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline and drive process improvements across Product/Eng.

  

* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams without losing sight of the bigger product strategy.

  

**What You'll Bring**
  

  

* 6–8 years of technical project/program management experience, ideally within a product company (SaaS or platform business).

  

* Strong grasp of Agile/Scrum and modern product development practices; comfortable working directly with engineers on technical tradeoffs.

  

* Experience managing roadmap\-to\-release delivery, not just project execution — you understand product lifecycle, not just task tracking.

  

* Skilled with tools like Jira, Linear, Asana, Confluence, or similar.

  

* Excellent communicator who can flex between engineering detail and executive\-level summaries.

  

* Track record of managing multiple concurrent product workstreams in a fast\-moving environment.

  

* PMP, CSM, or SAFe certification a plus.

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) and MBA.

  

**Nice to Have**
  

  

* Experience in enterprise SaaS or B2B platform companies.

  

* Familiarity with release management, feature flagging, and phased rollout practices.

  

* Exposure to customer\-facing launches or GA (general availability) processes

**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.


**Who We Are:**


At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high\-performing, future\-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M\+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.


Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Job Description: Senior Specialist, Product Development, Digital Transformation \& Optimization  

  

Overview:  

Mastercard is a global technology company. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making payment and data transactions safe, simple, smart, and successful. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

The Digital Transformation and Optimization team is part of Core Solutions. We are responsible for optimizing eCommerce solutions and for driving transaction authorization improvement for digital transactions globally. We do this by being a consumer centric for our products and services and being relevant in all consumer money flows.
  

  

The Role:  

* Have good understanding of hybrid application integrations, analytical tools to measure and track customer experience, like Mixtiles, and Project management frameworks/ tools like GIT, copilot and Jira
* Responsible for identifying, analyzing, developing, and bringing solutions to market that meet customer needs through supporting stories, feature management and project planning, helping to make solid product decisions and deliver value
* Drive product evolution with a focus on data science, engineering and business impact by helping to maintain the product backlog, and prioritize requirements
* Provide Operational support of new products where authorization recommendations are delivered from an AI engine to an Mastercard global application
* Act as a Program Admin to support Mastercard product governance tools and services (Studio, Architecture Reviews, AI governance, Compliance and Data Security, etc.)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, data science, operations, and design to deliver scalable solutions that enhance product connectivity, data flow, and performance insight
* Continuously innovate and explore new approaches, tools, techniques, and technologies to solve business problems
* Stay updated on emerging trends in integration technologies (e.g., AI ML model \& and data analytics platforms (e.g., Thoughtspot, Power BI)

  

Candidates based in India only  

  

ALL ABOUT YOU  

The candidate should demonstrate:  

* Must have a minimum of 5 years of experience in technical product management and project management
* Passion for all things digital and intrinsic curiosity to understand new technology like Artificial Intelligence, Cloud solutions
* Entrepreneurial spirit and global mindset with a passion for learning and using data to solve large scale business problems
* Experience using project management tools like Git, Jira, Aha, etc is preferable
* Excellent communication \& influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders; ability to articulate problem statements, opportunity areas and complex data models
* Excellent project management and execution skills, with strong problem solving, highly analytical, quantitative communication and organizational skills
* Create and maintain material in support of product development and management: business cases, product roadmaps, success metrics, etc.
* Good to have experience with Enterprise Business Intelligence Platform/Data platforms
* Ability to articulate the business value of products and actively participate in sales enablement efforts
* Proven success in interacting with stakeholders to understand technical needs and ensure analyses and solutions effectively meet their requirements

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Program Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 Location: Gurgaon (In\-office)
 



  





  





 Experience: 5 to 8 years
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The Term Insurance Business Unit relies on sharp, high\-volume data operationalization to track distribution productivity, quality indicators, and core performance metrics across sales channels. This role sits at the center of our business management and operations enablement effort. We are looking for someone who operates seamlessly with large\-scale datasets, excels in MS Excel, and can independently own performance reporting across the Term portfolio. You will be responsible for creating continuous visibility into channel performance, surfacing metrics around product fit and persistency, and pinpointing bottom\-quartile performers or compliance lags to enable target\-driven interventions.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Manage Business \& Operational Datasets: Extract, clean, and consolidate large daily/weekly datasets covering Term Insurance sales, policy issuance, distribution channels, and customer profiles.
* Track Business Metrics \& Outliers: Monitor productivity baselines, product\-fit indicators, customer alignment, and persistency metrics to identify low\-performing agents, partners, or distribution units.
* Build \& Publish Core MIS Dashboards: Design, automate, and publish high\-accuracy daily, weekly, and monthly business trackers, performance scorecards, and operational status reports for business leadership.
* Data Reconciliation \& Accuracy: Conduct routine reconciliation across core business systems to ensure zero discrepancies in published numbers and KPI scorecards.
* Drive Performance \& Exit Recommendations: Prepare clear, data\-backed cuts highlighting consistent non\-performance, low conversion rates, and policy non\-compliance to support channel review and optimization decisions.
* Partner with Business Leads: Work closely with distribution, compliance, and quality teams to provide rapid ad\-hoc data reporting and monitor whether corrective interventions improve metrics over time.



  





  





**Key Deliverables** 




  





  




* Daily, error\-free publishing of key Term Business trackers and performance scorecards.
* Clear operational visibility into bottom\-tier metrics, allowing business leads to act quickly on low performers.
* Streamlined data workflows through Excel automation, significantly reducing report turnaround times.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 4 to 7 years of experience in a dedicated MIS, Business Reporting, or Operational Analytics role (preferably in Life Insurance, Term Insurance, or Financial Services).



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Advanced MS Excel Skills: Expert in handling large datasets, Pivot Tables, complex lookup functions (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), Power Query, and dynamic dashboards. Exposure to SQL or VBA/Macros is a strong advantage.
* Metric \& Performance\-Driven: Strong focus on target adherence, persistency, quality metrics, and performance tracking.
* Attention to Detail: High accuracy in handling raw data cuts, identifying discrepancies, and reconciling source data.
* High Ownership: Ability to work against tight business timelines and manage daily reporting commitments with minimal oversight.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Exposure to SQL or VBA/Macros is a strong advantage.

title: Project Manager
description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 08/20/2026
* Job Type Permanent
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 8\-10 years
* City Chennai
* State/Province Tamil Nadu
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 600096
### **Job Description**


**Key Responsibilities**

 **A. Project Planning \& Execution**

  

* Take complete ownership of assigned digital transformation and MES projects.
* Conduct project kick\-off meetings with internal and customer teams.
* Understand project scope, technical requirements, deliverables and contractual commitments.
* Prepare detailed project execution plans and project schedules.
* Define project milestones, activities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish project governance and review mechanisms.
* Track project progress against approved baseline schedules.
* Ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables.
* Identify project delays and implement recovery plans.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously wherever required.

 **B. Customer Management**

  

* Act as the primary project\-level contact for customers.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with customer stakeholders.
* Understand customer expectations and resolve project\-related concerns.
* Prepare and present project status reports.
* Manage customer communication related to scope, schedule, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Maintain strong customer relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
* Escalate critical customer issues to management at the appropriate time.
* Ensure customer acceptance and successful project closure.

 **C. Technical Coordination**

  

* Coordinate with software development teams for application development.
* Coordinate with automation teams for PLC, SCADA and machine integration.
* Coordinate with database and infrastructure teams.
* Coordinate ERP/SAP integration activities.
* Review functional and technical specifications.
* Participate in solution architecture discussions.
* Ensure technical deliverables meet project requirements.
* Support technical teams in resolving critical implementation issues.
* Ensure integration between software, hardware, machines and enterprise systems.

  

The Project Manager is not expected to be the primary developer or automation engineer, but should possess sufficient technical knowledge to understand, coordinate and challenge technical decisions effectively.

 **D. Scope \& Change Management**

  

* Establish and maintain the approved project scope.
* Identify scope deviations during execution.
* Evaluate change requests from customers.
* Coordinate technical and commercial impact assessment.
* Maintain Change Request / Change Order documentation.
* Ensure additional work is not executed without proper approval.
* Communicate scope, schedule and cost impacts to stakeholders.
* Support the sales/commercial team in preparing change\-order proposals.

 **E. Resource Management**

  

* Prepare project resource plans.
* Allocate resources based on project priorities.
* Coordinate software developers, BA, QA, automation engineers, technical writers and commissioning engineers.
* Monitor resource utilization.
* Identify resource constraints and resolve conflicts.
* Plan onsite/offsite resource requirements.
* Ensure adequate technical resources are available during critical project phases.

 **F. Risk \& Issue Management**

  

* Identify project risks during planning and execution.
* Maintain a Project Risk Register.
* Define mitigation and contingency plans.
* Monitor technical, commercial, schedule and resource risks.
* Maintain an Issue Log and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate critical risks and issues to management.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis for major project problems.
* Implement preventive actions to avoid recurrence.

 **G. Project Documentation**

  

Ensure timely preparation and maintenance of:

  

* Project Charter
* Project Plan
* Requirement Specification
* Functional Requirement Specification (FRS)
* Technical Specification
* Project Schedule
* Resource Plan
* Risk Register
* Issue Register
* Change Request Register
* Meeting Minutes
* Weekly/Monthly Project Reports
* Test Plans
* FAT/SAT Documentation
* UAT Documentation
* Training Documents
* Deployment Plan
* Go\-Live Plan
* Project Closure Report
* As\-built Documentation

 **H. Testing, Commissioning \& Go\-Live**

  

* Plan and coordinate system testing activities.
* Coordinate SIT, FAT, UAT and SAT activities.
* Ensure defects are tracked and closed.
* Coordinate customer validation and acceptance.
* Prepare deployment and go\-live plans.
* Manage production implementation.
* Coordinate stabilization/support activities after go\-live.
* Ensure final project handover to support/operations teams.

 **I. Commercial \& Financial Responsibility**

  

* Monitor project cost against approved budget.
* Track project profitability and resource utilization.
* Monitor billing milestones and deliverables.
* Coordinate with finance/commercial teams for milestone billing.
* Identify potential cost overruns.
* Support management in project financial reviews.
* Ensure project execution remains commercially viable.

### **Requirements**


The candidate should have good working knowledge of:

### **Software / IT**

* Web\-based applications
* Python/.NET/Java or similar application environments
* SQL/NoSQL databases
* API and system integration
* REST APIs
* Authentication and user management
* Application deployment
* Server and network fundamentals

### **Industrial Automation**

* PLC concepts
* SCADA systems
* OPC UA / OPC DA
* Industrial communication protocols
* Machine data acquisition
* Sensors and industrial devices
* Industrial Ethernet
* Edge/data collection systems

### **Manufacturing Systems**

* MES architecture
* OEE
* Traceability
* Production monitoring
* Quality systems
* Maintenance systems
* Warehouse systems
* ERP integration
* SAP integration
* Manufacturing workflows

title: Data project Manager
description:
**Req ID:** 
 388757
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Data project Manager to join our team in Mumbai, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN).
   

  

**Position Overview** 
 The Data Project Manager will lead the data workstream, encompassing reference data (EDMCS), Data Hydration, App\-to\-App Integrations, Nuveen AUM and Data Conversion initiatives critical to the ERP upgrade's success. This role ensures data readiness across all functional domains within AmpliFi.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end project plan for data migration, cleansing, governance, and validation activities.
* Schedule and facilitate status meetings, domain meetings, steering committee and workshop specific to the Data Domain.
* Coordinate with functional workstream leads (R2R, S2P, O2C, Enabling Functions) to identify data requirements and dependencies.
* Manage master data management (MDM) activities, including data standards, ownership, and stewardship models.
* Oversee data extraction, transformation, load (ETL) processes and reconciliation activities with technical teams.
* Track data quality metrics and remediation plans throughout migration cycles (mock loads, dress rehearsals, final cutover).
* Manage risks and issues related to data readiness, escalating critical blockers to program leadership.


**Program\-Level Responsibilities (applicable to all six roles):**
* Adhere to AmpliFi program governance, PMO standards, and reporting templates/cadence.
* Participate in cross\-workstream coordination meetings to manage interdependencies.
* Escalate risks and issues through defined program governance channels.
* Support overall cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live stabilization for assigned domain.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related field.
* 6–10 years of project management experience, with at least 3 years focused on data migration, MDM, or data governance in ERP implementations.
* Familiarity with ERP data structures (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and data migration tools/methodologies.
* Understanding of data governance frameworks and master data domains (customer, vendor, material, GL).
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred; data management certifications (e.g., CDMP) a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and experience coordinating technical and functional teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Salesforce Functional Project Manager
description:

title: Senior Analyst II, Digital Project Manager in Bangalore, India
description:

We are looking for a motivated and execution\-oriented analyst to support Digital M\&A for R\&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.



This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R\&D, software engineering and digital platforms.



The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.



Approximately **80% of the role is dedicated to Digital M\&A activities within the R\&D and Engineering ecosystem**, while **20% focuses on cybersecurity andsource code governance initiatives**.


**What will you do?**


* We are looking for a motivated and execution\-oriented analyst to support Digital M\&A for R\&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.
* This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R\&D, software engineering and digital platforms.
* The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.


**What are the key skills we are looking for?**


* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of Digital M\&A acquisitions, integrations, and divestitures across R\&D and Engineering organizations under the leadership of the M\&A R\&D Program Manager.
* Coordinate onboarding of newly acquired software and engineering teams into Schneider Electric's Digital Engineering ecosystem.

* Maintain integration plans, action trackers, risk logs and governance documentation.
* Coordinate activities across R\&D, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Legal and Business teams.
* Support digital due diligence and integration readiness assessments.
* Track migration of engineering tools, development environments and digital platforms.
* Support application separation and carve\-out activities during divestitures.
* Prepare executive updates, governance reviews and status reporting.
* Drive follow\-up on actions, dependencies, risks and mitigation plans.

* This role offers a unique opportunity to build expertise at the intersection of **Digital M\&A, R\&D, Digital Engineering, and Cybersecurity** .
* You will gain hands\-on experience leading complex steams of acquisition, integration, and divestiture initiatives while collaborating with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
* The position provides valuable exposure to engineering ecosystems, digital transformation programs, secure development practices, and source code governance.
* You will strengthen your project management, stakeholder engagement, and executive communication skills while developing a broad understanding of Schneider Electric's digital landscape.
* This experience can accelerate your career toward leadership roles in **Digital Transformation, M\&A Integration, Cybersecurity, Strategy, or Program Management**.

* 7\+ years of experience in Project Management, Business Analysis, Digital Transformation , Technology Consulting and / or Cybersecurity, with a strong track record of driving execution and delivering results.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and influence teams without direct authority.
* Exposure to M\&A integration, acquisitions or divestitures.
* Experience working with R\&D, Engineering or Technology organizations.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity and secure development practices.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal), with experience working across global, multi\-country, and cross\-functional teams, including interactions with senior stakeholders.
* Execution\-oriented, adaptable, and self\-driven, with a passion for security and innovation, able to navigate ambiguity, manage changing priorities, and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

title: AV PROJECT MANAGER
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **AV Project Manager** to manage and deliver Audio\-Visual integration projects from project initiation through successful completion and handover.

The candidate will be responsible for **project planning, client coordination, technical execution, manpower management, procurement coordination, project scheduling, quality control, testing \& commissioning, and final handover**.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of **professional AV systems, video conferencing, display solutions, audio systems, control systems, structured cabling, and AV integration**, along with excellent project management and client\-handling skills.

Key Responsibilities1\. Project Planning \& Management

* Plan, schedule, execute, monitor, and close AV projects within agreed timelines.
* Understand project scope, specifications, BOQ, drawings, and client requirements.
* Prepare detailed project execution plans, schedules, and milestones.
* Allocate manpower, materials, tools, and other project resources.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion.

2\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and provide progress updates.
* Understand client requirements and manage project changes effectively.
* Resolve project\-related issues and escalations professionally.

3\. AV Project Execution

* Supervise complete AV system installation and integration.
* Coordinate installation of:
* LED/LCD/Interactive Displays
* Projectors and projection systems
* Professional audio systems
* Microphones and DSP systems
* Video conferencing systems
* Control systems
* Digital signage
* Room booking systems
* Matrix/Switching systems
* Structured AV cabling
* Video walls and collaboration solutions
* Ensure installation is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and industry standards.

4\. Team \& Subcontractor Management

* Manage AV engineers, technicians, programmers, and subcontractors.
* Allocate work and monitor daily site activities.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower and resources.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and ensure quality and timely execution.
* Conduct regular site inspections.

5\. Procurement \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with Procurement, Stores, and Vendors for project materials.
* Prepare and monitor material requirement schedules.
* Track material availability and delivery timelines.
* Ensure materials received at site match approved specifications.
* Minimize project delays caused by material shortages.

6\. Project Cost \& Commercial Control

* Monitor project budgets and expenses.
* Track project BOQ, variations, additional works, and change orders.
* Coordinate with the commercial/accounts team regarding project billing and documentation.
* Identify potential cost overruns and take corrective action.

7\. Testing \& Commissioning

* Coordinate system testing, commissioning, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Ensure all AV systems are fully functional before client demonstration.
* Coordinate integration between AV, IT, networking, and control systems.
* Conduct client demonstrations and resolve commissioning issues.

8\. Quality \& Safety

* Ensure project execution meets company and client quality standards.
* Ensure proper installation practices and workmanship.
* Follow site safety procedures and ensure technicians/subcontractors comply with safety requirements.
* Conduct quality inspections and ensure timely closure of snags.

9\. Documentation \& Handover

* Maintain project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Review and maintain:
* BOQ
* Project schedules
* Shop drawings
* As\-built drawings
* Installation checklists
* Testing \& commissioning reports
* Snag lists
* O\&M manuals
* Warranty documents
* Ensure complete project handover and obtain client sign\-off.

Required Technical Knowledge

The candidate should have good working knowledge of:

* Professional Audio \& Video Systems
* Video Conferencing Solutions
* Digital Signal Processors (DSP)
* Microphones and Audio Systems
* Projectors and Displays
* LED Walls / Video Walls
* AV over IP
* Matrix Switchers and Video Distribution
* Control Systems
* Digital Signage
* Room Automation
* Structured Cabling
* Network Fundamentals
* AV System Integration
* Testing \& Commissioning

Knowledge of platforms such as **Crestron, Extron, Biamp, QSC, Shure, Logitech, Cisco, Poly, Yealink, Barco, Samsung, LG** or similar AV technologies will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong project management and execution skills.
* Excellent client communication and coordination skills.
* Good leadership and team management abilities.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and project scheduling tools.
* Ability to read and understand AV drawings, schematics, and BOQs.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

Qualification \& Experience

**Education:**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Electrical, IT, Networking, Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience:**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in **AV System Integration / Audio Visual Projects / IT Infrastructure Projects**.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience managing AV projects independently is preferred.
* Experience handling commercial, corporate, hospitality, education, government, or large\-scale AV projects will be an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Project completion within agreed timelines.
* Project execution within approved budget.
* Client satisfaction.
* Quality of installation and commissioning.
* Effective manpower utilization.
* Timely material coordination.
* Reduction in project delays and rework.
* Successful project handover and documentation.
* Timely closure of project snags.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a **hands\-on AV Project Manager** who can independently manage projects, lead site teams, coordinate with clients and vendors, understand technical AV requirements, and ensure projects are delivered on time with the expected quality.

**Salary:** As per industry standards and candidate's experience.

**Location:** Pune

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

Pay: ₹23,382\.02 \- ₹60,796\.19 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

With 60\+ integrated modules, including HIMS, EMR/EHR, Telemedicine, LIMS, RIS/PACS, Pharmacy, IoT, and Advanced Analytics, KareXpert enables hospitals to deliver connected, efficient, and patient\-centric care.
 



 Recognized as the winner of the

 , KareXpert works with leading global technology partners such as Google, Microsoft, Oracle, AWS, GE Healthcare, and KPMG to drive digital transformation in healthcare.. 
 



   
 


**Lead Digital Transformation in Healthcare** 

 Are you passionate about leveraging healthcare technology to transform hospital operations and improve patient care? Join KareXpert and lead large\-scale HIMS implementations across some of the region's leading healthcare institutions. From project kickoff to go\-live and stabilization, you will work closely with hospital leadership, clinical teams, and cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful digital healthcare solutions.
 


**What You'll Do**

* Act as the face of KareXpert leadership for assigned customer engagements.
* Lead end\-to\-end HIMS implementation programs across multiple hospitals and healthcare networks.
* Drive resource planning, mobilization, and deployment to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage Steering Committee (SteerCo) meetings, executive reviews, and stakeholder communications.
* Develop project plans, implementation roadmaps, risk mitigation strategies, and governance frameworks.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks; proactively raise red flags and drive corrective actions.
* Govern project KPIs related to scope, cost, quality, timelines, customer satisfaction, and adoption.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring delivery excellence.

* Drive process compliance, operational governance, and continuous improvement initiatives across projects.
* Lead change management initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new clinical and operational workflows.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management** 
* Build strong relationships with hospital CXOs, clinical leadership, IT teams, and operational stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for project\-related issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Conduct executive presentations, business reviews, and program status updates for senior leadership.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and transparent communication.


**People Leadership** 
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10\+ professionals across implementation, clinical, training, and technical functions.

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer\-centric delivery.


**Technical \& Solution Leadership** 
* Possess strong hands\-on knowledge of Hospital Information Management Systems (HIMS) and healthcare workflows.

* Drive system configuration, workflow validation, training, testing, go\-live, and post\-go\-live support activities.

**Travel \& Deployment** 
* Be available for onsite engagement as required by business and project needs.

**What You Bring** 
* MBA (Healthcare) / B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics) / MCA.
* 5–8 years of experience in Healthcare IT and HIMS implementation.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale healthcare implementation programs.

description:
**Project Manager – Product \& Operations** 
**About the Job!!** 
**About Revin** 


 Revin is an award\-winning, IIT Palakkad\-incubated AgTech company building data\-driven, climate\-resilient agriculture solutions to help farms, institutions and agricultural stakeholders improve productivity, resource efficiency and decision\-making. 
 





 We combine AI, IoT, intelligent sensors, drones, computer vision and digital platforms to turn farms into data\-driven, climate\-resilient and commercially stronger enterprises.
 





 We are looking for a highly driven Project Manager who can bring structure to ambiguity, align multidisciplinary teams, and turn ambitious ideas into reliable, scalable outcomes.
 



**The Role** 


 As Project Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end execution of Revin’s digital product and hardware product initiatives.
 





 You will coordinate across software, hardware, product, agronomy, field operations, customers, and leadership to ensure that every project moves from planning to deployment with clarity, speed, and accountability.
 





 This is not a traditional coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think like an owner, anticipate problems, make informed decisions, and build the execution systems required for a growing startup.
 



**What You’ll Own** 
**Project Planning and Delivery (Agile)** 
* Plan and manage projects from start to completion.
* Set clear responsibilities, timelines, and expected outcomes.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and to the required quality.
* Keep teams focused on priorities and follow up until tasks are completed.


**Team Coordination** 
* Coordinate effectively across product, technology, field, and business teams.
* Ensure everyone understands what needs to be done, by whom, and by when.
* Conduct regular project meetings and maintain clear action points.
* Build accountability without unnecessary micromanagement.


**Day\-to\-Day Execution** 
* Lead sprint planning, team reviews, and regular progress discussions.
* Track deliverables, pending actions, risks, and dependencies.
* Identify delays early and take corrective action.
* Bring structure and clarity when priorities or requirements change.


**Stakeholder Communication** 
* Act as the primary point of contact for project\-related communication.
* Provide clear and timely updates to leadership, customers, and partners.
* Understand stakeholder expectations and convert them into actionable plans.
* Communicate challenges honestly, along with practical solutions.


**Deployment and Customer Success** 
* Coordinate product testing, customer deployment, training, and follow\-up.
* Ensure teams are prepared before every customer delivery or field implementation.
* Collect customer feedback and work with internal teams to address concerns.
* Ensure successful completion instead of treating deployment as the final step.


**Process Improvement** 
* Create simple systems for planning, documentation, reporting, and follow\-ups.
* Identify gaps and improve the way projects are executed.
* Reduce last\-minute confusion through better preparation and communication.
* Build processes that can support Revin as the company grows.


**Who We’re Looking For** 
* **A Startup\-Minded Executor**
* **An Outcome\-Driven Project Leader**
* **A Clear and Confident Communicator**
* **A Strong Team Coordinator**
* **An Organised and Accountable Professional**
* **An Adaptable and Fast Learner**


**Qualifications** 
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, Management, or a related discipline.
* **1–2 years of experience** 

 in project management, product operations, technical programme management, or startup execution.
* Practical experience working in a startup, product company, or fast\-moving technology environment is strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Agile and Scrum practices, sprint planning, backlog management, and iterative product delivery.
* Experience using tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Linear, Notion, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with software engineers, hardware teams, product managers, designers, and business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with APIs, cloud platforms, IoT systems, data pipelines, or connected products is highly desirable.
* Strong documentation, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and decision\-making abilities.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Palakkad and engage with field deployments when required.


**Why Join Revin?** 
* Work directly with the leadership  team.
* Build a market in a rapidly evolving AgTech ecosystem.
* Opportunity to work with government, enterprises, FPOs and large farms.
* High ownership and entrepreneurial responsibility.
* Direct opportunity to contribute to measurable impact in agriculture.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Project Manager** 




*Installations \& Project Execution \| Agriplast Protected Cultivation* 




**Location:** 
 Bangalore (on\-site), with regular travel to project sites across India and international markets
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Office Leadership
 



  





**About Us** 




 Agriplast Protected Cultivation is a greenhouse manufacturing company in India that builds large\-scale commercial greenhouse farms. Our range consists of Polyhouse, Greenhouse, Net Houses and Poly tunnels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Agriplast is scaling rapidly across domestic and international markets and is building out a strong project execution function to match. We are looking for a seasoned project leader to own the complete execution agenda from order handover and site mobilization through installation, commissioning, and client sign\-off across all project sites.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can build process and drive on\-ground execution simultaneously in a fast\-growing, project\- and manufacturing\-driven business. The ideal candidate will bring a superior strategic outlook and “get things done” leadership skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Strategy \& Planning** 




 •     Develop and execute the overall project execution strategy for domestic and international sites.
 



 •     Build detailed project plans, timelines, and resource/manpower deployment plans for each site.
 



**2\. Installation \& Project Execution** 




 •     Own end\-to\-end installation and commissioning of Polyhouses, Greenhouses, Net Houses and Poly tunnels at client sites.
 



 •     Ensure timely closure and handover of all critical and strategic projects within scope, budget and quality.
 



**3\. Vendor, Contractor \& Site Team Management** 




 •     Build and manage a reliable network of installation contractors, civil teams, and site supervisors/engineers across regions.
 



 •     Ensure timely mobilization of manpower, material, and equipment to project sites.
 



**4\. Quality, Safety \& Standards** 




 •     Establish and enforce quality control checkpoints and site safety protocols across all projects.
 



 •     Conduct regular site audits and inspections to ensure adherence to engineering, design and safety standards.
 



**5\. Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 •     Act as the primary escalation point for clients during execution, managing expectations and resolving on\-site issues.
 



 •     Coordinate closely with design, procurement, manufacturing and logistics teams to ensure seamless handoffs from order to site.
 



**6\. Cost, Budget \& Resource Control** 




 •     Monitor project costs against budget, control overruns, and protect project\-level profitability.
 



 •     Track material consumption, minimize wastage, and optimize deployment of manpower and equipment across sites.
 



**7\. Project Analytics, Systems \& Reporting** 




 •     Implement project management systems, dashboards and site\-tracking tools.
 



 •     Track and report the Project Execution scorecard to leadership across the following KPIs:
 



 •     Project Completion Rate (On\-Time)
 



 •     Installation Cycle Time (Order to Handover)
 



 •     Cost Variance / Budget Adherence
 



 •     Client Satisfaction / Handover Score
 



 •     Site Safety Incident Rate
 



 •     Quality Rework Rate
 



 •     Resource \& Equipment Utilization Rate
 



 •     Vendor/Contractor Performance Score
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 •     Experience: 12\+ years in project execution/installation management, including substantial time in a senior/leadership role, ideally in greenhouse, structural steel, construction, infrastructure or EPC project execution.
 



 •     Execution Track Record: Proven track record delivering large\-scale, multi\-site installation/construction projects on time, on budget and to quality standards.
 



 •     Vendor \& Contractor Management: Strong network and hands\-on experience managing multi\-site contractor, civil and labour teams.
 



 •     Quality \& Safety: Strong working knowledge of quality control, site safety compliance, and engineering/installation standards.
 



 •     Client \& Stakeholder Management: Hands\-on experience managing client relationships and expectations through project execution and handover.
 



 •     Systems \& Analytics: Comfortable implementing and running project management tools, dashboards and execution analytics.
 



 •     Communication \& Leadership: Exceptional communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with a strategic outlook and strong execution.
 



 •     Self\-Starter: Thrives in a dynamic “build\-from\-scratch” environment, comfortable with extensive travel, and takes ownership end\-to\-end.

title: PMO Manager – R&D and Engineering IT
description:
**The Opportunity**
 As PMO Manager (R\&D and Engineering IT – Mechanical CAD), you will coordinate and drive strategic initiatives and projects across Mechanical CAD and related engineering application portfolios. You will establish practical governance, integrated plans, decision forums, reporting, and communication routines that connect Service Manager, Application Portfolio Managers, engineering business stakeholders, and strategic vendors. You will provide clear visibility of scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, actions, financials, and benefits. The role combines hands\-on execution with strong stakeholder management and ensures that commitments are translated into coordinated, traceable, and sustainable progress across the MCAD ecosystem.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Drive cross\-portfolio initiatives and projects across Mechanical CAD and related engineering application landscapes from initiation through closure and benefit tracking.
* Establish and maintain fit\-for\-purpose PMO governance, including charters, integrated plans, milestones, decision logs, action tracking, status reporting, and closure criteria.
* Translate strategic priorities and business needs into clear workstreams, deliverables, ownership, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
* Coordinate Service Managers, Application Portfolio Managers, Product Owners, R\&D and engineering business stakeholders, and external partners around shared priorities and delivery commitments.
* Prepare concise, audience\-specific communications, leadership updates, steering materials, project briefings, and change or adoption messages.
* Plan and facilitate governance forums, workshops, reviews, and decision meetings; document outcomes and ensure timely follow\-through.
* Maintain transparent oversight of scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, benefits, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Coordinate vendor deliverables, service and project commitments, dependencies, performance reviews, and improvement actions in partnership with commercial and technical owners.
* Drive consistent ways of working, reusable templates, dashboards, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across the MCAD portfolio.
* Use data and digital tools, including AI\-enabled capabilities where appropriate, to improve reporting quality, identify delivery insights, and reduce administrative effort.
* Ensure projects and initiatives follow applicable internal governance, cybersecurity, architecture, procurement, data, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* 8–15 years of experience in PMO, project or program management, service management, portfolio coordination, transformation, or a comparable role in a global environment.
* Proven experience driving multiple concurrent initiatives involving business, IT, delivery teams, and external vendors.
* Strong project governance capabilities, including planning, milestone control, RAID management, dependency management, executive reporting, and benefit tracking.
* Exposure to Mechanical CAD and engineering application ecosystems such as PTC, Autodesk, Bentley, simulation tools, PLM, or PDM is an advantage.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and Power BI; experience with project and work management tools is expected.
* Practical knowledge of Agile and SAFe ways of working. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, SAFe, ITIL, or equivalent certification is an advantage.
* A structured, proactive, collaborative, and outcome\-oriented working style, with strong attention to detail and confidence to challenge constructively.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.

title: Fast-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

This role is responsible for supporting any new company code, mergers, acquisitions, and divestments by ensuring that acquired entities are efficiently integrated into the target CFIN architecture in alignment with business objectives.

The role requires close collaboration with Finance, IS Architecture, M\&A integration teams, and external vendors to ensure seamless system integration, data consistency, process standardization, and compliance with ABB standards. The architect will also contribute to automation and optimization initiatives to improve testing automation and operational efficiency within the CFIN environment.
   

  

 The work model for the role is:
   

  

 This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Team Leadership \- Lead, mentor and develop the R2R and M\&A Solution Architect team, Set clear priorities, accountabilities and delivery expectations across the team, Build strong functional capability and promote effective collaboration across workstreams
* M\&A \& Legal Entity Delivery \- Lead CFIN delivery for acquisitions, divestments, company\-code onboarding and separation activities, Coordinate migration, mapping, reconciliation, testing, cutover and post\-go\-live activities, Ensure cross\-functional dependencies with O2C, P2P, Treasury, Tax, MDG and technical teams are managed effectively
* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Coordination \- Work closely with Global Process Owners, Process Architects, M\&A teams, Finance, MDG, technical teams and external partners, Ensure agreed designs and requirements are translated into executable delivery plans, Resolve delivery blockers and drive alignment across teams where ownership or dependencies span multiple areas
* Delivery Assurance \& Operational Readiness \- Ensure solutions are fully tested, documented and operationally ready before deployment, Validate that agreed controls, reconciliation requirements and business acceptance criteria are met, Lead resolution of critical delivery and production issues during cutover and stabilization
* Continuous Improvement \- Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, automation and standardization across R2R and M\&A activities, Drive reusable approaches for testing, migration, onboarding and cutover, Use lessons learned from previous deployments to improve future delivery.


**Qualifications for the role:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science or a related field
* 12–15\+ years of SAP Finance experience with strong knowledge of SAP Central Finance and/or S/4HANA Finance
* Strong functional expertise in Record\-to\-Report, including General Ledger, close, reconciliation, intercompany and financial reporting
* Experience delivering complex M\&A, divestment, legal\-entity onboarding or Finance transformation initiatives
* Strong experience across testing, data migration, reconciliation, cutover and stabilization
* Proven experience leading Architects or senior functional teams
* Strong delivery management, stakeholder management and decision\-making capability
* Ability to manage complex cross\-functional dependencies and drive issues to resolution
* Strong communication skills with the ability to operate effectively across Finance, business, technical teams and external partners

title: Project Manager
description:
Position Title: Project Manager
 



 Department: Project Management / Execution
 



 Reports To: Head – Projects / COO
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 The Project Manager is responsible for end‑to‑end project planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, safety adherence, and cost control. The role requires strong leadership, cross‑functional coordination, client management, and the ability to manage multiple teams and subcontractors.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project Planning \& Initiation** 




 \- Develop comprehensive project execution plans, schedules, and budgets.
 



 \- Review engineering designs, BOQ, drawings, and technical specifications.
 



 \- Identify project risks and prepare mitigation plans.
 



 \- Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and finance teams.
 



  





**Project Execution \& Monitoring** 




 \- Lead the execution of all project phases to meet timelines and quality standards.
 



 \- Monitor progress using MSP/Primavera and ensure adherence to baseline schedules.
 



 \- Conduct regular review meetings with site teams and contractors.
 



 \- Resolve site bottlenecks and ensure smooth project flow.
 



  





**Contractor \& Resource Management** 




 \- Finalize work packages, contractor scopes, and resource allocation.
 



 \- Oversee contractor performance, productivity, and compliance.
 



 \- Verify work measurements, certifications, and billing.
 



  





**Quality \& Compliance** 




 \- Ensure adherence to QAP, ITP, and company quality standards.
 



 \- Conduct quality audits, inspections, and review NCRs with corrective actions.
 



 \- Ensure compliance with technical specifications and statutory requirements.
 



  





**Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)** 




 \- Enforce HSE standards across site operations.
 



 \- Ensure site safety plan implementation and regular audits.
 



 \- Promote a strong safety culture through toolbox talks and training.
 



  





**Commercial \& Cost Control** 




 \- Manage project budgets, cash flow, and material consumption.
 



 \- Identify cost‑saving opportunities and prevent cost overruns.
 



 \- Support procurement in vendor finalization and technical evaluations.
 



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 \- Act as the single point of contact for clients, consultants, and authorities.
 



 \- Conduct progress review meetings and manage approvals.
 



 \- Handle escalations and ensure high client satisfaction.
 



  





**Reporting \& Documentation** 




 \- Prepare daily/weekly/monthly progress reports and MIS.
 



 \- Maintain project documentation, contracts, and communication logs.
 



 \- Support management with dashboards, presentations, and closure reports.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Educational Qualification** 




 \- Bachelor’s Degree in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.
 



 \- PMP / PRINCE2 certification preferred (optional).
 



  





**Experience** 




 \- 10–20 years of experience in project management.
 



 \- Experience in Solar EPC / Industrial / Infrastructure / Power projects.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 \- Expertise in MS Project or Primavera.
 



 \- Strong understanding of engineering designs, drawings, and construction practices.
 



 \- Knowledge of QA/QC standards, contracts, and safety norms.
 



 \- Strong commercial and project costing knowledge.
 



  





**Behavioral Skills** 




 \- Excellent leadership and decision‑making capabilities.
 



 \- Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills.
 



 \- Ability to manage multi‑disciplinary teams.
 



 \- High adaptability and problem‑solving mindset.
 



  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 \- On‑time project delivery
 



 \- Budget adherence and cost control
 



 \- Quality compliance and minimal rework
 



 \- HSE performance and zero‑incident record
 



 \- Client satisfaction and approvals
 



 \- Contractor performance and productivity
 



 \- Documentation accuracy and timely reporting

description:
Senior Project Lead
   

  

 Project and Development Services – (Chennai/India)
   

  

 What this job involves:
   

  

 Leading projects to success
   

  

 As Senior Project Lead you’ll take total responsibility for the overall success of major
   

  

 projects—guiding teams in each phase to achieve outcomes that exceed clients’
   

  

 expectations and meet JLL’s commercial objectives. Driven and ambitious by nature, you
   

  

 have a mastery of the ins and outs of business—from products and systems to processes,
   

  

 tools and best practices. You’ll need to collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholders,
   

  

 leading from the front while also taking the time to understand their point of view.
   

  

 For each project, you’ll establish an effective organisational structure for reporting,
   

  

 communication and working procedures, and ensure that clear objectives and quality
   

  

 control systems are in place. You’ll lead a project team that is highly motivated, eager to
   

  

 contribute, and in sync with the stakeholders’ mind\-sets. You’ll also attend project
   

  

 meetings, submit monthly reports, and monitor project budgets, so an eye for detail and a
   

  

 structured approach to tasks will serve you well.
   

  

 Making clients our first priority
   

  

 The best person for this job is one who always considers what’s best for our clients. As
   

  

 such, you’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying
   

  

 their needs, requirements and constraints. While you act in the clients’ best interests
   

  

 throughout the project duration, you must make sure that the project’s revenue and
   

  

 payment cycles are properly managed.
   

  

 Keeping an eye on business opportunities is also among the highlights of the job. Do you
   

  

 have a knack for building rapport with prospects? Your expertise in surveying a client’s
   

  

 needs and supporting the preparation of PM proposals is key. Likewise, skilfully
   

  

 developing relationships with other company business lines is a must; we achieve are
   

  

 biggest success when working together, so clear communication is key, as is
   

  

 collaboration and team work.
   

  

 Maintaining the JLL legacy
   

  

 We uphold excellence in everything we do—that has been essential to our more than 200
   

  

 years of staying power. As the person in charge, your task is to continue our tradition of
   

  

 project success. You’ll accomplish this by creating a network of professional consultants
   

  

**Who Can Deliver The Required Scope Of Every Project.**
 Likewise, you’ll handle contract administration of all vendors professionally and according
   

  

 to legal requirements. It’s the best way to protect both our and the clients’ commercial
   

  

 interests. Your expertise will also be central in identifying project risks and mitigating
   

  

 them. Furthermore, you’ll be responsible for developing project\-related reports, analyses
   

  

 and reviews regularly.
   

  

 Sound like you?
   

  

 Our successful Project Managers ...
   

  

 Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their
   

  

 perspective.
   

  

 Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
   

  

 Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
   

  

 Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
   

  

 Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
   

  

 To apply you need to be:
   

  

 Project\-smart and technology\-savvy
   

  

 We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a
   

  

 degree in any property\-related discipline, and at least 10 to 12 years’ experience in
   

  

 design, construction or project management.
   

  

 Are you technology savvy? As the digital leader in project management, we use a range
   

  

 of technology platforms to deliver our projects.
   

  

 Do you have a deep understanding of the legal environment for each project in respect to
   

  

 planning, commercial aspects, and delivery? If your answers are ‘yes’, then you’re already
   

  

 one step ahead.
   

  

 A natural communicator
   

  

 This role calls for superior communication skills, as we’ll expect you to be able to handle
   

  

 complex conversations with business owners, senior executives, and decision makers. We
   

  

 believe in clear and straightforward communication and strong empathy and EQ at all
   

  

 times. Of course, you’ll be good at building team relationships and interacting effectively
   

  

 with stakeholders in and out of the organisation.
   

  

 What we can do for you:
   

  

 At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.
   

  

 We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your
   

  

 full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your
   

  

 ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits
   

  

 package.
   

  

 Apply today!

title: Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 As a Project Manager at Holmes AI, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving projects from initiation to completion. You will work closely with the leadership, technology, product, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the expected quality standards. The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, takes their work seriously, values the opportunity, and is comfortable working with flexibility in a fast\-paced startup environment. You should be highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of keeping multiple stakeholders aligned. A basic understanding of website development and technology projects is preferred. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding requirements, coordinating with technical teams, tracking progress, and identifying and escalating issues.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and manage projects from planning and execution through completion.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate closely with the Tech/ Engineering team to ensure timely execution of development\-related projects.
* Manage website development projects at a superficial/project\-management level, including requirements, timelines, content, design, development, testing, and launch coordination.
* Translate business requirements into clear tasks and actionable deliverables for the relevant teams.
* Track project progress, identify delays or dependencies, and proactively drive resolution.
* Coordinate between leadership, technology, product, design, marketing, and other teams as required.
* Conduct regular project follow\-ups and ensure owners are accountable for their deliverables.
* Maintain project plans, trackers, documentation, meeting notes, and status updates.
* Identify project risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate them appropriately.
* Coordinate testing and bug\-fixing activities with the Tech team before project releases.
* Track bugs and ensure they are assigned, prioritised, followed up on, and closed within agreed timelines.
* Ensure projects are delivered with the expected quality and attention to detail.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on project status, risks, timelines, and key decisions.
* Help establish and improve project management processes and ways of working as the company scales.
* Be flexible in handling changing priorities and take ownership of urgent or high\-priority requirements when needed. Required Skills \& Qualifications
* 3\+ years of experience in Project Management, Program Management, Operations, Product Operations, or a similar role.
* Strong project planning, coordination, execution, and follow\-up skills.
* Experience working with technology or software development teams.
* Basic understanding of website development and the overall software development lifecycle. ● Ability to understand requirements and convert them into clear tasks and timelines.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving blockers.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Strong working knowledge of project management and collaboration tools.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience working in a B2B SaaS, AI, technology, or startup environment.
* Experience managing website development or software implementation projects.
* Basic understanding of APIs, frontend/backend development, QA/testing, and product releases.
* Experience coordinating with external vendors, developers, designers, or agencies.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and a bias toward action.



  





  





**What We Value** 




  





 At Holmes AI, we are looking for someone who sees this as more than just a job.
 



  





 We value someone who:
 



  




* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Takes the job seriously and is committed to delivering high\-quality work.
* Values the opportunity to work in an early\-stage, high\-growth company.
* Is dependable and follows through on commitments.
* Is comfortable working with flexibility when business priorities require it.
* Is proactive, resourceful, and willing to go beyond their defined responsibilities when required.
* Communicates openly and takes accountability for outcomes.
* Is comfortable working in an environment where things are being built, changed, and improved continuously.



  





  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
 


* Projects delivered on time and within agreed scope
* Project milestone and deadline adherence
* Timely coordination and follow\-up across teams
* Bug resolution and release readiness
* Project execution quality
* Stakeholder satisfaction and communication
* Timely identification and resolution of project blockers
* Documentation and project tracking accuracy
* Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and changing priorities
* Overall contribution to improving project execution and operational efficiency

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**Brief Team/department Description**
 Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R\&D project management team, which coordinates cross\-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change\-inspired leader, to lead R\&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 This role will report to the R\&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R\&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R\&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R\&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.
   

  

 The role holder will lead cross\-functional initiatives to enhance R\&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology\-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R\&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R\&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement \& simplification opportunities.
   

  

 The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross\-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
   

  

**Principle Responsibilities**
* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO\-R\&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month\-on\-month project forecasts and manage CSO\-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R\&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R\&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co\-own the Long\-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R\&D opex, capex, and product\-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage\-wise Probability of Technical \& Regulatory success.

 Strong, hands‑on experience with
