**PROJECT DIRECTOR – HERITAGE DESTINATION DEVELOPMENT \& IMPLEMENTATION** 




**Move On Heritage Planner \| Thrissur, Kerala** 




**About Move On Heritage Planner** 




 Move On Heritage Planner is a new venture of Move on Leisure and Travels (India) Pvt. Ltd., a professionally managed Travel Management Company based in Thrissur, Kerala, serving travellers since 2008\. The venture aims to preserve and activate Kerala’s living heritage by developing selected Illams, Manas, Tharavads, ancestral homes and other heritage properties as distinctive destinations for weddings, cultural programmes, corporate events, photography, heritage dining and immersive experiences—creating sustainable value for property owners and local communities.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an accomplished Project Director to lead the end\-to\-end development and implementation of Move On Heritage Planner. The Project Director will translate the approved project vision and business model into a professionally managed heritage destination network, balancing conservation, commercial viability, destination development and community participation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·        Lead project planning, implementation, milestones, budgets and performance monitoring.
 



 ·        Identify, assess and onboard suitable heritage properties in coordination with owners and technical experts.
 



 ·        Coordinate conservation, restoration, architectural, structural, environmental and heritage requirements.
 



 ·        Develop approved properties into professionally managed event and experience destinations while protecting their heritage character.
 



 ·        Oversee destination weddings, corporate events, cultural programmes, photography/film shoots, heritage dining and community events.
 



 ·        Drive marketing, sales, partnerships and business development with tourism, wedding, MICE, event and creative\-industry partners.
 



 ·        Manage relationships with property owners, government/local bodies, professionals, vendors, communities, artisans and institutional partners.
 



 ·        Monitor financial performance, revenue models, property profitability and commercial sustainability.
 



 ·        Promote local employment, local sourcing and responsible heritage\-event practices.
 



 ·        Oversee project reporting, digital records, dashboards, KPIs, risk management and operational performance.
 



**Candidate Profile** 




 ·        Graduate/Postgraduate in Architecture, Heritage Conservation, Civil Engineering, Tourism, Hospitality, Event Management, Business/Project Management, Development, Cultural Management, Economics or a related field.
 



 ·        10–15 years of relevant professional experience, preferably with 5\+ years in senior management or project leadership.
 



 ·        Demonstrated experience in at least two relevant areas: heritage/conservation, tourism destination development, hospitality/property management, event management, infrastructure/project implementation or business development.
 



 ·        Strong leadership, strategic planning, commercial understanding, stakeholder management, negotiation and multidisciplinary team\-management skills.
 



 ·        Knowledge of Kerala’s traditional architecture, cultural heritage and responsible destination development will be an advantage.
 



**What the Project Director Will Lead** 




 ·        Heritage \& Architecture
 



 ·        Property Development \& Management
 



 ·        Events \& Venue Operations
 



 ·        Marketing, Sales \& Business Development
 



 ·        Heritage Experiences, Culinary \& Cultural Programmes
 



**Success Measures** 




 Success will be measured through property onboarding, conservation implementation, venue activation, events and revenue, sales conversion, strategic partnerships, customer experience, local economic participation, sustainability and expansion from pilot properties to a Kerala\-wide network.
 



**Engagement Opportunity** 




 The position may be structured as a full\-time Executive/Project Director or, where appropriate, as a stakeholder/strategic partner with executive responsibility. The final arrangement will define authority, remuneration/returns, responsibilities and performance expectations.
 



**Official Designation** 




 PROJECT DIRECTOR – HERITAGE DESTINATION DEVELOPMENT \& IMPLEMENTATION
 



**Employment or Stakeholder\-Based Engagement Model** 




 The position of Project Director may be structured flexibly according to the ownership, investment and management requirements of Move on Heritage Event Planner. The Project Director may serve either as a full\-time employee/director of the company or as a stakeholder/strategic partner with an agreed ownership or investment interest, subject to the company’s legal structure and governing documents.
 



**Option A – Project Director as Employee / Executive Director** 




 ·        The Project Director may be appointed as a full\-time employee or Executive Director of the company.
 



 ·        The person shall receive agreed salary/remuneration and may be eligible for performance\-based incentives.
 



 ·        The Project Director shall exercise the responsibilities and delegated authority specified in this role description.
 



 ·        The appointment, remuneration, reporting relationship and delegated financial/operational powers shall be documented through an employment or service agreement.
 



**Option B – Project Director as Stakeholder / Strategic Partner** 




 ·        The Project Director may participate in the company as a stakeholder, shareholder, promoter, investor or strategic partner, subject to the applicable legal structure.
 



 ·        The role may combine project leadership with strategic, financial, business\-development or network\-building responsibilities.
 



 ·        Remuneration may be structured through agreed professional fees, profit share, incentives, dividends or other legally permissible arrangements.
 



 ·        The stakeholder arrangement should clearly define ownership, decision\-making rights, responsibilities, performance expectations, conflict\-of\-interest provisions and exit/transfer arrangements.
 



**Option C – Stakeholder with Executive Responsibility** 




 Where a stakeholder is appointed to lead implementation, the person may function as an Executive Project Director with day\-to\-day operational responsibility. The stakeholder’s ownership interest does not replace the need for clearly defined project targets, reporting requirements, delegated authority and accountability for results.
 



**Recommended Provision** 




 The company may retain the flexibility to appoint the Project Director either from within its professional management team or from among strategic stakeholders/investors, depending on the stage of the project and the expertise, investment capacity and leadership contribution required. In either arrangement, the Project Director shall remain accountable for the approved implementation plan and agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Incident & Change Management Coordinator
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a detail\-oriented, process\-driven professional to build out and mature our Incident Management and Change Management functions. These functions currently exist but lack formal structure\-this role will own the transformation from ad hoc handling to a disciplined, auditable, well\-governed practice. You'll design and implement the processes, approval workflows, and reporting that give engineering, IT, and leadership confidence that incidents are resolved consistently and changes are reviewed, approved, and tracked before they hit production. This is a hands\-on process\-and\-tooling role, not just a policy\-writing one. You'll be expected to build the actual workflows, forms, and automations inside our Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, and related apps) that make the new processes stick.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and reports directly to the VP, IT Infrastructure and Operations.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Incident Management**
* Formalize incident management processes: severity classification, escalation paths, communication protocols, and resolution SLAs
* Own the incident lifecycle in Jira Service Management (or Jira), from detection/logging through resolution and closure
* Drive post\-incident reviews (blameless retrospectives / RCAs), ensure action items are tracked and closed, and report on recurring themes
* Build dashboards and recurring reports on incident volume, MTTR, severity trends, and SLA compliance for leadership visibility


**Change Management**
* Design and implement a formal Change Management process, including change categorization (standard/normal/emergency), risk assessment, and CAB (Change Advisory Board) review cadence
* Build structured Jira workflows and forms to capture change requests, required approvals, rollback plans, and post\-implementation review
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams (AWS, M365, Atlassian, and internal platforms) to ensure changes are properly vetted before deployment
* Track change success/failure rates and use data to continuously refine the process


**Tooling, Automation \& Governance**
* Configure and maintain Jira workflows, schemes, automation rules, and Jira Service Management request forms to support both processes end\-to\-end
* Use Atlassian automation (Jira Automation, Confluence integrations, forms) to reduce manual steps\-auto\-routing, approval reminders, SLA breach alerts, ticket linking, etc.
* Maintain Confluence documentation: runbooks, process guides, RACI charts, and CAB meeting notes
* Establish approval workflows and audit trails that satisfy internal governance and any relevant compliance requirements
* Identify opportunities to integrate Incident/Change data with other systems (e.g., monitoring/alerting tools, CMDB\-type asset tracking) as the practice matures


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Act as the process owner and point of contact across engineering, infrastructure, and vendor/contractor teams for all things incident and change related
* Facilitate CAB meetings and post\-incident reviews, keeping them efficient and action\-oriented
* Train and onboard teams on new processes, driving adoption without becoming a bottleneck


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 3\+ years of experience in Incident Management, Change Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), or a Project/Program Management role with process\-ownership responsibility
* Hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products\-Jira and/or Jira Service Management required; Confluence experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience building Jira workflows, automation rules, and forms (Jira Service Management request forms or similar) \- this is not just "used Jira," but "configured Jira."
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-aligned incident and change management concepts (formal ITIL certification is a plus, not required)

title: Fiber Engineer
description:

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field is preferred.

title: Program Manager
description:
You can become a part of …
 



 Founded in 2018, BharatPe is one of India's fastest\-growing fintech companies, offering a comprehensive suite of financial products and services. What began as a single interoperable QR code has grown into a platform used by over 1 crore merchants across the country.
 



 At our core, we exist to drive financial inclusion and accessibility for the real Bharat, which is underserved by traditional finance and held back by complexity, paperwork, and products never designed for it. We are changing that, by building simple, accessible financial tools that meet people where they are, in the language they speak and at the scale they need.
 



 For our merchant partners, we provide an integrated ecosystem spanning QR and PoS payments, working capital credit, and deposit and investment products, enabling small businesses to accept payments, access finance, and grow. For consumers, we are building a fast\-growing set of offerings across UPI payments, Credit on UPI (BharatPe Flex), Personal Loans, and Invest (Digital Gold, Digital Silver, Fixed Deposits, and Mutual Funds), giving them a single place to pay, borrow, and grow their money.
 



 Together, these two sides of our business form a single mission: to bring the full power of digital finance to every merchant and every consumer across India, not just the few who have always had access. Alongside the business, we are equally committed to building an organization where people take genuine ownership, do their most meaningful work, and see their ideas realized at a national scale.
 



 We value diversity, and we encourage different points of view, ways of thinking, and new capabilities to strengthen and improve the lives of our customers. And that is not all. We have a lot of fun while we explore new ideas, solve real problems, collaborate, and connect, and we do it all together.
 



 Connect with us over social media, coffee, or a call. We would welcome the opportunity to tell you more.
 



 In this role, you have the opportunity to …
 



  Develop and implement strategies to ensure BharatPe’s merchant growth and TPV (GMV)
 



  Analyze market data and trends to drive data driven decisions
 



  Work closely with a team of dynamic and professional individuals
 



  





 Responsibilities will include …
 



 This role is part of the Central Merchant platform \& Growth vertical. The overall objective of this vertical is to identify and operationalize new products/ services/ initiatives that lead to growth in merchant platform and create new revenue streams.
 



  





 Functional Expertise
 



  





 DIY Merchant Network Growth
 



  End\-to\-End Lifecycle Management: Drive the acquisition, retention, and reactivation of merchants across the DIY (Do\-It\-Yourself) network.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**About Toyota Connected:** 




 If you want to change the way the world works, transform the automotive industry and positively impact others on a global scale, then Toyota Connected is the right place for you! Within our collaborative, fast\-paced environment we focus on continual improvement and work in a highly iterative way to deliver exceptional value in the form of connected products and services that wow and delight our customers and the world around us. Come help us re\-imagine what mobility can be today and for years to come!
 



**Job Description:** 




**SDV Strategy \& Roadmap** 



* Define TKM's SDV vision, roadmap, and execution plan in alignment with TMC and global Toyota strategy
* Translate business goals into prioritised SDV initiatives and milestones
* Drive phased execution across platform, applications, and lifecycle capabilities, benchmarking OEM strategies to keep the roadmap competitive



**Cross\-Functional Program Planning** 



* Identify priority SDV use cases (infotainment, OTA, digital key, VUI, connected services) with business, product, and engineering teams
* Define KPIs and success metrics, and ensure alignment across vehicle engineering, IT, and digital teams
* Establish program governance, milestones, and reporting mechanisms



**SDV Architecture \& Platform Planning** 



* Partner with engineering on SDV architecture (central compute, zonal, cloud integration) and the vehicle OS, middleware, API, and OTA stack
* Ensure alignment with global SDV platforms (Arene, QNX, Android, cloud ecosystems)
* Facilitate decoupling of hardware and software layers



**Ecosystem \& Partner Alignment** 



* Coordinate with global stakeholders (TMC, Woven, TMNA, TRI), Tier\-1 suppliers (Denso, Panasonic, AISIN), and technology partners
* Drive joint roadmap planning and integration alignment across the partner ecosystem



**Connected Operations \& Lifecycle Management** 



* Define lifecycle capabilities: OTA updates, feature enablement/disablement, subscription models, and feature monetisation
* Establish frameworks for release management, feature rollout, and post\-launch performance monitoring
* Use data\-driven insights to drive continuous improvement



**Business Case \& Value Realization** 



* Build ROI models covering cost reduction (ECU consolidation, software reuse) and new revenue (subscriptions, feature unlocks)
* Align the SDV roadmap with vehicle volumes, pricing strategy, and customer lifetime value



**Capability Building** 



* Identify gaps and drive capability development in SDV engineering (embedded, cloud, DevOps), tools, and testing frameworks
* Support creation of SDV labs, prototyping, and simulation environments



**You are a successful candidate if you:** 



* 10\+ years in automotive product planning, program management, or strategy — preferably with OEM or Tier\-1 experience in connected/SDV domains
* Bachelor’s in engineering (Computer Science, Electronics, or Automotive); MBA or equivalent business exposure preferred
* Understanding of SDV architecture — central compute, zonal ECUs, OTA, vehicle OS, and cloud integration concepts
* Experience driving cross\-functional programs spanning business, engineering, IT, and digital teams across multiple stakeholders
* Proven ability to build and execute technology roadmaps aligned with global platforms and localised for regional markets
* Experience with connected\-vehicle lifecycle management — OTA release planning, feature enablement, and post\-launch performance analytics
* Business acumen to build ROI models — ECU consolidation savings, subscription revenue, feature monetisation, and lifecycle value
* Excellent stakeholder management and program governance — experience with Japanese OEM culture, global affiliates, and cross\-region structures; able to define KPIs and report to senior leadership (familiarity with platform partnerships such as QNX, Android Automotive a plus)



**What is in it for you?** 



* Top of the line compensation!
* You'll be treated like the professional we know you are and left to manage your own time and workload.
* Yearly gym membership reimbursement \& Free catered lunches.
* No dress code! We trust you are responsible enough to choose what’s appropriate to wear for the day.
* Opportunity to build products that improves the safety and convenience of millions of customers
* Cool office space and other awesome benefits!



**Our Core Values: EPIC:** 




**Empathetic:** 
 We begin making decisions by looking at the world from the perspective of our customers, teammates, and partners.
 



**Passionate:** 
 We are here to build something great, not just for the money. We are always looking to improve the experience of our millions of customers
 



**Innovative:** 
 We experiment with ideas to get to the best solution. Any constraint is a challenge, and we love looking for creative ways to solve them.
 



**Collaborative:** 
 When it comes to people, we think the whole is greater than its parts and that everyone has a role to play in the success!
 



 To know more about us, check out our Glassdoor page\-https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Reviews/TOYOTA\-Connected\-Corporation\-Reviews\-E3305334\.htm

title: Program Manager
description:
**Full\-Time \| On\-site \|** Bengaluru


As the Program Manager for Digiicampus, you will drive end\-to\-end delivery across multiple modules, connecting customer insights with engineering execution and ensuring strong product adoption. You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Product, Development, and Marketing to turn institutional requirements into impactful solutions for **Parents, Students, Teachers, and Administrators**.


This is a full\-time, high\-ownership role focused on delivery, stakeholder alignment, customer satisfaction, and high NPS.

  


**Roles \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


**Requirements Gathering \& Discovery**
---------------------------------------


* Own the end\-to\-end requirements gathering process by working closely with the Customer Success SPOC to understand institution\-specific needs, workflows, and pain points across all four stakeholder groups.
* Translate customer conversations and feedback into structured, unambiguous Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) that the development team can act on immediately.
* Prioritize incoming requirements based on customer impact, feasibility, and business goals, maintaining a clear and updated backlog at all times.


**Coordination \& Delivery Management**
---------------------------------------


* Serve as the primary bridge between the Customer Success team and the development team, ensuring requirements are communicated clearly, dependencies are tracked, and delivery timelines are met.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, and scope changes, and resolve them before they cascade into delays.
* Manage task tracking and sprint progress visibility using project management tools (ClickUp / JIRA), ensuring all stakeholders are always informed.


**Release Management \& Communication**
---------------------------------------


* Author detailed, customer\-friendly Release Notes for every feature or update shipped, ensuring accuracy and clarity for institutional stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the Marketing team for timely announcements and roll\-out communications that help educational institution customers understand, adopt, and get value from new features.


**Feature Adoption \& Product Health**
--------------------------------------


* Monitor which modules and features are actively being used by educational institutions, and proactively investigate gaps — understanding why certain features aren’t being adopted and bringing these insights back to the product and CS teams.
* Define and track success metrics including NPS, module adoption rates, and support ticket trends to continuously measure customer satisfaction and product health.


**Must Haves**
--------------


* 3–6 years of experience in a Program Manager, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role, preferably in a SaaS or technology product environment.
* Demonstrated ability to independently write clear, structured PRDs or functional specifications.
* Strong coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as JIRA, ClickUp, Asana, or equivalent.
* A structured, process\-oriented mindset with a strong bias for timely delivery and follow\-through.


**Good to Have**
----------------


* Prior experience in EdTech or working with educational institution customers.
* Exposure to Figma or ability to read and interpret design wireframes.
* Experience crafting release notes or customer\-facing product communications.
* Understanding of feature adoption tracking and basic product analytics concepts.
* Genuine interest in education and the impact technology can have on learning outcomes and institute operations.


**Digii's Commitment to You**
-----------------------------


* Make a real impact on how educational institutions across India operate.
* Competitive pay and an open, high\-trust culture built on passion and excellence.
* Learn and collaborate with top entrepreneurs, technologists, and education leaders.
* Grow with the organisation as projects scale across multiple customers.
* Performance is measured by impact, not hours.


### **Ready to make an impact? Let’s build the future together.**

title: Program Manager
description:
**Role Title:** 
**Program Manager / Sr. Program Manager**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India (Primary site leadership responsibility); relocation provided if need
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Executive Leadership \- Managing Director India Operations
   

  

**About This Role**
 Veradigm India has a lot of transformation underway. AI\-augmented capability hub building, integrated operations and operational excellence, talent development and culture building programs \- each with its own stakeholders, timelines, and interdependencies. What we need is someone who can hold all of that together.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue across Veradigm India's most important initiatives. You will partner with the key stakeholders, keep the assigned programs on track, surface risks before they become problems, and make sure the MD India has an accurate picture of where things stand.
   

  

 This role carries real strategic weight. You will be the person who ensures that Veradigm India's most important transformation programs do not just get started \- they get finished, on time, to the standard we set, with measurable outcomes. You will need to read situations accurately to inform and influence senior stakeholders. The right person for this role has key awareness of organizational culture, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, persistent, and politically aware \- someone who brings structure to complexity and credibility to every room they walk into.
   

  

 In essence, this role will drive execution of one or more major programs (strategic project or a group of strategically aligned projects), ensuring that commitments are delivered on time, within scope, to budget, and to the required quality standards. Operating at the most senior level with customers and/or internal stakeholders; managing business changes and implementing business strategies to meet the goals and objectives of the organization and our clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with HRBP and Culture leads to program\-manage Veradigm India’s associate culture building programs \- including culture and fun initiatives, sports and wellness, communication skill\-building, and other engagement initiatives \- owning the program plan, tracking milestones, coordinating across stakeholders, and reporting outcomes to MD India.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to program\-manage Veradigm India’s CSR and sustainability commitments \- ensuring initiatives are scoped, funded, tracked, and delivered with the same rigor as internal transformation programs, and that impact is documented and visible to leadership and the broader organization.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to program\-manage the campus hiring program \- maintaining the calendar, coordinating between TA and business leaders, monitoring execution quality, and flagging risks before they slip.
* Partner with the India Leadership Team to coordinate cross\-functional transformation workstreams \- capability building, operational improvement, and strategic initiatives \- take on program management of the execution\-heavy workstreams, bringing structure, tracking, and stakeholder coordination from kickoff through delivery \- ensuring each has a clear plan, an active owner, and is on track to deliver.
* Maintain a single, reliable view of all India transformation programs \- milestones, risks, decisions, and open items \- that executive leadership can trust at any point in time.
* Facilitate governance forums and working sessions that are purposeful: right people in the room, decisions made, actions assigned and followed through.
* Define and document program scope, objectives, and success metrics at program launch. Manage scope changes and escalate impact on timelines or deliverables as needed.
* Prepare crisp, decision\-ready program updates for executive leadership \- calibrated to what the audience needs to act, not just status summaries.
* Identify and escalate risks early, with context and a proposed path forward. Drive continuous improvement in how programs are planned and executed across India Operations.


**Success Metrics**
 Within 12 months, this Program Manager will be expected to demonstrate:
   

  

* Programs delivered on time and within scope \- with milestones tracked, risks surfaced early, and no surprises to leadership.
* All three workstreams (AI\-augmented capability hub building, integrated operations and operational excellence, talent development \& culture building programs) have active plans, clear owners, and status visible to MD India at any time.
* Governance cadence in place at a program level \- working sessions are purposeful, decisions are logged, and actions are followed through within agreed timelines.
* Stakeholder partners (HRBP, TA, ILT, Operations and Transformation) report that coordination is adding value \- reducing friction, not creating it.
* Executive updates and program communications are consistently clear, accurate, and decision\-ready \- not followed up for clarification.
* Risks and issues are raised proactively, with a recommended path forward \- not surfaced after they have already become problems.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
**Experience**
* 3\+ years of cross\-functional program management work experience
* Experience in healthcare, health tech, SaaS, IT services, or regulated industries strongly preferred
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2 or similar project management certification will be added advantage


**Key Skills And Leadership Traits**
* Can hold ten things at once and not drop any of them. Multi\-program coordination is the core of this role.
* Knows how to build a clean workplan, run a useful governance meeting, and write a crisp executive update \- without being asked twice for any of them.
* Metrics driven – drives measurable and outcomes driven processes
* Good at working with people, not around them. Your job is to help partners succeed, not to take their work over.
* Communicate at the right level for the right audience. Your executive update is sharp and to the point. Your working session with a team lead is detailed and collaborative.
* Can hold stakeholders accountable. You know how to follow up without making people feel managed.
* Well versed how to use LLM tools including Claude and is capability of augmenting work with AI .
* Proficient in MS Office \- PowerPoint, Excel, and Teams in particular


**Education**
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline is a plus \- but not required if the experience demonstrates the right thinking
* Tier\-I institute will be preferred (results matter more than resumes)


**Our Values**
 We talk about values a lot at Veradigm. But we mean them as operating principles, not wall art. Here is what they look like in practice.
   

  

* Better Starts with Different: The best thinking at Veradigm has always come from people who see things differently. We are not looking for conformity. We are looking for perspective.
* Unreasonably High Standards: We set the bar high \- not because we enjoy pressure, but because the work we do affects real patients and real clinicians. That matters.
* Outcomes that Matter: We are not here to be busy. We are here to move things. If the work is not making a real difference, we ask why and we change it.
* Make Decisions and Own Them: We do not hide behind process or wait for permission. We make the call, we own what happens next, and we correct course when we need to.
* No Silos, No Handoffs: When something needs to get done at Veradigm, the right answer is never 'that is not my team.' We stay in the conversation until it is resolved.


**Benefits**
 Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.
   

  

* Quarterly Company\-Wide Recharge Days
* Flexible Work Environment (Hybrid)
* Peer\-based incentive “Cheer” awards
* Tuition Reimbursement Program


 To know more about the benefits and culture at Veradigm, please visit the links mentioned below: \-
   

  

 https://veradigm.com/about\-veradigm/careers/benefits/
   

  

 https://veradigm.com/about\-veradigm/careers/culture/
   

  

 Veradigm is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce.
   

  

 Thank you for reviewing this opportunity! Does this look like a great match for your skill set? If so, please scroll down and tell us more about yourself!

Are you ready to join us and create the future? Come as you are, do what you love—start your journey with us today!

Resource \& Capacity Management: Resource planning, utilization tracking, and dependency alignment

Help track project financials, monitor expenses, and ensure resources are used efficiently.


Communication: Effective communication skills. Establish/conduct regular cadence with the PMO Process Lead and the Area Project Manager. Help raise issues needing attention around project hygiene, staffing, quality, risks, and issues.

Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 3\+ years' experience in project management.

OR equivalent experience.

title: Program Manager - Settlement Operations, Settlement Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is a fast paced, dynamic company with an ambition to be the world's most customer centric company in the world. Within Amazon India, Amazon's Payments team supports hundreds of millions of customers and millions of merchants in their payment needs by providing the most trusted, convenient and rewarding payment experience. We aspire to make Digital Payments accessible to every Indian. The Transaction Settlement Unit (TSU), part of the Payments team, Manages payment reconciliation for Amazon India’s Escrow and nodal accounts. This role sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and finance. The responsibilities include:  

  

* Ensuring transactions in the PPI Escrow and Nodal accounts are compliant with regulatory guidelines
* Managing end\-to\-end reconciliation to identify discrepancies, establish root causes, and drive resolution through cross\-functional stakeholder coordination
* Forecasting cash requirements, monitoring fund sufficiency in escrow accounts, and coordinating with Treasury, Finance, and business teams to ensure uninterrupted fund availability
* Front\-ending regulatory and statutory audits for escrow accounts and reporting to the regulator
* Preparing leadership updates and writing business requirement documents (BRDs) to define and drive automation and process improvement initiatives
* Conducting UAT and providing launch support to ensure business readiness for new system deployments

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Manage the planning, execution, and delivery of reconciliation programs, ensuring timely resolution of financial discrepancies and compliance with established processes of Nodal and Escrow accounts
* Conduct deep dives into transaction data and financial metrics to identify anomalies, root causes, and opportunities for process improvements


\-Monthly substantiation\- Daily identification, deep dive, escalation and closure of exceptions by partnering with various world\-wide teams  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders including finance, operations, and technology teams to align on project goals, mitigate delivery risks, and drive consensus on solutions
* Lead internal and external and regulatory audits of these accounts
* Advise business teams in launch of new products and capabilities w.r.t potential impact on these accounts
* Closely work with accounting and finance to ensure accurate representation in entity accounts
* Drive continuous improvement and automation
* Ensure ongoing compliance with guidelines and become backup of processes to ensure business continuity.

  

A day in the life  

Each day brings new challenges in transaction settlement operations. You might start your morning analyzing settlement data to identify reconciliation gaps, then transition to facilitating a working session with accounting and technology partners to resolve a complex discrepancy. Your afternoons could involve updating stakeholders on program status, documenting process improvements, or diving into financial metrics to surface potential risks before they impact operations. You'll work closely with team members who value analytical rigor and collaborative problem\-solving.  

  

About the team  

The Transaction Settlement Operations team plays a critical role in maintaining the financial integrity of Amazon's transactions. We work at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, solving complex reconciliation challenges at scale.  

  

Our culture values precision, innovation, and collaboration. We're building the future of settlement operations by implementing automated solutions and refining processes that handle millions of transactions. Join a team where your analytical skills and program management expertise will directly contribute to operational excellence and financial accuracy.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* Master's degree or equivalent
* 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams
* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification preferred.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Program Manager-Building India
description:
**I. About NationBuilding platform**




  





 As a not for profit initiative, Nationbuilding platform is committed to inspiring youth to pursue purpose driven careers, strengthening public service delivery and developing the country's next generation of public leaders. Through the NationBuilding platform, the Foundation engages over 1,00,000\+ students across 6,500\+ colleges.
 



  





 The foundation is working towards realising its vision through flagship initiatives like:
 



 ●
 **Case Study Competition:** 
 The largest undergraduate case study competition in India engaging students to solve challenging problem statements on
 **Education, Sports, Public Health etc.** 




 ●

 An annual national forum that brings together
 **policymakers, defence personnel, educationists, industry leaders, and youth delegate** 
 s to deliberate on India's development priorities and inspire pathways for public leadership and nation\-building.
 



 ●
 **Impact Chapters:** 
 Through this the foundation has established
 **a footprint in the top educational institutes of the country like IIT Delhi, IIT Kharagpur, Sri Ram College of Commerce, Dr. Ram Manohar Lohiya National Law University among others.** 
 Chapter Leaders champion and implement NationBuilding’s vision on the campuses, mobilising students to design and lead initiatives that create measurable impact while fostering civic leadership.
 



  





 These along with other high impact initiatives, provide a continuous pathway from policy ideation, to leadership development and community action.

 As the foundation scales, building strong, engaged student communities becomes central to our growth. The

 . This role requires a high\-ownership individual who can both design youth engagement initiatives and carry them through end\-to\-end along with the team.
 



  





**III. Roles and Responsibilities** 




 ●
 **Strategic conceptualization and program design:** 
 Architect zero\-to\-one initiatives by translating broad organizational goals into structured methodologies. Define the strategic roadmap, target outcomes, and core vision prior to on\-ground rollout.
 



 ●
 **Program execution and on\-ground management:** 
 Lead the end\-to\-end execution of our initiatives. Establish clear operating frameworks, timelines, and accountability mechanisms to ensure consistent, high\-quality delivery across institutes.
 



 ●
 **Building systems, reporting and impact measurement:** 
 Build scalable operating systems including reporting structures, documentation processes, and performance dashboards. Track participation, engagement, retention, and impact metrics to ensure data\-backed decision\-making and disciplined growth.
 



 ●
 **Community ecosystem building:** 
 Define and architect NationBuilding’s campus community model across awareness, participation, and leadership stages. Design structured engagement pathways that move members from discovery to ownership, ensuring long\-term depth, identity, and coherence across campuses and platforms.
 



 ●
 **Team management:** 
 Build and lead a team of young associates.
 



  





**IV. Desired Skills** 




 ●
 **Structured Problem Solving:** 
 Should be able to tackle complex situations through effective and structured problem solving and out\-of\-the\-box thinking, with the ability to propose practical solutions

 Drive clear and structured communication, and manage relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders, including vendors, agencies, and others

 \- Exceptional self\-drive, passion and a proactive approach to work \- \- Flexibility to undertake ad hoc tasks and adapt to evolving priorities in a dynamic environment Possess uncompromising integrity and ethical principles
 



 ●

 Display the requisite leadership qualities to take ideas forward
 



 ●

 Exhibit a strong bias for action, adapt quickly to dynamic situations and demonstrate exceptional commitment in a demanding work environment
 



  





**V. Eligibility** 




 ● At least 4 years of experience across operations, project development and execution roles
 



 ● Combine an impressive academic record with strong consulting skills

title: Assistant Project Manager, Nagpur
description:
**Who is Turner \& Townsend?**




 All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.
   

  





**Our purpose:**




**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**




 The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.
   

  





**Our values:**




**Love a challenge:** 
 We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.
   

  





**Stronger together:** 
 We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.
   

  





**Bring out the best in everyone:** 
 We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 About the Role
   

  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead and deliver large\-scale projects from planning through execution, commissioning, and handover. The role will be responsible for driving project performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and stakeholder management while ensuring successful project completion within defined timelines and budgets.
   

  





 The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and extensive experience managing multidisciplinary teams and complex projects.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Project Planning \& Execution
   

  




* Lead end\-to\-end project execution from project initiation to final handover.
* Develop project plans, schedules, resource plans, and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress and ensure milestones are achieved as per approved timelines.
* Drive project performance and ensure delivery within budget and quality parameters.
* Review construction methodologies and implement best practices for project delivery.



 Budget \& Cost Management
   

  




* Prepare and monitor project budgets and forecasts.
* Track project costs and ensure effective cost control measures.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities without compromising quality and timelines.
* Review contractor bills, change orders, and project expenditures.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Manage relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and present progress updates to leadership.
* Address project challenges proactively and ensure timely resolution of issues.



 Contract \& Commercial Management
   

  




* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project specifications.
* Evaluate variations, claims, extensions of time, and commercial risks.
* Coordinate with procurement, contracts, and commercial teams for project requirements.
* Support negotiation and management of project\-related contracts.



 Team Leadership
   

  




* Lead cross\-functional teams including engineering, procurement, planning, quality, safety, and construction teams.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
* Mentor and develop team members to build high\-performing project teams.



 Quality, Safety \& Compliance
   

  




* Ensure compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies.
* Drive Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) compliance across project sites.
* Conduct periodic reviews to ensure adherence to project quality plans and safety standards.
* Ensure timely closure of quality and safety observations.



 Risk Management
   

  




* Identify and assess project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Maintain project risk registers and monitor critical risk areas.
* Escalate major risks and issues to management with recommended solutions.



 Reporting \& Governance
   

  




* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Monitor project KPIs and report variances.
* Ensure documentation and project records are maintained accurately.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and governance requirements.


**Qualifications**

 Education \& Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree/MBA in Project Management or Operations preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is an advantage.



 Experience Required
   

  




* 15\-20 years of experience in Project Management.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale projects worth ₹100 Cr\+ (or equivalent).
* Experience in Construction, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Data Centers, Industrial, Commercial Fit\-Out, EPC, or Engineering Projects preferred.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders, contractors, and project teams.


**Additional Information**

 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
   

  





 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

**Job Title**

**Job Description Summary**
 This Role is part of PDS\-Investors Team, and selected candidates will be working on project management consultancy or construction management projects managed by Cushman \& Wakefield.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Develop comprehensive Project Strategy, Execution Plan, and Master Schedule in alignment with Schneider Electric’s targets.
* Translate RFP scope into actionable work packages for Civil, PEB, MEP \& Infrastructure.
* Monitor progress against milestones, proactively flag delays, and prepare recovery plans.
* Daily monitoring of site progress across Civil, PEB, MEP, Infra \& Interior packages.
* Ensure strict adherence to FM Global standards, SE guidelines, safety norms \& quality protocols.
* Drive site housekeeping, logistic planning, manpower utilization \& contractor performance.
* Lead \& coordinate PMC team: Planning, Project Engineers, MEP, Safety \& QS.
* Facilitate daily/weekly coordination meetings with the client and other stakeholders
* Ensure design deliverables are released timely – no work stoppage due to drawing delays.
* Communicate issues \& escalations with professional clarity and solution\-oriented approach.
* Track and ensure compliance for Labour laws \& IR, ESIC, PF, Medical \& Insurance, Excavation, Royalty, Labour License and Environmental – CGWB, PCB
* Maintain audit\-ready records for legal, HR, Finance \& statutory inspections.
* Implement and drive QA/QC plan, QAP adherence \& inspection protocols.
* Review and sign off Test certificates, Calibration reports and NCRs, Site Instructions, Observation Reports
* Support ISO 9001, 14001 \& OHSAS audits with corrective actions.
* Deep involvement with Safety Engineer for, Daily safety rounds, Work permit system, Toolbox meetings and High\-risk activity control
* Immediate reporting of critical safety breaches to SE leadership within 2 hours.
* Manage project budget and cost adherence.
* Validate contractor RA bills with PMC QS/Planning teams.
* Track cash\-flow, change orders, claims, and cost deviations.
* Drive value engineering initiatives for cost and time optimisation.
* Maintain complete project documentation of Drawings, QAP \& QC records, Approvals, Change logs and Safety \& compliance records
* Prepare Daily \& weekly progress reports, Monthly Executive Summary for Schneider Leadership and Risk registers and mitigation plans
* Ensure contractor resource deployment, productivity and performance.
* Validate the availability of manpower, machinery \& materials.
* Ensure strict schedule adherence for long\-lead items (PEB, Transformer, Panels, DG, HVAC etc.).
* Lead final punch list closure with all consultants \& vendors.
* Drive testing \& commissioning of all equipment.
* Ensure submission of, As\-built drawings (CAD \+ PDF), O\&M Manuals, Stability Certificate, Completion Certificates and Warranty certificates
* Prepare the final Project Closure Report \& Lessons Learned Document.


**About You**
* Proven experience in industrial construction (Factories, PEB, MEP, Infrastructure).
* Strong understanding of FM Global requirements.
* Excellent leadership \& stakeholder management abilities.
* Expertise in Project planning (MS Project/Primavera), Cost control, Compliance \& safety management and Quality systems (QAP, NCR handling, audits)
* Ability to manage large teams and multiple contractors simultaneously.
* Strong communication, negotiation \& decision\-making skills.
* Mandatory experience in at least 3 Greenfield/Brownfield industrial projects.
* Exposure to FM Global guidelines is essential.
* Experience working with multinational clients is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical Engineering.


**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**
 As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;
   

  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


 We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
   

  

 We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

description:
**Description**
 Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company? If so, come join us at Amazon.
   

  

 ShipTech is the connective tissue, which connects Transportation Service Providers, First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile to facilitate the shipping of billions of packages each year. Due to criticality of the ShipTech systems, world\-wide (WW) Amazon business organizations work with ShipTech every year to deliver their programs for network expansion, operational efficiency improvement, new feature delivery to enhance customer/operator experience, compliance asks, etc. WW requestors submit intakes to deliver: (1\) on\-boarding new shippers, carriers, and services to the shipping network, (2\) facilitating package movement and tracking in Amazon and third\-party (3P) network, (3\) changes in carrier artifacts like a label and manifest, (4\) carrier configurations like routing codes, account ids, and (5\) custom tech\-builds for meeting business specific asks delivered by ShipTech every year (6\) support improvement in the quality of Amazon’s worldwide shipment infrastructure by defining the usage, configuration, and standardization of transportation milestones
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to be a part of our effort to drive program for improving visibility and tracking capabilities for Amazon shipments. Our mission is to be a partner and enabler to Amazon Operations by improving shipment tracking logic and capabilities for different legs of logistics, customer messaging, validation of transportation milestones, enable logic for automated shipment workflows and improve quality of shipment tracking within and outside Amazon partners. This role gives an opportunity to work closely with Business team, Operations stakeholders, Tech teams, recipient experience teams and Senior Leaders to manage and deliver for Amazon businesses.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Drive improvement in worldwide shipment infrastructure by defining the usage, configuration, and standardization of transportation milestones.
* Drive initiatives to improvement accuracy of shipment visibility for improving improve customer experience
* Conducting evaluation of existing workflows and drive initiative to be Amazon central authority on workflows
* Identify and execute data driven workstreams to identify gaps in current infrastructure (Both tech and business rules) and define future state along with roadmap
* Improve the worldwide customer experience and operations visibility through accurate and informative delivery status of milestones.
* Execute our program and project initiatives, while providing great internal customer support and driving consistency, help us continue to support our initiatives, and identify process improvement opportunities
* Work with a variety of cross\-organizational stakeholders which includes worldwide Transportation, ATS, AMZL, Customer Service, Customer Experience, Product, and Tech teams.
* Communicate project statuses and updates across a global audience. Experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization
* Manage competing priorities and drive alignment with leadership from different teams to implement the optimal solves for worldwide network


 A day in the life
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be detail\-oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple stakeholders at once, able to work independently, and maintain professionalism under pressure. This role will need to have knowledge in analytical skills and in excel. The Program Manager will be passionate about their work, detail\-oriented, and have good problem\-solving abilities. This position will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have project\-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy\-to\-understand way.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a team of program managers who work across 20\+ platform tech teams. Our stakeholders are transportation teams across regions. We contribute to several large\-scale high\-visibility programs each year such as network expansion projects like market place launches and carrier launches, and new feature build outs to provide enhanced customer experience or better operational efficiencies. We also support several compliance programs across our worldwide stakeholders. We are looking for a Program Manager to work with global business customers and our engineering teams to support intake requests related to new carrier on\-boarding and ship method integrations.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

title: IOT Project Manager
description:
Job Description Job Title: IoT Project Manager 
 Department: Program / Product Management Reports To: Head of Product / VP Engineering 
 Location: Baner, Pune (India) Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Experience Level: 610 years, incl. IoT projects 
 About Us We build a modular, industrial-grade environmental monitoring infrastructure that uses cutting edge technology with a full IoT and cloud stack, deployed at scale (1,000+ units) across construction sites, urban streets, and smart-city environments. We are looking for an IoT Software Developer to build and maintain the cloud-connected telemetry systems that power every device in the fleet — from the MQTT based communications with the on-board industrial controller through to the cloud data pipeline & robust backend systems. 
 Key Responsibilities Program & Requirements Management Own the delivery plan for the program end-to-end: physical architecture, industrial controller/embedded software, IoT telemetry, cloud platform, and Application Front end. Translate the Engineering Requirements Specification into actionable workstreams, milestones, and acceptance criteria across hardware, embedded, and cloud teams. Track scope across the product variants and configurations, ensuring a shared core architecture is maintained while variant-specific requirements are met. Maintain the project schedule, budget, and risk register; report status to leadership and, where applicable, strategic/manufacturing partners. Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination Coordinate hardware engineers, embedded developers, cloud/software teams, industrial designers, and manufacturing partners to keep interdependent workstreams aligned. Own the interface between engineering and the cloud/API team to ensure fleet-management platform features (device onboarding, telemetry, RBAC roles, spare-parts logistics, API integrations) are delivered on schedule. Coordinate with certification/compliance stakeholders on cybersecurity requirements (TLS/mTLS, OTA signing, RBAC). Deployment, Service & Scale Readiness Plan and oversee pilot deployments, capturing field feedback on installation, service workflows, and feeding it back into engineering. Support rollout of the service workflow (technician authentication, guided maintenance checklists, tool/spare-part tracking) in partnership with service and training teams. Drive readiness planning for scaling to 1,000+ connected devices: manufacturing capacity, spare-parts logistics, cloud/IoT infrastructure scalability, and fleet-management processes. Manage risk and issue resolution across project in coordination with engineering and QA. 
 Required Skills & Experience 6–10 years of project/program management experience, including delivery of connected hardware or IoT products (not purely software projects). Demonstrated ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams spanning mechanical/structural, electrical, embedded software, and cloud engineering. Working knowledge of IoT architectures (MQTT, cellular/4G connectivity, cloud telemetry platforms) sufficient to plan and de-risk technical dependencies without needing to write code. Experience managing external manufacturing, hardware, or component suppliers, including quality and delivery tracking. title: Site Executive Engineer
description:
WHO ARE WE? California Burrito is a fast-growing QSR chain with 2500+ employees across 140+ locations across Bengaluru, NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune. We started in 2012 with a simple belief: no compromise, just real ingredients.Since then, weve been serving honestly good Mexican food while building a more wholesome,sustainable way to do fast food, including growing our own fresh ingredients. Our mission is to become Indias most recognised name in Mexican cuisine while setting the standard for quality, speed and friendly hospitality. And how we get there matters just as much. We stay Open & Honest, Strive for Excellence, believe in Freedom with Ownership, andfocus on Growing Every Day. 
 THE OPPORTUNITY / ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on Site Executive to drive construction and design execution for our new stores. This is a site-based role for someone with a sharp eye for finishes who wont accept a wavy wall, a misaligned tile, or an off-spec laminate and who can work closely with vendors and contractors daily to deliver stores exactly as designed. 
 WHAT WILL YOU OWN? 
 Construction & Design Execution Execute store fit-outs as per approved GFC drawings civil, interiors, electrical, plumbing,HVAC, and kitchen installation. Ensure design intent is translated accurately on site: materials, finishes, colours, lighting, and detailing match the brand specification. Maintain high standards of workmanship inspect finishes (tiling, painting, carpentry,cladding, false ceiling) at every stage, not just at handover. Identify deviations from drawings early and resolve them with the architect / Project Manager before rework becomes costly. Lead snagging: prepare detailed snag lists and drive contractors to close them fully before handover. 
 Vendor & Contractor Management Work closely with contractors, fabricators, and material vendors on a daily basis align them on scope, quality benchmarks, and timelines. Conduct sample / mock-up approvals for key finishes before bulk execution. Track vendor deliverables, follow up on material deliveries, and resolve on-site coordination issues between agencies. Verify work measurements and contractor bills against BOQs. 
 Project Coordination Monitor daily site progress against the project schedule; report slippages and risks to the Project Manager. Maintain site documentation: progress photos, quality checklists, trackers and MIS. 
 WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? 
 Youre self-driven and naturally take initiative. Youre comfortable figuring things out, takingchallenges head-on and owning what happens next.You think entrepreneurially, move with intent and dont need to be told every next step. You can bring people along, step up when something needs leadership and stay open to being challenged yourself. 
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 Bachelors degree or diploma in Civil Engineering. 2-3 years of on-site execution experience in interior fit-outs QSR, retail, F&B, or hospitality preferred. Strong ability to read and execute from GFC, MEP, and detail drawings. Demonstrated eye for finish quality and detailing; knowledge of materials and finishing standards. Proven vendor / contractor handling negotiation, follow-up, and quality enforcement on site. Willingness to be on site full-time, travel across cities, and work to tight launch deadlines.

title: Program Manager - Monitoring and Evaluation
description:
**About Sol’s Arc**
 Sol’s ARC is a registered NGO working to ensure that every child learns and every adult earns through inclusive education and vocational skilling. For over 20 years, we have partnered with governments, donors, and communities to create systemic change and equity for persons with disabilities.
   

  

 Our work spans inclusive education, vocational skilling, and systemic advocacy with government bodies at state and national levels — with a reach of over 4 million beneficiaries. This role sits within our Programs function, driving data\-informed decision\-making that strengthens the impact and credibility of our work.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We are looking for an experienced Program Manager with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in program documentation, data collection, and monitoring \& evaluation. Experience or understanding working on developing web\-based or app\-based program management monitoring systems is desirable. This role is central to how Sol’s ARC tracks, measures, and communicates its impact — managing documentation systems, designing data frameworks, and translating data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You will work closely with Program, M\&E, and Technology teams to ensure accurate, timely reporting aligned with organisational and donor requirements.
   

  

**Approximately**
**HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME**
**30% – M and E Systems, Documentation \& Reporting**
**30% – Data Analysis, Quality Checks \& Program Monitoring**
**20% – Data Collection and Management**
**20% – Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Capacity Building**
**What You’ll Actually Do**
**M and E systems, Documentation \& Reporting**
* Ensure all data collection systems and tools are aligned with program goals and reporting frameworks.
* Design M \& E forms and tools
* Develop dashboards, MIS reports and presentation for internal and external stakeholders
* Collaborate with technology teams to develop or integrate tools that support streamlined data collection, tool design and data management.
* Prepare program and donor reports with well\-documented data, analysis, and evidence of impact
* Prepare regular program briefs based on surveys and assessments that support programmatic development and strategic decision\-making.
* Provide support in development of proposals
* Develop logframes, define indicators
* Track all program activities, milestones, and impact data


**Data Analysis, Quality Checks \& Program Monitoring**
* Analyse program data both quantitative and qualitative to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for program enhancement.
* Conduct data quality checks and validation
* Monitor program indicators and its progress
* Identify trends, gaps and areas requiring improvement or corrective action.
* Conduct field visits as and when required


**Data Management**
* Maintain detailed, organised records in a central repository that facilitate easy retrieval of information for team use and donor communications.
* Design and implement effective data collection protocols and processes for various programs, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and consistency.
* Ensure all data collection, storage and management follow data privacy and protection protocols.
* Coordinate with field/program teams on data requirements, data collection challenges, and gaps
* Ensure data collection is complete, consistent and usable for analysis


**Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Capacity Building**
* Conducting cross\-team discussions to understand program implementation and data collection challenges
* Provide M and E data and platform related technical support.
* building program teams capacity to collect, manage, and use data effectively
* Participate in team meetings, sharing insights, providing recommendations, and keeping staff informed on documentation and data management practices.
* Represent Sol’s ARC in donor reviews and external evaluations as required.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Program documentation is current, complete, and audit\-ready at all times.
* Data collection systems are consistently used by field teams with high accuracy and minimal errors.
* Donor reports are submitted on time with clear evidence of impact and no discrepancies flagged.
* Leadership has timely, reliable data to make informed decisions about program strategy and resource allocation.
* A culture of data\-driven reflection is embedded within program teams.


**What’s Hard About This Role**
* Building data collection habits in field teams with varying levels of digital literacy and capacity.
* Translating complex data into simple, compelling narratives for diverse audiences — from community workers to government partners to international donors.
* Travelling across rural and urban locations in India to support field teams and ensure data quality at source.
* Keeping pace with evolving M\&E frameworks, donor reporting standards, and technology tools in a fast\-growing organisation.


**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS**
* You will be the evidence backbone of programs that directly impact millions of children and adults with disabilities across four states.
* Your data systems and insights will determine how Sol’s ARC grows, adapts, and advocates for systemic change.
* You will build deep expertise in program M\&E, data management, and development sector reporting.
* You will grow within an organisation that values transparency, equity, and bold social impact.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* Qualifications – Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Data Science, Program Management, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Preferred / Added Advantage – Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel or Looker; experience with digital MIS or data management platforms.
* Experience – 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in program documentation, data collection, and analysis, preferably in a nonprofit or development sector organisation.
* Demonstrated ability to design and manage data collection processes across multi\-site programs.
* Prior experience in monitoring \& evaluation, donor reporting, and cross\-functional collaboration is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data insights into actionable program recommendations.
* Excellent organisational, written, and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Willingness to travel across rural and urban India to support field teams and data collection efforts.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Technical Project Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Head Office) \| Work from the office
 



  





**Experience:** 
 5 to 8 years
 



  





**Gynoveda** 
 is India's first Ayurveda fertility healthcare company. 50\+ clinics across India. 100\+ doctors—20,000\+ babies born through our treatment. We treat period health, PCOS, and infertility at the root cause, and we are expanding.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 The architecture is decided. The agency builds. You make sure what they build is right.
 



  





 You convert the blueprint into agency deliverables. You review the code and design that comes back. You catch what is wrong before it goes live. You run delivery sprint by sprint. You manage a team of two, a DevOps Engineer and a Website Specialist, and you work directly with the founders.
 



  





 This role needs range, not one deep specialty. ERP, integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, websites. You have worked hands\-on across most of these earlier in your career. Now you can review and question all of them without building any—one person, holding the entire stack accountable.
 



  





 We run on off\-the\-shelf tools, configured well. Custom development is the exception. If your first instinct is to build from scratch, this role is not for you. If your first instinct is to check whether the vendor configured the existing tool correctly, apply.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  




* Technical review of all agency deliverables: code, architecture, quality gates
* The integration layer connecting our systems: specification, build oversight, testing, go\-live
* Website platform evaluation, migration, and optimization
* Marketing technology integrations, validated with the marketing team
* Infrastructure decisions, executed through the DevOps Engineer
* Tool evaluation and recommendations across the stack
* Sprint tracking and delivery coordination with the agency



  





**What You Will Not Own:** 




  





 Product roadmap. ERP workflow design. BI strategy. Agency commercials. These sit with the founders and other leaders. You are the technical authority on delivery, not the strategist deciding what gets built.
 



  





**What You Must Bring:** 




  




* 5 to 8 years in technology roles, minimum 3 years managing outsourced development teams or agencies
* Vendor review experience with proof: you have found real problems in agency code or architecture and can walk us through specific examples
* ERP implementation or configuration on any major platform (ERPNext, Odoo, Zoho One, SAP Business One, NetSuite, Dynamics 365, or similar). ERP thinking matters more than the platform name.
* Database evaluation: schema design, query performance, MariaDB or Postgres familiarity
* Cloud infrastructure literacy, AWS preferred. Able to evaluate decisions even if not hands\-on daily.
* Integration patterns: APIs, webhooks, ETL, event\-based flows
* Experience where end users are non\-tech staff in physical locations: clinics, hospitals, retail, warehouses
* Configure first. Build only when configuration genuinely cannot solve it.



  





**This Role Is Not for You If:** 




  




* You manage timelines and status reports but have never personally reviewed vendor code or architecture
* You cannot recall a specific instance where you caught a vendor's technical mistake
* Your 90\-day plan centers on building a new product or app
* You have only managed in\-house engineering teams, never an agency or vendor
* You are a coder first. This role reviews and directs. It does not build.
* You have depth in one layer and no working knowledge of the rest



  





**Why Join:** 




  




* One person's technical judgment governs the entire stack. That person is you.
* Founders sit in daily operations. Decisions move in days, not quarters.
* The systems you keep honest serve real patients across 50\+ clinics.
* The network is expanding fast. The technology spine is being built now, under your watch.\|
