title: Lead Technical Program Manager
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**



We're seeking a strategic and execution\-focused Technical Program Manager to drive large, cross\-functional initiatives from concept through launch. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-team programs—such as platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, and major product launches—while defining clear milestones, success metrics, and sequencing plans. You'll partner deeply with Engineering to proactively manage dependencies, mitigate risk, and ensure technical and business alignment. This role also strengthens our execution systems by improving program transparency, standardizing launch rigor, and translating technical complexity into clear executive\-level insights.


**What you'll do:**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-team initiatives (e.g., platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, major product launches)
* Define milestones, critical paths, and measurable success criteria
* Break ambiguous initiatives into executable phases with clear sequencing
* Identify and manage cross\-team technical dependencies
* Proactively surface risks and tradeoffs with mitigation plans
* Run structured risk reviews and escalation processes when needed
* Participate in technical design discussions to understand architecture and constraints
* Ensure design reviews, capacity planning, and rollout strategies happen early
* Collaborate with EMs and engineers leaders to align on realistic timelines
* Establish program tracking mechanisms that create transparency without bureaucracy
* Standardize launch readiness, milestone reviews, and postmortem follow\-ups
* Identify systemic delivery bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement
* Provide concise executive updates with clear status, risks, and asks
* Maintain decision logs and documentation for key initiatives
* Translate technical complexity into business impact


**What you'll need:**


**Must\-haves**


* 6\+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or related roles in high\-growth technology companies
* 6\+ years of experience hands on experience as a software engineer
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum/SAFe or other delivery frameworks (with pragmatic application)
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-team, multi\-quarter technical initiatives
* Strong technical fluency (experience working closely with backend, infrastructure, data, or platform engineering teams)
* Ability to understand system architecture, dependencies, and engineering tradeoffs
* Proven track record of driving programs to completion in ambiguous environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior engineering leaders
* Excellent english written and verbal communication skills
* Experience implementing program management frameworks, milestone tracking, and risk management systems


**Nice\-to\-haves**


* Experience in platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, large\-scale migrations, GenAI Integrations, inference infrastructure, data pipelines, model deployment platforms
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Experience in scaling startups
* Experience improving delivery predictability metrics (e.g., on\-time delivery, scope control, forecast accuracy)

* Good knowledge of Information practices.

**Ability to commute/relocate:**


* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

* Connect with Talent Acquisition


* Meet with the Hiring Manager

Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI\-powered solutions connect health plans' strategic goals and providers' needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. title: Senior Program Manager, Global Quality Ops - Platform Integrity
description:
**About the Role**  

  

The PI Quality Operations team will own the end\-to\-end quality operating rhythm across the PI BPO footprint within the GSO network, including quality audits, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), calibrations, quality score governance, insight generation, and quality improvement interventions . The team's mandate is to ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, trusted, and actionable , while identifying the key drivers of performance and translating quality data into clear actions that improve agent performance and customer outcomes.
  

  

The Quality Operations Manager \- Platform Integrity (PI) will lead this team of approximately 5\-7 Quality S\-ladder team members and be accountable for the overall health and performance of PI Quality Operations. The manager will partner closely with BPO Operations, Vendor Management, Training, Program, Policy, Product, Analytics, and Global Quality stakeholders to strengthen quality governance, address systemic performance gaps, and ensure quality insights lead to measurable improvements in frontline execution.
  

  

**What You'll Do*** Own PI Quality performance across the BPO network , driving sustained improvement in Quality scores and building clear recovery plans for underperforming sites, queues, or agent populations.
* Ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, and trusted by owning audit governance, sampling effectiveness, evaluator accuracy, score integrity, and scoring consistency across the network.
* Lead audit, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), and calibration programs to improve evaluator accuracy, reduce scoring variance, and strengthen alignment across internal and BPO Quality teams.
* Turn Quality data into actionable insights by identifying key defect drivers, conducting root\-cause analysis, and translating findings into targeted actions that improve agent performance.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Operations, Training, Policy, Program, Product, and Analytics to address systemic Quality issues and improve processes, tooling, scorecards, and frontline execution.
* Drive continuous improvement and scalability by simplifying, standardizing, and improving Quality operating mechanisms across sites, markets, languages, and lines of business.

**Basic Qualifications*** 6\+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Operations within BPO, contact center, customer support, trust \& safety, risk operations, or a comparable high\-volume service environment.
* Experience managing Quality professionals and demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and performance\-manage a team.
* Demonstrated experience improving Quality scores through structured root\-cause analysis and operational interventions rather than solely monitoring or reporting performance.
* Strong understanding of Quality measurement integrity , including scoring consistency, inter\-rater reliability, evaluator variance, sampling methodology, and calibration.
* Proven ability to analyze Quality data, identify performance drivers, generate actionable insights, and translate findings into improvement plans.
* Strong understanding of BPO operating environments, including vendor governance, performance management, SLAs/KPIs, corrective action planning, and multi\-site operations.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and demonstrated ability to influence teams outside of direct reporting lines.
* Experience working with Quality monitoring platforms, CRM/customer\-service systems, and business intelligence or reporting tools such as NICE, Observe.AI, Tableau, Looker, Data Studio, or comparable platforms .

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience building or redesigning Quality scorecards, sampling strategies, calibration frameworks, or Quality governance models.
* Experience using statistical or analytical techniques to evaluate scoring reliability, performance variation, and Quality trends..
* Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or other Quality/process\-improvement certification is advantageous.
* Multilingual experience or experience supporting multilingual Quality operations is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**  

  

Success in this role means:
* PI Quality scores show sustained and measurable improvement.
* Quality scores are **trusted by Operations and BPO partners** as an accurate representation of frontline performance.
* Audit and ATA accuracy remain consistently high across the network.
* Evaluator variance decreases, and calibration alignment improves.
* Quality insights consistently identify the highest\-impact performance opportunities and lead to concrete operational action.
Quality interventions demonstrate measurable improvement in agent behavior and performance.

title: Program Manager II, ECR, NOC ECR
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership. This team aims to transform every executive escalation into a systemic improvement opportunity by conducting rigorous root cause analysis, driving timely CAPA closures, and identifying thematic defect patterns that convert to programmatic interventions — ultimately reducing repeat defects and elevating the end\-to\-end customer experience across Amazon India's operations.  

  

The individual in this role will own defined workstreams within the ECR program charter, collaborating with program, product, tech, BI, and Science partners to execute, validate, and deploy customer experience capabilities. This role will coordinate with teams across IN Ops to support the launch and adoption of bespoke product solutions within their assigned scope. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing moderate complexity and ambiguity. Successful candidates will have experience in Program Management, comfort working with cross\-organizational stakeholders, and the ability to manage competing priorities with appropriate escalation.  

  

As a Program Manager, you will own and deliver well\-defined workstreams and projects by coordinating with cross\-disciplinary teams to execute customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by understanding the broader vision, aligning your workstream to it, and driving execution — proactively identifying risks, flagging escalations, making day\-to\-day trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must decompose assigned projects into clear deliverables with functional specifications and execute them on time with minimal oversight. Good judgment, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence peers and partner teams are essential. Working knowledge of data analysis and SQL is expected. The role will also be expected to support Generative AI adoption within ECR — including implementing automated case summarization, contributing to pattern recognition for thematic defects, and supporting predictive escalation routing — executing on identified Gen AI opportunities that augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

They will be responsible for working with all Miles (LM, MM, FC), Multiple Program teams (ACES, DSP, IHS, FC), and Multiple Product teams (ROW APEX, DEX, RCX) to identify pain points and scope out large high\-impact solutions to improve Delivery Experience.  

  

They will be responsible for driving VP inquiries to closure within SLA with clear articulation of issue and recommended initiatives to arrest the root cause of the defect. They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.  

  

They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.  

  

They will implement and iterate on Generative AI solutions (e.g., automated case summarization bots, AI\-assisted root cause analysis, intelligent response suggestion engines) to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate VP inquiry resolution timelines — executing on use cases identified and scoped by leadership

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Program Manager II (Cost To Serve), RBS : Cost To Serve
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and maintenance of new and existing artifacts focused on analysis of requirements, metrics, and reporting dashboards.
* Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
* Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.

* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

description:
Job Description: EXL is seeking a hands\-on analytics implementation engineer to execute audit and QA work across web and app properties for a multi\-brand digital client. The role is responsible for running event validation, querying BigQuery for data quality issues, validating mobile tracking payloads, and maintaining tracking documentation throughout the engagement. This is an execution and delivery role for someone who is rigorous about accuracy, thorough in documentation, and comfortable working across GA4, GTM, AppsFlyer, and BigQuery.


  
Responsibilities: • Execute web audit checklist items: walk through each customer journey using GTM Preview and the browser DevTools network tab — product view, add to cart, checkout, purchase, sign\-in, and form submission. For each step, confirm the correct event fires with the right parameters.
  

• Validate GA4 events in DebugView: confirm event name, required parameters, correct data types, and absence of PII in parameter values.
  

• Run BigQuery data quality queries: surface (not set) volumes in source and medium, purchase events with missing values, duplicate events, and parameters that do not match the tracking spec.
  

• Support AppsFlyer event validation: cross\-reference AppsFlyer event logs against the tracking spec and document any discrepancies with evidence.
  

• Log all findings in the audit tracker: surface, category, root cause, evidence, and recommended fix. The tracker is the primary input to the gap report.
  

• Maintain tracking documentation: draft event tables, parameter definitions, and implementation code snippet templates from specifications provided by the engagement lead.
  

• Prepare status reporting: pull current metrics and format findings for governance meeting summaries, flagging any new anomalies since the previous update.
  

Required skills \& experience
  

• Google Analytics 4 — navigate reports, use DebugView in real time, build Exploration reports, and understand the purchase event structure.
  

• Google Tag Manager — use GTM Preview mode, read tag and trigger configurations, and identify firing issues.
  

• Browser DevTools (network tab) — filter for the GA4 collect endpoint, inspect request payloads, and identify missing or malformed parameters.
  

• BigQuery and SQL — write queries against GA4 event export tables to identify data quality issues and summarise results for reporting.
  

• Structured documentation — produce clear, consistent audit checklists, findings logs, event tables, and data dictionaries.


  
Qualifications: AppsFlyer — navigate the dashboard, read event logs, and cross\-reference attribution data against GA4\.
  

• Firebase DebugView — enable debug mode and validate in\-app events in real time.
  

• Experience producing audit deliverables or gap reports in a consulting or agency context.
  

• Familiarity with Android emulator or device\-based tag validation for app audit work.
  

Education \& experience
  

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  

• 2–5 years in digital analytics implementation or QA, with hands\-on use of GA4, GTM, and BigQuery.
  

• Experience in a consulting or agency delivery environment is preferred.

**Description**
 The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership. This team aims to transform every executive escalation into a systemic improvement opportunity by conducting rigorous root cause analysis, driving timely CAPA closures, and identifying thematic defect patterns that convert to programmatic interventions — ultimately reducing repeat defects and elevating the end\-to\-end customer experience across Amazon India's operations.
   

  

 The individual in this role will own defined workstreams within the ECR program charter, collaborating with program, product, tech, BI, and Science partners to execute, validate, and deploy customer experience capabilities. This role will coordinate with teams across IN Ops to support the launch and adoption of bespoke product solutions within their assigned scope. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing moderate complexity and ambiguity. Successful candidates will have experience in Program Management, comfort working with cross\-organizational stakeholders, and the ability to manage competing priorities with appropriate escalation.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will own and deliver well\-defined workstreams and projects by coordinating with cross\-disciplinary teams to execute customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by understanding the broader vision, aligning your workstream to it, and driving execution — proactively identifying risks, flagging escalations, making day\-to\-day trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must decompose assigned projects into clear deliverables with functional specifications and execute them on time with minimal oversight. Good judgment, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence peers and partner teams are essential. Working knowledge of data analysis and SQL is expected. The role will also be expected to support Generative AI adoption within ECR — including implementing automated case summarization, contributing to pattern recognition for thematic defects, and supporting predictive escalation routing — executing on identified Gen AI opportunities that augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 They will be responsible for working with all Miles (LM, MM, FC), Multiple Program teams (ACES, DSP, IHS, FC), and Multiple Product teams (ROW APEX, DEX, RCX) to identify pain points and scope out large high\-impact solutions to improve Delivery Experience.

They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.
   

  

 They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.

**Who We Are**
 We are a start\-up based out of Bengaluru \& Delhi NCR. We are engaged in development of next generation missions and technologies (NGM\&T) towards future warfare needs of the Indian defence forces. It is undertaking research towards enhancing persistence and autonomy for unmanned vehicles and robotic swarms. NRT’s product development portfolio includes a solar power stratospheric high altitude pseudo satellite (HAPS) unmanned platform and an air/ground launched stand\-off autonomous system.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Plan project communications – meetings, email etc. Facilitate key stakeholder updates. Create Minutes of Meetings.
* Create and maintain project management documents based on set templates according to ISO / AS9100 standards.
* Collaborate with the Systems Engineering(SE) Team to monitor and assess the technical progress of the project.
* Track project health and schedule as laid down in the WBS plans via task management / collaborative task management tools.
* Monitor KPIs / milestones laid down for the project. Generate a report for PM to review. Capture and share lessons learned through the execution of the project. Manage knowledge sharing between all stakeholders.
* Identify, report, and monitor project risks. Collaborate with Systems Engineering(SE) Team to assess technical risks.
* Work closely with the SCM and the finance teams to facilitate the procurement pertaining to the project. Monitor project expenditures and overall budget. Provide periodic updates via reports / dashboards.
* Conduct market surveys, gather information supporting submissions of EOI / RFP / RFQ and other bids and proposals.
* Creation of project status summary, project briefs, executive summaries etc. to facilitate management decisions.


**Must Have Skills**
* Prior experience of working in the UAV industry.
* 6\-7 years of experience in driving project planning and control roles.
* Has working knowledge of PM tools like Microsoft Project / Wrike / ClickUp / Jira / SAP etc along with resource loading and critical path analysis.
* Ability to work independently and productively with minimal supervision.
* Self driven and accountable for the delivery of work.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to assimilate information and create concise summaries and reports.


**Basic Requirement (education \& Relevant Experience)**
* Bachelor’s Degree (Aerospace/Aeronautics, Mechanical) in Engineering.


**Job Title: Senior Project Manager**
 Location: Bengaluru, India
   

  

 Department: Programme Management
   

  

 Reports To: Program Director
   

  

 Experience: 6–7 years (minimum one full project lifecycle in Aerospace/Defence domain)
   

  

 Qualification: B.Tech / B.E. (Mechanical / Aerospace / Avionics related streams preferred)
   

  

**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT)**
 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s fastest\-growing Aerospace \& Defence R\&D company, developing next\-generation intelligent, autonomous aerial systems and uncrewed platforms for national defence and allied sectors. At NewSpace, we combine deep systems engineering with rapid prototyping and agile program execution to deliver mission\-critical capabilities for the Indian Armed Forces and international partners.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Senior Project Manager – Defence Programs will be responsible for driving project tracking, documentation, compliance, and cross\-functional coordination across all internal teams (Engineering, Production, SCM, Quality, Legal, and Compliance). This role ensures on\-time and proactive coordination towards ensuring timely delivery of complex Unmanned Aerial Systems programs while maintaining aerospace standards, documentation rigour, and certification compliance.
   

  

 This position offers full lifecycle exposure to cutting\-edge defence programs — from development through certification and production — in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Tracking \& Coordination


 Own and maintain project trackers for deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and risk flags across multiple teams: Production, SCM, Quality, Engineering, and Support Functions.
   

  

 Drive schedule adherence, task allocation, and daily progress tracking through digital tools (ClickUp, MS Project, or equivalent).
   

  

 Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Engineering, Production, Finance, IT, Admin, etc) to resolve operational bottlenecks.
   

  

 Prepare weekly and monthly project dashboards, highlight critical path activities, and report delays or issues for leadership review.
   

  

* Documentation \& Governance


 Develop and maintain project documentation templates and stage\-gate deliverables.
   

  

 Ensure internal and external documentation compliance for design reviews, production milestones, and delivery audits.
   

  

 Maintain document version control and traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Support techno\-legal document reviews (NDAs, contracts, agreements) in coordination with paralegal/legal teams.
   

  

* Compliance \& Certification


 Support and track compliance to Aerospace Standards and Defence Quality Assurance (DGQA) requirements.
   

  

 Coordinate certification efforts for Type Certification of UAVs — including DGCA, EASA, and related regulatory bodies.
   

  

 Liaise with certification authorities and ensure documentation is audit\-ready and standards\-compliant.
   

  

* Legal, IP \& Licensing Coordination


 Interface with the legal and paralegal teams for techno\-legal reviews, NDAs, license agreements, and renewals.
   

  

 Support coordination of IP and patent filing activities related to project deliverables.
   

  

 Track industrial licenses – granted, pending, and renewal cycles – ensuring compliance and timely submission.
   

  

* PLM Implementation \& Process Digitization


 Participate in or lead the implementation of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools across the organization.
   

  

 Support tool evaluation, deployment, user training, and adoption for PLM systems such as ENOVIA, Teamcenter, or Duro.
   

  

 Work with cross\-functional teams to align PLM structures with ongoing project workflows and documentation needs.
   

  

**Project Management**
**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 Proven experience managing multi\-stakeholder technical programs.
   

  

 Strong understanding of deliverable\-based tracking and cross\-functional coordination.
   

  

 Proficiency in project management software (ClickUp, MS Project, JIRA, or equivalent).
   

  

**Technical \& Compliance**
 Awareness of Aerospace standards, Defence compliance frameworks, and certification processes.
   

  

 Understanding of production, supply chain, and quality workflows in aerospace/defence environments.
   

  

**Documentation \& Legal Interface**
 Skilled in technical documentation, version control, and techno\-legal review processes.
   

  

 Familiarity with IP filing coordination, NDAs, and industrial licensing is preferred.
   

  

**PLM Systems**
 Exposure to PLM tools like ENOVIA, Teamcenter, or Duro is desirable.
   

  

**Soft Skills**
 Excellent organizational, analytical, and stakeholder management abilities.
   

  

 High attention to detail, with a “track\-to\-close” mindset.
   

  

 Ability to thrive in a dynamic, cross\-disciplinary, and fast\-evolving R\&D setup.
   

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 6–7 years of experience in Aerospace, Defence, or Industrial Manufacturing programs.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to handle multi\-stakeholder project execution with discipline and accountability.
   

  

 Has seen at least two complete project lifecycles (from initiation to delivery or certification).
   

  

 Balanced combination of energy, maturity, and long\-term ownership mindset.
   

  

**Growth \& Opportunity**
**This Role Offers Unparalleled Exposure To**
 Full\-cycle management of defence and UAV system projects.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with certification and compliance frameworks.
   

  

 Participation in strategic initiatives like PLM implementation and process standardization.
   

  

 Opportunities to grow into Program Management, Operations Excellence, or Certification Management roles within NRT.

title: Project manager
description:
**We are Manufacturing the Future!**
 Geomiq is revolutionizing traditional manufacturing by providing engineers worldwide with instant access to reliable production methods through our digital platform. As the UK’s leading Digital Manufacturing Marketplace, we offer an AI\-powered B2B MaaS (Manufacturing as a Service) solution, seamlessly connecting buyers and suppliers to drive efficiency and innovation.
   

  

 With our headquarters in London and quality branches in India, China, and Portugal, we collaborate with leading brands like BMW, Rolls\-Royce, Brompton Bikes, and Google—even contributing to space exploration.
   

  

 Check out our website!
   

  

**Our platform:**
 Geomiq offers a revolutionary platform that completely digitizes the quoting and ordering process for custom manufactured parts, ensuring the highest operational and quality outcomes. Our primary customers include Design Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, and Procurement teams, all of whom are involved in creating the world’s most innovative products.
   

  

 See our platform in action!
   

  

**About the Role:**
 As a
 **Project manager** 
 at Geomiq, you will be the key liaison between our UK team, Manufacturing Partners, and Bengaluru Quality hub. Your role is to ensure seamless order fulfilment, optimize vendor performance, and uphold high\-quality standards.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the primary contact for manufacturing partners, ensuring they have the necessary resources and technical data.
* Experience in managing and dealing with vendors, specifically within the CNC or Sheet Metal area.
* Track production progress, address quality concerns, and mitigate delays.
* Oversee order execution, ensuring on\-time delivery and adherence to specifications.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and manage logistics between vendors, QC, and shipping teams.
* Ensure vendors understand customer design requirements and technical specifications.
* Facilitate technical communication between all stakeholders.
* Support quality assurance by guiding vendors and resolving pre\-shipment issues with the QC team.
* Provide feedback to improve vendor management systems and customer experience.
* Maintain confidentiality of Geomiq’s supply chain and customer data.


**Experience Required:**
* 2 to 5 years of experience
* Proven experience in project management, supply chain, or manufacturing operations.
* Strong background in vendor management, quality control, and logistics.
* Knowledge of CNC machining, fabrication, or precision manufacturing is a plus.
* Familiarity with quality assurance standards and Lean/Six Sigma methodologies.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.


**Benefits:**
* Competitive Salary: We provide a compensation package that reflects your skills, contributions, and the value you bring to our team.
* Professional Development: Grow with us through training programs, mentorship, and internal promotion opportunities to advance your career.
* Lunch and snacks provided.


* Leave and Holidays:
+ Public National Holidays: 10 public holidays
+ Earned Vacation Leave: Take advantage of 15 days of paid vacation annually to recharge and relax.
+ Sick Leave: Prioritize your health with 5 days of paid sick leave for medical needs.
+ Casual Leave: 7 days
+ Birthday Leave: Celebrate your special day with an extra day off just for you.

title: Specialist, Technical Project Management
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Specialist, Technical Project Management
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
**The Role**
 As a Senior Technical Project Manager at Vymo, you will lead our most complex, high\-value implementations for global financial institutions. You are the strategic face of Vymo to client leadership. You combine strong technical context with client empathy to turn complex requirements into smooth, on\-time go\-lives.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Client Delight \& Ownership: Own the full onboarding lifecycle for Tier\-1 global accounts from discovery to go\-live. Serve as the primary, trusted partner for client business and IT executives.
* Technical \& Integration Governance: Lead discovery on data flows, APIs, and middleware. Spot and resolve technical risks early in complex, regulated BFSI environments.
* Agile Execution \& Control: Run sprint cycles tied directly to business milestones. Owning scope, timeline, and change requests while enforcing strict engineering and security standards.
* Launch \& Hypercare: Drive go\-live readiness, code freeze, and deployment runbooks. Lead post\-launch hypercare, incident triage, and root cause analysis (RCA) to protect production stability.
* Leadership: Mentor junior project managers and refine Vymo’s global delivery playbook to scale best practices.


**What You Will Bring**
**Experience and Fluency**
* Industry Experience: 8–12 years of Technical Project Management experience, with at least 5\+ years in a B2B SaaS product company.
* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of managing product implementations within the BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) sector.
* Global Delivery: Demonstrated experience delivering implementations for US\-based enterprise clients while collaborating with India\-based Engineering and Product teams.
* Technical Depth: Ability to evaluate APIs, data flows, and middleware architecture from a delivery lens without needing an engineer to translate.
* Agile Mastery: Advanced operational knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and JIRA execution. PMP, CSM, or equivalent certifications are a major advantage.
* Enterprise Execution: Experience managing multi\-stream technical projects with complex client integrations.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into business value for executive stakeholders.


**Mindset and Traits**
* High Agency: Extreme ownership. You do not wait for roadblocks to clear—you proactively solve problems and drive outcomes independently.
* Customer Obsession: Deep client empathy with a commitment to turning complex implementations into positive customer experiences.
* \\"Solve the Issue\\" Attitude: Calm under pressure during incidents, focused on immediate resolution, root cause elimination, and continuous improvement.

title: AI Program Manager
description:

 Oxeva.ai is focused on building the AI workforce for enterprise organizations, combining human expertise with agent\-powered technologies to deliver measurable business outcomes. The company designs and deploys AI\-driven solutions that augment teams, streamline operations, and enhance decision\-making across functions. By emphasizing human\-led oversight, Oxeva.ai ensures responsible, transparent, and effective use of AI in complex enterprise environments. Team members collaborate closely with clients and technical stakeholders to create scalable AI programs that are outcome\-driven and aligned with strategic goals.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The AI Program Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing AI initiatives from concept to deployment, ensuring that projects meet defined business objectives, timelines, and quality standards. Day\-to\-day tasks include coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder communication, defining program scope and milestones, tracking progress, and resolving risks or dependencies. The AI Program Manager will collaborate with data science, engineering, product, and operations teams to align technical solutions with enterprise use cases and performance metrics. The role also involves documenting program plans, maintaining governance processes, and continuously improving implementation frameworks for AI agents and related workflows.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Program and project management skills, including planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience working with AI, data, or software engineering teams, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical deliverables.
* Strong communication, documentation, and presentation skills for engaging with enterprise stakeholders and cross\-functional partners.
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities to assess program performance, interpret data, and drive outcome\-focused decisions.

title: Project Manager, OPSENG
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. Amazon Projects team need to have in\-depth understanding of Project life cycle including span allocation for all the four pillars (assessment, design and detailing, Execution and Performance qualification) of any project. Some of the key aspects of the role are Site Selection along with the RE team, Project statutory and Legal compliances adherence, Project Safety both in terms of design and execution, value management for large and medium scale projects, executing various formats of technical projects\-green field, brown field and Improvement projects.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The candidate is required to lead the planning and execution of all building formats and will be for a specific region \- North India. The Project Manager role will be responsible for setting up new Centers across different business formats, capacity expansion of existing facilities as well as relocation of facilities as per business requirements. Additionally, the Project Manager will also drive 1 or 2 project management initiatives viz. Standardization, Energy Conservation programs, Productivity Improvement measures etc. and Project Financial processes.
   

  

 Project Manager will be responsible for the on time and safe delivery and hand over of facilities across business formats as listed above, ensuring that the project is executed with highest standards and good engineering practices. Other roles and responsibilities of the Project Manager will include
   

  

* Support RE Team in site visits and due diligence through site inspections for a feasibility assessment of setting up a facility for the given business format
* To work on finalizing the conceptual layouts and to assess the layout parameters from an operations perspective
* Preparing Developer’s Scope of Work for the site as per standards and specification
* Preparing Amazon scope of work and the cost estimate and preparation \& submission of Build out Capex request for approval.
* Finalization of Project Management Consultants
* Project resource planning and management through the appointed PMC or hired resources
* Work with Procurement team to evaluate and finalize vendors for the projects

title: Program Manager - Component & Sub-systems
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Program Manager – Components**
**Position Summary**
 The Program Manager for Components \& Sub\-Systems is responsible for the end\-to\-end execution and delivery of a defined portion of a Fluence product or program, such as an electrical component, electronic subsystem, battery\-related subsystem, power electronics module, charging system, embedded controller, software module, or technical workstream.
   

  

 This role is ideally suited to candidates with experience delivering electrical and electronic products through development, validation, manufacturing readiness, and production launch. The successful candidate will drive timing, quality, cost, and readiness objectives while coordinating across Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product Management teams.
   

  

 The Program Manager owns schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, supplier coordination, and launch readiness activities for their assigned scope and is accountable for ensuring successful integration into the broader product platform.
   

  

 Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in battery systems, energy storage systems and Control software developments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of assigned subsystems/workstreams from requirements through validation, launch and production readiness.
* Develop and manage program plans, schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies and mitigation actions to ensure on\-time delivery.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Management, and external suppliers.
* Coordinate subsystem integration and readiness across hardware, software, manufacturing, procurement and validation activities.
* Manage engineering changes, launch readiness, issue resolution, and provide structured status updates to leadership.
* Build stakeholder alignment, proactively escalate risks, and support regulatory, compliance, and customer deliverables.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is required.
* 3–7 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing or related technical roles.
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional delivery of hardware and/or software development programs.
* Experience managing Embedded software components, electrical and/or electronic components or subsystems through development, validation, supplier engagement, manufacturing readiness and production launch.
* Strong experience with schedule management, risk management, milestone planning, dependency management, and executive communication.
* Proven ability to drive execution and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience working within multinational engineering or product development environments.


**Strongly Preferred Experience**
 Candidates with hands\-on experience in one or more of the following areas will be strongly preferred:
   

  

* Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
* Battery Management Systems (BMS)
* Power Conversion Systems (PCS)
* Renewable energy plants
* Embedded software development
* Semiconductor Products
* Electrical/Electronic Subsystem Integration


**Preferred Skills**
* Component Lifecycle Management
* Product Validation \& Verification
* Manufacturing Readiness \& Production Launch
* Engineering Change Management
* Agile, Scrum, Stage\-Gate, or Hybrid Product Development Processes
* Embedded Software, Firmware, API, or Software Integration experience


**Preferred Certifications**
* PMP (Required)
* Scrum Master / Agile Certification
* SAFe Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification


**Candidates who have applied within the past six months need not apply.**
 Qualified candidates are requested to submit a resume and cover letter at careers@fluenceenergy.com for consideration.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
   

  

**Unleash Voices**
 We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
   

  

**Customer Fluent**
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
   

  

**Infinite Impact**
 We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
   

  

**All In**
 We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

title: Engineering Program Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
 As a Client\-Facing Program Manager at Broadcom\-Payment Security division, you will play a pivotal role in our mission to enhance payment security for our clients. You will be responsible for managing and coordinating programs, ensuring the successful implementation and ongoing support for our clients. Your expertise in the payment security industry, particularly in 3D Secure, will be critical in driving client satisfaction and maintaining our reputation as a trusted partner.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

  

* Client Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients in the payment industry, understanding their specific needs , working with them to create and manage the lifecycle of Statement of work.
* Program Management: Define and develop statement of work (SOW), Oversee the end\-to\-end execution of the projects, including planning, implementation, and monitoring progress to ensure on\-time and on\-budget delivery while working with multi\-geographical customers
* Risk Assessment: Assess potential risks in the plan, and work collaboratively with clients \& internal stakeholders to mitigate these risks effectively.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Service accounting, legal, product development, customer success team, Engineering and technical support, to ensure seamless integration and support of the solutions.
* Reporting and Documentation: Generate regular reports on program progress and performance, keeping clients informed and making data\-driven recommendations for improvements.
* Compliance: Ensure that all programs and solutions adhere to industry standards and compliance regulations, and guide clients in maintaining compliance.
* 3D Secure Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert in 3D Secure technology, keeping up\-to\-date with industry trends and regulations.


 Qualifications:
   

  

  

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science or a related field preferred.
* Proven experience as a Program Manager (8\-15 yrs) in the software industry with client facing experience is a mandatory requirement.
* Exposure to the payment security industry, with a focus on 3D Secure technology will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of payment security protocols, regulations, and best practices.
* Exceptional client\-facing and communication skills.
* Project management expertise, including proficiency in tools like Microsoft Project, Clarity, Rally Oracle Engagement Cloud, Oracle CPQ, Wolken\-soft
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess and mitigate security risks.
* Knowledge of industry compliance standards (e.g., PCI DSS, EMVCo, PSD2\) is a plus.
* Certifications in program or project management (PMP, PgMP) are a bonus.

title: Program Manager, EMEA and JAPAC Contingent Workforce
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Role Description
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is looking for an EMEA and JAPAC Contingent Workforce Program Manager to work on the Global People Operations team to manage EMEA and JAPAC CW strategy and operations. This position will report to the Global Contingent Workforce Sr. Manager and is a great opportunity for a talented individual who has the desire to associate with a fast\-growing company in a truly international environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 This position calls for someone who possesses a strong operations mindset, who loves improving processes, and proactively goes the extra mile to support and provide direction to our assignment managers and program stakeholders. This person is a self\-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and has a bias to action, follow\-up, and follow\-through. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, thrives in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented, collaborative environment, and executes with excellence.
   

  

* Partner with procurement, finance, IT and AP in developing processes and systems to effectively manage and support the contingent workforce in JAPAC and EMEA
* Guide and work with MSP, VMS and staffing providers to ensure business processes and procedures are being executed with excellence for quality hiring manager and candidate experience
* Hold MSP, VMS and staffing providers accountable to SLAs and KPIs
* Lead and administer CW projects with MSP, VMS and internal teams
* Manage and administer the end to end temp lifecycle for MSP out\-of\-scope countries (this includes but is not limited to requisition management, performance escalations, extensions, terminations, contracts and billing queries)
* Be a consultative advisor and educate the business on best practices when engaging contingent workers
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with organizational leaders and partners including in\-house employment counsel, organizational workforce management teams, privacy, procurement, AP and commercial counsel
* Onboard staffing agencies, facilitate RFPs and administer agreements in collaboration with legal and procurement
* Support Global Program Manager in the implementation of MSP and VMS services in JAPAC and EMEA countries
* Draft, develop and socialize CW policies and procedures
* Adhoc projects assigned by reporting manager


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in contingent/extended workforce management managing contingent workforce program projects, developing and implementing policies, and overseeing end\-to\-end contractor lifecycle (from hire to exit/conversion)
* 2\+ years of experience in partnering with procurement and legal to negotiate and finalize staffing agreements with staffing agencies and payroll providers
* Experience with cultural and/or organizational change management and transformation.
* An understanding of co\-employment risk between large multinational companies and a contingent/vendor workforce


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with implementing MSP and VMS programs in new countries (plus!)
* Experience in working with EMEA and JAPAC employment legal teams and enforcing policy compliance
* Experience in building and automating processes with agentic solutions (nice to have)


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Creative Operations Lead/Creative Project Manager
description:
We’re looking for a self\-starter to lead creative operations across copy, design, and branding for our Pune team at DeltaX. You’ll manage client requirements, translate them into actionable briefs, oversee the design team’s bandwidth and workflows, and ensure high\-quality, on\-brand delivery across accounts. Working closely with clients, designers, creative strategists, and product teams, you’ll bring structure and consistency to creative execution while ensuring projects are delivered on time and aligned with campaign and brand objectives. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities shall encompass:
 



  





**Year of experience: 3 to 5 years \| Salary Range: INR 9 LPA to 12 LPA** 




  






 Key responsibilities:
 



* Creative Ownership: Ensure quality, consistency, and brand alignment across copy, design, and branding; review outputs before client delivery.
* Client Management: Own creative communication with clients, translate requirements into clear briefs, and manage feedback through closure.
* Team \& Resource Management: Manage design team bandwidth, priorities, allocation, and timelines while proactively identifying capacity gaps.
* Project Management: Oversee creative projects end\-to\-end, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, and dependencies for timely delivery.
* Creative Operations: Build and maintain SOPs, templates, and workflows while identifying bottlenecks and improving execution.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work with designers, creative strategists, Product, Growth, and Strategy teams to deliver effective creative solutions and support pitches and presentations.



  






 Qualifications:
 



* 3–5 years of experience in creative project management, creative operations, or similar roles within an agency, brand, or digital marketing company.
* Strong client communication, project management, and resource management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Experience managing creative/design team workloads, timelines, and quality, with a strong eye for aesthetics, copy, and brand consistency.
* Understanding of digital advertising formats, creative best practices, and how creative impacts campaign performance.
* Experience developing or improving creative workflows, SOPs, processes, or playbooks, with a proactive problem\-solving approach.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment; event planning or brand activation experience is a plus.



  





**About DeltaX:** 




 DeltaX is a Data\-Driven Digital Advertising Platform built for Agencies and Advertisers to optimally plan, design, buy, track, attribute and report ad campaigns across search, social media, display RTB, Mobile, Video and other media channels. Founded in 2012, the platform serves as the pioneer in the Advertising Technology Industry. The cutting edge technology has empowered digital marketing teams across the globe with deep insights, automated ROI based spends optimization, activating award winning technology\- driven campaigns.

**F** 
**ictiv exists to help product innovators create**
 Fictiv is a global manufacturing company that simplifies sourcing for custom manufacturing, from prototype to low\-volume production. Through its highly\-vetted manufacturing network, AI\-powered technology platform, and global operations centers across the USA, Mexico, India, and China, Fictiv delivers fast, high\-quality custom manufacturing services from quote to delivery. Fictiv’s capabilities span the full mechanical bill of materials, including Injection Molding, Compression Molding, 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Die Casting, and Sheet Metal. To date, Fictiv has delivered more than 30 million commercial and prototype parts for early\-stage companies and large enterprises alike, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.
   

  

**Impact in this Role**
 Are you ready to shake up the world of customer service? Do you thrive on making connections and finding creative solutions? If you’re passionate about putting customers first in a dynamic, non\-traditional environment, we want YOU on our team!
   

  

 In your role as
 **Associate Customer Program Manager** 
 , you will be working directly with our US\-based customers, and you’ll be using your agility, problem\-solving skills, and customer service advocacy to help our customers increase the velocity and quality of products delivered. You will collaborate with the cross\-functional teams to resolve customer pain points, address customer needs, and help manage customer projects end to end. You will support multiple customers across a variety of manufacturing orders to be fulfilled in different regions around the world.
   

  

**Work Hours:** 
 9
 **:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)**
 This role follow a hybrid work schedule \- 3 nights in office, 2 nights remote
   

  

****What You Will Be Doing****
* Customer Management: You will be our customers’ best ally at Fictiv. Work closely with our customers to ensure a seamless and high\-quality experience. Nurture relationships and resolve issues to help drive customer loyalty.
* Case management: Concurrently manage a variety of manufacturing orders with multiple customers and the internal operations teams. Prioritize and resolve top user requests to address their product development needs and meet customer expectations for timing and quality.
* Communication: Gather, interpret, and communicate engineering, design, manufacturing, and logistics requirements to ensure the orders will be delivered on time and in full
* Collaboration: Collaborate with sales and the manufacturing operations teams to ensure successful delivery to the customer and advocate on their behalf \- through the project lifecycle, including post\-delivery exceptions.
* Program Management: Manage projects with top\-down oversight throughout the entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify improvement areas and collaborate with the cross\-functional team to prioritize and define solutions to increase our efficiency.


**Desired Traits**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA required.
* 4\+ years of experience in program management, project management, supply chain or customer\-facing operations roles.
* Experience supporting NPI, low\-volume production, or rapid prototyping programs.
* PMP/project management certification and understanding of project management/operations knowledge preferred.
* The work is fast\-paced \- you will be working in an operations environment with tight deadlines and high standards. You will need to be organized with good time management, prioritization skills and great attention to detail.
* We obsess over our customers \- you will need to be personable and have outstanding communications skills (both written and verbal) and be able to adapt your communication style effectively. Must be fluent in written and spoken English. Proven experience working directly with US\-based customers and/or during US business hours is preferred
* This role requires a self\-starter mentality. We want you to be excited by a hands\-on, high\-performing, results\-oriented role and driven to exceed expectations for our clients. Accountability is everything; you say what you do and do what you say.
* Aligned with our culture centered around continuous learning \- bring passion to learn about the manufacturing ecosystem and the New Product Development process.


**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.

* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Music
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad\-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on\-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa\-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.
   

  

 As a Sr. Technical Program Manager in the Amazon Music team, you will collaborate with product, engineering, marketing, design, content producers and artist/label relation teams to deliver customer obsessed engineering solutions with efficient use of resources and technologies. You will assess risks, anticipate bottlenecks, make tradeoffs, balance the needs of the business and technical constraints. You will be a role model enforcer of industry standard software development processes and practices. You will be the face to leadership to demonstrate progress and surface risks early.
   

  

 You possess a deep understanding of customer facing product design, mobile implementations, complex software services and will represent the technical team to senior leadership and partners. Your technical expertise, attention to details with regard to process efficiencies and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions and drive secure and robust solutions. You should not only be passionate about delivering great music experiences, but should also be obsessed with driving continuous process improvements to optimize product delivery. If you enjoy solving problems in a dynamic environment, influencing product, business and technical leaders with creative solutions, we want to talk to you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Drive implementation and delivery of large\-scale Music initiatives.
* Lead agile engineering and design teams to coordinate, prioritize and deliver the roadmap
* Understand service inter\-dependencies, mobile implementation nuances and lead cross\-functional teams towards technical solutions
* Clarify, prioritize and drive project commitments as well as establish and maintain clear chains of accountability
* Strong (executive) communication and presentation skills
* Articulate program goals, desired outcomes, risks and mitigation plans clearly
* Strong metrics based decision making skills
* Drive continued process improvements in the organization
* Strong JIRA/Asana skills
* Mentor junior employees and build effective teams


**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
