title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**About Valeo Health** 




 Valeo Health is a preventive healthcare and wellness platform operating across Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), offering diagnostics, teleconsultation, AI\-driven health insights, supplements, and care programs. We are building AI\-first, compliant, and scalable healthcare platforms that handle sensitive health data while delivering reliable, high\-quality customer experiences across geographies.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the POD that builds and operates Valeo's compliance and finance platforms across KSA and the UAE. Your POD owns the integrations that keep Valeo legal and running — connecting to national health data exchanges (NABIDH, Malaffi, Riayati, NPHIES) and to Saudi Arabia's ZATCA e\-invoicing (Fatoora) — end\-to\-end, from design and build through certification, go\-live, and ongoing operation.
 



  





 This is a backend\- and integration\-heavy role where correctness is non\-negotiable — regulators, auditors, and patients depend on it. Driving AI adoption is a must: you will build AI into the platforms and roll out AI\-assisted engineering across the team, while holding an uncompromising bar on data privacy and security (HIPAA, ISO 27001, UAE PDPL, KSA PDPL).
 



  





**The Mindset We Hire For** 




 These three traits matter more than any specific technology on your CV. If they don't describe you, this is not the right role.
 



 •
 **Ownership:** 
 You don't escalate problems — you bring solutions. When a regulatory deadline or an
 



 integration is at risk, you own it end to end until it's resolved.
 



 •
 **Deliver Results:** 
 You measure your POD in systems shipped, integrations certified, and reliability
 



 improved — not stand\-ups attended.
 



 •
 **AI\-Forward \& Quick to Learn:** 
 You actively adopt AI tools, get productive fast in unfamiliar
 



 regulatory domains, and bring AI into your team's workflow without compromising compliance.
 



  





**What We Expect from Our Engineering Managers** 




**Own Delivery \& Execution** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of compliance and finance integration platforms through a POD model.
 



 • Translate dense regulatory and tax requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans.
 



 • Balance speed, quality, reliability, and compliance — and know where there is zero tolerance for
 



 error.
 



**Build Reliable Regulatory \& Finance Integrations** 




 • Deliver and operate integrations with UAE health exchanges (NABIDH, Malaffi, Riayati) and KSA
 



 NPHIES, using HL7 / FHIR.
 



 • Build ZATCA e\-invoicing (Fatoora) Phase 2 — UBL / XML, cryptographic stamps, QR codes,
 



 clearance/reporting, and platform onboarding.
 



 • Engineer resilient, observable integrations — retries, idempotency, reconciliation, and monitoring
 



 against external platforms.
 



**Drive AI Adoption (a must)** 




 • Build AI into the platforms — document extraction, data mapping and validation, claims/coding
 



 assistance, invoice reconciliation, and anomaly detection.
 



 • Roll out AI\-assisted engineering (coding, review, test generation, agentic workflows) to raise team
 



 throughput and quality.
 



 • Establish safe patterns for AI on regulated data — no PHI/PII exposure to third\-party models, with
 



 evals and guardrails.
 



**Build Secure \& Compliant Systems** 




 • Ensure secure SDLC and data\-privacy requirements across services and AI systems.
 



 • Collaborate with Compliance, Security, and Legal on HIPAA, ISO 27001, UAE PDPL, and KSA
 



 PDPL.
 



 • Maintain audit readiness, certification, and documentation for regulator and government\-platform
 



 onboarding.
 



**Lead Teams Effectively** 




 • Manage and mentor a POD of 8–10 engineers.
 



 • Drive sprint planning, estimation, execution, and delivery predictability.
 



 • Upskill the team on applied AI and modern AI\-assisted engineering practices.
 



 • Make hiring decisions and grow the team in line with business priorities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own delivery and operation of compliance and finance integration platforms across KSA and UAE.
 



 • Own the roadmap for embedding AI into the platforms and adopting AI tooling across the team.
 



 • Manage certification, onboarding, and go\-live with regulators and government platforms.
 



 • Drive incident response, root\-cause analysis, and post\-mortems for integrations and AI systems.
 



 • Define and track reliability, data\-quality, and audit\-readiness metrics and SLAs.
 



 • Partner with Product, Compliance, Finance, and Legal on PDPL, HIPAA, and ISO 27001
 



 obligations.
 



 • Work with DevOps/SRE for uptime, scalability, and cost efficiency; hire and grow the team.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Experience** 




 • 5–10 years of software engineering experience, with a strong backend/integrations focus.
 



 • 2–4\+ years as an Engineering Manager or Senior Tech Lead managing 6 or more engineers.
 



 • Track record delivering compliance\-heavy or regulated integrations end\-to\-end.
 



 • Experience integrating with government or regulatory platforms is a strong plus.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong backend systems, APIs, and distributed / integration patterns — queues, retries,
 



 idempotency, reconciliation.
 



 • Healthcare data standards (HL7 / FHIR) and e\-invoicing/tax formats (UBL / XML), or ability to
 



 master them fast.
 



 • Applied AI: LLM integration, RAG, model serving and evaluation; plus AI\-assisted engineering
 



 tooling.
 



 • AWS or GCP, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and observability tools.
 



 • Data security, encryption, and PII/PHI handling; understanding of AI data governance.
 



**Leadership \& Mindset** 




 • Strong people\-management and stakeholder\-communication skills.
 



 • Proven ability to drive change and AI adoption across an engineering team.
 



 • Ability to operate in ambiguity while maintaining delivery discipline and a compliance\-first mindset.
 



 • High ownership, bias for action, and customer\-first mindset.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)** 




 • The required KSA and UAE health\-exchange and ZATCA integrations are live and compliant, on
 



 regulatory timelines.
 



 • AI is embedded in the platforms and in the team's workflow, with measurable gains in effort and
 



 quality.
 



 • Improved integration reliability and a reduction in production issues.
 



 • Clean audits, with audit\-ready documentation across owned systems.
 



 • Strong team growth — including at least one engineer ready for promotion within the year.
 



  





**Why Join Valeo Health** 




 • Build and scale mission\-critical compliance and finance platforms across international markets.
 



 • High\-impact role at the intersection of healthcare regulation, finance, and AI.
 



 • Clear growth path toward Senior Engineering Manager and leadership roles.

title: AI Business Consultant
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 Avaali Solutions is looking for an AI Business Consultant who will serve as the bridge between enterprise business challenges and AI\-powered solutions delivered through our proprietary Avagama platform. This role combines business consulting acumen with hands\-on platform delivery \- you will engage directly with customers to understand their processes, identify automation and intelligence opportunities, and own the end\-to\-end build of solutions including agentic AI workflows, intelligent document processing pipelines, and process orchestration layers.
 



 You will work within the Agentic AI \& Intelligent Automation Practice, collaborating with delivery teams, pre\-sales, and product engineering to position and deploy Avagama\-powered solutions across industries including BFSI, manufacturing, retail, energy, and facilities management.
 



  





**ABOUT AVAGAMA** 




 Avagama is Avaali's proprietary SAP\-aware enterprise process intelligence and agentic AI orchestration platform. It enables organizations to discover, analyze, and automate complex business processes by combining process mining, AI\-driven decision intelligence, and an agentic orchestration engine that can plan, reason, and execute multi\-step enterprise workflows autonomously. Avagama is designed for deep SAP integration while remaining vendor\-agnostic across ERP and enterprise landscapes.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Business Discovery \& Process Understanding** 



* Conduct structured discovery workshops with customer stakeholders to map current\-state business processes, pain points, and transformation goals.
* Translate business process narratives into structured process maps, value\-stream views, and opportunity catalogues.
* Identify areas where AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, or process orchestration can create measurable business value.



**Avagama Platform Consulting \& Solutioning** 



* Use Avagama's process intelligence capabilities to analyze process data, mine patterns, and surface automation and AI applicability.
* Map business requirements to Avagama's agentic orchestration, IDP, and decision\-intelligence modules to design fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Build solution architectures and present them to customer CxO / IT leadership with clear ROI articulation.
* Identify where agentic AI agents should be deployed versus rule\-based automation, and design hybrid orchestration strategies.



  





**Solution Build \& Delivery Ownership** 



* Own the hands\-on build of Avagama\-based solutions \- configure agents, define orchestration workflows, set up IDP pipelines, and integrate with enterprise systems (SAP, ERPs, CRMs, custom APIs).
* Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents that perform multi\-step enterprise tasks: approvals, reconciliations, exception handling, document classification, and data extraction.
* Collaborate with data engineers and ML engineers for model tuning, prompt engineering, and performance optimization where custom AI components are required.
* Ensure solution quality through structured testing, UAT coordination, and go\-live support.



  





**Client Engagement \& Value Realization** 



* Serve as the primary consultant on customer engagements \- own the relationship from discovery through steady\-state handover.
* Build business cases, ROI models, and transformation roadmaps aligned with client KPIs.
* Conduct training and enablement sessions for client teams on deployed solutions.
* Produce engagement artifacts: process assessment reports, opportunity catalogues, solution design documents, and post\-deployment value reports.



  





**Pre\-Sales \& Practice Contribution** 



* Support pre\-sales with discovery\-driven scoping, effort estimation, and proposal inputs.
* Contribute to Avagama's positioning \- case studies, competitive intelligence, demo scenarios, and sales training content.
* Feed product insights back to the platform engineering team based on real\-world deployment learnings.



  





**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS** 



* 4–8 years of experience in business consulting, process consulting, or technology consulting in an enterprise context.
* Demonstrate ability to independently run discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and process mapping exercises.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of: process mining tools, RPA platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate), or intelligent automation platforms.
* Working knowledge of enterprise systems \- SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP), or equivalent ERP/CRM landscapes.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts \- LLMs, prompt engineering, document AI, and agentic AI patterns (tool use, ReAct, multi\-agent orchestration).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into concrete solution designs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- comfort presenting to CxO audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Experience with SAP integration technologies \- BTP, SAP AI Core, Joule, ArchiveLink, VIM, or xECM.
* Familiarity with GCP Document AI, Azure Document Intelligence, or AWS Textract.
* Prior experience building or configuring AI agents or multi\-agent orchestration systems.
* Exposure to industry domains such as BFSI, manufacturing, energy, retail, or facilities management.
* Certifications in SAP, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or any cloud AI/ML specialization.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification is a plus.

**Experience you'll need to have:**

* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

description:
**What Cognite is:****Relentless****to achieve**
================================================



Cognite operates at the forefront of **industrial digitalization, building AI**, and data solutions that solve the world's hardest, highest\-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low\-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.



We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward \- not backwards \- you'll feel right at home here.



Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

  

**How you'll demonstrate** **Ownership**
========================================

  

**About the Role**
------------------



Cognite Academy is looking for a highly organized and execution\-focused **Senior Project Lead – Academy Content \& Operations** to drive the day\-to\-day execution of our training content development initiatives.



This role will be responsible for ensuring that content development projects move from planning to completion on time, with clear ownership, strong cross\-functional coordination, and minimal execution friction.



You will work closely with instructional designers, technical content developers, trainers, product experts, and subject matter experts (SMEs) across Cognite. You will establish project plans, maintain execution cadence, track deliverables and dependencies, proactively identify risks, and follow up with stakeholders to keep projects moving.



This is an **individual contributor role** with significant responsibility for driving accountability and execution across the Academy team.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Project Planning \& Execution**


* Own the end\-to\-end project management of Academy content development initiatives.
* Translate content development priorities into clear project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
* Establish and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly execution rhythms across active projects.
* Ensure every project has clearly defined tasks, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and status.
* Track project progress against agreed timelines and proactively address schedule risks.
* Maintain a consolidated view of all active content development projects and their health.
* Drive projects through to completion rather than simply tracking and reporting progress.


**Team Coordination \& Accountability**


* Coordinate closely with Academy team members to ensure weekly commitments and project tasks are clearly defined and updated.
* Follow up proactively on overdue or at\-risk deliverables and help remove obstacles affecting execution.
* Facilitate regular project check\-ins, stand\-ups, and status reviews as required.
* Ensure project management systems remain accurate and reflect the latest status, ownership, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Create visibility into upcoming milestones, workload, risks, and potential bottlenecks.


**Cross\-Functional \& SME Coordination**


* Coordinate with Product, Professional Services, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams to secure SME participation required for Academy projects.
* Schedule and manage SME engagements, reviews, technical validation sessions, and content approvals.
* Follow up with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure dependencies are completed on time.
* Identify cross\-functional blockers early and proactively work with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Escalate unresolved risks and dependencies with clear context, impact, and recommended actions.


**Project Governance \& Reporting**


* Establish consistent project management practices across Academy content development.
* Maintain project dashboards, trackers, risk logs, action registers, and project documentation.
* Provide concise weekly status reporting covering progress, upcoming milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
* Identify recurring execution bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Help improve the predictability and scalability of Academy's content development operations.

**The** **Impact** **you bring to Cognite**
===========================================


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


* Academy content projects have clear plans, owners, milestones, and deadlines.
* Weekly commitments are visible and consistently followed through.
* Project risks and delays are identified before they become critical.
* SMEs and cross\-functional dependencies are engaged early enough to avoid project delays.
* Team members spend less time chasing dependencies and coordinating logistics.
* Leadership has clear visibility into project health, risks, capacity, and delivery timelines.
* Content development projects are completed predictably and on time.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience in project management, program coordination, program operations, or a similar execution\-focused role.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with both team members and senior stakeholders.
* Strong ability to drive follow\-through and accountability across teams without having direct reporting authority.
* Advanced knowledge of modern project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of project management practices including milestone planning, dependency management, risk management, capacity planning, status reporting, and escalation.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to identify blockers, facilitate decisions, and proactively move projects forward.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with multiple stakeholders and changing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience managing training, learning content, technical documentation, product education, or content development projects.
* Experience working with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, or other technical teams.
* Familiarity with instructional design or technical training development processes.
* Experience building dashboards and reporting mechanisms for portfolio/project visibility.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or similar project management certification is beneficial but not required.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------


* **Execution Discipline** – Creates structure, maintains momentum, and drives projects through completion.
* **Communication** – Communicates clearly, concisely, and confidently across functions and levels.
* **Ownership** – Takes responsibility for outcomes rather than simply documenting project status.
* **Influence Without Authority** – Builds relationships and drives accountability across stakeholders without relying on reporting structures.
* **Proactive Problem Solving** – Identifies risks and blockers early and works actively to resolve them.
* **Organization \& Attention to Detail** – Maintains accurate project plans and ensures commitments do not fall through the cracks.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** – Builds productive relationships with SMEs and stakeholders across the organization.

**Role Scope**
--------------



This is an individual contributor role and does not have direct people\-management responsibility. The role owns the execution and coordination of Academy projects, while functional leaders and content owners remain accountable for their respective subject\-matter and content decisions.

* Impact 2025

**Location:** *Gattahalli, Bangalore, Karnataka.*

MEICON is a cutting\-edge construction \& Project management firm specializing in infrastructure development. Our team of professionals has extensive experience in civil and electrical work functions, including Estimation, Design, Planning and Scheduling, Project Management,Contract, Quality, Operations, and Maintenance management.

**Skills \& Responsibilities:**

* Managing entire construction projects and organizing and managing the timely mobilization of resources on\-site, ensuring alignment with the client's defined time, cost, and quality objectives.
* Conduct regular and thorough site inspections to verify that all construction works are being executed in strict compliance with the project's contract specifications and quality standards.
* Overseeing construction work from scratch to completion of project.
* Conduct and facilitate regular weekly site meetings with contractors and consultants to ensure effective communication, track progress, address issues, and maintain timely delivery of work.
* Undertaking surveys as required on site.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive construction schedule, including detailed two\-week and one\-month look\-ahead schedules for each contractor, updated bi\-weekly, to ensure accurate progress tracking and proactive management of potential delays.
* Conduct detailed reviews of contractor methodologies and resource allocations, and upon client approval, issue necessary instructions to ensure alignment with project requirements.
* Continuously monitor and report on contractor progress to the client, proactively identifying and analyzing delay factors related to labor, equipment, and scheduling to mitigate potential impacts.
* Oversee and coordinate all commissioning, final inspections, and handover operations, ensuring a seamless transition from the contractor to the client.
* Take lead responsibility for the review, monitoring, coordination, and resolution of all defects with the Main Contractor and nominated subcontractors during the defects liability period, ensuring all repairs are completed to the client's satisfaction.
* Monitor and ensure the timely and accurate preparation of all necessary handover documentation, including operations and maintenance manuals, as\-built drawings, equipment commissioning reports, and warranties.
* Establishing standards for final acceptance during the defects liability period and work completion prior to final acceptance.
* Generate and manage Requests for Information (RFIs), ensuring timely responses and proper closure, and maintain comprehensive records of all RFI activities.
* Prepare punch lists, indicating the items of work remaining to be accomplished and ensure that these items are completed in an expeditious manner.
* Co\-ordinate and expedite the preparation by the trade contractors of operating and maintenance manuals and similar instructions.
* Organize and coordinate manufacturer representative services to provide on\-site personnel with comprehensive training on all major equipment.
* Expedite the timely preparation and submission of accurate as\-built drawings from all trade contractors to the client upon project completion, as per specifications.
* Experience in executing complex residential projects and setting out sites.
* Determines project costs by calculating labor, material, and related costs.
* Coordinating and instructing the manpower to conduct the works as per standard codes and industry practices.
* Liaising with clients, subcontractors, architects and other professionals, quantity surveyors and the overall project manager.
* Providing technical advice and solving problems on site.
* Preparing site reports and logging progress.
* Ensuring that health and safety and sustainability policies and legislation are adhered to.
* Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

**Requirements and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in construction, management, or engineering preferable.
* 2\-4 years’ working experience.
* Highly developed team management \& relationship building skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects with deadlines.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* An eye for detail.
* The ability to solve problems and think on your feet.
* Communication skills.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
**Job Title**


Assistant Project Manager**Job Description Summary**


The role will require close coordination with the Client, PMC, consultants, contractors, design teams, procurement teams and site execution teams to ensure that project milestones are achieved within the approved project schedule. Having strong hands\-on expertise in Primavera P6, construction sequencing, progress measurement, critical path analysis, delay analysis and schedule reporting.**Job Description**

**About The Role:**

* We are looking for an experienced Planning Engineer with around 10 years of experience in construction planning and project controls to be based in Bangalore.
* The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining and controlling project schedules, monitoring contractor performance, identifying schedule risks and delays, and providing timely recommendations for corrective and recovery measures.
* Develop and maintain the Project Master Schedule in Primavera P6\.
* Establish appropriate WBS, activity coding, calendars, relationships, milestones and critical path.
* Develop baseline, detailed execution, procurement, design and commissioning schedules.
* Integrate design, approvals, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
* Review contractor baseline schedules for logic, sequencing, durations, resources and achievability.
* Ensure alignment of contractor schedules with overall project milestones.
* Develop detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules as required by the project.
* Prepare and maintain 2\-week, 4\-week and monthly look\-ahead schedules.
* Identify interface activities and constraints affecting project progress.
* Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline schedule.
* Collect and validate progress information from site teams and contractors.
* Carry out weekly and monthly schedule updates.
* Analyse planned vs. actual progress and identify slippages.
* Track critical and near\-critical activities.
* Monitor key project milestones and sectional completion dates.
* Identify potential delays at an early stage and escalate them to the Project Manager.
* Ensure that reported progress is supported by actual site achievement.
* Prepare and monitor manpower histograms and resource loading.
* Review contractor manpower and equipment deployment against planned requirements.
* Monitor productivity against planned norms.
* Identify resource shortages affecting critical activities.
* Prepare resource\-based recovery plans where required.
* Monitor material and equipment requirements against project milestones.
* Coordinate with design consultants to track drawing and document deliverables.
* Monitor design approvals against construction requirements.
* Integrate procurement schedules with the construction programme.
* Track long\-lead items and ensure delivery dates are aligned with site requirements.
* Highlight delays in design approvals, material procurement and statutory approvals that may impact the programme.
* Review and comment on contractor schedules and programmes.
* Conduct regular planning meetings with contractors and site teams.
* Challenge unrealistic activity durations, sequencing and progress claims.
* Ensure contractors submit updated schedules and recovery programmes on time.
* Monitor contractor commitments against agreed action plans.
* Provide planning inputs during commercial and contractual discussions.
* Maintain a clear record of delay events, instructions, approvals and their schedule impact.
* Maintain a schedule risk and constraint register.
* Identify activities with potential impact on project completion.
* Carry out schedule risk assessments and mitigation planning.
* Support cost and commercial teams by providing schedule information for forecasting and change management.
* Analyse the schedule impact of variations and change orders.
* Support project forecasting and expected completion\-date assessments.
* Ensure schedule changes are properly documented and traceable.

**About You:**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
* Post Graduate qualification in Construction Management / Project Management will be an advantage.
* Primavera P6 certification will be preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in construction planning/project controls.
* Should have substantial experience in preparing and managing construction programmes rather than only updating schedules.
* Experience with a PMC/Client/Consultant organisation will be preferred.
* Experience in reviewing contractor programmes and delay claims will be an advantage.
* The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on construction planning professional, not merely a Primavera operator. He/she should be capable of independently analysing a project programme, identifying why the project is slipping, determining the impact on the critical path, developing recovery options and presenting clear recommendations to the Project Manager/Client.
* Experience with major contractors such as L\&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons, Brigade, Prestige or similar organisations, or experience with a reputed PMC/consultancy, will be preferred.

Amazon Prime Video brings world\-class storytelling to global audiences through high\-impact creative campaigns and experiences.  We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Learning Content Producer – 3D \& Video to own day\-to\-day planning and delivery across digital\-learning content production. The role turns approved scripts, storyboards and animatics into structured, trackable production plans and coordinates the complete content pipeline—from 3D assets, animation and lighting through video, voice\-over, subtitles, review and quality control—to ensure work is delivered on time, at the required quality, and ready for formal review and delivery.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Creative Director, Project Head, instructional designers, storyboard artists, 3D artists, animators, editors, QA teams, language and voice teams, vendors and relevant stakeholders. This is a hands\-on delivery leadership role: the focus is dependable execution, clear ownership, early risk visibility and disciplined follow\-through.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain master schedules for content units, segments, shots and deliverables.
* Break briefs and scripts into clear tasks, dependencies, owners, estimates, milestones and review gates.
* Track daily production across scripting, storyboarding, animatics, 3D, animation, lighting, rendering, video editing, audio, subtitles, translation and QA.
* Coordinate handoffs between creative, technical, production and quality teams so work does not stall between stages.
* Maintain a single source of truth for status, blockers, priorities, due dates, feedback, revisions and next actions.
* Monitor workload and capacity, identify bottlenecks early, and recommend practical reallocation or sequencing changes.
* Run concise production reviews and stand\-ups, document decisions and follow up until actions are closed.
* Establish and enforce internal quality gates; ensure only complete, checked and approved work moves to formal review or delivery.
* Review progress and output readiness across multiple teams without replacing specialist creative or technical ownership.
* Coordinate external vendors and contract teams, including briefs, handoffs, follow\-ups, review cycles, corrections and delivery commitments.
* Prepare clear status reports covering progress, risks, dependencies, resource constraints, decisions required and recovery actions.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders professionally, escalating risks with options and evidence.
* Support realistic planning during peak delivery periods while protecting quality, ownership and sustainable workload.
* Maintain organised production records, trackers, references, approvals and version history.
* Handle work materials with discretion and confidentiality.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 5–10 years of experience in production, delivery, project coordination or program operations within digital learning, animation, media, gaming, VFX, interactive content or related industries.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and delivering multiple content streams or recurring deliverables.
* Strong understanding of digital learning and content production workflows, including scripts, storyboards, animatics, 3D and animation, video, audio, subtitles, review and QA.
* Proven ability to build schedules, manage dependencies, maintain trackers and drive closure of blockers.
* Practical experience with quality gates, review cycles, feedback management and delivery\-ready outputs.
* Strong workload planning, prioritisation, risk management and escalation skills.
* Experience coordinating vendors, contract teams or distributed production teams.
* Strong written and spoken communication in English is required. Ability to read and write Hindi fluently is mandatory.
* Comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets and project or task\-tracking tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, Trello, ShotGrid, fTrack or equivalent.
* Ability to work from the Chennai workspace on a full\-time, on\-site basis.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and ability to operate calmly under delivery pressure.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in e\-learning, educational video, animation, 3D production or game\-engine\-based workflows.
* Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing or voice\-over, language review and localisation workflows.
* Experience with production dashboards, reporting, SOPs, QC checklists or process improvement.
* Experience managing high\-volume, repetitive content delivery with consistent quality.
* Relevant education in project management, media, animation, digital learning, design, technology or an equivalent practical background.

* Monitor and report on key performance indicators to measure project success.

* 10\+ years of experience in project delivery and/or application management or IT services within a multinational organization
* Proven experience managing complex IT projects within large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Previous experience in SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW, SAP IBP and PI is a must.
* Understanding of Data \& Analytics including Data Sphere and Data Bricks
* Experience of working or understanding of SAP MDG

 English

**Join us!**

 Quality

 Carrier Excellence

**Qualifications**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution (Engineering / Supply Chain / Analytics preferred).

 The role also involves supporting authority inspections, assisting in project handover documentation, and ensuring all systems are installed and commissioned in accordance with local regulations and client requirements. Experience in Data Centre, Commercial Building, Industrial, Infrastructure, Healthcare, or Mission Critical Facility projects is preferred. The candidate should possess strong knowledge of potable water systems, drainage networks, plumbing installations, water treatment systems, pump systems, hydraulic principles, testing and commissioning procedures, and relevant standards such as IPC, UPC, IS Codes, and local authority regulations. Strong technical, planning, coordination, problem\-solving, and communication skills are essential for successful project execution and delivery. Project is HYD123\&124\.

description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Project Manager to drive the planning, coordination, and delivery of creative and marketing projects across the organization. The role will be responsible for translating briefs into clear project plans, aligning stakeholders and timelines, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and to the expected quality standards.
 



 The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple projects and teams in a fast\-paced environment. You will play a key role in bringing structure and efficiency to the creative and marketing workflow while ensuring smooth execution from brief to final delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 ﻿**




**1\. Project Planning \& Delivery** 



* Own projects end\-to\-end, from initial brief and planning through execution and final delivery.
* Develop clear project plans with defined timelines, milestones, deliverables, owners, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure projects remain on track and within scope.
* Identify potential bottlenecks and timeline risks early and proactively resolve them.
* Manage feedback and revision cycles to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and aligned with the original brief.



  





**2\. Brief Consolidation \& Calendar Alignment** 



* Consolidate creative and marketing briefs in alignment with the NPD calendar and always\-on content requirements.
* Ensure briefs are clear, complete, and actionable before being handed over to execution teams.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to clarify requirements, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Maintain visibility of upcoming projects and ensure timely handoffs to the respective teams.



  





**3\. Workflow, Process \& Template Optimization** 



* Build and maintain structured workflows, SOPs, templates, and project management systems for recurring work.
* Ensure all projects are tracked through a centralized system with clear ownership and real\-time status updates.
* Identify inefficiencies in existing processes and implement solutions to improve turnaround times.
* Develop repeatable frameworks and tools that enable teams to execute projects more efficiently.
* Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes based on team feedback and project outcomes.



  





**4\. Resource \& Bandwidth Management** 



* Work closely with creative and marketing teams to understand team bandwidth and allocate resources effectively.
* Assign projects based on priorities, skill sets, availability, and project requirements.
* Monitor workloads to identify potential bottlenecks, under\-utilization, or over\-allocation.
* Coordinate with freelancers, vendors, and external partners when additional resources are required.
* Ensure external resources are onboarded and briefed efficiently and have the necessary information to execute their deliverables.
* Proactively flag resource constraints and recommend solutions to stakeholders.



  





**5\. Marketing Channel Quality Checks** 



* Conduct regular quality checks across key marketing touchpoints, including social media, website, in\-store communication, and other relevant channels.
* Ensure creative and marketing assets are aligned with approved briefs, brand guidelines, and campaign requirements.
* Identify and communicate errors, inconsistencies, or execution gaps to the relevant teams.
* Track flagged issues through resolution and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain a high standard of consistency and execution quality across all live marketing channels.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–3 years of experience in project management, creative operations, marketing operations, or a similar role.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously across creative, marketing, design, content, or brand teams.
* Strong project planning, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate ambiguous briefs into clear plans, timelines, and actionable deliverables.
* Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to problem\-solving.
* Comfortable working with project management tools, calendars, trackers, and workflow systems.
* Ability to proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across cross\-functional and external teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining visibility and control across multiple projects.

title: Project Manager Construction, BOM
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
   

  

 As a Data Center CM you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
   

  

 Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
   

  

 At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team\-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**The Data Center CM Will Be Responsible For**
* Assist in project management and oversight of construction\-related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Hydrabad area, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support efforts to drive costs down and shorten schedules while maintaining quality.
* Contribute to Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
* Participate in reviews of construct\-ability of electrical and mechanical systems and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
* Assist in creating project scope and equipment requirements, help with request for proposals, and capital requests.
* Support total project quality by assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing, and helping oversee the execution of the project.
* Help manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers.
* Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
* Learn to manage multiple projects concurrently, including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
* Provide operational support of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
* Develop leadership skills within the group and in internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Travel to datacenter sites for electrical, mechanical system audits and reviews, construct\-ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required, under supervision.


 A day in the life
   

  

 At Amazon we are a global team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Senior Manager — Technical Diligence and Programme Control
description:
Senior Manager \- Technical Due Diligence \& Project Monitoring \| Vantrock Real Assets \| Mumbai
 



 We want a civil engineer who started on the developer or contractor side, carried a site, then moved into technical due diligence or independent engineer work. Depth first, structure second. A site tells you what it will cost long before a contractor does.
 




 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain \- first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



 The platform was founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built every platform he led as if it were his own \- three times over, on other people's capital. This is the fourth build, on his own. Across his career that record runs to 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor, over 2,000 acres acquired and all of them litigation\-free, and more than 200 buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms. The board is chaired by Shailesh V. Haribhakti. The platform runs on Vantrock Intelligence, its own AI\-native operating layer.
 




 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 




 Read a site badly at diligence and the error is baked into the underwriting for the life of the asset. Read it well and the deal either improves or dies early, the cheapest outcome available. The same skill, pointed at a contractor's programme, tells you whether the date on it is real.
 



 Vantrock currently buys both judgements from consultants, one assignment at a time, with nobody inside who can mark their work. The pipeline is 10 million sq ft and ground breaks on the first 2 million in January 2027\. From that point the platform is running acquisitions and construction at once, and whoever can walk a site in the morning and take apart a Primavera file in the afternoon becomes the most useful person in the room.
 




 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 




 \- Technical pre\-diligence on every site under consideration \- ground, levels, access, power, drainage, existing structures, and every physical constraint that changes what can be built there. Your output goes into the underwriting as a technical view with the assumptions stated.
 



 \- The buildability and cost\-shape read. Not a BOQ, a judgement: what makes this site expensive, and where the foundation cost goes.
 



 \- Drawing review at concept stage, against what actually builds, before it is a tender.
 



 \- Programme review and claims. Take apart the contractor's and the PMC's programmes and report what is real. Assess extension\-of\-time claims on merit.
 



 \- Technical validation on site: running bills, measurement, quality and progress against the drawings, with the record captured into Vantrock Intelligence.
 



 \- Command of technical partners: geotechnical agencies, surveyors, TDD firms, inspection agencies, PMCs. You never take a report on trust because it came on letterhead.
 




 THE CAREER SHAPE, AND THIS ONE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE
 




 We are looking for a specific arc, in a specific order. You started on the developer's or the contractor's side. You carried responsibility on a site, and you know what a delay costs because you have been the person who had to explain it. Then you moved into technical due diligence, lender's independent engineer, technical audit or advisory work, where you learned to structure a problem, write for an executive, and hold more than one project in your head at a time.
 



 The order matters more than either half. Someone who has only ever consulted can build a governance framework nobody on the ground respects, because it asks for things a site cannot give. Someone who has only ever been on site can hold a project but not a portfolio. We want depth first and structure second, and we want both.
 



 Bring the first half in detail. We will ask which sites, what your scope was, what the ground turned out to be and what it cost to deal with.
 




 QUALIFICATION
 




 \- A full\-time B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. This one is not negotiable and no other discipline substitutes.
 



 \- A postgraduate qualification is a strong plus rather than a requirement: NICMAR (ACM, APM or the QSCM diploma), RICS School of Built Environment, an IIT or NIT M.Tech in structural, geotechnical or construction engineering, and NMIMS MBA (Tech.) Civil Engineering with Operations Management. An MBA in Finance, a CFA or CA is an added advantage.
 




 TECHNICAL GROUNDING \- ESSENTIAL
 




 This is the part of the seat that cannot be learned on the job here, so we will test it directly, on a real drawing set.
 



 \- Ground and land form. Borelogs, SPT data, safe bearing capacity, settlement, water table, ground\-improvement options. Contours, cut and fill, approach gradients, and survey output read rather than taken on trust. You know what to specify to a geotechnical agency before they mobilise.
 



 \- Codes and authorities. IS 456, 800, 875 and 1893, the National Building Code, and the authority rules that bind a site \- MIDC, HSIIDC, KIADB.
 



 \- Warehousing and industrial specifics. Pre\-engineered buildings, portal frames, crane gantries, floor loading and flatness to the occupier's standard, and what an insurer's engineering requirements do to a design.
 



 \- Services and cost. HT power, sanctioned load, distance to substation, water, sewage treatment, storm water outfall. BOQ, rate analysis, running account bills, variations, escalation, retention, defect liability. You can look at a rate and say whether it is real.
 



 \- Programme and drawings. Primavera P6 or MS Project at critical\-path, float and resource\-loading level, and extension\-of\-time claims assessed on merit \- essential in this seat, because reading a programme against physical reality is the job. GFC review, structural and services coordination, BIM clash detection at a level where you know what the model hides.
 



 \- Writing. A TDD report a lender's or an investment committee can act on, plus advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
 



 \- Platforms. MS Project at working level, plus SAP, Primavera P6 or Project Online.
 




 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
 




 \- 8 to 12 years, the majority of it on or around sites rather than in a design office.
 



 \- At least three years on technical due diligence, independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring work. Not delivery with a diligence assignment attached once.
 



 \- Sites assessed across greenfield land and built assets both. Assessing only completed buildings is half the seat.
 



 \- One constraint you found that nobody else had, and what it changed. This is the question the whole interview turns on.
 




 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 




 \- Not delivery or EPC, and not design. Execution is owned elsewhere and that seat is filled; you review what is proposed, you do not draw it.
 



 \- Not the deal, and not portfolio governance. Investments owns underwriting; the register sits with the EPMO Lead. You supply the technical view into both, even when it kills the deal.
 




 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 Deliberately small, no departments. Survey, soil investigation, third\-party inspection and measurement all go to specialist agencies. What stays inside is the judgement about whether their work is any good. Expect to be on site most weeks, and expect your written view to be read by the founder, the investment committee and, in time, by lenders.
 




 THE WORK IS YOURS TO DO
 




 We are not building an army. You do the work rather than receive, route and report on it. The coordination, inside the platform and outside it with consultants, agencies, lenders and authorities, is done by you in person, on the phone and on site. You run your own tech stack rather than specifying it for someone else. Seniority changes what you are accountable for, not whether you roll up your sleeves.
 




 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 Two requirements stand behind that and apply to every seat here. AI proficiency: every candidate takes the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, supervised, regardless of seniority. Partner command: consultants, contractors, auditors, valuers, law firms and system vendors do a great deal of Vantrock's work, and everyone here is expected to command that work rather than defer to it.
 




 COMPENSATION
 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity, with performance\-linked incentives and ESOPs. We discuss numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 




 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 An AI interview, reviewed before your CV. The AI Proficiency Test. A site round: a real site, or a real drawing set and soil report, and you tell us what you see. That round decides it. Two references. Five working days to hear back, and every conversation is confidential.
 




 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com, subject line "VR\-45 Senior Manager, Technical Diligence \- \[your name]". Four things: your CV, with the site half of your career set out as clearly as the advisory half; one artefact you personally wrote, redacted as you must, with three sentences on what you found that nobody else had; your current fixed compensation, expectation and notice; and one short paragraph naming the single site constraint you have seen change a deal most, and how you would have caught it earlier. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform.

title: Vice President — Enterprise Programme Management Office
description:
Head \- Enterprise PMO / Vice President, EPMO \| Vantrock Real Assets \| Mumbai
 



 We want someone who started on the developer or contractor side, carried a site, then moved into consulting. Depth first, structure second. A career that begins in advisory and stays there will not clear this seat. Not a delivery role either \- construction execution is owned elsewhere and that seat is filled.
 




 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain \- first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



 The platform was founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built every platform he led as if it were his own \- three times over, on other people's capital. This is the fourth build, on his own. Across his career that record runs to 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor, over 2,000 acres acquired and all of them litigation\-free, and more than 200 buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms. The board is chaired by Shailesh V. Haribhakti. The platform runs on Vantrock Intelligence, its own AI\-native operating layer.
 




 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 




 Ground breaks on the first 2 million sq ft of a 10 million sq ft pipeline in January 2027\. From that day the platform is running land, approvals, design, procurement, construction, leasing, operations and corporate initiatives at once, in several markets, with a deliberately small team.
 



 Right now every initiative reports to the founder in a different format on a different rhythm. That works at ten, not at fifty, and fifty is where this platform is by the end of next year. Filled well, the founder stops being the integration layer. Filled badly, we have added a reporting bureau.
 



 It is the senior of three seats, and the seat the Chief of Strategy and EPMO is most likely to be filled from. The EPMO Lead beneath you builds and runs the machine. The Senior Manager for Technical Diligence holds the ground truth under both. You hold the office's authority: the sequencing, the benefits at platform level, and every escalation that reaches the founder and the board.
 




 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 




 \- The framework's authority. The EPMO Lead establishes the framework, operating rhythm, standards, stage gates and escalation protocols. You approve them, hold them when a project wants an exception, and are the reason they are respected across ten functions.
 



 \- Portfolio prioritisation and sequencing. Which initiatives run, in what order, against what capital and capacity. Project and non\-project, core and ancillary. The judgement the founder currently makes alone.
 



 \- Benefits realisation at platform level. Every initiative carries a stated operational, financial or customer benefit. You are accountable for whether the portfolio delivers them, and for killing those that will not.
 



 \- Transformation. Operational excellence, process improvement, cost optimisation and digital enablement, scoped by you and delivered through the office.
 



 \- Escalation to the founder and the board. The exceptions that matter, early, with options attached. A flag without an option is a complaint.
 



 \- Command of programme partners. You appoint them, set the standard they are held to, and replace them when they fail. Site\-level planning goes to a PMC reporting in, never to a seat on the roll.
 



 \- Building the bench. Two seats now, a third on trigger. Coach project and functional teams so the discipline survives you being on leave.
 




 THE CAREER SHAPE, AND THIS ONE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE
 




 We are looking for a specific arc, in a specific order. You started on the developer's or the contractor's side. You carried responsibility on a site, and you know what a delay costs because you have been the person who had to explain it. Then you moved into consulting, advisory or programme management, where you learned to structure a problem, write for an executive, and hold more than one project in your head at a time.
 



 The order matters more than either half. Someone who has only ever consulted can build a governance framework nobody on the ground respects, because it asks for things a site cannot give. Someone who has only ever been on site can hold a project but not a portfolio. We want depth first and structure second, and we want both.
 



 Bring the first half in detail. We will ask which projects, what your scope was, what went wrong on your watch and what it cost.
 




 QUALIFICATION
 




 \- A full\-time bachelor's degree in engineering \- Civil preferred and read first, Mechanical and Electrical read seriously \- or in Architecture or Construction Management.
 



 \- A postgraduate qualification in construction, infrastructure or project management. Programmes we know well: NICMAR (ACM, APM, REUIM), RICS School of Built Environment, CEPT, an IIT or NIT M.Tech, NMIMS MBA (Tech.) Civil with Operations Management.
 



 \- PMP, PRINCE2 or MRICS is an added advantage and not a substitute for either half of the arc.
 



 \- A finance qualification, and on this seat a requirement rather than an advantage: an MBA in Finance, a CFA, or CA. The office sequences capital as well as programmes, and whoever holds it reads a project's money as fluently as its schedule.
 




 TECHNICAL GROUNDING \- ESSENTIAL
 




 \- Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. The analysis and the executive pack are the product of this seat, and we will test both.
 



 \- Project controls, scheduling, cost monitoring, risk management and governance, understood well enough to challenge a schedule, a budget, a forecast or a progress claim and be right.
 



 \- Commercial and contract capability across procurement, consultant engagements, variations and claims, and fluency in a bill of quantities, a rate analysis and a running account bill from the site half of your career.
 



 \- Microsoft Project at working level, and a background working in at least one of SAP, Primavera P6 or Project Online. We will ask which one and what you actually did in it.
 



 \- Structured problem\-solving, and report writing an executive can act on without a meeting.
 




 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
 




 \- 15 to 20 years across real estate development, construction or capital projects, with the arc above visible in it.
 



 \- Portfolio monitoring across multiple concurrent construction projects: controls, management reporting and risk governance. Give us the size in initiatives, square feet or crores, sites and states.
 



 \- Transformation or process improvement delivered to a measured benefit, and a governance function you built rather than inherited.
 



 \- One occasion where you told a chief executive or a board something they did not want to hear, early, with the options already worked out.
 




 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 




 \- Not a delivery or EPC seat. Execution and construction delivery are owned elsewhere and that seat is filled. You review a programme; you do not build to it.
 



 \- Not financial planning and analysis. Forecasting and budget red flags sit in finance.
 




 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 Deliberately small, no departments. The doctrine before any addition is outsource first, then automate, then hire, and it applies to your own function as much as anyone else's. What stays inside is judgement, relationships, negotiation and accountability. You will sit next to the founder, and what arrives is the ambiguous part.
 




 THE WORK IS YOURS TO DO
 




 We are not building an army. You do the work rather than receive, route and report on it. The coordination, inside the platform and outside it with consultants, agencies, lenders and authorities, is done by you in person, on the phone and on site. You run your own tech stack rather than specifying it for someone else. Seniority changes what you are accountable for, not whether you roll up your sleeves.
 




 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 Two requirements stand behind that and apply to every seat here. AI proficiency: every candidate takes the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, supervised, regardless of seniority. Partner command: consultants, contractors, auditors, valuers, law firms and system vendors do a great deal of Vantrock's work, and everyone here is expected to command that work rather than defer to it.
 




 COMPENSATION
 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity, with performance\-linked incentives and ESOPs. We discuss numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 




 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 An AI interview, reviewed before your CV. The AI Proficiency Test. A supervised practical on a real Vantrock initiative. Two references. Five working days to hear back, and every conversation is confidential.
 




 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com, subject line "VR\-21 Vice President, EPMO \- \[your name]". Four things: your CV, with the site half of your career set out as clearly as the advisory half; one artefact you personally designed, with three sentences on what was hard about it; your current fixed compensation, expectation and notice; and one short paragraph naming one thing in this description you think is wrong, and what you would do instead. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform.

title: Project Procurement Co-Ordinator
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Position Summary**

The Accounts Payable Specialist is responsible for managing project\-related financial transactions, vendor payments, cost tracking, invoice processing, and GBS tracking for projects. The role ensures compliance with company policies, contractual requirements, accounting standards, and project budgets while supporting accurate financial control throughout the project lifecycle.


The position works closely with Procurement, Project Controls, Contracts, Supply Chain, and Project Management teams to ensure timely processing of supplier invoices, cost allocations, accruals, and project financial reporting.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounts Payable Management**

* Review and process supplier and subcontractor invoices in accordance with contractual terms and company procedures.
* Verify invoice accuracy against purchase orders, goods receipt notes, milestone completion, service entry sheets, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure proper coding and allocation of costs to project cost codes and work breakdown structures (WBS).
* Process vendor payments within agreed payment terms.
* Monitor outstanding invoices and resolve discrepancies promptly.
* Maintain vendor master data and payment records.
* Coordinate with suppliers to resolve invoice and payment\-related queries.
* Prepare monthly project cost reports and financial summaries.
Assist with project close\-out activities and final account reconciliations.  
* 

**Financial Reporting**

* Prepare weekly status reports of assigned invoices.
* Assist in preparation of cost\-to\-complete and estimate\-at\-completion reports.
* Support internal and external audits.

**Systems \& Data Management**

* Maintain accurate financial data within ERP systems.
* Support system improvements and process automation initiatives.
* Ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or related discipline with 12–15 years of Experience.

**Experience**

**Project Accountant**

* 12–15 years of project accounting experience within Oil \& Gas, LNG, Petrochemical, EPC, EPCM, or Energy sectors.

**Accounts Payable Specialist**

* 8–10 years of accounts payable experience supporting large industrial projects.
* Experience with multinational suppliers and project\-based accounting environments preferred.
* Knowledge of project cost control and procurement processes is advantageous.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Project accounting principles.
* Accounts payable processes and controls.
* Financial reporting and reconciliation.
* Purchase order and contract administration.
* Invoice verification and payment processing.
* Taxation, GST/VAT, and withholding tax requirements.
ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, or Microsoft Dynamics.  
* 

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong accounting and financial analysis skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective verbal \& written communication and stakeholder management.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced project environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Invoice processing cycle time.
* On\-time vendor payment performance.
* Accuracy of project cost reporting.
* Month\-end close completion timeliness.
* Number of invoice discrepancies and resolution time.
* Audit findings and compliance performance.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
