title: Data Conversion Project Manager (Pune)
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Historical Data Conversion Project Manager, you will serve as the essential link between our technical Data Solution Consultants (DSCs) and the client’s business stakeholders. While DSCs focus on the technical execution of data migration and complex analysis, your role is to translate that work into a clear narrative for the client while relaying client requirements back to the internal team. You will leverage a strong understanding of HDC processes, investment data, and technical frameworks to comfortably bridge the gap between technical execution and client expectations. By working side\-by\-side with the DSCs to identify data remediation strategies, you will translate technical requirements into actionable directives for the client and proactively secure necessary inputs. This role is for a subject matter expert who can navigate technical language and investment complexities to drive project progress and maintain high\-impact communication regarding status, gaps, and timelines.
   

  

 You’ll also be among the first members of the Data Solutions team based in India, helping establish our presence in the region while working closely with colleagues across the U.S., U.K., and other global offices. This is a collaborative role offering the opportunity to shape our operating model locally and strengthen how our global teams deliver together.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with Data Solutions: Serve as the dedicated partner to the internal Data Solutions Consultants, ensuring they have clear specifications and context while managing administrative workflows to allow them to focus on technical execution.
* Translate Technical Progress: Translate technical progress, data challenges, and migration results provided by the Data Solutions team into digestible business narratives for client stakeholders.
* Lead Client Status Calls: Lead regular status calls with clients to convey project health, presenting successful data loads and managing expectations around timelines or data discrepancies.
* Facilitate Information Flow: Facilitate the flow of information between parties, ensuring client requirements are accurately scoped for the technical team and technical constraints are clearly explained to the client.
* Oversee Portfolio of Projects: Prioritize and context\-switch effectively to oversee simultaneous projects, maintaining close alignment with the Data Solutions team on resource availability.
* Drive Process Improvement: Identify and drive opportunities to improve the communication workflow between the Project Management and Data Solutions functions.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: Minimum 2\+ years of experience in project management, finance, or consulting, with a strong record of managing client relationships and communicating complex project updates.
* Client\-Focused: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and manage "difficult conversations" regarding timelines or scope.
* Investment\-Savvy: Strong understanding of financial products and securities modeling (technical implementation skills not required, but conceptual understanding is key).
* Solutions\-Oriented: Creative problem\-solver who operates with ownership and accountability in ambiguous environments.
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and functions to deliver measurable impact, specifically in bridging the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Process\-Minded: Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and continuously looking for ways to improve efficiency and scale.
* Adaptable: Thrives in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities and global stakeholders.
* Technical (Bonus): Familiarity with Python or SQL. While you won’t be building the infrastructure, your ability to query data or understand automated workflows will help you scale your impact and communicate more effectively.


**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Project Manager - Civil & Interior, PDS Projects
description:
**Job Profile: Project Manager \- Corporate Interior Fit\-Out Works**
**Profile Overview**
 The Project Manager for Corporate Interior Fitout Works at JLL serves as the central point of leadership for the successful delivery of interior construction projects for our corporate clients. This role is instrumental in translating client vision into practical, efficient, and high\-quality workspace environments while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and safety. The position represents a critical client\-facing function that directly impacts JLL's reputation for excellence in project management services.
   

  

 This position sits within JLL's Project \& Development Services (PDS) division, specializing in interior buildouts and workspace transformations for corporate clients across various industry sectors. The Project Manager reports directly to the Senior Project Manager or Regional Director of Project Management, while providing guidance and direction to Assistant Project Managers, Project Coordinators, and managing relationships with external consultants, contractors, and vendors engaged on assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Planning \& Execution: Develop and implement comprehensive project execution plans covering scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management for corporate interior fitout projects ranging from 10,000 to 100,000\+ square feet.
* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary day\-to\-day client contact, understanding business objectives, managing expectations, and ensuring continuous alignment between project execution and client goals throughout the project lifecycle.
* Financial Oversight: Develop, monitor and manage detailed project budgets, including cost estimation, tracking expenditures, approving payment applications, managing change orders, and forecasting costs to completion while identifying opportunities for value engineering.
* Schedule Management: Create, maintain and monitor detailed project schedules using industry\-standard tools, identifying critical path activities, mitigating potential delays, and implementing recovery strategies when necessary.
* Procurement \& Vendor Management: Manage the selection and performance of general contractors, specialty consultants, and vendors; negotiate contracts, review bids, and oversee the procurement process for furniture, fixtures, and equipment.
* Technical Oversight: Review and coordinate design documentation, provide constructability feedback, ensure code compliance, and oversee quality control processes throughout the construction phase.
* Risk Management: Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution to minimize impacts on schedule, budget, and client satisfaction.
* Project Closeout \& Transition: Oversee project closeout activities including punch list completion, systems commissioning, documentation handover, warranty management, and transition to facilities management teams.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 7\-8 years of progressive experience in project management, with at least 5 years specifically managing commercial interior construction or corporate fitout projects
* Demonstrated experience managing projects with budgets exceeding $1 million
* Strong technical understanding of interior construction methodologies, building systems, and local building codes
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting architectural and engineering drawings
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
* LEED Accredited Professional credential desirable
* Knowledge of workplace design trends and corporate real estate strategies


**Skills And Competencies**
**Technical Skills:**
* Proficiency with project management software (e.g., Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project)
* Strong capabilities with Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel for budget tracking and PowerPoint for client presentations
* Working knowledge of CAD/BIM concepts and ability to review technical drawings
* Familiarity with construction documentation systems and processes
* Understanding of sustainable design principles and WELL building standards
* Knowledge of local building codes, permitting requirements, and ADA compliance


**Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for effective client interaction
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
* Team leadership and ability to influence across organizational boundaries
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving orientation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Client\-centric mindset with strong service orientation
* Meticulous attention to detail while maintaining big\-picture perspective


**Performance Metrics**
 The Project Manager will be evaluated based on the following key performance indicators:
   

  

* Project Delivery Performance: On\-time and on\-budget delivery of projects against established baselines (target: 90% of projects delivered within 5% of approved budget and schedule)
* Client Satisfaction: Measured through post\-project client surveys and retention/repeat business metrics (target: minimum 85% client satisfaction rating)
* Financial Management: Accuracy of cost forecasting, change order management, and overall project profitability (target: maintain average project profit margins within 2% of targets)
* Safety Performance: Maintaining zero recordable incidents on project sites and ensuring contractor compliance with safety protocols
* Quality Management: Minimizing defects and rework as measured by punch list items and warranty claims
* Team Development: Mentoring junior staff and contributing to department knowledge sharing


 This role requires a versatile professional who can balance technical expertise with strong client relationship skills while embodying JLL's values of teamwork, ethics, excellence, and client focus in delivering exceptional project outcomes.

Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

 The PMO plays a key role in supporting portfolio governance, financial management, and project delivery across a multi\-project capability. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate financial tracking, standardized reporting, and adherence to governance frameworks while enabling effective decision\-making through data\-driven insights. The PMO Analyst works closely with Program Managers and leadership to drive operational efficiency, maintain project controls, and ensure consistency across all projects.
   

  

**Role Justification**
**Role**

* Ensure consistent governance and adherence to project management standards across all initiatives
* Provide centralized financial management, including budget tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis
* Improve visibility for leadership through structured reporting (SteerCo, Jen reports, dashboards)
* Strengthen data integrity across tools (Clarity PPM, ADO, SharePoint, Power BI, Excel and PowerPoint, AI tools)
* Drive efficiency, risk management, and quality assurance across projects
* Support detailed project planning activities
* Enable better decision\-making through KPI tracking and consolidated insights

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage capability\-level budgets, including rolling forecasts and quarterly funding models
* Partner with IT Capital Governance to validate business cases and track benefit realization
* Support governance and oversight across multiple projects
* Ensure adherence to PMO standards, methodologies, and processes
* Maintain the overall capability roadmap and high\-level project plans
* Track risks, issues, and dependencies across the portfolio
* Support Project Managers in governance, reporting, and planning activities
* Provide regular updates and insights to Program Manager and leadership


* Conduct audits across projects to ensure compliance with standards and processes
* Identify gaps and drive corrective actions to improve delivery quality
* Maintain data integrity across:
+ Clarity PPM
+ Azure DevOps (ADO)
+ SharePoint
+ MS tool \- Power BI, Excel and PowerPoint,
+ AI tools

* Support ADO hygiene and create dashboards for project tracking
* Establish and track KPIs and performance metrics at project and portfolio levels
* Provide administrative support in project execution


**Accountabilities**
* Establish and maintain PMO standards, processes, and governance frameworks
* Ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial and operational reporting
* Drive compliance with project management methodologies and quality standards
* Enable effective portfolio tracking and leadership decision\-making


**Core Competencies**
* Financial Analysis \& Budget Management
* Governance \& Compliance
* Reporting \& Data Analysis
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Attention to Detail
* Tools \& Process Orientation


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* for internal applications \- 24 months as Consultant
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Technology, or related field
* 4\+ years of experience in PMO, portfolio/program management, or governance roles.
* Strong experience in financial governance including budgeting, forecasting, and variance management.
* Detailed Project Planning experience
* Expertise in PPM tools (e.g., Clarity), Agile tools (Azure DevOps), and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, AI tools).
* Proven experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-project portfolios.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

title: AI Project Manager, Loop Engineer
description:
**Role Description** 




 A NEW KIND OF PROJECT MANAGER
 



 BetaCraft builds software with a small human team and a fleet of AI coding agents. The agents write most of the code. What they cannot do is the thing this role is for: take a half\-formed sentence from a domain expert, turn it into something buildable, get it built, prove it works, and make sure the same mistake never needs fixing twice.
 



 We call that loop engineering. A loop is: a stakeholder says something → it becomes a plan in plain language → a human approves it → agents build it in isolation → a gate checks it against evidence → a pull request opens → the stakeholder sees it working → and whatever was learned becomes a rule the next loop inherits. Loop engineering is designing that so a human touches it only where judgment matters, and it keeps closing when you walk away.
 



 We are hiring two to three senior people to own loops end to end. You will not groom a board or write a weekly deck. You will sit in the middle of a domain expert, a client's engineering lead, a second developer, an internal control plane, and six to eight parallel AI build lanes — and you will be the reason all of it converges.
 



  





 THE BASICS
 



 In\-office role, based in Pune.
 



 Full\-time, Senior
 



 .
 



 STAKEHOLDER\-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT, AS WE PRACTISE IT
 



 — The stakeholder's words are the spec. Old documents are history, never authority. The hierarchy is: built code, then the client's primary sources, then our own specs.
 



 — Every request becomes a tracked story in our system. Every story gets a plan a non\-technical person can approve. Approval is the only merge signal.
 



 — Thinking is front\-loaded. We measure success by how often an approved story ships correctly with zero human touches after approval, and we always show that number beside its guard: how much came back within a week.
 



 — "Done" is a claim. Evidence is a real\-environment walk, a screenshot, a number traced to its source, green CI on the final commit. You reject the rest, politely, every time.
 



  





 HUMANS ARE THE BOTTLENECK. WE DESIGN AROUND IT.
 



 Agents build in minutes. Humans answer in hours, or the next morning, or after the weekend. Every loop we run is shaped by that one fact, and this role owns the shape.
 



 — Thinking is front\-loaded. The plan is argued before approval, so nothing waits on a human after it.
 



 — Park and continue. When a loop hits a question only a human can answer, it parks that item with a default and keeps moving. Nothing blocks on a ruling.
 



 — Decide the rest yourself. Only the genuine 50\-50 calls reach the expert. Everything else you decide, record, and stand behind.
 



 — Primaries before people. A question goes to the expert only after you have proven the answer is not already in a primary source, an earlier ruling, or an old email. Then you batch, ask once, and store once.
 



 — The nightly loop runs alone and reports only. A regression walk runs every night; humans read one morning report and rule on the few parked items. That report is your control surface.
 



 — Two pipeline tiers. Small changes take the fast path; money, schema and cross\-surface changes take the full path. You pick the tier, and a human sees it only when urgency and tier conflict.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO
 



 — Sit with the domain expert. Hear a rule, restate it as a testable build order, ask "does that make sense?", and write it down where the next loop will find it.
 



 — Decide what to ask and what to build. If a primary source answers the question, you do not ask the expert. If you must ask, you batch, you ask once, and you store the answer once. The expert is never the bottleneck.
 



 — Design loops. Intake, plan, approve, build, gate, verify, record. You pick the pipeline tier per change, you write the impact brief before dispatch (what else this touches, what could break, who must say go), and you decide when a human is needed and when they are not.
 



 — Build harnesses. When something slips, you do not just fix it. You build the guard: a deterministic check, a parity test, a regression walk that runs every night and reports only, a morning report that is your control surface. Sweeps discover; guards lock. Every rule carries the incident that paid for it.
 



 — Run the agent fleet. Know when a lane is stale, when to kill it, when context is the bottleneck, when to say "don't build, just answer". Escalate only the genuine 50\-50 calls; decide the rest yourself.
 



 — Hold the boundaries. The client's engineers own their code; you flag, you never touch. A second developer's work is gated before it merges. Merges are sequenced with an order and a parallel\-safety note, never a bare list.
 



 — Communicate like a colleague. Firm, factual, collaborative, no blame. Every number you send is backed by a ledger you keep.
 



  





 WHO DOES WELL HERE
 



 — Problem\-solving is your reflex, not a skill you list. You reduce a messy report to the actual failing mechanism before anyone touches it.
 



 — You read fast and completely. A long regulatory guide, a two\-hundred\-row issue log and a forty\-file diff in one morning, holding the contradictions between them in your head.
 



 — You can read a code diff. You do not need to write code. You do need to notice that a fix landed in the wrong layer and ask why.
 



 — You see every bug as a class, and you also know when a class\-wide sweep is too risky to run mid\-acceptance.
 



 — You have product taste. You know a random banner when you see one, and you think about context before you delete an info icon.
 



 — You are calm under a date that does not move, and you would rather build the guard tonight than explain the same miss tomorrow.
 



  





 STRONG SIGNAL
 



 — You have been the single point of contact between a domain expert and an engineering team, and things shipped.
 



 — You have run or supervised AI coding agents on real work and have opinions about where they fail.
 



 — You have written a process rule after an incident that a team still follows.
 



 — Delivery in a domain where a wrong number costs money: tax, payments, insurance, compliance, analytics.
 



  





 NOT REQUIRED
 



 — Writing production code.
 



 — Prior knowledge of any specific domain. You learn each one from its primary sources.
 



 You will struggle here if your instinct on a hard question is "I'll check with the team", if you count tickets moved rather than proofs produced, or if telling a senior engineer that a green build is not evidence makes you uncomfortable.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 Proven experience managing complex engineering or software implementation projects, in technology\-driven environments.
 



  





 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field.
 



  





 HOW WE HIRE
 



 Work samples only. No behavioural interviews. About five hours over two weeks.
 


1. Design the loop (take\-home, 90 min): a stakeholder scenario with an expert, a client engineer and an agent fleet. Draw the loop, name where a human must touch it, and name the first three guards you would build.
2. The "done" report (live, 45 min): an agent's confident pull request with passing tests. Say what evidence you would demand and what you would say to the agent.
3. The expert relay (live, 45 min): a call transcript. Sort every item into build now, ask first, already answered, out of scope. Draft the one message you send back.
4. Incident to guard (live, 30 min): a real post\-mortem. Write the rule, then the mechanical check that enforces it.
5. Conversation with Leadership Team (60 min): we show you our own process review, cons included, and ask where you think we are wrong.



  





 Apply with a short note and one thing you wrote that other people still use: a process rule, a post\-mortem, a decision log, a runbook.
 



  





 To be considered for this opportunity, please complete our short application form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3Kp0vjf\-8TpgC3SCctw1p4MMO2HZMEgVUcZTxYpwZnyNOvg/viewform

title: SAP Implementation Lead - India
description:
Our client, a leading global healthcare and consulting organization, is seeking an experienced
 **SAP Implementation Lead** 
 to drive the successful delivery of large\-scale SAP transformation initiatives across global business functions. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in end\-to\-end SAP implementation delivery, S/4HANA transformation programs, stakeholder management, deployment governance, and cross\-functional execution within complex enterprise environments. This role will act as the primary bridge between business and technology teams, ensuring successful solution design, implementation execution, business readiness, and transition into steady\-state operations while maintaining alignment with program objectives and global standards.
   





 This is a contractual role through the end of 2026, with a strong likelihood of extension well into 2027\. Candidates must be able to commute to the Client’s on\-site Pune, India office.
   




 Responsibilities
   

* Lead end\-to\-end SAP implementation activities across planning, design, build, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support phases
* Drive SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives ensuring delivery within scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations
* Partner with business leaders, functional teams, System Integrators, and technical stakeholders to define implementation roadmaps and execution strategy
* Translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and industry best practices
* Own implementation governance, status reporting, risk management, and executive stakeholder communication
* Facilitate workshops, solution design sessions, decision\-making forums, and architecture discussions across business and technology teams
* Coordinate deployment planning, environment readiness, cutover activities, and transition into hypercare and stabilization phases
* Ensure seamless integration across SAP modules and connected enterprise systems
* Support business readiness activities including process alignment, change management, training coordination, and user adoption initiatives
* Oversee testing strategy and execution including SIT, UAT, defect management, and release readiness
* Establish delivery controls across project milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, and implementation quality assurance
* Drive data migration coordination and support governance around system readiness and operational continuity
* Provide leadership and mentoring across implementation teams while promoting delivery excellence and continuous improvement
* Act as the escalation point for implementation risks, blockers, and critical decisions throughout the project lifecycle
* Partner closely with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to support the ECC to SAP S/4HANA upgrade and ensure alignment with financial transformation objectives
* Lead finance\-related workstreams including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets, and Financial Reporting processes during the S/4HANA implementation
* Ensure financial controls, accounting policies, period\-close processes, and reporting requirements are appropriately designed and transitioned into the S/4HANA environment
* Support finance process harmonization, chart of accounts alignment, and integration between SAP Finance (FI/CO) and operational modules as part of the enterprise transformation program


 Requirements
   

* 10\+ years of experience delivering SAP implementation and transformation programs
* Proven experience leading at least 2–3 full lifecycle SAP implementations, preferably SAP S/4HANA
* Strong understanding of SAP implementation methodologies (SAP Activate, Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid delivery models)
* Experience managing global deployments and enterprise\-scale transformation initiatives
* Strong expertise across business process design, solution deployment, and operational readiness
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams including Business, IT, Data, Testing, Change, and Integration workstreams
* Hands\-on understanding of SAP functional landscapes and integration across enterprise applications
* Experience supporting cutover planning, hypercare, stabilization, and transition management
* Familiarity with testing governance, defect management, and release execution processes
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and executive communication skills
* Consulting experience within Healthcare, Pharma, Life Sciences, or regulated environments preferred
* Strong accounting and finance background with experience working closely with CFO organizations and finance stakeholders
* Experience supporting ECC to SAP S/4HANA system upgrades with significant Finance (FI/CO) transformation components

Driven by our mission Enhancing Society Together, we believe that each and every one of us holds the power to deliver measurable positive impact on society through our projects, and in our own operations
   

  

 What will you do
   

  

* Supervise and monitor execution of utility and civil infrastructure works undertaken by the EPC Contractor to ensure compliance with approved drawings and contract requirements for specifications, scope, quality, health and safety at site.
* Review construction methodologies, work procedures, resource deployment plans, and site execution strategies and provide technical comments and recommendations. Also, review and monitor implementation of approved Method Statements, Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs), Quality Plans, and construction procedures. Identify constructability issues, interface conflicts, site constraints, and design discrepancies and coordinate their resolution with stakeholders.
* Review contractor submissions, including GFC drawings, shop drawings, technical proposals, testing records, and quality documentation.
* Verify setting out, alignment, levels, grades, dimensions, and interfaces between utility networks and adjacent infrastructure. Conduct regular site inspections and surveillance to verify workmanship, construction quality, progress, and compliance with approved standards.
* Monitor construction of Utilities like water distribution systems, sewerage networks, stormwater drainage systems, power distribution corridors, utility crossings, and underground utility infrastructure. Also, supervise construction of GLSRs, ESRs, pump houses, substations, utility buildings, and other associated civil structures.
* Critically review ongoing construction activities, identify deficiencies, deviations, and non\-conformities, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Review contractor resource deployment, construction planning, and work fronts to ensure efficient project execution.
* Witness inspections, testing, and commissioning activities for utility networks, reservoirs, structures, and associated infrastructure.
* Monitor project progress, identify delays and risks, and recommend corrective measures to support timely project delivery.

 Roha, Raigad.

* Bachelor's degree in civil engineering.
* Ability to review engineering drawings, utility layouts, technical specifications, construction methodologies, and contractor submissions.

* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in construction, testing, and commissioning of utility infrastructure.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior role with a PMC, Owner's Engineer or EPC Contractor on large infrastructure or industrial development projects.

title: EC project Coordinator
description:
JOB PROFILE – ENVIRONMENTAL CLEARANCE (EC) PROJECT MANAGER

**Position:** Environmental Clearance (EC) Project Manager  
**Department:** Environmental Consultancy / Regulatory Affairs  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years in Environmental Consultancy / EC / EIA  
**Reporting To:** Director / Head – Environment / Senior Management

1\. JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced and technically competent **Environmental Clearance (EC) Project Manager** to manage end\-to\-end Environmental Clearance projects under the applicable environmental regulations and regulatory framework.

The candidate will be responsible for **project planning, EC documentation, EIA/EMP coordination, regulatory submissions, consultant coordination, client communication, government liaison, project tracking, quality control, and timely completion of EC projects**.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the **EIA Notification, 2006 and amendments, MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, PARIVESH portal, MPCB requirements, EC procedures, EIA/EMP preparation, public consultation, compliance requirements, and environmental regulatory processes**.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. EC Project Management

* Manage multiple Environmental Clearance projects from initiation to EC grant.
* Prepare project execution plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Monitor project progress against agreed timelines.
* Allocate work among project team members and coordinate with technical experts.
* Identify project risks, delays, and regulatory issues and take corrective action.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of all EC\-related documents.
* Maintain project trackers, status reports, and documentation.
* Conduct regular internal project review meetings.
* Coordinate with management regarding project status, challenges, and critical issues.

B. Environmental Clearance Process

* Handle the complete EC process from **project inception to Environmental Clearance**.
* Understand project applicability, category, schedule, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of:
* Form 1 / Form 1A, wherever applicable
* Pre\-feasibility / conceptual reports
* Terms of Reference (ToR) applications
* EIA Reports
* Environmental Management Plans (EMP)
* Executive Summaries
* Risk Assessment / Disaster Management Plans, wherever applicable
* Environmental Cost Benefit Analysis, wherever applicable
* Additional studies as required
* Coordinate submission and processing of EC proposals through the **PARIVESH portal**.
* Track proposal status and regulatory observations.
* Coordinate responses to queries, deficiencies, additional information requirements, and committee observations.
* Prepare and coordinate compliance to **ToR conditions and EC conditions**.

C. EIA/EMP Coordination

* Coordinate with EIA coordinators, functional area experts, laboratories, GIS teams, and other technical consultants.
* Review baseline environmental monitoring data.
* Coordinate studies related to:
* Air environment
* Water environment
* Noise environment
* Soil
* Ecology and biodiversity
* Traffic
* Socio\-economic environment
* Land use
* Hydrogeology
* Risk assessment
* Solid and hazardous waste
* Review EIA/EMP reports for technical consistency and regulatory compliance.
* Ensure recommendations and mitigation measures are practical and project\-specific.
* Coordinate preparation of environmental management budgets and implementation plans.

D. Regulatory Authority Coordination

* Coordinate with **MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, SPCB, local authorities, and other applicable government departments**.
* Monitor agenda items, meeting schedules, presentations, observations, and decisions.
* Coordinate preparation of presentations for SEAC/EAC/SEIAA meetings.
* Prepare briefing notes and responses for committee observations.
* Attend regulatory meetings along with the project team/client, wherever required.
* Maintain professional communication with regulatory authorities and stakeholders.

E. Client Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for EC\-related matters.
* Understand client requirements, project scope, and regulatory objectives.
* Conduct client meetings and project review discussions.
* Provide regular updates regarding project progress.
* Explain regulatory requirements and technical issues to clients in a clear manner.
* Communicate anticipated delays, additional requirements, and regulatory risks.
* Maintain good professional relationships with clients.
* Support business development by identifying additional environmental consultancy requirements from existing clients.

F. Team Management

* Lead and supervise EC project coordinators and junior environmental professionals.
* Assign responsibilities and monitor individual deliverables.
* Review work prepared by team members before submission.
* Train junior staff regarding EC procedures and documentation.
* Ensure proper coordination between technical, regulatory, documentation, and project teams.
* Maintain accountability for project deadlines and quality.

G. Documentation \& Quality Control

* Review all EC documents before submission.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and proper formatting of documents.
* Maintain project\-wise documentation and records.
* Ensure version control of reports and drawings.
* Maintain records of:
* EC applications
* ToR
* EIA/EMP reports
* EC letters
* Compliance reports
* Meeting minutes
* Presentations
* Regulatory communications
* Client communications
* Ensure that all submissions comply with applicable regulatory requirements.

H. EC Compliance \& Post\-EC Activities

* Coordinate preparation of **six\-monthly EC compliance reports**.
* Track EC conditions and implementation status.
* Coordinate with clients for compliance evidence and supporting documents.
* Review compliance reports before submission.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring requirements.
* Track EC validity, compliance schedules, and reporting requirements.
* Assist clients with amendments, transfers, extensions, validity\-related matters, and other post\-EC regulatory requirements.

I. Technical \& Regulatory Knowledge

The candidate should have working knowledge of:

* EIA Notification, 2006 and subsequent amendments
* Environmental Clearance procedures
* MoEF\&CC requirements
* SEIAA / SEAC procedures
* EAC procedures
* PARIVESH portal
* ToR process
* EC amendment procedures
* EC transfer procedures
* EC validity and compliance requirements
* Public consultation / public hearing process
* Environmental monitoring
* EIA/EMP preparation
* Environmental Management Plan
* Risk Assessment and Disaster Management Plan
* Solid Waste Management
* Hazardous and Other Wastes Management
* Plastic Waste Management
* Construction \& Demolition Waste Management
* Water and wastewater management
* Air pollution control
* Noise pollution management
* Greenbelt / plantation planning
* Rainwater harvesting
* STP/ETP/WTP systems
* Environmental monitoring and compliance

3\. REQUIRED SKILLSTechnical Skills

* Strong knowledge of Environmental Clearance procedures.
* Strong understanding of EIA/EMP preparation.
* Ability to interpret environmental regulations and notifications.
* Knowledge of PARIVESH portal and online EC submission.
* Ability to review technical environmental reports.
* Knowledge of environmental standards and applicable legislation.
* Understanding of pollution control technologies and environmental management systems.
* Ability to prepare/review presentations for SEAC/EAC/SEIAA meetings.

Project Management Skills

* Project planning and scheduling
* Team management
* Task allocation
* Deadline management
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Client coordination
* Multi\-project management
* Documentation control
* Quality assurance
* Follow\-up and escalation management

Communication Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong email drafting skills.
* Ability to communicate with clients and government authorities.
* Strong presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical and regulatory matters clearly.
* Negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.

Computer Skills

* MS Word – Advanced
* MS Excel – Advanced
* MS PowerPoint – Advanced
* PDF/document management
* PARIVESH portal
* Email and online communication tools
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD/GIS is an advantage.

4\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

**Essential:**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in:
* Environmental Engineering
* Environmental Science
* Civil Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Environmental Management
* Ecology / related environmental field

**Preferred:**

* M.Tech / M.E. Environmental Engineering
* M.Sc. Environmental Science
* MBA / PG Diploma in Project Management or Environmental Management

5\. EXPERIENCE

**Preferred experience: 5–10 years**

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:

* Environmental Consultancy
* Environmental Clearance
* EIA/EMP preparation
* MoEF\&CC / SEIAA projects
* SEAC/EAC coordination
* PARIVESH portal
* MPCB coordination
* Regulatory compliance
* Infrastructure / construction projects
* Township and area development projects
* Mining projects
* Industrial projects
* Water resources / river valley projects

Experience in handling projects independently from **EC application through EC grant** will be highly preferred.

6\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The EC Project Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Timely completion of EC projects.
* Number of projects successfully processed/granted.
* Quality and accuracy of EC submissions.
* Effective handling of regulatory observations.
* Client satisfaction.
* Reduction in project delays.
* Effective team utilization.
* Timely submission of compliance reports.
* Quality of EIA/EMP documentation.
* Regulatory coordination and follow\-up.
* Successful handling of SEAC/EAC/SEIAA observations.
* Contribution to repeat business and new project opportunities.

7\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The candidate should be:

* Responsible and accountable.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented.
* Detail\-oriented.
* Strong in follow\-up.
* Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously.
* Comfortable interacting with senior management and clients.
* Professional in dealing with government authorities.
* Able to work under strict deadlines.
* Good at team coordination and leadership.
* Willing to travel for client meetings/site visits/regulatory meetings when required.

8\. PREFERRED PROFILE

An ideal candidate should be capable of independently handling the complete lifecycle of an EC project:

**Client Requirement → Project Understanding → EC Applicability → Documentation → ToR Application → ToR Compliance → Baseline Studies → EIA/EMP → Public Consultation → Final EIA/EMP → PARIVESH Submission → SEAC/EAC/SEIAA Coordination → Presentation → Compliance to Observations → EC Grant → Post\-EC Compliance**

9\. JOB RESPONSIBILITY – SHORT VERSION FOR JOB PORTALS

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end\-to\-end Environmental Clearance projects.
* Coordinate EC applications, ToR, EIA/EMP reports, and PARIVESH submissions.
* Coordinate with MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, and other regulatory authorities.
* Manage EIA consultants, functional area experts, laboratories, and technical teams.
* Prepare and review EC documentation, presentations, and regulatory responses.
* Track project timelines and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Handle client meetings, project updates, and regulatory discussions.
* Lead and supervise EC project coordinators and junior team members.
* Monitor EC compliance and six\-monthly compliance reporting.
* Identify regulatory risks and provide appropriate solutions.
* Maintain complete project documentation and quality control.
* Support business development and client relationship management.

**Required Skills:** Environmental Clearance, EIA/EMP, PARIVESH, MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, Regulatory Compliance, Project Management, Team Management, Client Coordination, Technical Report Review, Presentation Skills and Excellent Communication Skills.

title: Account Manager
description:
ACCOUNT MANAGERAVW Storytellers LLP
 
**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Experience:** 
 4–7 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Chief Storyteller \& Strategist
 


 About AVW Storytellers
 
 AVW Storytellers is a strategic marketing and communications agency that helps brands build stronger narratives through
 **strategy, storytelling, creative communication and audio\-visual content** 
 .
 



 We work with corporates, institutions and ambitious brands to translate business objectives into meaningful communication.
 



 We are looking for an
 **Account Manager** 
 who can sit at the intersection of
 **client relationships, strategy, creative execution and team management** 
 .
 



 This is not a role where you simply take briefs and pass them on.
 



 You will be responsible for understanding what the client needs, getting the best work out of the team, maintaining relationships and ensuring that every assignment moves from
 **brief → thinking → execution → delivery** 
 .
 


 THE ROLE
 
 As an Account Manager, you will be the
 **bridge between the client and the AVW team** 
 .
 



 Your primary responsibility will be to:
 


* Own and nurture client relationships.
* Understand client businesses, objectives and communication requirements.
* Translate client requirements into clear internal briefs.
* Oversee the people working on different accounts and projects.
* Ensure the creative, strategic and production teams deliver the required work.
* Push the team to improve the quality of thinking and execution.
* Coordinate across strategy, creative, design, content, social media and production.
* Track timelines, deliverables and approvals.
* Identify potential issues before they become client problems.
* Ensure clients feel heard, understood and well\-managed.



 In short:
 



**You own the relationship.** 




**You drive the work.** 




**You get the team to deliver.** 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Client Relationship Management
 * Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong, professional and long\-term relationships with corporate clients.
* Understand client businesses, industries, audiences and communication challenges.
* Participate in client meetings and presentations.
* Proactively identify client needs and opportunities.
* Manage expectations, timelines and communication effectively.
* Handle feedback professionally and ensure it reaches the right team members.
* Maintain regular communication with clients and keep them updated on progress.


 2\. Internal Team Management
 * Oversee the teams working on assigned accounts.
* Allocate briefs and coordinate with relevant team members.
* Ensure that briefs are clearly understood before execution begins.
* Follow up with creative, strategy, design, content and production teams.
* Ensure work is delivered within agreed timelines.
* Review work internally before it reaches the client.
* Push teams when work needs greater strategic depth or creative quality.
* Ensure accountability across team members.



**You should be comfortable asking:** 




**“Where is the work?”** 




**“Is this the best thinking we can present?”** 




**“What is the next step?”** 



 3\. Strategy \& Creative Coordination
 
 The Account Manager should be able to understand both
 **strategic thinking and creative execution** 
 .
 



 You will:
 


* Understand brand and business objectives.
* Participate in brainstorming and ideation.
* Help convert business requirements into communication opportunities.
* Work closely with strategists and creative teams.
* Ensure that creative outputs remain aligned with the strategic objective.
* Understand campaigns, brand narratives, content, films, social media and communication assets.
* Present and explain the thinking behind the work to clients.



 You do
 **not necessarily have to be the strongest copywriter or designer** 
 , but you must have enough understanding of strategy and creative to recognise good work and drive the team towards it.
 


 4\. Project \& Delivery Management
 * Maintain project timelines and trackers.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously.
* Follow up on dependencies and approvals.
* Ensure deliverables are completed as committed.
* Flag delays, bottlenecks and risks early.
* Coordinate with production partners/vendors wherever required.
* Ensure final deliverables meet AVW's quality standards.


 5\. Social Media — Added Advantage
 
 Experience in social media will be a strong advantage.
 



 The ideal candidate should understand:
 


* Social media strategy
* Content calendars
* Platform\-specific content
* LinkedIn and Instagram communication
* Content performance
* Paid social basics
* Campaign planning
* Community/content management



 You don't necessarily need to be a hands\-on social media specialist, but you should be able to
 **understand, evaluate and manage social media work** 
 .
 


 WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 


 Corporate\-Client Experienced
 
 You should have experience working with
 **corporate clients, brands or established organisations** 
 , preferably in an agency, marketing, advertising, communications, branding, digital or consulting environment.
 



 You should be comfortable dealing with:
 


* Senior stakeholders
* Marketing teams
* Corporate communication teams
* Brand teams
* CXOs/business heads
* Multiple stakeholders and approval layers


 A Strong People Manager
 
 You should know how to get work done through people.
 



 You must be comfortable coordinating with different personalities, skill sets and functions while keeping everyone accountable.
 


 Strategic \+ Creative
 
 You should be able to understand:
 



**Business Problem → Communication Problem → Strategic Thought → Creative Solution → Execution** 




 You should not look at work only from a project\-management perspective.
 



 You should care about the
 **quality of the thinking and the final output** 
 .
 


 Proactive
 
 We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for instructions for every next step.
 



 You should be able to:
 


* Anticipate requirements.
* Follow up without being asked.
* Identify gaps.
* Suggest solutions.
* Escalate issues at the right time.
* Keep projects moving.


 A Strong Communicator
 
 Excellent verbal and written communication is essential.
 



 You should be able to communicate confidently with both a corporate client and an internal creative team.
 


 MUST\-HAVE SKILLS
 * 4–7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing corporate/enterprise clients.
* Strong client relationship management.
* Strong project and account management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to coordinate creative and strategic teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication.
* Ability to create clear briefs and follow through on execution.
* Strong follow\-up and ownership.
* Good understanding of marketing and communication.
* Ability to work under deadlines.
* Strong presentation and meeting skills.


 GOOD TO HAVE
 * Social media experience.
* Advertising/creative agency experience.
* Brand strategy experience.
* Content marketing experience.
* Digital marketing exposure.
* Experience working with senior corporate stakeholders.
* Experience in B2B communication.
* Experience with audio\-visual/film projects.


 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 
 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 



**1\. Own client relationships** 




 Clients know they can rely on you.
 



**2\. Understand the business** 




 You understand what the client is trying to achieve—not just what they have asked for.
 



**3\. Drive the team** 




 Work moves without the leadership having to chase every task.
 



**4\. Improve the quality of output** 




 You are able to identify when something is not good enough and get the team to improve it.
 



**5\. Maintain delivery discipline** 




 Timelines, approvals and deliverables are managed proactively.
 



**6\. Create trust** 




 Both clients and internal teams see you as someone who can get things done.
 


 THE AVW MINDSET
 
 At AVW Storytellers, we don't believe an Account Manager is simply a
 **messenger between the client and the team** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can
 **think, communicate, coordinate and deliver** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who can walk into a client meeting, understand the business problem, come back to the team, articulate what needs to be solved, drive the thinking and make sure the final work goes back to the client at the highest possible standard.
 


 If you are someone who enjoys owning relationships, solving problems, managing people and making good work happen — this role is for you.

title: SPM/Project Lead - Fundraising
description:
**SPM/Project Lead, Fundraising**
**Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives**
**Central Square Foundation**
**Location:** 
 New Delhi
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Senior Project Lead, Fundraising
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\-8 years
   

  

**About Central Square Foundation**
 Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is an education\-focused nonprofit working to ensure quality education for every child in India through system\-led reform. CSF partners with the government to design, implement and scale evidence\-based initiatives across its five priorities: Foundational Literacy and Numeracy, ensuring every child attains foundational literacy and numeracy skills; Early Childhood Education, building strong early learning foundations that prepare every child to succeed from their very first day of school; School Governance, strengthening school accountability and parent engagement for improving school quality; EdTech \& AI, leveraging technology to improve teaching and learning at scale; and High Potential Students, creating pathways for high potential students from underserved backgrounds to realize their potential and become leaders of tomorrow. CSF works across 13 states and one Union Territory.
   

  

**About Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives**
 The Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives (PSI) team works across CSF to build and nurture strategic partnerships and initiatives that advance the organisation's mission. The Fundraising team, a core part of PSI, is responsible for mobilising the resources and building the partnerships that enable CSF to pursue its priorities. This includes developing a strong and diversified fundraising pipeline, building and deepening donor relationships, translating CSF's work into compelling funding propositions, supporting effective donor stewardship, and strengthening the systems and processes that enable high\-quality and agile resource mobilisation. The team works closely with colleagues across CSF, including programme teams, leadership, Finance, Communications and RMEAL, as well as a wide range of donors, government stakeholders, philanthropic organisations and partners across the education and impact ecosystem.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to help build and grow CSF’s fundraising efforts, bringing strong relationship\-building, strategic thinking and execution capabilities to the Fundraising team within PSI across both donor cultivation and relationship management.
   

  

 The Project Lead, Partnerships \& Strategic Initiatives (Fundraising) will play a key role in advancing CSF’s fundraising efforts and building the institutional resources needed to support its mission.
   

  

 This is a broad, hands\-on role spanning the full fundraising lifecycle, from prospect research and pipeline development through outreach, donor cultivation, proposal development, engagement, stewardship and renewals, across CSR, domestic and global philanthropic foundations and HNIs/UHNIs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Project Lead, PSI, the role combines independent ownership with close collaboration, working closely with the Senior Project Lead and relevant colleagues across the fundraising function.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Fundraising Pipeline Building
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective donors across CSR, domestic and global philanthropic foundations, HNIs/UHNIs and other funding sources.
* Conduct prospect research and landscape analysis to identify and qualify prospective funders, assessing their priorities, interests, funding potential, decision\-making processes and potential areas of alignment with CSF.
* Identify relevant entry points for qualified prospects and develop tailored approaches for initiating and deepening conversations.
* Manage assigned opportunities through the fundraising funnel, from prospect identification and qualification through outreach, cultivation, proposal development and closure.
* Identify opportunities to leverage CSF's existing relationships and networks to strengthen connections with prospective funders and broaden the fundraising pipeline.
* Stay abreast of developments across philanthropy, CSR and the wider social\-impact ecosystem to identify emerging funding opportunities.
* Donor Cultivation
* Develop and advance relationships with prospective funders, identifying relevant opportunities and approaches to build interest in CSF and progress potential funding relationships.
* Develop and execute thoughtful cultivation plans for priority prospects, identifying relevant opportunities and touchpoints to build familiarity, trust and interest in CSF’s work.
* Contribute to converting prospective donors into long\-term CSF partners, including by identifying opportunities for multi\-year, expanded or repeat engagement.
* Donor Engagement, Management \& Stewardship
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing donors, serving as a responsive, reliable and trusted point of contact and ensuring a consistently high standard of donor servicing.

* Support efforts to develop existing donors into long\-term advocates, champions and connectors for CSF, creating opportunities for them to deepen their association with CSF’s mission.

* Fundraising narratives and collateral
* Develop high\-quality, tailored concept notes, proposals, and other funding applications, translating CSF's priorities, evidence and systems\-change approach into compelling propositions.

* Contribute to the development of broader fundraising collateral, including investment cases, one\-pagers, primers, prospect briefs, presentations, leveraging existing evidence and organisational knowledge and tailoring them to different donor archetypes.

* Represent CSF at relevant donor forums, conferences, sector convenings and meetings, as appropriate, helping strengthen CSF's visibility and positioning within the philanthropic and CSR ecosystem.

**What We're Looking For**

title: Project Engineer-Operations
description:
**Why This Role Exists**
The Project Engineer – Operations role exists to strengthen how construction projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered by ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows seamlessly across teams. This role transforms design data, BIM models, and project documentation into clear guidance that supports predictable outcomes, reduces risk, and improves decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle.


By proactively identifying issues, improving constructability, and supporting disciplined workflows, the Project Engineer enables project teams to move from reactive problem\-solving to confident execution.

**Responsibility and Focus Areas:**
-----------------------------------

**Document \& Models Management** – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents \& models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. The process can involve various Project Management Platforms like ACC Build, Procore, Bluebeam etc.

**RFI Management** – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings \& Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.

**Submittal Management** – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms

**Change Management** – Through the updated Drawings and Models, assisting the project in tracking and reflecting the cost changes (due to changes in Drawings, RFI or any other factor) on the Project Management Platforms. Also, generating a scope change report by comparing the revised drawings against the current set of drawings, to help the project teams in validating cost changes.

**Construction Document \& Design Review** – Review various construction documents like Design Drawings, Construction Drawings, Shop Drawings, Submittals and RFIs in the preconstruction phase to identify inconsistencies, incomplete information, and constructability issues.

**Model Based Coordination** – Leveraging BIM, identify and resolve spatial and temporal conflicts between trades virtually thereby preempting them in the field which could be costly and can derail the project schedule. Identify data inconsistencies using Navisworks.

**Quality check** models for completeness, accuracy and constructability based on design drawings and construction know\-how. Use automation wherever possible.


Use **Data Visualization** means to track metrics, indicators for project progress, and quality.

**Process Improvement \& Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and tools.
* Partner with innovation teams on automation and AI initiatives.
* Document lessons learned and best practices.

**A day in this role**


The day begins with reviewing priorities, open items, and any risks that need attention. You look at model updates, documents, and change requests to ensure the information going to the team is accurate and current. Short conversations with project managers, engineers, and field teams help align what needs to move first. You support client check ins by preparing updates or clarifying next steps. You guide junior team members on technical questions or workflow challenges. You spend time coordinating with cross functional groups so information flows without gaps. You also explore improvements in the way work is done by trying new tools or refining steps that can reduce rework. Before wrapping up, you capture key learnings, update trackers, and prepare for what the next day will require.

**What You Should Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
* 2\-5 years of experience in construction operations and/or BIM
* Strong understanding of construction lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of building systems and proficiency with tools such as Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, BIM 360 or ACC, and Procore.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills.

We provide services and solutions to the Construction Industry in the area of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting and Software Development. On any given day, we make an impact on several large\-scale construction projects across the globe through our services and solutions.


Since we started in 2013, we are at a continuous lookout for talent driven by the vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology.

title: Store Development & Project Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Future World India is looking for a hands\-on Store Development \& Projects Manager to manage the development and execution of our retail stores across India.
 



  





 The person will be responsible for taking a store project from initial site assessment and store brief through civil work, interiors, vendor coordination and final handover, ensuring that the store is completed on time, within budget and as per the required design and quality standards.

 .

* Review proposed layouts and identify practical execution issues before work begins.

* Flooring
* False ceilings
* Walls and partitions
* Civil modifications
* Painting and finishes
* Carpentry and furniture
* Glass work
* Electrical work
* Lighting
* HVAC
* Plumbing
* Fire\-safety\-related works
* Signage and façade
* Fixtures and other retail fit\-outs



 The candidate should be able to
 **understand drawings and specifications and translate them into actual site execution.** 




  





**3\. Contractor \& Vendor Management** 



* Identify and coordinate civil contractors, interior contractors and specialist vendors.
* Obtain and compare quotations.
* Prepare / review
 **BOQs, measurements and cost estimates** 
 .
* Negotiate with contractors and vendors.
* Allocate work and monitor contractor performance.
* Ensure contractors maintain agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Develop a reliable vendor/contractor network across key cities.



  





**4\. Project Management** 



* Manage projects from
 **site handover to store opening** 
 .
* Prepare project timelines and execution schedules.
* Monitor daily/weekly progress.
* Coordinate multiple contractors and agencies working simultaneously.
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action.
* Escalate major issues and provide practical solutions.
* Maintain project documentation, estimates, BOQs, quotations and completion records.
* Ensure projects are completed within the approved budget.



  





**5\. Cost Control** 



* Prepare preliminary project cost estimates.
* Track project expenditure against approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising quality.
* Check contractor bills and measurements.
* Control variations, additional works and project overruns.
* Ensure commercial terms agreed with contractors are adhered to.



  





**6\. Quality Control** 



* Conduct regular site inspections.
* Check workmanship, materials, dimensions and finishes.
* Ensure execution matches approved drawings/design standards.
* Identify defects and coordinate corrective action.
* Prepare snag lists and ensure timely closure.
* Conduct final quality checks before store handover.



  





**7\. Store Opening \& Handover** 



* Coordinate with internal teams including Retail Operations, IT, Security, Visual Merchandising and other stakeholders.
* Ensure all civil/interior works are completed before the committed opening date.
* Coordinate final testing and commissioning wherever required.
* Ensure the store is
 **100% ready for merchandising and operations** 
 .
* Complete project handover and close all pending issues.



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 We are looking for a
 **hands\-on project execution professional** 
 , rather than someone whose experience is limited to preparing drawings.
 



 The ideal candidate should:
 


* Have strong practical knowledge of
 **civil construction and commercial interiors** 
 .
* Have experience executing
 **retail stores, showrooms, offices, restaurants, commercial spaces or similar projects** 
 .
* Be comfortable spending significant time at project sites.
* Understand architectural/interior drawings and be able to coordinate their execution.
* Have good knowledge of civil, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, flooring, ceiling, lighting and finishing works.
* Understand BOQs, measurements, estimates and contractor bills.
* Have strong contractor and vendor management skills.
* Be a good negotiator.
* Be able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Be willing to travel extensively for store projects.
* Have the ability to independently resolve day\-to\-day site issues.



  





**Qualification** 




 A formal architecture degree is
 **not mandatory** 
 .
 



 Candidates with the following backgrounds may be considered:
 


* Diploma / Degree in Civil Engineering
* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Construction Management
* Diploma in Civil / Interior\-related fields
* Other relevant qualifications with strong practical experience



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in:
 


* Retail store development
* Premium retail
* Electronics / mobile / technology retail
* Fashion or lifestyle retail
* Showrooms
* Shopping malls
* Commercial interiors
* Multi\-location retail projects



 Experience in executing
 **multiple stores across different cities** 
 will be a strong advantage.
 



  





**Key Skills** 




**Essential:** 



* Civil construction
* Retail/interior fit\-outs
* Contractor management
* Vendor management
* BOQ \& estimation
* Site supervision
* Project scheduling
* Cost control
* Quality control
* Drawing interpretation
* Problem solving



**Desirable:** 



* AutoCAD – basic/intermediate
* MS Excel
* Project planning tools
* MEP knowledge
* Mall/landlord coordination
* Knowledge of retail design standards



  





  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




 The candidate will be responsible for:
 


1. **On\-time completion of stores**
2. Project cost within approved budget
3. Quality of civil and interior execution
4. Reduction in rework and project delays
5. Effective contractor/vendor management
6. Timely resolution of site issues
7. Compliance with approved store design standards
8. Store readiness before committed opening date



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate is someone who can
 **own the entire execution process** 
 .
 



 Someone who can walk into an empty retail space and say:
 



**“This is what needs to be done, this is how we will execute it, these are the contractors/vendors required, this is the estimated cost, this is the timeline, and I will ensure the store is ready for opening on time.”** 




 We value
 **practical knowledge, ownership, execution capability and problem\-solving ability** 
 more than titles or academic qualifications.
 



**Important Note** 




**This is not a pure architecture/design position.** 




 The role is primarily focused on
 **store development, civil \& interior execution, contractor management and project delivery.**

description:
**Health Actuaries – Rx Financial**
 Rx Financial team is seeking candidates for the following position based in the Mercer’s Gurugram office\-
   

  

**Manager \- Health Actuarial**
**Last Date to Apply:**
**What can you expect?**
 Mercer is the industry leader in helping companies create dynamic solutions that make a difference in the moments that matter. We are searching for a MercerRx Actuary – Pharmacy Practice. This is a tremendous opportunity to be a part of one of Mercer’s fastest growing specialty practices. MercerRx Actuaries are responsible for supporting various financial projects related to pharmacy benefit management (PBM) for clients. This role involves working closely with the MercerRx team, analyzing financial data, and providing recommendations to optimize client's pharmacy benefit programs.
   

  

 The Mercer RX team is a part of US Actuarial \& Financial group with a broad range of health actuarial \& financial management services primarily for US clients. Team serves over 40 locations across United States and has a client base of 1500\+ clients, producing more than 3,000 reports annually. With exciting developments happening in the US health business, there is expected to be increasing revenue growth, providing opportunities for career advancement at AFG India.
   

  

 This role involves working closely with the MercerRx team, analysing financial data, conducting cost projections, and providing insights to support the development and implementation of pharmacy benefit strategies. A key part of this role is also to act as a project manager for projects as well as liaise with onshore consultants on various work aspects. The candidate will be responsible for delivering an excellent and consistent experience for all our clients by meeting defined SLAs and onshore delivery protocols. The individual will be an offshore member of the client team. They will be responsible for maintaining excellent quality in their deliverables along with meeting the timelines. The individual should communicate their findings and suggestions through effective communication via different channels
   

  

**What is in it for you?**
* Holidays (As Per the location)
* Shared Transport (Provided the address falls in service zone) and meals at office


**We will count on you for:**
* Analyze pharmacy claims data and collaborate with the team to address any data\-related questions or issues.
* Assist in contract review, focusing on financial terms and definitions.
* Evaluation of comprehensive RFPs (Request for Proposal) to solicit proposals from pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) or vendors.
* Evaluate the competitiveness of pharmacy benefit vendors in the market, assessing capabilities, pricing, and services to ensure clients receive the best value.
* Monitor and address significant changes or disruptions to the formulary and retail networks, working with clients to assess the impact and develop strategies to mitigate any negative effects.
* Utilize Mercer’s proprietary financial tools to evaluate financial impact of PBM proposals.
* Coordinate with team members on projects, seeking guidance and ensuring accurate and timely completion.
* Prepare presentations and reports based on completed financial models.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in pharmacy benefit management.
* Works on complex actuarial/quantitative analysis projects with some guidance from onshore project team members to assess and project costs, rates, risks and trends associated with Rx Financials and Pharmacy Actuary Support
* Ensure seamless and superior client service delivery on the work aligned as per prescribed SLAs viz. Accuracy / Timeliness / Efficiency / Utilization etc.
* Proactively managing all stakeholders, which includes internal and onshore health business leaders.
* Participates in the development of company's intellectual capital to develop knowledge of health insurance actuarial services and products.
* Represent India AFG in global forums related to technical competencies and other mutual collaborations.
* Anticipate and plan for developing future technical capabilities across AFG India
* Ensure gating procedures, process control and enhancements via reporting, RCA etc.
* Active participation in SME/knowledge sharing/training/process improvement initiatives and participate in testing of new tools/processes and roll outs.
* Innovate and implement areas of improvement on quality and efficiency.
* Support transition of new services/geographies and in managing ongoing operations of established services.
* Participate and contribute in any special / ad\-hoc project requirements.


 Note: Applicants should be flexible working in shifts in onshore – offshore delivery model
   

  

**What you need to have:**
***Knowledge \& Skills:***
* Strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office—Word, Excel, and PowerPoint—and advanced programming skills are a plus (e.g. R, Python, SAS and SQL).
* Knowledge of data analysis, project management, and presentation design.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Intellectual curiosity; seeking opportunities to develop new skills.
* Ability to work independently and be flexible to work under tight deadlines and changing client needs.
* Superior organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Sound knowledge of process documentation, development of SOP, knowledge artefacts.
* Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a demanding work environment.


***Education:***
* Graduation with Mathematics/Statistics/Actuarial Science or any subject with sizeable mathematical content
* Fully / Nearly qualified actuary preferably in health domain


***Work experience:***
* Minimum 10 years’ experience overall in actuarial services (domestic or international)
* Experience in health insurance is preferred


**What makes you stand out?**
 Adaptable communicator, facilitator, influencer and problem solver
   

  

* High attention to detail
* Good relationship skills, proven ability to work on own initiative as well as in a team
* Stakeholder management mainly onshore stakeholders
* Adaptable communicator, facilitator and problem solver
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize time effectively
* Demonstrate quick learning skills


 Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
