title: System Interface Manager – Rail Metro Projects
description:
### **Job Description**

Job Title: **System Interface Manager – Rail Metro Projects**

Job Location: **Dhaka, Bangladesh**

**Join Us!**

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy’s deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!


This role requires to manage and coordinate all system interfaces across Rail Metro projects, ensuring seamless integration between engineering disciplines, contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders for safe, timely, and successful project delivery.


**What will you do?**

**1\. Interface Management**

* Develop and maintain the Project Interface Management Plan and Interface Register.
* Identify, monitor, and close internal and external project interfaces.
* Ensure timely resolution of interface issues affecting project delivery.

**2\. System Integration**

* Coordinate interfaces among OCS, Traction Power, Civil, Signaling, Telecommunications, SCADA, Rolling Stock, Stations, and Depot systems.
* Ensure technical compatibility and compliance across all project systems.
* Support integrated design, testing, and commissioning activities.

**3\. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as the focal point for interface management with clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and authorities.
* Lead interface meetings and drive action closure.
* Maintain effective communication across all project stakeholders.

**4\. Engineering \& Construction Support**

* Review design deliverables to identify interface risks and gaps.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering reviews and approvals.
* Support construction, installation, testing, and commissioning teams in resolving interface\-related issues.

**5\. Risk \& Compliance Management**

* Identify and mitigate interface\-related technical, schedule, and commercial risks.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and HSE regulations.
* Escalate critical interface issues impacting project objectives.

**6\. Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain interface registers, action trackers, and interface agreements.
* Provide regular interface status reports to project management.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of interface actions.

**Experience, Education and other Required:**
=============================================

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Civil, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent discipline.
* Overall experience of 20\-22 years with minimum 10 years of experience in Rail/Metro.
* Minimum 7 years in System Integration, Interface Management, Systems Engineering, or Project Engineering roles.
* Experience in managing multidisciplinary interfaces within Metro Rail projects.
* Sound knowledge of Health, Safety, Environmental, and Quality requirements for rail infrastructure projects.
* Preferred Industry Experience: Metro Rail, Railway Electrification, Urban Transit, High\-Speed Rail, Transportation Infrastructure, and Large EPC Projects.
* **Good understanding of:** Overhead Catenary Systems (OCS), Traction Power Supply, Signaling \& Telecommunications, SCADA Systems, Rolling Stock, Civil \& Depot Works, Station Systems and System Integration

**ED\&I:**

When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon \- we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more \- so whoever you are, we hope you’ll see things our way, too.


**About Linxon**

Building the infrastructure to power the world with carbon\-free energy.


We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy’s leading technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.


Linxon’s vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world\-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.


As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.


To know more about Linxon : www.linxon.com or watch our video:


Building the infrastructure to power the world \- we are Linxon! \- YouTube


### **Worker Type**

Employee
### **Job Type**

Regular
*At Linxon, we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world\-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.*

Job Title: **HSE Officer – Rail Metro Projects**

Job Location: **Dhaka, Bangladesh**

**Join Us!**

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy’s deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!


This role requires to support safe and compliant execution of Rail Metro Projects by implementing Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE) programs, ensuring adherence to statutory requirements, client standards, and company policies, while promoting a strong safety culture across project sites..


**What will you do?**

**HSE Compliance \& Implementation**

* Implement project HSE plans, procedures, and company safety standards.
* Ensure compliance with client, regulatory, and statutory HSE requirements.
* Conduct routine site inspections and safety audits.

**Site Safety Management**

* Monitor high\-risk activities including electrical works, lifting operations, work at height, confined spaces, and construction activities.
* Identify unsafe acts and conditions and ensure timely corrective actions.
* Verify compliance with Permit\-to\-Work (PTW) systems and safe work procedures.

**Risk Assessment \& Incident Management**

* Support preparation of risk assessments, method statements, and Job Safety Analyses (JSA).
* Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses, and track corrective actions.
* Maintain incident records and safety statistics.

**Training \& Awareness**

* Conduct HSE inductions, toolbox talks, and safety awareness programs.
* Promote a proactive safety culture among employees, contractors, and subcontractors.

**Contractor \& Environmental Management**

* Monitor contractor compliance with project HSE requirements.
* Support environmental controls, waste management, and sustainability initiatives.
* Participate in emergency response planning and drills.

**Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain HSE documentation, permits, inspection reports, and compliance records.
* Prepare weekly and monthly HSE performance reports.

**Experience, Education and other Required:**

* Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Occupational Health \& Safety, Environmental Science, or related discipline.
* NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent HSE certification preferred.
* Overall experience of 20 years with 10 years of HSE experience in Rail Metro, Railway Electrification, Infrastructure, Construction, or EPC Projects.
* Experience working on live construction and electrical project sites.
* Health, Safety \& Environmental Management Systems.
* Risk Assessment, Incident Investigation, and Permit\-to\-Work systems.
* Electrical, Construction, and Rail Safety requirements.
* Strong communication, reporting, and stakeholder management skills.

**What will you do?**

**1\. Contract Management**

* Administer customer and subcontract agreements from project award to closeout.
* Interpret contract terms and advise project teams on contractual obligations and entitlements.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and contractual requirements.

**2\. Claims \& Change Management**

* Manage variation orders, change requests, EOT claims, and commercial claims.
* Prepare, review, and negotiate contractual notices and claim submissions.
* Ensure timely identification and recovery of contractual entitlements.

**3\. Commercial Risk Management**

* Identify, assess, and mitigate contractual and commercial risks.
* Support project teams in managing contractual exposures and opportunities.
* Advise management on commercial strategies and claim positions.

**4\. Commercial \& Financial Support**

* Support project budgeting, cash flow, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Assess commercial impact of project changes, delays, and variations.
* Contribute to achieving project margin and profitability targets.

* Participate in commercial negotiations and dispute resolution discussions.

* Support preparation, review, and negotiation of subcontract agreements.

* Support resolution of contractual disputes through negotiation and settlement.

* Ensure contractual compliance with Health, Safety, Environmental, and Quality requirements.

title: S4E Program Management Support Testing Team
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As part of Siemens Energy’s global SAP S/4HANA transformation, this role provides Program Management and PMO support to the central Test Team, which delivers standardized, industrialized testing services across all rollout clusters.
   

  

 The Test Factory is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing end‑to‑end testing activities—including ITC, UAT automation support, Cluster Conflict Testing, Roles \& Authorization Testing (RAT) and Non‑Functional Testing—while ensuring governance, quality gates, KPI transparency and audit readiness. This role supports structured execution, cross‑factory coordination, and management reporting across complex, parallel rollout landscapes.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**

 WSP Transportation and infrastructure, as part of the WSP Group, specializes in providing sustainable development infrastructure solutions from initial concepts, through planning to full construction implementation.  Desired Skills:

You will also be expected to support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice.

* Proficiency in MS Outlook, and MS office (Excel, Word, Power Point) is expected.
* A thorough understanding and/or experience of using 3D Modelling, using Software such as Bentley Open Roads, digital delivery using iTWINs, Advanced 4D construction sequence using SYNCHRO would be a distinct advantage.

You'll harness key process reengineering concepts with cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be a successful "Process Architect \- Lead", you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Any Graduate/Post Graduate
* Analysis and problem\-solving (process focussed preferred)
* Stakeholder management across different organisation levels (C\-level to junior)
* Process Mapping/ Modelling tools e.g. Blueworks, Visio.
* A positive ‘can\-do’ attitude.
* Knowledge of process reengineering and analysis.
* Working knowledge of process automation tools.
* Ability to work successfully in a matrix organisation structure with dual reporting
* Experience of working in a project team (as a lead).


**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**
* Ability to review processes, engage with SMEs, and identify process risks and challenges.
* Familiarity with process design concepts, and ability to recognise automation opportunities and provide recommendations as part of optimisation review.
* Experience in working as a business analyst in technology projects.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment and thinking on your feet.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with process reengineering as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 Location \- Noida.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance \& optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance \& optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance \& optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Processing and Project Specialist
description:
**Who are we?** 








 Howden is a collective \- a group of talented and passionate people all around the world. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no\-limits mind\-set, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 26,000 employees spanning over 100 countries.
 







 People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It's what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down disappointed head\-hunters for years. Whatever your priorities \- work/life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering \- you'll find like\-minded people driving change at Howden.
 







**Working at Howden Re** 








 At Howden Re, we're on a mission to do things differently. Our no silo approach, elite team, and clear focus on innovation and relentless execution means our clients are at the heart of all we do.
 







 As a big 4 global reinsurance broker, we deliberately avoid the one\-size\-fits\-all approach, committing to creating bespoke solutions that address the unique challenges of a modern and dynamic marketplace. Our team is empowered to drive progress, creating opportunities for career and personal development, unlocking new value for clients, fostering long\-term partnerships, and using the collective power of Howden to change how the world sees risk and insurance.
 



 When you join Howden Re, you become part of a vibrant and entrepreneurial workplace culture that prioritises collaboration, ownership, and shared success. Here, your contributions will directly impact our mission to be the global partner of choice in reinsurance and strategic advisory.
 







 Be a part of Howden Re's exciting journey. Together, we are shaping the future of reinsurance.
 











**The Role** 








 This role sits within the Operations and Processing functions, supporting end\-to\-end post\-placement activities, ad hoc operational projects, and system adoption across key platforms including counterparties management systems and broking platforms.
 







 This position plays a critical role in ensuring operational continuity, strengthening processing capability, and driving consistency across regions during ongoing platform and operating model evolution.
   





 This role is well suited to someone with strong systems aptitude and a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach, who is comfortable acting as a hands\-on subject matter expert and supporting teams across multiple regions.
 











**What will you be doing?** 







* Deliver end\-to\-end processing across facultative, treaty and some binder business, from receipt through to payment with limited claims exposure.
* Provide Global XB training and support, including hands\-on guidance, troubleshooting and query resolution.
* Participate in system testing and validation, including new fields, document types and workflows.
* Deliver ad hoc operational and project support, including issue resolution and pragmatic workarounds.
* Support brokerage accrual processes where required.







**Development \& future responsibilities** 







* Support Open Twins rollout, leveraging prior experience of broking platform roll\-outs to facilitate adoption.
* Act as a subject matter expert for Open Twins, supporting training and user queries.
* Assist with security reviews and counterparties onboarding for new locations and entities where required.
* Provide targeted processing support across regions where bottlenecks arise, including one\-to\-one support and process optimisation.







**Key capabilities:** 







* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end post\-placement processes.
* Strong systems aptitude, ideally with exposure to Global XB and Open Twins broking platforms, risk processing workflows or similar platforms.
* Confidence acting as a hands\-on subject matter expert, providing training and troubleshooting support.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to support teams across multiple regions and functions.
* A problem\-solving mindset, with a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones, ensuring responsiveness and continuity of operations.











**What do we offer in return?** 








 A career that you define.
 







 Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society's greatest challenges.
 



 And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work \- and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.
 



 Diversity and Inclusion
 







 At Howden we value diversity \- there is no one Howden 'personality type'. Instead, we're looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
 






* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference, at work and beyond







 We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect \- regardless of age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, or family circumstances.
 







**Reasonable adjustments** 








 We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\* or hybrid working\*.
 







 If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it's the right fit for you, send us your application \- if your profile fits the role's criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
 



 \*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.
 



 Our sustainability promise
 







 We're on a life\-long journey to become an ever\-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.

title: Real Estate Manager, Real Estate
description:
**Description**
 Job Description:
   

  

 Amazon is currently looking to hire an experienced Manager \- Real Estate to join the team and play a critical role in supporting all property acquisition activity across East India. Regular travel will be require and this role reports to the Regional Manager – Real Estate North.
   

  

 In this role, you will support the India team to ensure the timely completion of new lease transactions including renewals, expansions, terminations, and reconfiguration of existing warehouse space. This encompasses the entire process from working with the local management team in defining the requirements, lease negotiations (business and legal terms), on\-site surveys, comparative financial analysis of lease transaction, and project management to affect the end result. Your primary objective in this role is to provide adequate, cost effective storage/operation space for Amazon on the continent given the market conditions working to challenging deadlines and budgetary requirements.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Tasks/Responsibilities**
 Deliver the Real Estate requirements of the assigned region in keeping with the overall strategy for maintaining and developing space requirements of Amazon India Warehouse/storage strategy
   

  

 Ability to monitor and manage large construction projects
   

  

 Develop a strong team of capable of working on and delivering various Real Estate requirements of Amazon
   

  

 Develop strong relationships with developers, property consultants, and key govt. functionaries in the assigned geography
   

  

 Strong understanding of the Zoning rules, Development planning byelaws, Master planning and Land title due diligence.
   

  

 Discuss with local stakeholders and governmental bodies to ensure support for FC (Fulfillment Center) expansions
   

  

 Innovate and structure complex real estate transactions
   

  

 Landlord relations, negotiation and contractor management, including escalation of any issues beyond regular daily activity
   

  

 Stakeholder management across different levels, both internal and external
   

  

 Basic qualifications – BE (civil)/ B. Arch. / LLB with PG in management / PMP / MBA with BE
   

  

**Experience/Skills Required**
* Significant exposure to Industrial, Commercial and Retail real estate asset class
* Significant transaction management experience with ability to close agreements, due diligences and commercial terms in line with corporate policies.
* Industry expert with strong network of key players in the market
* Strong knowledge of construction, budgeting, valuation and scheduling of large construction projects
* Asset Management skills (property and buildings), including the acquisition and disposition of assets and lease administration
* Experience of team building and team management
* Ability to proactively monitor and control various vendor relationships and external resources (including contract negotiation and vendor management skills)
* Knowledge of financial analysis techniques including discounted cash flow and capital budgeting
* Understanding of real estate trends, best practices and the vendor marketplace


**Basic Qualifications**
 5\+ years of Reliability Program Manager or equivalent experience
   

  

 Bachelor's degree, or 2\+ years of Amazon experience
   

  

 Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
   

  

 Experience with computers, including MS Excel, Word and Office
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience
* Experience with computers, including MS Excel, Word and Office


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of team management, budget responsibilities, supplier management, problem solving, and client/ customer relations experience
* Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
* Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics \& robotics
* Experience working with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) integrators
* Experience maintaining material handling equipment and integrated systems
* Experience in project management
* Experience with statistical analysis

**Job Title\- Project Manager**
**Location: Naroda**
 Experience\- 8\-10 years
   

  

**About Us**
 Ingersoll Rand advances the quality of life by creating comfortable, sustainable and efficient environments. Our products, systems and solutions increase the efficiency and productivity of industrial, commercial operations, homes, and improve the health and comfort of people around the world. We have opportunities for career growth through our diverse businesses which manufacture and service many well\-recognized brands.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 For our CSS division we are looking for a Project Manager who will lead multiple projects, ensuring alignment with internal and contractual requirements. The Project Manager will act as the central controller for all project\-related activities, coordinating cross\-functional teams and maintaining strong communication with stakeholders. This role also contributes to the development of processes and tools in collaboration with other Project Managers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of the assigned projects.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, cost control, risk registers, and status reporting.
* Identify and resolve with the team any potential deviations from the approved project plan and manage critical paths to achieve milestone goals.
* Coordinate internal functions, i.e. engineering, procurement, manufacturing and QA/QC.
* Facilitate consensus decisions and conflict resolution within the team
* Communicate project status, issues, risks, and activities; chair meetings and maintain minutes.
* Manage project costs and drive improvements in cost ratio
* Ensure key milestones are met within time and cost constraints, while adhering to proper quality requirements.
* Ensure goods and deliverables are supplied by Project requirements.
* Build trust\-based relationships with Customers, acting as main point of contact.
* Share best practices across the organization.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, procurement, and vendors to track deliverables
* Support audits and client reviews with accurate documentation.


**Basis Qualifications**
* 5\+ years’ experience in leading major projects in Oil \& Gas environment
* Lean knowledge valued
* PMP certification or equivalent valued
* Proven techniques / methods for resolving issues and conflicts
* Process oriented and self\-directed
* Strong verbal, communication, and presentation skills
* Ability to develop detailed project timelines / schedules
* High proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel, Word and Power Point
* SAP and Oracle proficiency valued
* Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001, API, ASME, etc.).
* Excellent organizational and stakeholder communication skills.
* Fluency in English required.
* Management and Industrial / Mechanical engineering degree preferred


**Key Competencies**
* Project Management
* Stakeholder communication
* Conflict resolution
* Process improvement
* Customer focus
* Drive for results
* Integrity and Trust
* Collaboration and Teamwork


**What We Offer**
* Dynamic international working environment
* Smart working policy and flexible working time
* Welfare program
* LinkedIn Learning access
* Inclusive and diverse culture, that values different backgrounds and experiences


 Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a customer\-facing environment.
* Good understanding of project management principles, including budgeting, planning, scheduling, and risk management.
* Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to analyze project performance and take corrective actions where required.
* Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools.
* Should have managed 5\-10 engineers/ managers in his present/ past roles.

* On\-time project completion.
* Revenue achievement against forecast.
* Gross margin performance.
* Collection and receivables management.

* Quality and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Timely closure of project risks and issues.

Design \& Planning

* Ensure designs are practical and suitable for on\-ground execution.
* Coordinate design requirements based on different store sizes, locations, and site conditions.

* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies to ensure timely completion of project activities.

* Follow up on quotations, material requirements, procurement, and deliveries.

description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high\-stakes, cross\-functional engineering initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy, system architecture, and operational execution. You will drive the technical delivery strategy for complex software integrations, scale distributed systems, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture leaders to turn ambitious roadmaps into reliable software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery Strategy: Architect end\-to\-end program delivery plans for multi\-team initiatives, translating high\-level product requirements into detailed engineering milestones.
* Architecture \& Dependency Management: Identify, track, and resolve complex cross\-functional dependencies across API contracts, core platform services, and external integrations.
* Technical Problem Solving: Drive alignment on system trade\-offs (e.g., latency, scalability, technical debt) and participate in architectural reviews to keep execution aligned with long\-term platform health.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical, security, and operational risks weeks before they impact launch schedules, building actionable contingency plans.
* Operational Excellence: Establish a lightweight, high\-impact execution cadence (e.g., agile delivery processes, integration testing syncs, execution metrics, post\-mortems) across distributed engineering teams.
* Executive Communication: Synthesize technical status, risks, and execution health into clear, data\-driven updates for senior leadership.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 7\+ years of experience as a TPM, Engineering Manager, or Systems Architect managing complex software development cycles.
* Technical Depth: Deep understanding of distributed systems, service\-oriented/microservices architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Ability to hold technical discussions with Principal Engineers and Architects.
* Execution Track Record: Proven history of delivering large\-scale, multi\-team software initiatives from inception to rollout on time and at scale.
* Leadership \& Influence: Outstanding stakeholder management skills; ability to align disparate engineering, product, and business teams without direct authority.
* Data\-Driven: Proficiency with program management frameworks (Jira, Confluence) and using metrics to measure delivery velocity and system reliability.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience in ad tech, data engineering, complex integrations (e.g., third\-party verification, SDK integrations), or high\-throughput real\-time systems.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Senior Program Manager, Quality – GTM Vendor Solutions
description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a strategic and highly collaborative Senior Program Manager, Quality to lead Quality orchestration across the GTM Vendor Solutions (GTMVS) ecosystem. This role will be responsible for driving a consistent, scalable, and data\-driven quality framework across our global vendor programs supporting both Sales and Support motions.
   

  





 The Senior Program Manager will serve as the central point of orchestration between GTMVS, business stakeholders, program managers, and our external Quality partner which provides Third\-Party Quality Assurance (3PQA) across our vendor programs.
   

  





 This role goes beyond quality reporting. The successful candidate will translate business priorities into quality strategies, identify systemic risks and opportunities, drive accountability across stakeholders and vendors, and use data and insights to influence operational decisions and improve customer and business outcomes.
   

  





 The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who understands how Sales and Support organizations operate, is highly analytical, communicates with executive presence, and can navigate complex stakeholder environments. They will be equally comfortable defining a quality strategy, challenging assumptions with data, diving into operational details, and holding internal and external partners accountable for outcomes.
   

  





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Responsibilities:
   

  





 1\. Quality Strategy \& Orchestration
   

  




* Own and evolve the GTMVS quality operating model across global vendor programs supporting Sales and Support.


* Translate business priorities, customer expectations, and operational goals into clear quality strategies, frameworks, and measurement mechanisms.


* Establish consistent quality standards, methodologies, governance, and ways of working across vendor programs while allowing for appropriate program\-level flexibility.


* Partner with GTMVS leadership and business stakeholders to define quality priorities, identify emerging risks, and establish measurable improvement goals.


* Serve as the strategic quality advisor to Program Managers, Vendor Managers, and operational leaders.


* Continuously assess the effectiveness of the quality model and identify opportunities to simplify, scale, automate, and innovate.



 2\. 3PQA Vendor Management \& Accountability
   

  




* Own the strategic partnership and operating model with our 3PQA Vendor provider across GTMVS programs.


* Establish clear expectations, performance standards, SLAs, governance mechanisms, and accountability frameworks for the quality partner.


* Orchestrate quality execution across programs, ensuring consistent sampling, evaluations, calibration, reporting, and feedback mechanisms.


* Hold the vendor accountable for quality outcomes, delivery against commitments, and continuous improvement.


* Identify gaps in vendor performance and lead structured remediation plans, ensuring actions have clear owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.


* Build a strong partnership with Vendors while maintaining the appropriate level of rigor, challenge, and accountability.



 3\. Quality Analytics, Insights \& Business Impact
   

  




* Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of quality performance across vendor programs, identifying trends, risks, root causes, and opportunities.


* Analyze quality data alongside operational metrics to identify the drivers of performance and understand the impact on customer experience, productivity, revenue, and business outcomes.


* Move beyond reporting metrics to provide actionable insights and recommendations to leadership.


* Establish mechanisms to identify systemic issues and recurring failure patterns across programs and vendors.


* Partner with Analytics, Operations, Training, WFM, and other GTMVS functions to connect quality insights to broader operational performance.


* Develop executive\-level reporting and business reviews that clearly articulate performance, risks, opportunities, and required decisions.



 4\. Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-Functional Influence
   

  




* Act as the central quality partner across GTMVS, connecting Vendor Management, Program Management, Operations, Training, Analytics, and business stakeholders.


* Build strong relationships with Sales and Support leaders and understand the distinct operating models, customer journeys, and quality requirements of each motion.


* Influence senior stakeholders and vendor leadership without direct authority to drive alignment and action.


* Facilitate quality governance forums, business reviews, calibrations, and performance discussions.


* Create clear communication mechanisms that ensure quality insights and expectations are understood and acted upon across internal and external teams.


* Confidently challenge stakeholders when performance, process, or quality outcomes do not meet expectations.



 5\. Continuous Improvement \& Innovation
   

  




* Identify opportunities to improve quality processes, methodologies, tooling, and operating mechanisms.


* Drive initiatives that improve the scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness of the 3PQA model.


* Explore and implement innovative approaches, including automation, AI\-enabled quality analysis, and new methods of identifying customer and operational insights.


* Partner with Training and Operations to ensure quality findings translate into meaningful coaching, enablement, and process improvements.


* Establish closed\-loop feedback mechanisms that connect Quality → Insights → Coaching/Training → Operational Improvement → Business Outcomes.


* Develop scalable playbooks and best practices that can be adopted across global vendor programs.



 6\. Quality Governance \& Operational Excellence
   

  




* Establish robust governance mechanisms to ensure quality programs operate consistently and effectively across vendors and geographies.


* Maintain clear documentation of quality standards, methodologies, processes, and decision rights.


* Drive regular calibration and alignment across internal stakeholders and the 3PQA partner.


* Monitor adherence to quality requirements and proactively identify operational or compliance risks.


* Establish structured action tracking and escalation mechanisms to ensure commitments are delivered.



 Drive a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, and accountability across the quality ecosystem.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  




* 5\+ years of experience in Program Management, Quality, Operations, Vendor Management, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience working with external vendors, BPOs, or third\-party operational partners.
* Experience working in either Sales, Customer Support, Customer Success, or another customer\-facing operational environment.



 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  




* Proven experience managing complex, cross\-functional programs across global teams and external partners.
* Strong understanding of Sales and/or Support operating models, workflows, and performance metrics.
* Experience designing or managing Quality Assurance / Quality Management programs, preferably in a BPO or outsourced operating model.
* Demonstrated ability to translate data and operational metrics into actionable business insights and recommendations.
* Good analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and connect quality performance to business outcomes.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and external partners without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to hold internal and external stakeholders accountable while maintaining strong, collaborative relationships.
* Experience managing vendor performance through governance, SLAs, KPIs, business reviews, and structured improvement plans.
* Experience driving process improvement, operational excellence, or transformation initiatives.
* Good executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information and clearly articulate recommendations.
* Demonstrated curiosity and an innovation mindset, with a willingness to challenge existing processes and explore new technologies, tools, and approaches.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and able to balance strategic thinking with strong execution discipline.
* Experience working across geographically distributed teams and global vendor ecosystems.
* Experience in Reporting, Analytics \& Automation: Working knowledge of Power BI, Power Automate, Tableau, and AI\-enabled automation tools, with the ability to support data analysis, reporting, workflow automation, and dashboard development.



 Suggested Skills:
   

  




* Strategic Program Management
* Quality Management \& Continuous Improvement
* Vendor Management \& Accountability
* Stakeholder Management \& Influence
* Data \& Analytics
* Sales \& Support Operations
* Executive Communication
* Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation \& Change Management

title: Senior Program Manager, RBS Brand Experience (BX)
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!
   

  

 Retail Business Services (RBS) Brand Experience (BX) leverages technology to improve customer experience and selling partner experience while lowering Amazon’s cost structure. Vision of RBS is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by 1\) improving the customer experience by fixing detail page catalog defects at scale, 2\) improving selling partner listing quality to drive GMS and reducing fulfillment defects to drive profitability and 3\) improving store operations efficiency by driving down cost of operations. We strive to eliminate the root cause of the defect and wherever not possible, we leverage machine learning to find and fix at scale or surface to selling partners. RBS has multiple programs/services aimed at reducing the listing friction, improving listing quality, reducing customer returns and improving star ratings of products that are dependent on selling partner support for effective execution.
   

  

 As the Senior Program Manager, you will own the development and innovation of products and features to improve brand experience for WW brands. You will be expected to identify the brand requirements using primary \& secondary research, gather business and systems requirements from internal and external stakeholders, propose and validate solutions, build proof\-of\-concepts, write specifications, drive roadmap from design to release, and manage the production launch. You will work with our internal/external product, business and technology teams to align on roadmap, prioritization, execution, navigating ambiguity and removing roadblocks while sustaining launch/expansion velocity. You will leverage your team to provide solutions that address peripheral needs (functional, legal, compliance). In addition, you will work closely on driving adoption of the product in your target segments, improving actionability of the insights you share through the initiative, and maintaining the quality of product features. You will own the reporting of metrics, and launches through business reviews at leadership level.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be an exceptional strategic thinker and will have exposure to customer experience improvement. Key skills for the role include an extraordinary ability to deal with ambiguity, to network effectively and influence partner teams without authority, to overcome unforeseen obstacles, and a passion for developing a deep understanding of the tech product.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build deep knowledge of RBS BX offerings, and business requirements.
* Develop trust\-based relationships with program’s key stakeholders.
* Help define the program strategies, develop program roadmap, and organize work steams and milestones; gain buy\-in and interlock across functional and regional leaders.

* Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, manage escalations, balance trade\-offs, and resolve complex execution and operational issues.
* Build and deliver program’s operational and management reports. Use data and analytics to make day\-to\-day business decisions and achieve results
* Work with global and regional teams to lead program’s adoption efforts. Hold regular business reviews with both internal and external partners
* Define and manage to program KPIs. Use Voice of the Customer, experimentation, data analysis, to set global quality standards and specifications for all product media for Amazon
* Present strategic program and user insights and recommendations to stakeholders and cross\-functional team.
* Provide ad\-hoc support and analysis to senior leaders on strategy documents and research requests.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager
Department Project Management Office (PMO) / Delivery
Reports To Delivery Manager / Head of Delivery
Experience 3+ years in project management (services / consulting environment)
Location Remote (occasional travel for client or team offsites, if required)
Employment Type Full-time
Shift Aligned to client time zones flexibility for European / North
American overlap where required
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our Project Managers set the standard for how delivery runs they own the plan, run the
governance, protect the margin, and make sure the client sees measurable return on every rupee
they spend with us.
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive Project Manager who can independently run
4–5 concurrent client projects end to end. This is a hands-on delivery role: you will run the sprint
ceremonies, own the RAID log, chase the blocker, build the dashboard, and then present the
delivery story to a client stakeholder in the same day.
The person who succeeds here brings structure to ambiguity, communicates in facts rather than
adjectives, and escalates early with a proposed solution attached. Project Mobilisation & Onboarding
Take overall responsibility for planning, coordination, execution, and completion of new client
onboarding in line with the standard onboarding playbook — delivered within the agreed
timetable and budget.
Prepare and maintain the onboarding plan, project plan, milestone schedule, resource
plan, and RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
Run project kick-off and mobilise extended teams, including internal squads, consultants, and
third-party vendors.
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and — where applicable — technical
specifications, involving all relevant stakeholders and confirming technical feasibility before
commitment.
Establish clear entry/exit criteria, acceptance criteria, and a RACI matrix (Responsible,
Accountable, Consulted, Informed) so ownership is unambiguous from day one. Service Delivery & Day-to-Day Operations
Lead day-to-day delivery of contracted services across 4–5 accounts, ensuring quality,
productivity, and continuity across distributed teams.
Ensure every project is delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Coordinate internal resources and third-party vendors to ensure proper execution.
Manage the testing and acceptance regime — including phased and final acceptance — and
align milestone sign-offs to the agreed performance-based payment plan.
Manage ticket queues and support operations: incident and request management, triage,
prioritisation, SLA tracking, and closure.
Track project performance against short-term and long-term goals, and adjust constraints based
on financial and delivery analysis. Daily & Weekly Milestone Targets
Break every project plan down into daily and weekly milestones with named owners, due
dates, and a clear definition of "done" — no task carried without a date against it.
Set and communicate daily delivery targets for each squad at stand-up; confirm at end of day
what moved, what slipped, and what is at risk for tomorrow.
Own weekly milestone achievement across all 4–5 projects: track planned vs. actual
completion, calculate slippage, and publish a weekly milestone scorecard to Delivery leadership.
Maintain a target of 90% weekly milestone adherence per project; any milestone missed
must carry a documented reason, recovery plan, and revised date within 24 hours.
Run a short daily blocker review — anything blocking a daily target for more than one working
day is escalated the same day, not held to the weekly review.
Reconcile daily task closure and weekly milestone burn against sprint burndown so the sprint,
the plan, and the client commitment never drift apart.
Chase timesheet and effort logging daily so weekly effort-vs-plan variance is accurate before it
reaches Finance or the client.
Publish a weekly delivery summary every Friday per account: milestones achieved,
milestones missed with cause, upcoming week's targets, open risks, and open blockers.
Convert weekly misses into corrective action in the next planning cycle — repeated slippage on
the same workstream is treated as a structural problem, not a scheduling one. Agile & Scrum Execution
Run all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and
backlog refinement.
Own and groom the product/project backlog alongside the Product Owner and client
stakeholders.
Break epics into user stories with clear acceptance criteria; ensure stories are estimated and
sprint-ready before planning.
Track and act on velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, throughput, and defect trends
— forecast from data, not optimism.
Apply the right framework per engagement: Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban, Waterfall, or a hybrid
model, as the contract and client maturity demand.
Continuously improve workflow efficiency; ensure retrospective actions are actually
implemented, not just recorded. Tooling, Dashboards & Reporting
Configure and administer Azure DevOps and Jira — boards, workflows, custom fields, epics/
features/stories, sprints, iterations, and release plans.
Build and maintain dashboards for sprint progress, delivery health, defect trends, SLA
adherence, resource utilisation, and risk exposure — for both team-level and executive
audiences.
Produce weekly status reports (WSR), MIS reports for senior management to support
strategic decisions, governance decks, and monthly delivery reviews.
Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, communication plans, and a live
decision/action log.
Working knowledge expected across: Confluence, ServiceNow, MS Project, MS Visio, Excel
(advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards), PowerPoint, and BI/reporting tools such
as Power BI.
Stay current on new Excel, PowerPoint, and AI-assisted productivity tooling to keep reporting
sharp and effort low. Governance, Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Operate the engagement governance model: chair operational performance meetings, support
periodic governance committee reviews, and contribute to annual strategic reviews.
Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, and minutes within agreed timelines.
Manage escalations through defined governance tiers — with a documented owner, action,
and target date for every open item.
Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for client stakeholders on assigned accounts.
Present oral and written reports covering plans, problems, and resolutions to the appropriate
level of management.
Manage expectations proactively: flag anything that may affect timely completion the moment it
is known, never at the review. Risk, Change & Blocker Management
Proactively identify, document, and communicate risks, and propose mitigation approaches
before they become issues.
Identify roadblocks early — scope creep, technical dependencies, resource constraints, thirdparty
delays — and drive them to resolution.
Run a disciplined blocker/impediment process: log it, assign it, escalate it, close it within
agreed timelines.
Manage all changes to scope, schedule, and cost through a formal change-control process —
impact assessment, client approval, re-baselining.
Convert genuine scope expansion into commercial opportunity rather than absorbing it silently. Commercial & Resource Management
Manage project budget and resource allocation; monitor costs and track expenses to protect
delivery margin.
Support Work Orders, SOWs, and Change Requests — including scope, volumes, charges,
and applicable service levels.
Communicate resource requirements and availability ahead of need, not at the point of crisis.
Track and follow up on client invoices and receivables in coordination with Finance.
Ensure sufficient, competent staffing and team continuity across extended teams and
consultants. Quality, Security & Compliance
Ensure final deliverables meet both the agreed brief and the technical requirements.
Ensure delivery complies with contractual security requirements, data processing obligations,
supplier code of conduct, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Maintain audit-ready project documentation at all times. People & Continuous Improvement
Mentor team members on Agile practice, delivery hygiene, and stakeholder communication.
Support team building, resourcing, and retention within a distributed working model.
Continuously identify ways to improve quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of delivery in line
with engagement improvement commitments.
EXPERTISE YOU'LL BRING
Must-Have
3+ years of project management experience, ideally in an IT services, consulting, digital
agency, or managed-services environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage 4–5 concurrent projects without letting delivery quality slip
on any of them.
Hands-on proficiency with Azure DevOps and Jira — configuration and reporting, not just
usage.
Strong practical command of Agile and Scrum, backlog management, sprint execution, and
ceremony facilitation.
Working knowledge of RACI, RAID logs, change control, and structured escalation/
blocker mechanisms.
Proven discipline in setting and tracking daily and weekly milestone targets, with visible
planned-vs-actual reporting.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and incident/request management (ServiceNow or
equivalent) and time/resource management tooling.
Strong MS Office skills — Excel (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards) and PowerPoint at a clientpresentable
standard.
Excellent written and spoken English; structured, data-driven communication.
Strong attention to detail, organisational discipline, and the ability to prioritise across competing
deadlines.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Project Management, Business, or a
related discipline (Master's/MBA desirable).
Proven self-management in a remote setting — reliable connectivity, a professional working
environment, and strong async communication habits.
Certification (at least one required)
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I / II)
PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, or PRINCE2 / PRINCE2 Agile
SAFe Agilist / SAFe Scrum Master
ITIL Foundation (advantage for support and managed-services engagements)
Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer (advantage)
Good-to-Have
Exposure to SLA/KPI-based engagements and commercial constructs (SOWs, Work Orders,
Change Requests).
Experience with onshore–offshore or distributed delivery models serving European or North
American clients.
Basic understanding of databases/queries, SDLC, UI/UX principles, CMS platforms, and QA/
production environments.
Familiarity with creative delivery workflows (design, content, video) where engagements are
agency-adjacent.
Exposure to regulated environments (BFSI, healthcare, public sector) or government/publicsector
project delivery.
Commercial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, margin management, and contract awareness.
QUALITIES & CHARACTERISTICS
Ownership: a strong sense of personal responsibility for your own and the team's work — you
proactively step in to ensure quality delivery within timeframes, whatever the situation.
Composure: able to lead cross-functional teams and stay calm under tight deadlines and client
pressure.
Negotiation: comfortable holding a position with a client while keeping the relationship intact.
Curiosity: eager to learn new tools, frameworks, and techniques in project management and
delivery.
Judgement: knows what to escalate, what to absorb, and what to decide alone.
KEY SUCCESS FACTORS IN THIS ROLE
Managing multiple projects and priorities across regions and time zones simultaneously.
Balancing global delivery standards with individual client expectations.
Maintaining accuracy and predictability of forecasts while running at high volume.
Building trust with clients you will rarely, if ever, meet in person.
SUCCESS INDICATORS — FIRST 6 MONTHS
All assigned projects delivered within agreed schedule, effort, and margin variance thresholds.
90% weekly milestone adherence sustained across all assigned projects, with every miss
carrying a documented cause and recovery plan.
Daily targets and weekly scorecards published consistently without prompting from leadership.
Live, accurate dashboards available to leadership and clients without manual chasing.
Zero surprises — risks and blockers surfaced before they become escalations.
Measurable improvement in sprint predictability and velocity stability.
Clean, audit-ready documentation and a fully current RAID log across every account.
WHAT WE OFFER
100% remote working with a distributed, delivery-focused team.
Exposure to diverse clients, domains, and technology stacks — broader in a year than most
product roles give in three.
Certification sponsorship and structured learning support.
Real ownership from day one — you run your accounts, not someone else's checklist.
Note: Adjust tool names and certification preferences to match your actual delivery stack before
publishing.

The role serves as the primary escalation point between business/function stakeholders and the extended TMO team, driving consistent execution of transition strategy and governance across all active waves, and ensuring a sustainable, well-governed handover into steady-state operations. 1.1 Enterprise Transition Execution Own end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale, multi-wave transitions across towers, vendors and geographies within the Global IT portfolio. title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
SUMMARY 
 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a technically strong Senior Technical Project Manager to drive delivery of complex, technology-heavy projects for our retail-focused client portfolio. This role is weighted toward technical ownership and hands-on execution the ideal candidate is someone who can dig into code, architecture, and infrastructure decisions directly, not just track status. Deep working knowledge of Python, .NET, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) is essential, along with practical experience implementing modern deployment strategies (CI/CD, blue-green, canary releases) and a solid understanding of retail industry systems such as omnichannel commerce, POS, supply chain, and customer engagement platforms. 
 The Senior Technical Project Manager will be hands-on in reviewing architecture and code-level decisions, troubleshooting technical blockers, validating deployment pipelines, and ensuring solutions are technically sound using project management skills as a means to keep technical delivery on track, rather than as the core focus of the role. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the technical delivery of projects end-to-end from solution design review through deployment for retail client engagements. 
 Get hands-on with Python and .NET codebases where needed: reviewing code quality, debugging issues, validating designs, and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices. 
 Evaluate and make recommendations on cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP compute, storage, networking, managed services, and cost optimization. 
 Design, implement, and troubleshoot deployment strategies and pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), blue-green/canary releases, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM). 
 Perform technical risk assessments and gap analyses on architecture, integrations, and non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, security). 
 Translate business and functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs. 
 Set up and maintain project-level technical tracking (sprint boards, technical backlogs) using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with a focus on technical accuracy over administrative reporting. 
 Serve as the technical point of contact for client engineering counterparts, resolving technical queries and unblocking implementation issues directly. 
 Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud service offerings (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) based on technical fit, scalability, and cost including proof-of-concept work where needed. 
 Embed DevSecOps practices into the SDLC security scanning, compliance checks, and governance gates within CI/CD pipelines. 
 Apply retail domain knowledge to solution design for e-commerce platforms, POS integration, inventory/order management, supply chain systems, and customer data platforms. 
 Contribute technical estimations, architecture diagrams, and solution approaches for proposals and pre-sales efforts. 
 Evaluate and pilot AI/automation tooling (agentic coding tools, LLM Ops, AI guardrails) to improve engineering efficiency and delivery quality. 
 Produce and maintain technical documentation architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, integration specs, and technical decision logs. 
 Coordinate lightweight project logistics (timelines, dependencies, status updates) only to the extent needed to keep technical delivery unblocked this is not a resourcing/staff-management role. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience 
 12+ years of overall IT/engineering experience, with substantial hands-on time writing, reviewing, or architecting Python and/or .NET applications. 
 Strong, current working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) including compute (EC2/App Services/Compute Engine), storage, networking, serverless (Lambda/Azure Functions), and managed database services gained through direct implementation, not just oversight. 
 Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies : Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes); blue-green/canary releases; infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates). 
 Prior technical delivery experience within the retail domain e-commerce, POS, order management, supply chain, merchandising, or customer loyalty platforms strongly preferred. 
 Experience integrating and evaluating different cloud service offerings (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) for fit, scalability, and cost. 
 Working knowledge of monitoring/observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch, Grafana) and hands-on incident/troubleshooting experience. 
 Practical exposure to AI/ML-driven tooling or automation frameworks in SDLC processes (e.g., agentic coding tools, LLM Ops, AI guardrails) is a strong plus. 
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery is expected, 
 Skills 
 Strong, practical command of Python and/or .NET : able to read, review, and reason about code, APIs, microservices, and integration patterns directly rather than through a manager's summary. 
 Solid grasp of cloud architecture across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models, with the ability to independently evaluate trade-offs and design options. 
 Deep understanding of software deployment and release management rollback strategies, zero-downtime deployments, and pipeline debugging. 
 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills comfortable digging into logs, configs, and system behavior to diagnose root causes. 
 Ability to produce clear technical documentation (architecture diagrams, runbooks, technical specs) independently. 
 Working knowledge of security and compliance considerations relevant to retail/e-commerce (PCI-DSS, data privacy). 
 Clear technical communication skills for engaging with engineering teams and client technical counterparts this role is not focused on executive stakeholder management or team leadership. 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 Relevant certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe Agilist, AWS/Azure/GCP certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are highly desirable. 
 
 Preferred Attributes 
 Prior consulting or IT services experience serving retail/fashion clients. 
 Experience with tooling strategy and SDLC process tracking. 
 Comfortable being the most technically hands-on person in the room prototyping, debugging, or reviewing designs directly rather than delegating. 
 A proactive, self-directed mindset with the ability to operate independently on technical problems in fast-paced, client-facing environments.

title: Senior Civil Engineer
description:
Only Male Candidates from Pune, PCMC will be considered. Apllicants other than Pune (out of Pune city) will not be considered. 
 
 Position Senior Civil Engineer Department Projects / Construction Reporting To Site In-Charge / Project Manager Location PCMC & Nearby Areas, Pune Employment Type Full-Time 


 Preferred candidate locations - Ravet/Pimple Gurav/Bhosari/Chakan/Punawale/Moshi/Alandi/Charholi/PCMC and nearby areas only. 
 1. Job Purpose The Senior Civil Engineer will be responsible for assisting in the planning, execution, supervision, and monitoring of civil construction activities at project sites. The role requires strong knowledge of civil engineering principles, practical site execution skills, quality awareness, and the ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, vendors, and internal teams. 
 The candidate will ensure that construction work is executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, project schedules, and company requirements. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Site Supervision & Execution Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at the assigned project site. Monitor construction activities including excavation, PCC, RCC, reinforcement, shuttering, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring, tiling, painting, and other finishing works. Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and instructions from senior engineers. Check the availability and proper utilization of manpower, materials, tools, machinery, and equipment. Coordinate with contractors and subcontractors to ensure timely completion of assigned activities. Monitor the progress of work and report delays, site issues, and constraints to the reporting manager. Ensure proper sequencing of construction activities to avoid unnecessary delays and rework. B. Drawing & Technical Understanding Read and understand structural, architectural, civil, and service-related drawings. Verify dimensions, levels, alignments, locations, and other details before execution. Coordinate with senior engineers and consultants in case of discrepancies or missing information in drawings. Ensure that construction is carried out according to the latest approved drawings. Maintain proper records of drawings, revisions, instructions, and site-related documents. Assist in preparing basic quantity calculations and measurements from drawings. C. Quality Control Ensure that construction work complies with approved specifications and required quality standards. Check reinforcement, shuttering, concrete, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, and finishing work before proceeding to the next stage. Assist in checking the quality of incoming construction materials. Coordinate with the quality-control team for inspections and testing. Ensure proper curing of concrete and masonry work. Identify defective or substandard work and immediately report it to the concerned senior. Monitor rectification and ensure that rejected or defective work is corrected properly. Minimize material wastage and prevent unnecessary rework. D. Quantity & Measurement Assist in taking measurements of completed work executed by contractors. Prepare and maintain measurement records for civil works. Assist in checking contractor bills against actual site measurements. Verify quantities of materials consumed at the site. Assist in preparing basic BOQ quantities and material requirements. Maintain records of concrete, steel, cement, sand, blocks, tiles, and other construction materials. Monitor material consumption against approved quantities and identify unusual wastage. E. Material Management Coordinate with the stores and purchase departments regarding material requirements. Check materials received at site for quantity and basic quality requirements. Ensure materials are used appropriately and wastage is controlled. Inform the senior engineer about upcoming material requirements to avoid work stoppage. F. Contractor & Labour Coordination Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, supervisors, and skilled/unskilled workers. Allocate daily work activities as instructed by senior engineers. Monitor labour productivity and work progress. Maintain discipline and proper coordination among site workers. Report manpower shortages and productivity issues to the reporting manager. Ensure workers understand the required quality and execution standards. Coordinate with contractors for timely completion of assigned targets. 
 G. Safety Compliance Follow and promote all safety rules and procedures at the construction site. Ensure workers use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Immediately report unsafe working conditions, accidents, near misses, and hazards. Ensure proper housekeeping and safe movement of workers and materials. Coordinate with the safety team to address site safety observations. Never compromise safety for speed or project deadlines. H. Daily Reporting & Documentation Prepare daily progress reports as required by the reporting manager. Record manpower deployment, material consumption, work progress, and major site activities. Maintain site photographs and progress documentation. Report any technical, manpower, material, quality, or coordination issues promptly. Maintain proper records of inspections, measurements, checklists, and site instructions. Assist senior engineers in preparing weekly and monthly project progress reports. 3. Coordination Responsibilities The Senior Civil Engineer will regularly coordinate with: Senior Civil Engineers Site In-Charge / Project Manager Architects Structural Consultants MEP Teams Quality Control Team Safety Team Purchase Department Stores Department Contractors & Subcontractors Vendors and Suppliers The candidate must maintain professional communication and ensure that instructions received from senior management are properly implemented at site.

 Experience: 5-7 years of relevant experience in residential and commercial construction is preferred. 5. Required Technical Skills The candidate should have knowledge of: Civil construction practices RCC and structural work Reinforcement and shuttering Masonry and plastering Waterproofing Flooring and finishing works Quantity estimation and measurement Reading architectural and structural drawings Basic knowledge of AutoCAD MS Excel and MS Office Basic understanding of construction materials Quality control procedures Site safety practices

 7. The candidate must have a hands-on approach, good observation skills, and the ability to identify site-level problems and escalate them appropriately.
