title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Elevate Consulting provides project management and construction support services to construction companies . We work closely with contractors, project managers, consultants, vendors, and field teams to support projects from planning through completion. We are looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager who can independently manage and support multiple construction projects. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage end-to-end project management from award through successful completion. Oversee project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Coordinate with clients, architects, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and other project stakeholders. Review drawings, BOQs, specifications, scope of work, project schedules, resource plans, and construction methodologies. Manage RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, change orders, procurement, and project documentation. Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation or recovery plans. Conduct project review and coordination meetings and provide recommendations to stakeholders. Ensure compliance with contract conditions, technical specifications, safety requirements, and quality standards. Coordinate directly with U.S.-based project management and field teams and take ownership of open items through completion. Candidate Requirements Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred. Minimum 5+ years of construction/project management experience . Strong understanding of construction drawings, specifications, BOQs, and scopes of work. Experience with RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, scheduling, and subcontractor coordination . Strong knowledge of architectural, structural, civil, and MEP construction activities. Ability to review drawings and identify scope conflicts, missing information, and potential field issues. Strong written and spoken English. Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PDF/Bluebeam-type software. AutoCAD knowledge is a plus. Experience supporting U.S. construction projects is highly preferred. Must be organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously. Must be able to work independently and communicate effectively with U.S.-based clients and project teams. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a construction-minded Project Manager, not just a documentation coordinator . The candidate should understand how projects are actually built, be capable of reviewing drawings and specifications, identifying potential issues, coordinating multiple trades, managing project documentation, and independently following tasks through completion.

title: Program Manager, Supply chain, JWO
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
  

  

We are optimizing the shopping experience for Amazon’s Customers in the Physical retail space. This role will be a key member of the program team located in Hyderabad supporting Just Walk Out (JWO) tech and business teams. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-energy and ever\-changing environment.  

  

A successful candidate will:  

* Have the ability to work independently in a broad array of environments.
* Manage cross\-functional project teams, planning and organizing, and executing complex projects across multiple organizations and stakeholders to enable the launch of new sites at scale.
* Build strong partnerships with operations leaders to understand improvement opportunities.
* Have the ability to work in fast\-paced environment.
* Confidence operating in a highly ambiguous and iterative business space.
* High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
* Willingness to challenge and influence senior leaders through data driven insights.
* Able to work with internal and external partners to drive long term solutions.

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.
* Build relationships and partner across cross\-functional teams to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders and partners to deliver on project goals. Coordinate a portfolio of programs from inception to delivery.
* Define and implement metrics to measure performance across procurement, operations and transportation logistics.
* Compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading meetings to align on project requirements.
* Communicate program status updates to the stakeholders and senior leadership on a regular basis.
* Provide program insights and data driven recommendations to support strategic decisions.
* Communicate efficiently with internal and external partners to drive process improvements.

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. description:

title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.  

  

Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision\-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re\-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever\-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well\-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.  

  

We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of \~200\+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10\+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.  

  

We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly\-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self\-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self\-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities \-
  

  

* Define and manage cross\-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
* Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade\-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross\-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
* Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.

  

A day in the life  

TFS has over 200\+ engineers, and 20\+ product \& program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.  

  

About the team  

Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation \& management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with \~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end\-to\-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

description:

 In the Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce (WW R\&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long\-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.
   

  

 WW R\&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R\&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross\-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.
   

  

 Refunds Experience is a charter of WW R\&R that is dedicated to providing the best\-in\-class refunds experience to customers, by prioritizing faster refunds and ensuring 100% completeness. We strive to build a strong enforcement function to preserve CX, mitigate risk \& avoid policy abuse.
   

  

 We are looking for a seasoned Program Leader who has a passion for working in cross\-functional environments, strong communication skills (verbal \& written) in addition to proven program management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.

title: PMO / Delivery Lead — Enterprise AI
description:
**The Job** 




 You will own delivery across Applix’s enterprise AI and data engagements, working with engineering teams in India and enterprise customers in the US.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on delivery leadership role for someone who can bring structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex AI programs. You’ll work across technical teams, customer stakeholders, and business leadership to move programs from discovery through production and adoption.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* **End\-to\-end delivery** 
 of enterprise AI and data programs — from discovery and proof of concept through production deployment and adoption.
* **Program governance and reporting** 
 — establishing a clear operating rhythm through weekly updates, stage reviews, executive reporting, and decision tracking.
* **Risk and dependency management** 
 — identifying blockers early, driving resolution, and ensuring dependencies across internal and customer teams stay on track.
* **Scope, timeline, and budget management** 
 across multiple concurrent workstreams, with clear and transparent reporting.
* **Cross\-functional coordination** 
 between engineering teams in India and customer stakeholders in the US, ensuring everyone is working from the same priorities, decisions, and delivery plan.
* **Customer communication and execution discipline** 
 — ensuring stakeholders have consistent visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.



  





**The Part Most Job Descriptions Leave Out** 



* Enterprise AI delivery is
 **40% coordination and 60% dealing with people who are busy, skeptical, or both.**
* You will chase a VP for a spreadsheet three times and still be welcome on the next call.
* You will tell a client data scientist that their team’s data has a defect, with evidence, and hold the position when they push back — because they’re often right and occasionally not.
* You will be the person who says,
 **“That date won’t hold,”** 
 in week two rather than week nine.
* **We need someone with spine and judgment about when to use it.**
* People who only escalate are exhausting. People who never escalate are worse.



**What We Need** 



* Real delivery ownership on
 **complex technology programs** 
 — AI, data, cloud, or adjacent areas. Titles matter less than whether things shipped.
* Enough technical fluency to follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate, and know when an engineer is describing a real blocker versus a preference.
 **You don’t need to be an engineer.**
* Experience running delivery for
 **US enterprise clients from India** 
 , including the timezone reality — some early mornings and some late evenings.
* Fluency with
 **formal enterprise PMOs** 
 . Our clients may run PMP\-certified project offices using Microsoft Project and gated governance.
 **You need to speak that language with the client without importing the bureaucracy into how we work.**
* Agile in practice, not just certification —
 **Scrum, Kanban, or whatever the program actually needs.**
* Written communication strong enough to produce an
 **executive one\-pager that a VP can read without needing a follow\-up call.**



**Helpful, Not Required** 



* GenAI, LLM, agentic AI, or production ML delivery
* Manufacturing, industrial, or supply\-chain experience
* Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or Smartsheet
* Experience working inside client environments — client email, VDI, badged access, and enterprise security processes



**Six Months In** 



* Nobody at a client has to ask what’s happening on their program.
* Risks reach the right person from us
 **before they escalate** 
 .
* Multiple engagements are running in parallel without you becoming the bottleneck.
* And delivery is a
 **function with a process behind it** 
 , not a set of habits living in individual heads.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
**AIKAARA TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED** 




**Associate Project Manager — AI\-First Delivery** 




**Location:** 
 Pune, India (on\-site client placement in later phases)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 Years
 



**Reports To:** 
 Product Head
 



**CTC:** 
 Up to ₹9 LPA (based on interview performance)
 



  




* **About the Role**



 Aikaara Technologies builds and maintains enterprise web applications for US\-based clients. We run as an AI\-first team. Claude, Claude Code and Cursor are part of daily work — used to understand codebases, draft specifications, prepare test cases and move delivery forward. This is how we work, not an occasional shortcut.
 



 We are looking for an Associate Project Manager with 2–3 years of experience who is genuinely good at working with AI tools and wants to grow into a full delivery role. You do not need to have managed large teams or hold a certification. You need to be organised, curious, clear in writing, and capable of using AI to produce the output of a much larger team.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You will run sprints, track delivery, write documentation, test features yourself, and be the reliable point of coordination between developers, QA, UI/UX and the client.
 


* **AI Skills — What We Actually Look For**



 This section carries the most weight in our evaluation.
 



 •    Uses AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) as part of daily work, not occasionally.
 



 •    Can write clear, well\-structured prompts and get usable output on the first or second attempt.
 



 •    Can use AI to read and understand an unfamiliar codebase or product, and explain it back in plain language.
 



 •    Can use AI to draft specifications, user stories, test cases, release notes and client emails — and then review, correct and take ownership of that output.
 



 •    Has the judgment to recognise when AI output is wrong, incomplete or invented, and verifies before acting on it.
 



 •    Willing to learn Claude Code with Cursor in depth. Structured training and time will be given.
 



 •    Advantage: has independently built something with AI — a script, a small app, an automation, a dashboard, an internal tool. Bring it to the interview.
 



  




* **Key Responsibilities**



 •    Coordinate day\-to\-day delivery across development, QA and UI/UX.
 



 •    Run Agile ceremonies — daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
 



 •    Break requirements into clear user stories with acceptance criteria, and keep Jira accurate and current.
 



 •    Use AI tools to draft specifications, BRDs, test cases, meeting summaries and status reports.
 



 •    Test features on staging before they reach the client; raise clear, reproducible bug reports.
 



 •    Track progress, dependencies and blockers; escalate early rather than late.
 



 •    Join client calls, take structured notes, and convert discussion into actionable tickets.
 



 •    Prepare weekly status reports and release notes for internal and client stakeholders.
 



 •    Support UAT, production releases and post\-release checks.
 



 •    Maintain project documentation so that anyone joining the project can get up to speed quickly.
 



  




* **Required Skills**



 •    2–3 years of experience in project coordination, delivery, business analysis, QA or associate product roles in a software or product company.
 



 •    Working understanding of Agile / Scrum and the software development lifecycle.
 



 •    Hands\-on with Jira or a comparable tracking tool.
 



 •    Strong written and spoken English — you will write to US clients directly.
 



 •    Ability to document clearly and structure information well.
 



 •    Attention to detail, ownership and consistent follow\-through.
 



 •    Comfortable working from the Pune office, with some overlap with US client hours.
 



  




* **Technical Understanding**



 A functional understanding is expected in the following areas:
 



 •    Web applications and how they are structured
 



 •    React.js frontend (functional level)
 



 •    Ruby on Rails backend (functional level)
 



 •    REST APIs and basic SQL
 



 •    Git and branching basics
 



 •    Staging, UAT and production release flow
 



*Hands\-on coding experience is not mandatory. You should, however, be able to read code with AI assistance and hold a technical conversation with developers without needing everything translated.* 



* **Tools**



 •    Jira, Confluence
 



 •    Claude / Claude Code, Cursor
 



 •    GitHub
 



 •    Slack / Microsoft Teams
 



 •    Google Workspace, Excel / Sheets
 



  




* **Preferred Qualifications**



 •    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology.
 



 •    Exposure to SaaS, ERP or enterprise software projects.
 



 •    Exposure to international or US\-based clients.
 



 •    CSM / PSM certification is a plus, but not required.
 



  




* **What You Get**



 •    Direct exposure to US clients and the full product lifecycle, from requirement to release.
 



 •    Structured training on Claude Code with Cursor, and the freedom to use AI across your work.
 



 •    A clear growth path to Project Manager based on delivery ownership, not years served.
 



  




* **Must\-Have Skills**



 AI Tools Usage · Prompt Writing · Agile / Scrum · Jira · Requirement Documentation · User Stories · Sprint Coordination · Functional Testing · Client Communication · SDLC
 


* **Nice\-to\-Have Skills**



 Claude Code · Cursor · React.js \& Ruby on Rails exposure · SaaS or ERP projects · API testing (Postman) · Confluence · US client coordination

description:
**Who We Are**
 Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award\-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting\-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people\-first culture.
   

  

 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end\-to\-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile \& Digital Marketing \| Enterprise AI \| Customer Care AI \& Technology \| Enterprise Technology Modernization
   

  

**Location \& Flexibility**
 Noida, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Program Manager / Senior Manager to lead end\-to\-end cloud migration and modernization initiatives across multi\-cloud environments — including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure. In this highly visible role, you will drive large\-scale transformation programs that accelerate the organization's cloud adoption, modernize legacy workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with executive stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, and vendors to define program strategy, govern delivery, manage risk, and champion cloud\-native best practices across the enterprise. This role requires a blend of technical acumen, program governance expertise, and leadership presence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Governance**
* Develop and own the end\-to\-end program roadmap for cloud migration and modernization, spanning GCP, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Establish and manage program governance frameworks including steering committees, status reporting, RACI structures, and decision\-making processes.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of architects, engineers, DevOps practitioners, and business analysts across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Track and report on program health — scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality — to senior leadership and C\-suite stakeholders.
* Drive milestone delivery, manage dependencies, and resolve escalations to keep programs on track.


**Cloud Migration Execution**
* Define and execute migration strategies including Rehost (lift \& shift), Replatform, Refactor,Repurchase, Retire, and Retain (6Rs/7Rs).
* Oversee infrastructure assessments, application portfolio rationalization, and cloud readiness evaluations.
* Coordinate migration waves, manage cutover planning, and ensure zero\-downtime or minimal\-disruption transitions for critical workloads.
* Manage relationships with hyperscale partners (Google, AWS, Microsoft) and third\-party migration tooling vendors.
* Ensure proper implementation of cloud landing zones, networking, IAM, security controls, and compliance requirements.


**Modernization \& Transformation**
* Champion cloud\-native modernization initiatives including containerization(Kubernetes/GKE/EKS/AKS), microservices adoption, and serverless architectures.
* Drive application re\-platforming to managed cloud services (e.g., Cloud SQL, RDS, Azure SQL, Big Query, Redshift, Synapse).
* Lead DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline modernization to enable continuous delivery and cloud\-native development practices.
* Partner with data and AI/ML teams to enable cloud\-native analytics and AI workloads on GCP(Vertex AI), AWS (SageMaker), and Azure (Azure AI).


**Financial \& Risk Management**
* Own program budgets ranging from $5M to $50M\+, with responsibility for FinOps, cost optimization, and cloud spend visibility.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, operational, and business risks throughout the program lifecycle.
* Drive business case development, ROI modeling, and benefits tracking for cloud transformation investments.


**Stakeholder Management \& Change Management**
* Act as the primary program interface for senior technology and business leaders, building trust and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
* Develop and execute organizational change management plans to drive cloud adoption and new ways of working.
* Build cloud capability and literacy across engineering and product teams through training, communities of practice, and enablement programs.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of program/project management experience with 5\+ years directly in cloud migration or transformation programs
* Demonstrated delivery of large\-scale migrations ($10M\+ budgets) on at least two of: GCP, AWS, Azure
* Experience managing multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud environments with 500\+ workloads or applications
* Track record of managing cross\-functional teams of 20\+ people across engineering, architecture, and business functions
* Experience with enterprise change management and organizational transformation
* Deep familiarity with cloud architecture patterns: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless,containers
* Understanding of networking (VPC,VPN, DirectConnect/Interconnect/ExpressRoute), IAM, and security in cloud
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes,CI/CD, Terraform/IaC, and DevOps toolchains
* Familiarity with migration tooling: AWS MGN, Google Migrate, Azure Migrate, Velostrata, CloudEndure, etc.
* Understanding of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization levers


**Equal Opportunity Employer**

All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*

title: Senior Lead (Construction Project Management) — Campus Development
New Product Development - Project Manager
description:
**Scope** 




  





 End\-to\-end ownership of the new product launch calendar. Works closely with Design, sourcing, manufacturing partners, quality, operations and revenue.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




  




* The next phase of growth is a product story before it is a marketing one it means launching into new categories more often, without loosening design quality or safety standards.



  




* Every launch already depends on a long chain of moving parts: design iterations, overseas tooling and sampling, regulatory certification, packaging, production, shipping, inbound inventory, and catalogue readiness across a D2C store and multiple marketplaces. Any one of them can move the launch date, and nobody owns that chain end to end today.



  




* This role does. You own the launch calendar from the point a concept is approved to the point operations has sellable inventory and the revenue team has a live, listed product. You will not manage most of the people you depend on, which makes this a job about clarity, foresight and follow\-through rather than authority.



  





**What you will own** 




  





**The launch calendar and the critical path** 




  




* Own the master NPD calendar across every product in development, with one current, committed launch date per product.
* Work backwards from each launch date across every step — design freeze, tooling, sampling, certification, PO, production, shipping, inbound and listing — and know which step is most at risk.
* Run a clear checkpoint process: what has to be true before a product moves to the next stage, and the confidence to hold it back when it is not ready.
* Escalate early. A three\-week tooling delay raised in week one is a schedule change; the same delay raised in week eight is a missed season.



  





**Development and supplier execution** 




  




* Drive the development cycle with design, sourcing and manufacturing partners across India and Asia — brief, sample, review, iterate, approve.
* Track sample rounds, tooling timelines and final sample sign\-off, holding partners to committed dates and flagging slippage as it happens.
* Track costing against target margin through development, so cost surprises surface early rather than at launch.
* Plan around the constraints that actually bite: factory shutdowns, shipping lead times, and seasonal demand windows.
* Support category and competitor benchmarking — market visits, portfolio gaps and pricing — to inform what gets developed next.



  





**Quality, safety and compliance** 




  




* Treat certification as a launch gate, not paperwork. This category carries live regulatory requirements that must be tracked and planned for from day one.
* Coordinate the certification timeline with sourcing, quality and external partners.
* Coordinate QC protocols, pre\-dispatch inspection and defect thresholds with the quality and sourcing teams.



  





**Handover to operations** 




  




* This role is judged on the handover. Give operations a genuinely launch\-ready product: confirmed specs, packaging and carton detail, barcodes, SKU codes, weights, dimensions and inbound schedule.
* Work with operations and supply chain on launch quantities, warehouse readiness and inbound planning.
* Make sure documentation arrives with the product, not chasing it.



  





**Working with revenue** 




  




* Partner with the revenue and marketplace teams on launch readiness across D2C and marketplace channels — catalogue copy, imagery, listing setup, pricing and go\-live dates.
* Align launch timing with marketing so campaigns land against inventory that actually exists.
* Feed launch performance and consumer research findings back into the next development cycle.



  





**Process and reporting** 




  




* Own the single source of truth for NPD status — one tracker, always current, that leadership, operations and revenue all read from.
* Run a weekly launch review — what moved, what slipped, what changes — and strengthen the templates and checklists as launch volume grows.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 3–6 years in new product development, product marketing, project management or sourcing within consumer products — houseware, hardgoods, kids, appliances or similar physical goods.
* Hands\-on involvement in taking physical products from concept to market — briefing design, coordinating development, packaging and in\-market launch.
* Experience working with manufacturing partners on samples and production timelines. Overseas sourcing exposure is a plus, not a requirement.
* Organised by instinct — you hold timelines, dependencies and follow\-ups in one place, and chase before things slip.
* Awareness of Indian product compliance and certification, ideally BIS or ISI. The detail can be learned here.
* Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets — cost sheets, margins and forecasts as a daily tool.
* The temperament to chase without friction — you depend on people who do not report to you.
* Useful but not essential: exposure to D2C and marketplace launches.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant, CCAAS
description:

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.

* Deliver expert\-level consultation on Sprinklr capabilities, integrations, and CCaaS best practices.
* Establish trusted advisor relationships with customer champions and executive stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in deploying Voice and Non\-Voice Contact Center applications such as Genesys Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, RingCentral, or similar platforms.
* Proven track record in leading complex implementation projects, preferably in CCaaS, UCaaS, or CPaaS environments.
* Deep understanding of voice technologies, protocols (TCP/IP, VOIP, SIP, RTP, WebRTC), and contact center infrastructure (ACD, IVR, CTI, Dialer, SBC).

* Development experience with Groovy, JavaScript, and/or scripting for integrations is a plus.

**We focus on our mission**

Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

title: Product Expert Treasury Mgmt Tech
description:

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 FIS Quantum is Haleon’s global Treasury Management System, enabling the business to efficiently manage daily and periodic treasury business processes. The platform integrates with core finance systems, supporting end\-to\-end processes from Cash Management \& Forecasting, Foreign Exchange (FX) \& Hedge Accounting, to Payments \& Bank Connectivity.
   

  

 As the Product Expert for FIS Quantum within Digital \& Technology, you will be responsible for defining, implementing, and optimizing our treasury solutions across Haleon, in line with the priorities of our Treasury business team and to maximize value for money over the lifecycle of the product.
   

  

 In support of a SOx\-relevant (Sarbanes\-Oxley Act) application, this role is also pivotal in ensuring we comply with SOx requirements by embedding robust control frameworks into product operations – this may span designing and implementing controls to overseeing training, audit readiness, and continuous improvement. This SOx Compliance ensures our financial reporting applications are secure, reliable, and auditable \- minimising risk and supporting regulatory integrity.
   

  

 You will join our Corporate Applications Technology team, reporting directly to the Product Manager for Treasury \& Banking Tech.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Vision \& Strategy**
* Develop and maintain a product roadmap that reflects business priorities, regulatory requirements, and user needs.

**Requirements \& Documentation Management**

* Maintain comprehensive documentation covering system architecture, security, compliance, and operational processes, ensuring accessibility and audit readiness.

* Ensure our controls operate effectively and that any control or audit findings are remediated as per agreed timelines
* Maintain and test business continuity and disaster recovery plans for critical applications.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Act as a subject matter expert for FIS Quantum, providing guidance and support to end users, stakeholders and Tech colleagues.
* Lead user adoption initiatives, including training, communication, and support for continuous improvement such as automation, new features or process changes.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Minimum 10\+ years’ experience with FIS Quantum, including configuration, integration, and administration.
* Experience with FIS Quantum modules such as Cash Management \& Forecasting, Foreign Exchange (FX) \& Hedge Accounting, and Payments \& Bank Connectivity and the business processes these modules support.
* Supporting day\-to\-day treasury operations through hands\-on problem solving, including tracking payments and bank statements, utilising FIS Trax and SWIFT, and liaising with banking partners.
* Hands\-on experience integrating FIS Quantum (QTM) with third\-party market data providers, including Bloomberg and LSEG Workspace.
* Proven experience integrating FIS Quantum (QTM) with SAP ERP and other enterprise systems to support treasury operations and data workflows.
* Experience of working with compliance and control frameworks, and of preparing for and supporting application audits (internal and external)
* Proven track record in SaaS product management, solution design, and delivery, ideally in a global or multi\-country environment.
* Familiarity with integration to internal and external finance and access management systems (e.g., SAP ECC/S4HANA, SailPoint, CyberArk).

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

* Experience of designing and/or operating SOx controls are a plus.

title: AIT (Assembly, Testing & Integration) LEAD
description:
**Satellite AIT Ownership** 
  




* Own and drive all AIT activities for the Drishti Gen\-2 satellite — mechanical assembly, electrical integration, harnessing, and functional/performance testing.
* Develop and maintain AIT plans, schedules, procedures, and test flow for satellite\-level integration, in coordination with systems engineering.
* Lead troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and non\-conformance resolution during integration and test.
* Ensure test readiness reviews, test result reviews, and sign\-offs are completed per program milestones.



**Scaling to Constellation Build** 
  




* Transition AIT processes from a single\-satellite, prototype\-style build to a repeatable, higher\-cadence constellation build process.
* Define and implement standardized work instructions, travelers/routers, and quality checkpoints suited to serial production.
* Identify and drive improvements in tooling, jigs/fixtures, and test consoles to reduce AIT cycle time per satellite as volume increases.



**Team \& Floor Leadership** 
  




* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of AIT technicians on the shop floor — planning daily/weekly work, ensuring safety, and maintaining build discipline.
* Train technicians on assembly, integration, and test procedures, and build bench strength as the team grows with constellation ramp\-up.



**Cross\-functional Coordination** 
  




* Partner with the
 **Operations Manager** 
 to align AIT schedules with the overall production plan.
* Work with the
 **Inventory Manager** 
 to ensure parts, sub\-systems, and consumables are available and traceable for each build (kitting, GRN/issue tracking, shortage escalation).
* Align with the
 **Ground Floor Manager** 
 on facility, cleanroom, EGSE/GSE, and safety requirements against the AIT schedule.
* Coordinate with
 **Tech Heads, Project Managers, systems engineering, system leads, quality, and payload/sensor teams** 
 to resolve interface and requirement issues surfaced during integration.



**Documentation \& Compliance** 
  




* Maintain AIT documentation — test procedures, test reports, non\-conformance reports, and traveler/router records — per applicable quality standards (e.g., ISO 9001; ECSS\-Q\-ST or equivalent space\-quality framework, as adopted internally).
* Support configuration control and traceability of build records for each flight unit


 Requirements
   

  


**Must\-have** 
  




* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in satellite/spacecraft (or closely related aerospace/defense electro\-optical systems) Assembly, Integration \& Testing.
* Demonstrated experience owning AIT for a satellite or major sub\-system through to qualification/flight readiness — not just component\-level test.
* Experience with environmental qualification testing (vibration, thermal/thermal\-vacuum, EMI/EMC).
* Prior experience leading a technician team on the floor, including planning, training, and mentoring.
* Experience working within a documented quality system (ISO 9001, ECSS, DO\-254\-equivalent, or similar), and comfort maintaining traceable build/test records.
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced startup environment and help build repeatable processes as the program scales from one satellite to a constellation.



**Nice to have** 
  




* Prior exposure to serial/repeat production rather than one\-off builds, given the constellation scale\-up ahead.
* Direct satellite AIT experience (as opposed to only ground/defense electro\-optics).
* Experience setting up or improving AIT floor processes from scratch — facilities, tooling, work instructions — for a scaling program.


 Benefits
   

  

- Fair compensation will be provided as per market standards

- Experience rapid growth and start\-up culture

- Flexible Working Hours

- Open to exploring, discussing and implementing new ideas and processes

- Opportunity to work closely with the Founding Team at GalaxEye

- Get a chance to work with Advisors holding senior positions and decades of experience.

 We are looking for an engineering manager to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI\-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU\-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter\-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI\-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready\-to\-use applications for developers. Embracing open\-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, thereby supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R\&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, the “Strike” team is a new sub team within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm to both, consult on ideas, and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.

You will also lead the team on its goals, the focus will be on improving areas including developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, promoting generative AI for BU\-specific adoption, etc. People and project management is going to be a key part of the job role.

Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


You will work in a fast\-paced environment alongside program and project managers in delivering a host of innovative solutions that meet the needs of our diverse customer base. You derive energy from working with others of diverse backgrounds and engaging directly with customers.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------


This role offers a range of responsibilities and possibilities:

* Managing independent projects \- Project sizes will vary and may be part of a program. You will manage the project throughout its life cycle \- from qualification stage through project closure. Attention to detail time management and influencing people skills are key ingredients to be successful in managing projects.
* Working with Program and/or Project Managers \- There will be times when you will be assigned to assist a program or project manager by managing sub\-projects or key task elements. With each assignment you report regularly on the progress and manage each assignment through its completion.
* Working with project teams \- Every project is completed through team effort. You can work effectively with teammates that may be local or distant. You host meetings as needed to gather and share project details. Your ability to help drive activities through others to meet the project timelines and goals are key for driving project success.\*
* Working with customers \- When working with program or project managers you help fulfill the project commitments to our customers as assigned. There will be times when you will be in front of the customer clarifying requirements communicating on project status or interacting with customer work teams on project activities.\*
* Project Management administration \- Your ability to write clearly and simply are key skills to documenting project activities. Documentation can range from requirement summaries resource and project plans status reports change requests risks issues and variance reports to lessons learned. Accuracy is the key to all documentation.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------

* 4\+ years of experience in Project Management, managing more projects from inception through to closure within a commercial environment.
* Ideally, you have experience with an IT solutions or airline industry solutions provider and are ready to hit the ground running.

**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

* Change control
* Client Relationship management
* Communicating for impact
* Cross\-team integration
* Empowerment
* Leadership
* Managing Risk
* Products and Services
* Project completion and integration
* Project planning and control
* Project scope management
* Quality Management
* Resource Management
* Stakeholder management

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
---------------------

* Adhering to Principles \& Values
* Communication
* Creating \& Innovating
* Customer Focus
* Impact \& Influence
* Leading Execution
* Results Orientation
* Teamwork

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

* University degree or equivalent experience
* Formal project management training and certification \- PMP desired but not mandatory

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

Your development journey is supported every step of the way.

title: Director, IT Project Management
description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award\-winning learning programs like i\-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world\-class programs and support every day.

**Director, IT Project Management**


The Director of IT Project Management is responsible for leading and overseeing the planning, execution, and delivery of internal\-facing IT projects across CA’s ecosystem of business systems, custom applications, infrastructure, AI tools, and data. This role ensures that IT initiatives align with business goals, adhere to best practices, and are completed on time and within budget. The Director will lead a global team of project managers and collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to drive efficiency, innovation, and strategic value through IT projects.

  

The IT Project Management Office is part of CA’s Major Projects team, which leads enterprise\-scale strategic initiatives that transform the way we do our work. Reporting into the Vice President, Major Projects, you'll have an opportunity to bring your experience and expertise to bear to help shape the growth of this function, ensuring we're ready to lead CA's most complex, innovative, and impactful IT projects.

**The Impact You'll Have:**

* Oversee the IT project portfolio, ensuring successful project delivery through effective planning, resource management, staffing, and risk mitigation.
* Lead, develop, and manage an India and US\-based team of IT project managers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Establish and enforce Hybrid project management methodologies and best practices, as well as strong governance frameworks to ensure consistent project delivery.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while meeting quality standards.
* Collaborate with IT leadership, business units, and key stakeholders to define project priorities, objectives, and success metrics; receive and action feedback; and diagnose and solution challenges.
* Drive process optimization and implement tools (including AI and automation) to enhance project execution and efficiency, with an eye toward continuous improvement.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and constraints at both a project and portfolio level to ensure delivery success.
* Provide regular updates and reports to senior leadership on project status, key milestones, and potential challenges.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to enhance IT project management capabilities.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 10\+ years of experience in IT project management, with at least 5 years leading project management organizations.
* 3\+ years experience leading, developing, and mentoring a global team required.
* Proven track record of managing large\-scale IT programs and delivering consistent results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong strategic mindset and business acumen with sound judgment and problem\-solving capabilities. Experience partnering with executive\-level internal customers preferred.
* Strong understanding of IT systems, software development life cycle (SDLC), AI applications within IT, and digital transformation.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc.) and tools (JIRA, SmartSheet, etc.).
* Collaborative mindset; ability to build strong relationships and work effectively with cross\-functional teams, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in budget management, vendor negotiations, and contract management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* PMP or other project management certification preferred.
* Familiarity with SFDC, Workday, and M365 preferred.

**Travel:**


Candidates should expect to travel to the US office 1\-2 times per year for team gatherings and key project meetings.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Project Manager **Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to manage the execution of small projects with low complexity. Each day, you will ensure that all related activities are executed in accordance with procedures, regulations, standards, specifications and targets. You will also showcase your skills by defining and applying basic project scheduling techniques to manage schedule risks in advance.


The work model for the role is: \#LI \- Onsite


This role is contributing to the Automation in Energy Industries in the India Region. Main stakeholders include customers, project sponsors, engineering, procurement, finance, HSE/compliance teams, vendors, and senior leadership, working together to ensure effective project delivery, governance, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.

 **You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Leading the project team allocated to the project, motivating and monitoring internal and external resources.
* Monitoring and controlling project progress, resource utilization, financials, invoicing status, cost, expenses, and cash flow.
* Identifying, qualifying, quantifying, and managing project risks while pursuing all opportunities.
* Ensuring compliance with ABB directives, procedures, cybersecurity regulations, contractual requirements, and HSE policies.
* Securing formal acceptance of the project, contract close\-out, and acknowledgment by the customer.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You have 8 to 10 years of experience in Project Management.
* You are proficient in using MS Project and other project management tools to plan, track, and execute projects effectively.
* You have experience delivering projects effectively in a busy business environment.
* You possess effective communication and collaboration skills, enabling you to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* You are highly proficient in SAP and can effectively use it to support project planning, execution, and reporting.

**More about us:**


The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start\-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.


Recruitment Fraud Warning


ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.


View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home


For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how\-to\-apply/fraud\-warning

title: Lead Senior Project Manager
description:
Genpact Experience (formerly Rightpoint) is seeking a senior delivery and engineering leader to drive outcomes across its Technology Practices. This role will lead end\-to\-end delivery across Digital Experience Platforms, cloud\-native and mobile experiences, and Modern Workplace solutions, while accelerating the adoption of AI\-assisted engineering and agentic workflows across the software lifecycle. The leader will partner with client executives and cross\-functional Genpact teams to deliver measurable business impact—faster time\-to\-value, higher quality, improved productivity, and scalable engineering operating models.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Project Delivery \& Execution**

* Own end‑to‑end project delivery including scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
* Create and maintain project plans, delivery schedules, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Lead project kick‑off, sprint ceremonies, status meetings, and retrospectives.
* Proactively identify risks and issues, driving mitigation and escalations as required.
* Ensure adherence to Genpact Experience project management methodology and delivery standards.

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders on delivery matters.
* Set and manage client expectations through clear, proactive communication.
* Build strong client relationships and continuously seek opportunities to improve client satisfaction.
* Support proposal development, scoping discussions, and SOW reviews when required.

**Financial \& Operational Management**

* Track project budgets, forecasts, burn, and margins.
* Ensure accurate timesheet validation and adherence to financial controls.
* Support invoicing, budget reviews, and financial reporting in collaboration with Finance/Client Managers.
* Monitor utilisation targets and support staffing adjustments

**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Plan and secure appropriate staffing for project needs.
* Guide and support project team members; conduct regular check‑ins and remove blockers.
* Foster collaboration across onshore/offshore teams and cross‑disciplinary partners.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and offboarding of team members.

**Governance, Closure \& Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure compliance with project governance and internal review processes.
* Lead UAT, production launch, hyper‑care, and project closure activities.
* Conduct retrospectives and document lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.

  



**Required Skills \& Experience**

**Core Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Project Management principles (Agile, Scrum, Hybrid).
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven experience managing budgets, schedules, and risks.
* Hands‑on experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar.
* Ability to manage distributed, cross‑shore teams effectively.
* Preferably certified CSM / CSPO / PSM / PSPO / PMP.
* Domain – Having experience in Marketing, Hospitality domains.
* Tech Stack – Should have worked on AEM , Workfront, Figma etc.
* Hands‑on experience with Project Management Tools like Jira, Trello, Azure Dev Ops or similar, project planning tools, collaboration tools.
* Hands‑on experience with AI tools in Project Management.
* Should have Business Analysis skills like story writing, understanding of wireframing, and design, requirements analysis, discovery, stakeholder interviews, user journeys documentation etc.

**Experience**

* Typically **5\+ years** of project management experience and not more than 8 years.
* Experience delivering digital, platform, or enterprise technology projects preferred.
* Prior client‑facing delivery experience strongly preferred.

 **Success Measures**

* On‑time and on‑budget project delivery
* Client satisfaction and relationship strength
* Project margin and utilisation health
* Quality of reporting, risk management, and governance adherence
* Team engagement and delivery predictability

 **Why Genpact?**

* Be a transformation leader and work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation
* Make an impact by driving change for global enterprises and solving business challenges that matter
* Thrive in a values\-driven culture
* Flexible PTO — If you need a day off or an extended vacation, take the time!
* Hybrid work environment: Casual and open office or Remote…You choose!
* Great insurance coverage (Multiple Options) and flexible spending accounts
* 401K with Company Matching
* Continuous Training, Certifications, and Learning Opportunities
* Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion: We care about making Genpcat a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization to bring about meaningful and measurable changes to representation, team member experience, and client engagement. Our Employee Resource Groups (ERG) are created and run by team members who share a common community, identity, or allyship. These groups play a vital role in contributing to Genpact's inclusive environment where all are valued and empowered to succeed.





We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.




**EEO Statement**


Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

title: Project Lead
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end delivery of assigned engagements within defined scope, timeline, cost, and quality standards
* Own day\-to\-day delivery, including task planning, monitoring, and issue resolution.
* Ensure On Time Delivery (OTD) and First Pass Yield (FPY) targets.
* Track delivery performance and proactively identify and mitigate risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies.
* Ensure compliance with Project Management System and internal governance processes.
* Drive delivery excellence and continual improvement initiatives
* Hire and develop high performing technical talent with a particular focus on delivering values.
* Organize cross\-functional activities, Manage customer, Onsite resources, fulfilment of requirement.
* Provide management oversight to several activities running in parallel, address issues/concerns with speed, and enable coarse corrective actions.
* Customer interaction, project reporting
* Team handling onsite and offshore teams. Resource management, progression planning and development.
* Maintains operational metrics and measures. Quality management
* Business Development – delivery led growth, cross selling, upselling.
* Drive customer technical meetings and governance forums.

  

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

  

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 10–15 years of experience.
* Experience in Oil \& Gas Domain or upstream oil drilling industry is desired.
* Act as the primary interface with Customers, Technical Leaders, and Leadership.
* Build and maintain strong Customer Technical Lead relationships.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly customer connects/reviews.
* Manage and align expectations across business and technical stakeholders
* Should have at least 2 \- 3 years of prior experience as Project Leader
* Experience in design/ development/ engineering/ documentation support
* Excellent Communication and Interpersonal skills are a must. Should have track record of customer interaction, identify business opportunities.
* Should have demonstrated consistent business growth/head count addition over the last years.
* Should have demonstrated strong hold on technology development / Continuous improvement and productivity improvement leading to higher contribution margin and new business initiation
* Strong process management, project management, stakeholder management, requirement management and team handling skills
* Hands\-on experience in Project Management Tools (Scheduling, Tracking, Employee engagement, Metrics)
* Ability to understand and take decisions on technical proposals.
* Ability to quickly ramp up new technologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem solving, debugging skills interpretation skills.
* Self\-motivated, good verbal and written communication.
* Self\-driven and proactive

**Standards \& Process Improvement**

* Develop, update, and enhance engineering standards, procedures, and checklists based on customer and project needs.
* Drive continuous improvement in quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.

**Leadership \& Behavioral Skills**

* Proven experience leading engineering teams of 10–20 resources.
* Strong ownership mindset with ability to manage multiple engagements independently.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills.
* Customer‑centric approach with high accountability and execution focus.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field
* Knowledge on Piping, P\&ID will added advantage

High\-impact description of the APJC Renewals\& Program Operations team highlighting recurring revenue acceleration, operational governance, and multi\-theater leadership alignment.
  
  

Your Impact

* 5 years \+ of Sales/Renewals Operations Experience
* High\-energy strong analytical thinker with excellent judgment
* Excellent quantitative analysis, use of spreadsheets, excel and modeling tools
* Good team player, collaborative and able to work with a range of different people
* You are a Salesforce expert with extensive reporting and dashboard skills


Preferred Qualifications (Provide up to five (5\) bullet points:
  
  

* Ability to see the big picture, strong creativity

* Change management leadership in multi\-regional matrixed organizations.

\#WeAreCisco
  
\#WeAreCisco where every individual brings their unique skills and perspectives together to pursue our purpose of powering an inclusive future for all.
  
  

Our passion is connection—we celebrate our employees’ diverse set of backgrounds and focus on unlocking potential. Cisconians often experience one company, many careers where learning and development are encouraged and supported at every stage. Our technology, tools, and culture pioneered hybrid work trends, allowing all to not only give their best, but be their best.
  
  

We understand our outstanding opportunity to bring communities together and at the heart of that is our people. One\-third of Cisconians collaborate in our 30 employee resource organizations, called Inclusive Communities, to connect, foster belonging, learn to be informed allies, and make a difference. Dedicated paid time off to volunteer—80 hours each year—allows us to give back to causes we are passionate about, and nearly 86% do!
  
  

Our purpose, driven by our people, is what makes us the worldwide leader in technology that powers the internet. Helping our customers reimagine their applications, secure their enterprise, transform their infrastructure, and meet their sustainability goals is what we do best. We ensure that every step we take is a step towards a more inclusive future for all. Take your next step and be you, with us!
  
  

Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. 3\. Planning, Design and Procurement• Develop and maintain project schedules, milestone plans, procurement programmes and resource plans; monitor critical paths, approvals, long\-lead items and material deliveries.

Exposure to multidisciplinary coordination with Supply Chain, Planning, and Cost Engineering teams for material management, budget control, and project execution efficiency is preferred.

Responsibilities include preparation and review of requisitions and construction drawings and associated engineering documentation.

title: Manager - Brand Activations (BTL)
description:
AssetPlus is looking for an Assistant Manager / Manager \- Brand Activations to lead on\-ground brand experiences for a bespoke category creation initiative.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing brands to life through high\-quality offline activations. You will be responsible for planning and executing events, roadshows, city activations, ambient branding, and innovative BTL campaigns that build awareness and create meaningful engagement at scale.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is highly execution\-focused, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and is willing to travel extensively to ensure flawless execution across regions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Brand Activations \& BTL Campaigns** 



* Plan and execute BTL campaigns that build awareness and drive engagement for the initiative.
* Conceptualise and execute innovative on\-ground activations that create memorable brand experiences.
* Manage city launches, roadshows, partner meets, educational events, and regional activation programmes.
* Identify new activation opportunities that strengthen brand visibility in key markets.



**2\. Events \& On\-ground Execution** 



* Own end\-to\-end execution of offline events from planning through post\-event closure.
* Coordinate venue selection, logistics, branding, production, registrations, and on\-ground operations.
* Ensure every activation reflects the brand's quality standards and delivers a consistent experience.
* Be willing to travel across cities to oversee execution whenever required.



**3\. OOH \& Ambient Branding** 



* Plan and execute outdoor branding initiatives across relevant markets.
* Explore innovative ambient branding opportunities that increase visibility and recall.
* Coordinate installation, execution, quality checks, and timely rollout of all branding assets.



**4\. Vendor Management** 



* Identify, onboard, and manage agencies, production partners, fabricators, printers, and event vendors.
* Define clear deliverables, timelines, and quality expectations for every partner.
* Track vendor performance through defined KPIs covering quality, turnaround time, compliance, and cost efficiency.
* Build a reliable network of regional vendors to support large\-scale activations across India.



**5\. Planning \& Coordination** 



* Develop activation calendars and execution plans aligned with business priorities.
* Work closely with internal marketing, design, content, and business teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
* Ensure timely procurement, production, approvals, and execution across multiple concurrent projects.



**6\. Measurement \& Optimisation** 



* Track activation effectiveness through predefined success metrics.
* Conduct post\-event reviews and recommend improvements for future campaigns.
* Maintain budgets, vendor documentation, and execution reports.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4 to 8 years of experience in BTL marketing, brand activations, events, or experiential marketing.
* Proven experience planning and executing offline campaigns, roadshows, events, exhibitions, or city activations.
* Strong understanding of OOH, ambient branding, and experiential marketing.
* Experience managing multiple agencies and vendors simultaneously.
* Ability to define, monitor, and improve vendor performance through measurable KPIs.
* Strong project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent negotiation, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment with tight timelines.
* Willingness to travel extensively for regional activations and on\-ground execution.

**About You**

* Masters degree in Hydrology or equivalent discipline.
