Project Lead**Job Description Summary**


This role is responsible for supporting end\-to\-end project management through effective planning, scheduling, procurement coordination, and reporting within Cushman \& Wakefield’s PDS delivery framework. The Planning / MIS / Project Coordinator will prepare and monitor project schedules, cost forecasts, and resource plans to ensure seamless execution of investor\-led base\-build projects. The position involves progress tracking, deviation analysis, and coordination with clients, consultants, and contractors to maintain program alignment. It also oversees MIS reporting, procurement monitoring, and change control processes, providing accurate and data\-driven insights to support timely and successful project delivery within scope, budget, and schedule.**Job Description**

**About the Role:**

* Monitors progress against baseline schedules, updates weekly and monthly reports, and identifies potential risks or delays to mitigate proactively.
* Coordinates with the project team, contractors, and consultants to ensure the timely availability of drawings, approvals, and materials in line with the project plan.
* Tracks procurement schedules, monitors lead times for critical materials, and ensures timely delivery to prevent execution delays.
* Prepares and circulates weekly and monthly MIS reports including progress dashboards, schedule variance, manpower, and procurement status.
* Ensures smooth communication and coordination between client, consultants, and site teams to maintain project governance and reporting accuracy.

title: Project Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Project Engineer
  
Project and Development Services – (Chennai/India)
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Pillar of the team
  
Working closely with either the project manager or the senior project manager (or both),
  
you’ll play a pivotal role in driving project success. You’ll take ownership of small projects,
  
and provide a boost to the major ones. Being one of the leaders at the helm, you’ll explore
  
ways to bring out the best in your team by striving to ensure optimal outcomes for all
  
stakeholders. Likewise, you’ll play a lead role in managing the organisational structure for
  
each project, making sure that all reporting, communication and working procedures are
  
streamlined, and that every project has clear objectives in place.
  
Your attendance at project meetings is necessary, and you’ll be expected to create project\-
  
related reports, analyses and reviews. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
  
is crucial; this role needs someone who is good at forecasting project expenditure and
  
ensuring effective management of project budgets.
  
Building strong client relationships
  
We live and breathe client satisfaction. We therefore need someone who shares the same
  
passion and dedication. You’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients
  
by identifying their needs, requirements and constraints.
  
Of course, as you represent our clients’ best interests, you’ll also keep in mind JLL’s own
  
business needs—and, thereby, strive to achieve an ideal balance between the two. You’ll
  
do so by being on the lookout for opportunities to introduce potential prospects to other
  
business lines at JLL and build relationships with clients. You’ll also see to it that project
  
revenue and payment cycles are properly managed to avoid bad debt.
  
Upholding excellence in project delivery
  
For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help
  
continue this history of excellence. You’ll manage professional consultants necessary for
  
the design and documentation of the project, as well as carry out contract administration
  
of all vendors professionally and in accordance with legal requirements to protect
  
commercial interests of clients and JLL. You will also help identify project risks and
  
implement measures to mitigate them. Similarly, core to our reputation is our strong
  
focus on health \& safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front\-
  
of\-mind at all times.
  
Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems,
  
improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies.
  
You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines.
  
Sound like you?
  
Our successful Project Managers ...
  
·
  
Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their
  
perspective.
  
·
  
Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
  
·
  
Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
  
·
  
Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
  
·
  
Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
  
  

**To apply you need to be:**  

An expert in the field
  
We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a
  
degree in any property\-related discipline, and at least three years of experience in
  
design, construction or project management.
  
Our project management teams are tech\-savvy and digitally enabled. We are the digital
  
leader in project management, so it’s important that you help drive the effective use of
  
JLL technology platforms to deliver our projects.
  
An empowering colleague
  
In this role, you’ll work with people of different ranks and responsibilities—that is why the
  
ideal candidate is expected to promote open and constructive relationships with
  
superiors, subordinates, peers and clients. With a healthy drive to succeed, you’ll achieve
  
your goals most effectively when you work together and collaborate.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.
  
We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your
  
full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your
  
ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits
  
package.
  
Apply today!
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Director - Manufacturing CMC Project management
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Lilly, a leading innovation\-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better – through medicines and information – for some of the world’s most urgent medical needs. Founded over 150 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly knows its business has prospered because of its employees – people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team – and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!
   

  

**Manufacturing and Quality Technical Hub Hyderabad**
 Lilly has made a strategic investment of more than $1B dollars to establish a Manufacturing and Quality technical hub. This hub will oversee the significant investment in contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India and the technical services responsible for managing the scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. The hub will be recruiting top talent in the areas of process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to build a cutting\-edge scientific organization supporting the exciting manufacturing portfolio of Lilly.
   

  

**About This Role**
 Lilly’s product commercialization spans a growing global manufacturing network, dozens of specialized functions, and an expanding portfolio of transformative medicines. The gap: no single leader owns the full picture.
   

  

 This role fills that gap. You are the single point of accountability for a product’s entire commercialization lifecycle—from post\-Phase 2 through launch and beyond. You own the manufacturing CMC strategy, lead the Product Core Team, collaborate with development, and serve as the go\-to interface for senior executives who need clarity, not noise.
   

  

 This is a strategic leadership role, not a coordination role. It demands deep pharma development and/or manufacturing knowledge, executive presence, and the ability to drive alignment across a powerful, matrixed organization — without direct authority.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In Year One**
 Lilly’s commercialization process involves deep, specialized functions — Development, Engineering, Analytical Quality, TS/MS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Sites, and CMC Regulatory. Each brings critical expertise. The winning Manufacturing CMC Project Manager orchestrates them: knowing when to convene the full team, and when to engage only who’s needed — protecting expert time and driving efficient progress. In year one, you will have demonstrated:
   

  

* Stakeholder orchestration credibility — functional leaders trust that when you call them in, it matters; when you don’t, it’s handled.
* A Mfg technical agenda that serves as the true single source of truth — every relevant function’s input synthesized into one coherent product strategy.
* At least one major bottleneck resolved through smart, targeted convening — the right people in the room, no one else.
* Senior leaders who say you “always know where the product stands” — earned through disciplined intelligence\-gathering, not reporting overhead.
* A product team operating with more speed and purpose than before — siloed expertise channeled into coordinated, forward momentum.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Manufacturing CMC Strategy \& Commercialization Ownership**
* Own the Manufacturing CMC Commercialization Strategy across Development, Manufacturing, and Business Units.
* Lead the Product Core Team and oversee its technical execution, ensuring clear ownership, milestone accountability, and proactive risk management.
* Drive alignment of launch presentation and commercial image strategy across relevant functional and affiliate stakeholders.
* Ensure gate deliverables are clearly defined, plans are in place, and execution is on track; proactively identifying and resolving gaps.


**Governance \& Executive Visibility**
* Serve as the accountable representative for the product at all Governance and Oversight Forums, providing clear, confident updates on progress, risks, and decisions required.
* Act as the primary interface for senior executives seeking visibility into commercialization status — translating technical complexity into concise, actionable insight.
* Ensure escalations are surfaced proactively and resolved with appropriate speed and rigor.
* Demonstrates proficiency in using enterprise project management, collaboration, and reporting tools to drive transparency and execution excellence.


**Cross\-Functional Alignment \& Stakeholder Leadership**
* Ensure sustained alignment across Development, Manufacturing, and Business Unit stakeholders throughout the product’s lifecycle, including global manufacturing site teams and CMC Regulatory.
* Influence without authority across a complex, matrixed organization — building trust, resolving conflict, and driving decisions through collaboration rather than directive.
* Partner closely with Development and CMC Regulatory on submission strategy, ensuring the manufacturing program supports regulatory timelines and requirements.


**Post\-Launch Technical Agenda**
* Lead Post\-Launch Technical Agenda (PLTA) strategy for assigned products, influencing pre\-submission deliverables and lifecycle management planning.
* Ensure the product’s long\-term commercial and technical sustainability by driving proactive planning for process improvements, line extensions, and continuous manufacturing optimization.


**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
* Advanced engineering, scientific degree (M.S., Ph.D., or MBA with strong technical foundation). Advanced degrees are preferred although a Bachelor with equivalent industry experience may also be considered.


**Experience**
* Minimum 8 years of progressive pharmaceutical industry experience, with meaningful exposure to development, manufacturing, commercialization, and/or technical program leadership.
* Experience with both drug substance and drug product. Small or large molecule experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading or significantly contributing to cross\-functional programs through key development and commercialization milestones (e.g., tech transfer, process validation, regulatory submission readiness, product launch).
* Ability to evaluate manufacturing network strategies and their impact on launch readiness, supply continuity, cost, and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to influence and lead without direct authority across complex, matrixed organizations.
* Track record of operating effectively at the senior leadership level — communicating with confidence, handling ambiguity, and making high\-quality decisions under pressure.


**Functional Background (one Or More Areas Preferred)**
* TS/MS, CMC development, Operations, Supply Chain, or Mfg.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strategic Leadership: Shapes long\-range manufacturing CMC commercialization strategy; translates vision into execution.
* Influence Without Authority: Drives alignment and decisions across powerful, matrixed stakeholders without formal reporting relationships.
* Change Leadership: Leads teams through organizational, technical, and strategic change while maintaining stakeholder engagement and execution momentum
* Executive Communication: Distills complex technical and operational information into clear, confident narratives for senior audiences.
* Negotiation \& Conflict Resolution: Balances competing functional and affiliate priorities with fairness, speed, and strategic judgment.
* Commercial Acumen: Understands the business implications of manufacturing decisions — including supply risk, launch readiness, and lifecycle value.
* Risk Management: Proactively identifies, surfaces, and resolves program risks before they become schedule or quality issues.
* Cross\-Cultural \& Global Collaboration: Effective working across global manufacturing sites, development organizations, and business units with varying priorities.
* Entrepreneurial Mindset: Comfortable operating in an evolving role structure; builds credibility and process from the ground up.


**Schedule**
* Flexible in supporting critical business discussions outside standard local working hours to meet global business needs.


**Location**

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Role Overview**
*The Manager, Technical Consulting — Marketing Cloud Next leads a team of Technical Consultants and Sr Technical Consultants delivering enterprise\-scale migrations from legacy marketing platforms (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, legacy SFMC) to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. This role sits within Salesforce Professional Services' Global Delivery Centre (GDC) and is a 50% billable position — equally accountable for hands\-on technical architecture delivery and people leadership of the Marketing Cloud Next migration track within the Migration Factory. As a trusted advisor to clients and a people\-first leader within the CoE, you will drive high\-quality, repeatable delivery across concurrent migration waves while growing a high\-performing team of marketing technology migration specialists*
**Responsibilities**
* People Leadership: Manage up to 15 direct reports (Sr Technical Consultants and Technical Consultants) across the Marketing Cloud Next migration track — responsible for hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management and career development.
* Technical Delivery (50% Billable): Act as the hands\-on Technical Architect for complex Marketing Cloud Next migration engagements — owning solution design, subscriber data architecture, journey migration blueprint, Data Cloud implementation design and cutover strategy.
* Migration Factory Contribution: Drive the Marketing Cloud Next track within the Migration Factory — ensuring wave delivery adheres to factory standards, playbooks and accelerators, and that all team members follow the MDLC phase discipline.
* Trusted Advisor: Serve as the senior technical point of contact for clients on Marketing Cloud Next migrations — building trusted relationships with client marketing operations leads, CDOs and Enterprise Architects.
* Workshop Leadership: Lead and facilitate functional and technical discovery workshops, solution design reviews and cutover planning sessions with client stakeholders and internal delivery teams.
* Solution Design Governance: Review and approve all Marketing Cloud Next solution design documents, data mapping artefacts and integration designs produced by the track team — ensuring compliance with factory standards and Salesforce best practices.
* Data Architecture Oversight: Oversee the subscriber data migration strategy — including data extension schema design, consent record migration (GDPR/CAN\-SPAM/CASL), suppression list architecture and Salesforce Data Cloud unified profile design.
* Journey Migration Leadership: Guide the team in translating legacy marketing automation workflows, drip campaigns and triggered sends to Marketing Cloud Next Journey Builder — ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved.
* Risk Management: Proactively identify and manage solution risks within the Marketing Cloud Next track — including subscriber key conflicts, deliverability degradation, consent compliance gaps and Data Cloud ingestion failures.
* Practice Development: Drive internal initiatives to grow the Marketing Cloud Next migration practice — developing reusable playbooks, config accelerators, subscriber migration toolkits and AMPscript/SSJS template libraries.
* Cross\-track Collaboration: Work closely with Lead Architects, Integration Architects and Data Migration Architects across concurrent waves to align Marketing Cloud Next delivery with the broader migration programme dependencies.
* Metrics \& Outcomes: Own and report on team utilisation, delivery velocity, defect density, client satisfaction (CSAT) and wave throughput metrics for the Marketing Cloud Next track.
* Hiring \& Talent: Actively participate in hiring, interviewing and onboarding Marketing Cloud Next technical consultants — building pipeline of talent aligned to the Migration Factory's growth roadmap.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next Platform: Advanced hands\-on expertise in Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio and Contact Builder — with proven ability to lead complex migration deliveries.
* Salesforce Data Cloud: Hands\-on experience with Data Cloud — data stream configuration, identity resolution, unified profile design and segmentation activation to Marketing Cloud Next.
* Subscriber Data Migration: Proven expertise migrating high\-volume subscriber databases, data extensions, consent records and suppression lists with zero data loss and full compliance preservation.
* Consent \& Compliance: Expert knowledge of GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL — consent architecture design, preference centre migration and compliance\-aligned subscriber data handling.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging integration patterns.
* Data Architecture \& Management: Strong understanding of subscriber data models, data extension architecture, sendable objects, contact counts and Large Data Volume (LDV) strategies for marketing platforms.
* Platform Security: Knowledge of data encryption, field\-level security and compliance protocols during subscriber data migration windows.
* Sharing \& Visibility: Understanding of how migrated subscriber and consent data will be secured and accessed post\-deployment across business units and regions.
* People Management: 5\+ years of experience managing technical consulting or engineering teams — including performance management, career development, hiring and mentoring in a delivery\-oriented environment.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory) for large\-scale subscriber data migration
* Knowledge of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Personalisation for journey personalisation post\-migration
* Familiarity with email deliverability management — IP warm\-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation management
* Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS and LINE channel migration in addition to email
* Understanding of marketing data warehouse patterns (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources


**Experience Requirements**
* 10–16 years of Salesforce and marketing technology consulting experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud delivery experience, with at least 2 end\-to\-end migration projects
* 5\+ years of people management experience leading technical consulting or delivery teams
* Demonstrated track record of leading concurrent migration workstreams in a factory or programme delivery model

title: Senior Analyst - Project Delivery Coordinator
description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will work as an embedded member of DESRI’s Project Delivery team, supporting the portfolio managed by Commercial \& Delivery Lead (CDL), building a deep understanding of how Project Delivery Leads (PDLs) manage projects from commitment through commercial operation, and helping design and implement solutions that allow PDLs to spend more of their time on project execution, relationships, and judgment\-intensive activities.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Operate as an embedded member of the PDL team, participating in project calls, email traffic, internal discussions, and other day\-to\-day activities across the CDL’s portfolio.
* Develop a deep understanding of the PDL role, including project workflows, contractual obligations, recurring deliverables, project milestones and administrative requirements.
* Identify \& support recurring administrative burdens and process inefficiencies that consume PDL time.
* Surface and implement opportunities for automation, process improvement, standardization, or expanded support from DESRI’s Hyderabad office.
* Define and coordinate solutions with the appropriate U.S. and Hyderabad teams — designing the mechanism and routing work to the right owner, rather than absorbing administrative tasks directly.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures, trackers, contract exhibits, and other key process documents used within Project Delivery.
* Support implementation and adoption of improved workflows and automation tools.
* Support and strengthen existing DESRI Hyderabad Project Delivery workstreams, including lender reporting, transaction support, and project performance testing.
* Improve and standardise Hyderabad\-supported processes across document management, milestone coordination, landowner payments, account setup, and vendor invoicing.
* Identify and build the case for expanding Hyderabad support into areas such as change order review, lender diligence, and project schedule coordination.
* Serve as a bridge between the U.S. Project Delivery organisation and Hyderabad — supporting project\-specific analysis where needed, driving more consistent processes across PDLs and projects, and identifying where deeper integration can create meaningful value.
* Help enable PDL’s to focus more of their bandwidth on critical\-path relationship and judgment\-intensive aspects of project delivery.
* Qualifications
* B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or Construction Management or related field.
* Around 5–7 years of experience, with large infrastructure or energy projects — in project delivery, project management, project controls, development, owner’s engineer / PMC, infrastructure advisory, or infrastructure investing. Renewable energy experience is preferred but not required.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex workflows and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Demonstrated curiosity around technology, automation, and process improvement, ideally with evidence of having built or implemented something that lasted.
* Working knowledge of project scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 or MS Project and strong Excel skills; exposure to Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, or Smartsheet is an advantage.
* Strong organisational and written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work directly with senior U.S.\-based stakeholders.
* Comfort operating across multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, in an environment where scope is not always fully defined.
* A proactive and intellectually curious approach, with the judgment to identify problems, develop recommendations, and coordinate solutions with more senior team members

You will manage end‑to‑end delivery of audit engagements, ensuring consistent adoption of Internal Audit methodology, effective coordination with business stakeholders, and timely completion of audit activities.

* Data Visualization \& Reporting
* Data Governance \& Quality Management
* Automation \& Continuous Monitoring
* Critical Thinking \& Problem Solving

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt’s pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality

title: Oracle EPM Allocations Lead
description:
**Enterprise Functions Engineering**
 Enterprise Functions Engineering drives the strategy, delivery, and support of LSEG's enterprise platforms across Finance, Risk and other corporate functions. Our mission is to simplify and standardise business processes, accelerate digital transformation, and enable data\-driven decision\-making through innovative technology solutions.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As an Oracle EPM EPCM Specialist, you will contribute to the design, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, with a focus on Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management (EPCM). Working closely with Enterprise Functions stakeholders and Engineering teams, you will help deliver scalable profitability and cost allocation solutions that support strategic decision\-making across the organisation.
   

  

 This role is ideal for professionals passionate about solving complex business challenges, improve transparency in financial performance, and drive continuous process improvement.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Proven experience as a Manager or Lead Consultant, Senior Consultant, or Solution Architect with hands\-on implementation and support of Oracle EPM Cloud solutions, specifically EPCM.
* Strong understanding of profitability modelling, cost allocation methodologies, managerial accounting, and driver\-based planning and allocations.
* Experience designing and implementing complex allocation frameworks and profitability models within large enterprise environments.
* Deep understanding of Finance transformation initiatives and Enterprise Performance Management best practices.
* Experience integrating Oracle EPM with ERP, data warehouses, and reporting platforms.
* Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively within a wider delivery team.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication capabilities.


**Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities**
* Own and prioritise business requirements related to Oracle EPCM and associated EPM applications.
* Partner with Finance and Corporate Function stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document detailed business requirements.
* Design and configure profitability and cost allocation models that support business planning and performance management objectives.
* Build and maintain rule sets, drivers, calculations, metadata structures, allocations, and reporting solutions within Oracle EPCM.
* Analyse business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, transparency, and decision\-making through technology.
* Support enterprise planning transformation initiatives through process standardisation and automation.
* Evaluate Oracle monthly releases and implement enhancements where appropriate.
* Plan, test, and deploy solution enhancements while ensuring alignment with governance and control requirements.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Engineering, Data, Test, Change, and Operations teams to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Finance and Enterprise Function stakeholders on EPM best practices and optimisation opportunities.
* Stay current with Oracle EPM roadmap developments, industry trends, and emerging technologies.


**Key Relationships**
 To successfully deliver technology solutions, it is essential to partner closely with Finance, Finance Transformation teams, process owners, wider Engineering teams, Technology Delivery, External implementation and consulting partners where applicable. This collaboration ensures alignment across strategic priorities, operating models, governance requirements, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Essential Skills**
**Technical / Professional Skills \& Competencies**
* 7\+ years of experience implementing or supporting Oracle EPM Cloud solutions.
* Deep expertise in Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management (EPCM).
* Strong knowledge of Financial Planning, Cost Management, Management Reporting, and Enterprise Performance Management processes.
* Experience designing and deploying complex profitability and allocation models.
* Experience with Calculation Manager \- Groovy, metadata management, reporting and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of Oracle EPM architecture and integration patterns.
* Experience working with Oracle ERP Cloud, Oracle Fusion Applications, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
* Strong SQL, data analysis, and reconciliation capabilities.
* Ability to communicate technical solutions effectively to both technical and business audiences.
* Strong project delivery, prioritisation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, testing, deployment, and support.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.


**Desired Skills**
* Experience with Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (PBCS), Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), EDM, or Narrative Reporting.
* Knowledge of strategic cost management and transfer pricing methodologies.
* Familiarity with Azure, cloud integration technologies, and enterprise data platforms.
* Experience within global financial services or complex multinational organisations.
* Agile delivery experience and familiarity with DevOps practices.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills.


**Education / Certifications**
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Oracle EPM Cloud Certification, preferably in Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management.
* Professional accounting or finance qualifications (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA) are desirable.

title: Workday HRIS Specialist, Senior Principal ( Advanced Compensation and Integrations)
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) \- the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI\-powered applications and experience with agility and ease.
   

  

 We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a
 **HRIS Specialist, Senior Principal** 
 and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Learn More about
 **us**
 We are hiring an experienced Workday Technical and Functional Consultant to act as the single point of contact between our HR, Finance, IT and business stakeholders and the Workday delivery team. This is a hands\-on configuration role, not a program management role: the successful candidate will have spent the last 10 years working inside Workday tenants, configuring solutions, building and troubleshooting integrations, and producing reporting that leaders actually use.
   

  

 The role sits at the center of demand and delivery. Requests arrive from many directions and in many forms, from a one\-line question about an eligibility rule to a multi\-quarter programme of work. This person translates those requests into clear problem statements, sizes them honestly, and then distributes the work across the full delivery group, which spans our internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant. Part of that judgement is deciding at the point of intake which items should sit with the consultant from the start rather than being picked up internally and handed over later. Equally important is the ability to explain the resulting design back to the requesting team in plain business language, and to the delivery group in configuration terms.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Stakeholder Engagement and Requirement Intake**
* Serve as the single point of contact for all stakeholder groups raising Workday demand, running a consistent intake process rather than an ad hoc queue.
* Gather, challenge and document requirements from HR, Payroll, Finance, IT and business leaders, converting loosely worded asks into precise, testable problem statements.
* Translate business problem statements into functional and technical design for the team, and translate proposed Workday solutions back into language the requesting team can validate and sign off.
* Maintain a single prioritized demand backlog, agree sequencing with stakeholders, and communicate trade\-offs when capacity is constrained.
* Run design walkthroughs, impact assessments and readiness sessions ahead of each Workday release.


**Configuration and Solution Design**
* Own end\-to\-end configuration design across the Workday footprint, working hands\-on in the tenant rather than directing others from a distance.
* Configure and troubleshoot business processes, condition rules, security groups, domain and business process security policies, calculated fields and eligibility rules.
* Assess downstream impact of every change across modules before it is built, and protect tenant hygiene through disciplined use of sandbox, sandbox preview and production migration practices.
* Define and enforce configuration standards, naming conventions, testing expectations and documentation for the team.


**Integrations and Reporting**
* Design, build and support integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio and web services, including error handling, monitoring and re\-run procedures.
* Act as the technical authority on integration issues raised by vendors and downstream system owners, and drive root cause analysis to closure.
* Build advanced, matrix, composite reporting, and advise stakeholders on the right reporting approach rather than building every request as asked.
* Ensure reporting and integration outputs respect data privacy, segregation of duties and audit requirements.


**Work Sizing, Prioritization and Distribution**
* Assess the complexity, risk and effort of each incoming requirement and assign it to the right owner across the delivery group, which includes internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant.
* Balance workload across internal team members and consultant capacity, track progress against commitments, and escalate early when a commitment is at risk.
* Review the work of internal team members and the consultant, provide technical coaching, and raise the overall configuration capability of the group.


**Sourcing Decisions at Intake**
* Decide at the point of intake, rather than mid\-delivery, which items should go to the consultant from the start and which the internal HRIS team should own, based on complexity, specialist skill requirements, timeline pressure and internal capacity.
* Prepare scope and requirement documentation for consultant\-delivered work, review the designs and deliverables that come back, and hold the consultant to quality and timeline expectations.
* Track the split between internal and consultant delivery, and advise leadership on where that boundary should sit as internal capability grows.


**Subject Matter Expertise Required**
 The candidate must demonstrate working familiarity with all Workday modules in our footprint and deep, demonstrable subject matter expertise in the following two areas:
   

  

* Advanced Compensation, including compensation and merit plan configuration, eligibility rules, compensation review cycles, bonus and stock processes, matrices and worksheet configuration, and troubleshooting cycle issues under time pressure.
* Integrations, including EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, web services, integration security configuration, and the operational support model that keeps integrations running.


**Your Background**
* Overall 12\+ years of experience in HR Systems. Minimum 10 years of experience working exclusively on the Workday configuration side, in a technical and functional consulting or in\-house product capacity.
* Working knowledge of all Workday modules, with the ability to reason about cross\-module impact rather than treating each module in isolation.
* Subject matter expertise in Advanced Compensation and Integrations, evidenced by full\-lifecycle delivery in both.
* Strong reporting capability across advanced, matrix, composite reporting, and comfort with calculated fields.
* Proven experience as the requirements owner or single point of contact for a stakeholder community, including prioritization and expectation management with senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to size and distribute work across a mixed\-seniority team, and to decide at intake which work belongs with internal team members and which with an external consultant.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical design to non\-technical audiences and business intent to technical colleagues.
* Willingness to work the 1:00 pm to 10:00 pm shift and to be present in the Bengaluru or Hyderabad office two days per week.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Workday Pro certification or partner certification in Compensation, Advanced Compensation or Integrations.
* Experience supporting a global workforce across multiple regions and regulatory environments.
* Experience operating within a shared services or HR technology centre of excellence model.
* Familiarity with ticketing and demand management tooling, and with release governance for Workday feature releases.


**Compensation**
 If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we’d be happy to chat. What we offer in return is the opportunity to experience a great company culture with wonderful colleagues to learn from and collaborate with, and also to enjoy:
   

  

* Competitive remuneration package
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan Enrolment


**Vacation, Family, and Health**
* 30 days of earned leave
* An extra day off for your birthday
* Various other leaves like marriage leave, casual leave, maternity leave, and paternity leave
* Premium Group Medical Insurance for employees and five dependents, personal accident insurance coverage, and life insurance coverage
* Professional development reimbursement
* Interest subsidy on loans \- either vehicle or personal loans.

description:
**Role Summary**


The **Finance Risk Infrastructure Business Solutions Team (FRIBS)** is responsible for providing business and technology solutions for our Finance and Risk business partners. This role is responsible to drive end\-to\-end program/project management activities for a portfolio of projects aligning to a business area. Primary objectives of this role are to plan the project activities and drive through delivery and post\-deploy support in order to achieve the target business outcomes while helping ensure project costs, timeliness and resourcing are aligned. This is inclusive of operational readiness activities, coordination across to our IT and vendor partners and close analysis work with our line of business subject matter experts.


**Major Responsibilities**

* Program/Project Management \- including the pre\-execution phase of planning with our business, technology and vendor partners.
* Issue Identification and Resolution \- proactive and prompt identification, resolution and where necessary, escalation of critical issues impacting the program/project.
* Over time grow to know the business of Finance as well as our business partners and the leverage a learned knowledge of our systems and data repositories to help use such knowledge to drive solutions and outcomes.
* Financial Management \- ownership for the planning/definition of the financials required to deliver program/project work. This ownership includes forecast management and working with the business to ensure project spend is optimized.
* Establish Program/Project Management Office capabilities that help influence visibility and transparency of project outcomes, risks, issues and challenges.
* Strong ability to solution business outcomes across the Finance spaces specifically Global Accounting, Financial Planning \& Analysis and Controllers business areas
* Communications with Senior Leaders \- candidate must be able to communicate to senior level leaders
* Influence Management \- candidate must be able to collaborate with key stakeholders to influence decisions in a timely manner.
* Drive to deliver high quality results on\-time, on\-benefit

Additionally, the candidate may be asked to:


* Lead internal FRIBS work to strengthen our project management, business analysis and risk management capabilities for the this business area.
* Maintain strong understanding of our full financial process and the flow of work through this process looking to streamline and optimize processes and organizations where needed.
* Work with a bias for action to help pull swift decisions and delivery with urgency
* Align to our core values and leadership principles
* Value continuous learning and skill\-building
* Maintain a professional decorum while being comfortable with dissenting opinions and getting to the right outcome when such opinions exist.
* Passionate about working in teams and strengthening team effectiveness, camaraderie and output.

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in the Finance or CFO business unit of a global corporation
* Minimum of 12 years of experience in change management with solution delivery mindset

title: Director - Manufacturing CMC Project management
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

Company Overview
  
Lilly, a leading innovation\-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better – through medicines and information – for some of the world’s most urgent medical needs. Founded over 150 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly knows its business has prospered because of its employees – people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team – and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!
  
Manufacturing and Quality Technical Hub Hyderabad
  
Lilly has made a strategic investment of more than $1B dollars to establish a Manufacturing and Quality technical hub. This hub will oversee the significant investment in contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India and the technical services responsible for managing the scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. The hub will be recruiting top talent in the areas of process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to build a cutting\-edge scientific organization supporting the exciting manufacturing portfolio of Lilly.
  
About This Role
  
Lilly’s product commercialization spans a growing global manufacturing network, dozens of specialized functions, and an expanding portfolio of transformative medicines. The gap: no single leader owns the full picture.
  
This role fills that gap. You are the single point of accountability for a product’s entire commercialization lifecycle—from post\-Phase 2 through launch and beyond. You own the manufacturing CMC strategy, lead the Product Core Team, collaborate with development, and serve as the go\-to interface for senior executives who need clarity, not noise.
  
This is a strategic leadership role, not a coordination role. It demands deep pharma development and/or manufacturing knowledge, executive presence, and the ability to drive alignment across a powerful, matrixed organization — without direct authority.
  
  

What Success Looks Like in Year One
  
Lilly’s commercialization process involves deep, specialized functions — Development, Engineering, Analytical Quality, TS/MS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Sites, and CMC Regulatory. Each brings critical expertise. The winning Manufacturing CMC Project Manager orchestrates them: knowing when to convene the full team, and when to engage only who’s needed — protecting expert time and driving efficient progress. In year one, you will have demonstrated:
  
  

* Stakeholder orchestration credibility — functional leaders trust that when you call them in, it matters; when you don’t, it’s handled.
* A Mfg technical agenda that serves as the true single source of truth — every relevant function’s input synthesized into one coherent product strategy.
* At least one major bottleneck resolved through smart, targeted convening — the right people in the room, no one else.
* Senior leaders who say you “always know where the product stands” — earned through disciplined intelligence\-gathering, not reporting overhead.
* A product team operating with more speed and purpose than before — siloed expertise channeled into coordinated, forward momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  
Manufacturing CMC Strategy \& Commercialization Ownership
  
  

* Own the Manufacturing CMC Commercialization Strategy across Development, Manufacturing, and Business Units.
* Lead the Product Core Team and oversee its technical execution, ensuring clear ownership, milestone accountability, and proactive risk management.
* Drive alignment of launch presentation and commercial image strategy across relevant functional and affiliate stakeholders.
* Ensure gate deliverables are clearly defined, plans are in place, and execution is on track; proactively identifying and resolving gaps.


Governance \& Executive Visibility
  
  

* Serve as the accountable representative for the product at all Governance and Oversight Forums, providing clear, confident updates on progress, risks, and decisions required.
* Act as the primary interface for senior executives seeking visibility into commercialization status — translating technical complexity into concise, actionable insight.
* Ensure escalations are surfaced proactively and resolved with appropriate speed and rigor.
* Demonstrates proficiency in using enterprise project management, collaboration, and reporting tools to drive transparency and execution excellence.


Cross\-Functional Alignment \& Stakeholder Leadership
  
  

* Ensure sustained alignment across Development, Manufacturing, and Business Unit stakeholders throughout the product’s lifecycle, including global manufacturing site teams and CMC Regulatory.
* Influence without authority across a complex, matrixed organization — building trust, resolving conflict, and driving decisions through collaboration rather than directive.
* Partner closely with Development and CMC Regulatory on submission strategy, ensuring the manufacturing program supports regulatory timelines and requirements.


Post\-Launch Technical Agenda
  
  

* Lead Post\-Launch Technical Agenda (PLTA) strategy for assigned products, influencing pre\-submission deliverables and lifecycle management planning.
* Ensure the product’s long\-term commercial and technical sustainability by driving proactive planning for process improvements, line extensions, and continuous manufacturing optimization.


Required Qualifications
  
Education
  
  

* Advanced engineering, scientific degree (M.S., Ph.D., or MBA with strong technical foundation). Advanced degrees are preferred although a Bachelor with equivalent industry experience may also be considered.


Experience
  
  

* Minimum 8 years of progressive pharmaceutical industry experience, with meaningful exposure to development, manufacturing, commercialization, and/or technical program leadership.
* Experience with both drug substance and drug product. Small or large molecule experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading or significantly contributing to cross\-functional programs through key development and commercialization milestones (e.g., tech transfer, process validation, regulatory submission readiness, product launch).
* Ability to evaluate manufacturing network strategies and their impact on launch readiness, supply continuity, cost, and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to influence and lead without direct authority across complex, matrixed organizations.
* Track record of operating effectively at the senior leadership level — communicating with confidence, handling ambiguity, and making high\-quality decisions under pressure.


Functional Background (one or more areas preferred)
  
  

* TS/MS, CMC development, Operations, Supply Chain, or Mfg.


Key Skills \& Competencies
  
  

* Strategic Leadership: Shapes long\-range manufacturing CMC commercialization strategy; translates vision into execution.
* Influence Without Authority: Drives alignment and decisions across powerful, matrixed stakeholders without formal reporting relationships.
* Change Leadership: Leads teams through organizational, technical, and strategic change while maintaining stakeholder engagement and execution momentum
* Executive Communication: Distills complex technical and operational information into clear, confident narratives for senior audiences.
* Negotiation \& Conflict Resolution: Balances competing functional and affiliate priorities with fairness, speed, and strategic judgment.
* Commercial Acumen: Understands the business implications of manufacturing decisions — including supply risk, launch readiness, and lifecycle value.
* Risk Management: Proactively identifies, surfaces, and resolves program risks before they become schedule or quality issues.
* Cross\-Cultural \& Global Collaboration: Effective working across global manufacturing sites, development organizations, and business units with varying priorities.
* Entrepreneurial Mindset: Comfortable operating in an evolving role structure; builds credibility and process from the ground up.


Schedule
  
  

* Flexible in supporting critical business discussions outside standard local working hours to meet global business needs.


Location
  
Lilly Manufacturing India \-Hyderabad

Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

title: Associate Project Manager, DMS East
description:

 CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
   

  

 We’re looking for an execution\-focused Associate Project Manager to manage creative and marketing projects across videos, animations, infographics, and design for scientific and academic clients. You’ll own projects from brief to delivery—translating requirements into actionable plans, coordinating creative teams and vendors, managing timelines and review cycles, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to quality expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end project execution—translate client briefs into clear scope, deliverables, timelines, milestones, and review cycles.

* Coordinate cross\-functional teams—assign and manage work across designers, animators, writers, freelancers, and vendors in collaboration with team leads.

**Responsibilities:** 




 Project Planning \& Coordination:
 


* Coordinate the planning and implementation of projects, ensuring all tasks, timelines, and resources are clearly defined and aligned with project objectives.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, goals, milestones, timelines, and resource allocation.
* Coordinate internal and external resources to ensure the efficient execution of project tasks.



  





 Team Leadership \& Collaboration:
 


* Coordinate cross\-functional teams, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Foster a collaborative environment to facilitate team cooperation, knowledge sharing, and problem\-solving.
* Provide guidance and support to team members to ensure that project goals are met and tasks are completed effectively.



  





 Budget \& Resource Management:
 


* Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring that resources are allocated efficiently and effectively.
* Monitor project expenses, track variances, and take corrective actions when necessary to keep the project within budget.
* Manage resource allocation, ensuring the availability of necessary resources (e.g., personnel, equipment, technology) throughout the project.



  





 Risk \& Issue Management:
 


* Identify potential risks and obstacles that may impact project success and develop mitigation strategies to address them.
* Proactively address issues as they arise, working with stakeholders to resolve them quickly and effectively.

title: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre
description:
**Job Description**
* Collaborate independently with regional stakeholders and GSC functional owners to understand business objectives, process scope, pain points, volumes, service expectations, controls and dependencies.
* Design end\-to\-end GSC / offshoring solutions, including target operating model, team structure, spans and layers, capacity, skill mix, governance and charge back.
* Translate the agreed solution into detailed process scope, resource requirements, implementation approach, dependencies, assumptions, service levels, controls and measurable business outcomes.
* Apply strong knowledge of GSC, shared services and offshoring models, transition methodologies, process design, operational controls and industry best practices to develop practical and scalable solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor and primary transition / solutioning partner to senior regional and functional stakeholders, independently leading discussions, workshops, negotiations and decision\-making forums.
* Communicate solution options, trade\-offs, risks, dependencies and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders; constructively challenge assumptions where required to protect transition and operational outcomes.
* Collaborate with GSC leadership, operations, process owners, HR, finance, technology, Process Excellence and other enabling functions to validate solution feasibility and ensure end\-to\-end implementation readiness.
* Define clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights and governance across regional and GSC teams throughout solution design, transition and stabilization.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive solution and transition documentation, including scope and process maps, target operating model, organization design, resource and capacity plans, RACI, assumptions, dependencies, business case inputs, implementation plans and governance packs.
* Own end\-to\-end transitions of process scope from regions into the GSC, from initiation and due diligence through planning, knowledge transfer, readiness, go\-live, stabilization and formal handover to operations.
* Define transition objectives, in\-scope / out\-of\-scope activities, success measures, milestones, deliverables and acceptance criteria jointly with stakeholders and receiving operations teams.
* Develop and manage integrated transition plans covering resourcing, hiring and onboarding, knowledge transfer, training, access and technology readiness, controls, documentation, communications and operational readiness.
* Establish and govern structured transition toll gates with clear entry / exit criteria and evidence\-based readiness assessments; ensure appropriate stakeholder sign\-offs before progression and go\-live.
* Maintain robust RAID management, proactively identifying risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies; define mitigants, owners and escalation paths and drive timely resolution of roadblocks.
* Lead transition governance and stakeholder reporting, tracking milestones, actions, decisions, readiness and overall transition health; escalate material risks or deviations with clear recommendations and recovery plans.
* Manage go\-live and stabilization / hypercare, monitor agreed service and quality indicators, close residual risks and actions, capture lessons learned and complete a structured handover to business\-as\-usual operations.


**Qualifications \& Competencies**
* Minimum bachelor's degree in Business Management, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree and/or recognized project, transition or change management certification (e.g., PMP) is a plus.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with significant hands\-on experience in transition management, solutioning, shared services / GSC, BPO or offshoring environments. Experience independently leading complex, cross\-functional transitions is essential.
* Strong knowledge of transition and solutioning frameworks, target operating model and organization design, capacity / resource planning, governance, toll\-gate methodology, risk management, process migration and operational readiness.
* Strong analytical, structured problem\-solving and commercial mindset, with the ability to convert ambiguous requirements into executable solutions and transition plans.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills, with confidence engaging independently with senior leaders across regions and functions.
* Strong project and program management capability, including governance, milestone management, RAID management, executive reporting and management of multiple concurrent transitions.
* Demonstrated ownership, judgement and decision\-making ability; comfortable challenging constructively, managing competing priorities and driving outcomes in a matrixed, multicultural environment.
* Strong change leadership and knowledge\-transfer capability, with a focus on business continuity, control effectiveness, service quality and sustainable adoption.
* Ability to work autonomously, travel as required for transition activity, and manage stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Workplace type: In office.

* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines.

title: Senior Project Controller
description:

 Your impact
   

  

* Familiarization with the process of project control procedures
* Understanding Contract vis\-à\-vis project scope of work
* Developing Cost WBS structure and control budget for the project based on the approved estimate.
* Proactively monitor and communicate budget, actual status, and forecast costs/labor hours for projects monthly.
* Consolidate performance data to support performance measurement, data analysis, and cost forecasting.
* Assist in the development of project work plans and schedules.
* Create client and internal status reports that effectively communicate schedule status and identify critical path.
* Provide technical guidance to other project controls staff in project financial status
* Ensuring all financials are in order, preparing spreadsheets and a wide variety of routine cost analyses, cash flow, and other cost related evaluations.
* Set\-up, monitor \& report earned value progress measurement systems for projects, including analysis based on input from project leads
* Identify business acumen by identifying for us potential project problems early, report issues and problems to operations leadership, and work with project teams to address and implement recovery plans.
* Review of expenditure details, identifying incorrect charges, and commencement of the charge correction process will ensure our financials are accurate. To review, process, and track sub consultant invoices on various projects.
* Prepare and update project schedules and cost/resource loading them.
* Identify and drive optimizations in planning and execution of projects
* Advise Project Controls Lead and Project Leadership Team of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provide guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends.
* Develop and review schedule corrective actions and recovery plans and verify needed actions plans are implemented.
* Review project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.
* Monitor and report on schedule implications of changes
* Support project team with ongoing project progress measurement and schedule analysis, reporting, and forecasting activities.
* Develop change management and maintaining change log.
* Support in monitoring of cost developments of engineering/vendors/contractors and develop the cost reports.
* Look for ways to reduce project costs and for ways to improve our work processes.
* Perform price estimation and price budgeting from contract commitment to fit the baseline program
* Provide planning / scheduling, and cost controlling mechanism for all projects which includes variation reporting, monitoring of milestone progress to the preparation of customer billing processes, etc.
* Ensure effective project implementation and utilize productive reports from the creation of WBS with the use of project management system to monitor the status of the project.
* Perform project costing related reporting to the team and management’s review monthly to ensure that expenditures are kept within the project budget.
* Performing and/or managing the analysis of cost and risks for projects with a focus on support of project management.
* Accountable for investment of project cost, and schedule and reports to the Project Manager of one or more projects during the planning and execution phase.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Graduate / Advanced degree in Engineering or other technical disciplines
* Experience in the infrastructure sector or in construction industry is highly preferable, with exposure in site engineering, project management, project planning, project costing, project scheduling, coordination, procurement and construction workflows.
* Knowledge in cost control tools and technics to drive /contribute project financial health, knowledge in Estimation, Project / Cost Controlling, Project Tracking, Project Scheduling
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of interdependency of underlying cost and schedule drivers.
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of the entire system of the business, relationship between productivity vs profitability
* Minimum of 7 years post qualification experience (PQE) in project control / planning or relevant sectors


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

 B.Tech Civil
