title: Process Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Position: Process Engineer**
 Location: Navi Mumbai, India \| Reports to: Project Manager / Service Delivery Lead
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Process Engineer is responsible for reviewing, understanding and following customer inquiries and technical specifications. This person has overall responsibility with the design of oil and gas field equipment and technologies and performs project execution. The role includes field operations and treatments, as well as implementing, monitoring, and controlling different solutions to meet project and client expectations. The objective of the position is to support sales, service, delivery, and technical support of clients in assigned geographical areas and territory.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Evaluate customer inquiries and specifications to determine the best process or equipment design for the application.
* Design equipment or technologies to match specifications required to help customers maximize production.
* Lead the development and creation of all project process engineering deliverables
* Perform complex process simulations utilizing business\-defined software
* Lead HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, and other safety studies.
* Support and interface with clients on field development planning and multi\-discipline services.
* Manage multiple stakeholders including Client, PMC engineers, contractors, and sub\-contractors.
* Prepare Scope of Work (SOW) for FEED and adequacy studies.
* Understand and implement Data Confidentiality Standards and IT Security Policies.
* Utilize digital twin tools to monitor real\-time facility and equipment performance against design baselines, and support engineering decisions and adequacy studies.
* Apply AI\-assisted process optimization workflows to identify opportunities for production improvement, OPEX reduction, and emissions management.
* Leverage asset health monitoring platforms to interpret equipment condition data, support predictive maintenance planning, and minimize unplanned downtime.
* Integrate digital simulation outputs (steady\-state and dynamic) with real\-time operational data to enhance process troubleshooting and performance reviews.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
**Qualification:** 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical, Petroleum, or Petrochemical Engineering or equivalent; higher degree preferred.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7–12 years in Process Engineering within E\&P / Oil \& Gas / Service industry, with a mix of Operator, Licensing, and Consultancy exposure.
   

  

**Project Types:** 
 Hands\-on experience in Concept Development, FEED, Pre\-FEED, Detail Engineering and Digital projects for onshore and offshore upstream Oil \& Gas projects.
   

  

**Language:** 
 Proficiency in English and Hindi required.
   

  

**Technical Skills**
* Basic Engineering, FEED, Detail Engineering \& Concept Development for upstream Oil \& Gas (onshore \& offshore).
* Greenfield \& Brownfield development experience.
* Process lead for Design Reviews, HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, and other safety studies.
* Preparation and review of all process engineering deliverables.
* Technical report writing: adequacy studies, hydraulic/surge studies, technical notes, and SOW for FEED.
* Field Development Plan (FDP) preparation.
* Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (API, IEC, ASME, etc.).


**Digital \& Software Skills**
**Process Simulation**
**Flow Assurance**
**Digital Twin / AI**
**Productivity**
 Symmetry or industry equivalent
   

  

 OLGA
   

  

 PIPESIM
   

  

 Digital Twin /
   

  

 Asset Performance
   

  

 Microsoft Excel
   

  

 (Advanced)
   

  

* Proficient in process simulation tools: Symmetry or industry equivalent for steady\-state and dynamic simulation.
* Experienced in flow assurance and transient analysis using OLGA and PIPESIM.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel for engineering calculations, production profiles, and data analysis.
* Exposure to digital tools for technical report writing, engineering deliverables management, and project documentation systems.


**Digital Skills**
 The candidate is expected to demonstrate awareness and working aptitude across three core digital capability areas increasingly adopted in upstream oil \& gas operations:
   

  

* Digital Twin – Facility, Equipment \& Pipeline
* Understanding of digital twin concepts for upstream surface facilities \- virtual models of processing equipment, pipelines, and entire facility networks that mirror real\-world performance in real time.
* Ability to use equipment and facility twin outputs to track performance against design baselines, support engineering decisions, adequacy studies, and design reviews.
* Working knowledge of physics\-based modelling, data\-driven AI techniques, and hybrid (physics\-informed AI) approaches applied in facility and equipment twins.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based digital twin deployment and integration with operational data from multiple OEM or vendor systems.
* Ability to apply digital twin insights to identify performance gaps, support commissioning, and enhance engineering documentation.
* Process Optimization
* Ability to use digital process twins and simulation tools for real\-time and predictive optimization of facility operations.
* Experience in ‘what\-if’ scenario analysis using simulation models and digital twins to maximize production, optimize energy usage, and reduce emissions.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted optimization workflows – automated insights that reduce OPEX, increase throughput, and improve energy efficiency.
* Ability to interpret AI\-generated advisory outputs and translate them into practical process engineering actions for production assurance and performance improvement.
* Knowledge of integrating digital optimization tools with conventional process engineering workflows – PFDs, P\&IDs, steady\-state and dynamic simulation models.
* Awareness of emissions performance monitoring and carbon footprint optimization as part of process system design and operations.
* Asset Health Monitoring \& Reliability
* Familiarity with condition\-based monitoring, continuous assessment of equipment health using real\-time sensor data and AI\-driven anomaly detection.
* Understanding of prognostic health management (PHM), applying predictive failure models and machine learning to anticipate equipment issues ahead of occurrence.
* Ability to interpret failure prediction and anomaly detection outputs and translate them into actionable maintenance recommendations and engineering responses.
* Knowledge of facility\-wide health management analytics, integrating data across compressors, pumps, separators, pipelines, and process equipment into a unified monitoring view.
* Familiarity with maintenance planning workflows – using real\-time equipment data and AI insights to plan, prioritize, and optimize maintenance activities.
* Ability to collaborate with reliability engineers, OEM specialists, and operations teams to convert digital health monitoring insights into engineering actions.


*Hands\-on experience with a specific digital twin or asset performance management platform is advantageous but not mandatory. Candidates with strong process engineering foundations and demonstrated exposure to simulation tools, real\-time monitoring environments, or AI\-assisted engineering workflows will be considered.*
**BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES**
* Strong stakeholder management skills – experience interfacing with Client, PMC, contractors, sub\-contractors, and senior management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experienced in presenting to senior management and clients.
* Proactive problem\-solving approach with strong conflict resolution capability.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience working and leading in multicultural environments.
* Quick learner adapts to new technologies and environments.
* Personally committed to continuous improvement, quality, and HSE.


**Qualification:** 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical, Petroleum, or Petrochemical Engineering or equivalent; higher degree preferred.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7–12 years in Process Engineering within E\&P / Oil \& Gas / Service industry, with a mix of Operator, Licensing, and Consultancy exposure.
   

  

 SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Manager-Patient Experience
description:
**About QI Spine** 




 QI Spine is a specialized spine\-care organisation focused on delivering evidence\-based, patient\-centric spine care through a network of clinics.
 



  





 As we scale our clinic network, we are looking for a
 **Patient Experience Manager** 
 who can build and institutionalize a consistent, high\-quality patient experience across every touchpoint of the patient's journey.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Patient Experience Manager will own and drive the
 **end\-to\-end patient experience across QI Spine clinics** 
 — from the first interaction and appointment through consultation, treatment journey, follow\-ups and post\-treatment engagement.
 



  





 The role will be responsible for identifying experience gaps, strengthening service standards, driving timely resolution of patient concerns, and partnering with Clinic Operations, Doctors, Patient Counsellors and other teams to continuously improve patient satisfaction and loyalty.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be
 **highly execution\-oriented, data\-driven and comfortable working across multiple stakeholders and clinics.** 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Own the Patient Journey
 


* Map and continuously improve the end\-to\-end patient journey across QI Spine clinics.
* Identify critical patient touchpoints and define the expected experience at each stage.
* Monitor key experience parameters such as appointment experience, waiting time, communication, consultation coordination, treatment coordination and follow\-up.
* Identify friction points and work with Operations to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure that patient experience standards are consistently followed across clinics.



  





 2\. Patient Feedback, NPS \& CSAT
 


* Own the overall patient feedback mechanism across clinics.
* Drive
 **NPS, CSAT and Voice of Customer (VOC)** 
 programs.
* Analyse patient feedback to identify recurring themes, service gaps and clinic\-level trends.
* Create clinic\-wise and function\-wise experience dashboards.
* Translate patient feedback into actionable improvement plans.
* Track improvement in patient experience metrics over time.



  





 3\. Complaint \& Escalation Management
 


* Act as the escalation point for critical or unresolved patient concerns.
* Establish a structured complaint management and closure process.
* Ensure complaints are acknowledged, investigated and resolved within defined TATs.
* Coordinate with Clinic Operations, Doctors, Patient Counsellors and other stakeholders for resolution.
* Drive service recovery wherever required.
* Conduct
 **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** 
 for recurring complaints and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Track repeat complaints and ensure sustainable resolution rather than one\-time closure.



  





 4\. Clinic Experience Audits
 


* Conduct regular patient\-experience audits across QI Spine clinics.
* Evaluate adherence to patient experience SOPs and service standards.
* Assess key areas such as:
* Patient greeting and communication
* Waiting\-time management
* Patient counselling
* Clinic environment
* Coordination between teams
* Doctor interaction experience
* Follow\-up communication
* Complaint handling
* Patient exit experience
* Share audit findings with relevant stakeholders and track closure of action items.



  





 5\. Service Standards \& SOPs
 


* Develop and standardise patient experience SOPs across clinics.
* Define service standards for different patient touchpoints.
* Create guidelines for patient communication, escalation handling and service recovery.
* Partner with Operations and L\&D to ensure teams are trained on the required standards.
* Conduct periodic audits to ensure SOP adherence.



  





 6\. Cross\-functional Stakeholder Management
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Clinic Operations
* Doctors / Clinical Teams
* Patient Counsellors
* Central Operations
* Training \& L\&D
* Marketing / CRM
* Quality / Process teams
* Leadership



  





 to identify and resolve patient experience gaps.
 



  





 The role should be able to
 **influence stakeholders without relying solely on hierarchy** 
 and drive closure of issues within agreed timelines.
 



  





 7\. Data \& Experience Analytics
 


* Build and maintain a central patient experience dashboard.
* Track metrics such as:
* NPS
* CSAT
* Complaint volume
* Complaint resolution TAT
* Escalation rate
* Repeat complaints
* Feedback closure %
* Waiting time
* Patient drop\-offs / experience\-related leakage
* Clinic\-wise experience scores
* Identify trends and provide actionable insights to leadership.
* Use data to prioritise experience improvement initiatives.



  





 8\. Patient Experience Improvement Projects
 


* Identify opportunities to improve patient satisfaction and retention.
* Lead cross\-functional improvement projects based on patient feedback and operational data.
* Benchmark patient experience practices within healthcare and other high\-service industries.
* Introduce innovative ways to improve patient communication and engagement.
* Build a culture where every team member understands their role in delivering a superior patient experience.



  





 Key Performance Indicators
 



 The success of this role will be measured through:
 


* Improvement in
 **Patient NPS / CSAT**
* Reduction in patient complaints and escalations
* Complaint resolution TAT
* Feedback closure %
* Reduction in recurring complaints
* Improvement in clinic\-level patient experience audit scores
* SOP adherence
* Reduction in experience\-related patient drop\-offs
* Implementation and closure of patient\-experience improvement initiatives
* Stakeholder adherence to agreed action plans



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 Must Have
 


* 5–8 years of experience in
 **Patient Experience / Customer Experience / Patient Relations / Healthcare Operations / Hospitality / Service Excellence** 
 .
* Experience managing customer/patient escalations and service recovery.
* Strong understanding of customer/patient journey management.
* Experience working with NPS, CSAT, feedback mechanisms or similar CX metrics.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong execution orientation with the ability to work across multiple locations/functions.
* Comfortable with MIS, dashboards and data analysis.



 Preferred
 


* Experience in hospitals, healthcare chains, clinics, diagnostics, wellness or other healthcare businesses.
* Experience managing patient experience across
 **multiple centres/locations** 
 .
* Experience in designing SOPs, service standards and audit frameworks.
* Exposure to CRM, HMS, patient feedback or experience\-management platforms.
* Experience in a fast\-growing healthcare/start\-up environment.



  





 Educational Qualification
 



 Graduate / Postgraduate in:
 


* Hospital / Healthcare Management
* Healthcare Administration
* Business Management / MBA
* Hospitality Management
* Customer Experience / Service Management



 or a relevant discipline.
 



  





 Key Competencies
 



**Patient Centricity \| Service Excellence \| Problem Solving \| Complaint \& Escalation Management \| Stakeholder Management \| Data Orientation \| Process Improvement \| Communication \| Empathy \| Ownership \| Execution Excellence** 




  





 Who will succeed in this role?
 



 We are looking for someone who can move beyond
 **“handling patient complaints”** 
 and build a
 **scalable patient experience system for QI Spine** 
 .

title: Assistant Manager – Soft Services
description:
Soft Services Manager – Residential Building
   

  

* Position Details


 ParticularDetails
 **Position** 
 Soft Services Manager
 **Department** 
 Property Management / Facility Management
 **Reporting To** 
 Property Manager / Estate Manager
 **Location** 
 Residential Building
 **Nature of Job** 
 Full\-time / Site\-based
 **Team Managed** 
 Housekeeping, Cleaning, Waste Management, Pest Control, Landscaping, Support Services, etc.
 **Experience** 
 5–8 years in Facility Management / Residential Property Management preferred
   

  

* Job Purpose


 The
 **Soft Services Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, supervising and ensuring the effective delivery of all soft services within the residential property. The position is responsible for maintaining high standards of
 **cleanliness, hygiene, housekeeping, waste management, pest control, landscaping and overall presentation of common areas** 
 , while ensuring compliance with the property's SOPs, safety requirements and service standards.
   

  

 The Soft Services Manager shall ensure that the residential premises provide a
 **clean, hygienic, safe, aesthetically pleasing and comfortable environment** 
 for residents, visitors and staff.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities
* Housekeeping \& Cleaning Management
* Plan and supervise daily housekeeping operations throughout the building.
* Ensure proper cleaning of: Entrance lobby Reception area Corridors Lift lobbies Staircases Common toilets Clubhouse Swimming pool surroundings Parking areas Service areas Terrace and other common areas.
* Ensure cleaning schedules are prepared and implemented.
* Conduct regular inspections of all common areas.
* Ensure adequate availability and proper use of cleaning chemicals, tools, machinery and consumables.
* Ensure housekeeping staff are properly groomed and equipped with appropriate PPE.
* Monitor mechanised cleaning activities such as scrubber\-dryer, vacuum cleaning, pressure washing, etc.
* Ensure periodic deep cleaning of identified areas.
* Maintain high standards of hygiene and presentation appropriate to a premium residential property.
* Housekeeping Staff Management
* Prepare and monitor manpower deployment plans.
* Ensure adequate manpower is available for each shift.
* Prepare duty rosters and ensure proper shift deployment.
* Monitor attendance, absenteeism and replacement arrangements.
* Ensure proper grooming and uniform standards.
* Conduct daily toolbox meetings/briefings wherever required.
* Train staff on: Cleaning procedures Chemical handling Machine operation PPE Waste segregation Emergency response Resident interaction Workplace safety.
* Monitor employee performance and provide feedback.
* Coordinate with the manpower vendor for shortage, replacement and disciplinary issues.
* Waste Management


 The Soft Services Manager shall ensure proper implementation of the property's waste\-management system.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Ensure segregation of waste at source.
* Monitor collection of wet, dry and reject waste.
* Ensure proper operation of the Organic Waste Converter/Composting system, where applicable.
* Monitor transportation of waste from collection points to designated disposal areas.
* Ensure waste rooms are clean and hygienic.
* Maintain records of waste generation and disposal.
* Coordinate with authorised waste disposal agencies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable municipal and environmental requirements.
* Educate housekeeping staff and residents regarding waste segregation.
* Identify opportunities to reduce waste generation and improve recycling.
* Pest Control Management
* Monitor the pest\-control AMC.
* Ensure scheduled pest\-control treatments are carried out.
* Maintain the pest\-control schedule and treatment records.
* Monitor pest activity in: Garbage rooms Basement STP/WTP areas Common areas Clubhouse Food\-service areas Landscaping areas.
* Immediately escalate major infestation issues to the Property Manager.
* Ensure chemicals are stored and used safely.
* Verify that the pest\-control agency follows appropriate safety practices.
* Track complaints related to termites, cockroaches, rodents, mosquitoes and other pests.
* Landscaping \& Horticulture


 Where landscaping is part of the property's soft\-services scope:
   

  

* Supervise landscaping and gardening activities.
* Ensure plants and lawns are properly maintained.
* Monitor pruning, trimming and fertilisation.
* Ensure appropriate watering schedules.
* Monitor plant health and identify disease/pest infestation.
* Maintain indoor plants and decorative landscaping.
* Coordinate with horticulture vendors.
* Ensure proper disposal of garden waste.
* Recommend improvements to the property's landscape presentation.
* Resident Complaint Management


 The Soft Services Manager shall ensure prompt resolution of resident complaints related to soft services.
   

  

 Typical complaints include:
   

  

* Cleaning issues
* Housekeeping service
* Garbage disposal
* Pest infestation
* Odour
* Toilet hygiene
* Landscaping
* Spillage
* Common\-area cleanliness
* Waste segregation
* Staff behaviour.


 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Monitor complaints received through the Helpdesk/App/email.
* Assign complaints to the concerned staff/vendor.
* Ensure timely closure.
* Verify satisfactory completion.
* Identify recurring complaints and initiate corrective action.
* Prepare periodic complaint analysis for the Property Manager.
* Vendor Management
* Manage soft\-service vendors and contractors.
* Monitor vendor manpower and performance.
* Ensure contractual scope is being delivered.
* Verify attendance and deployment.
* Monitor consumable usage.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews.
* Coordinate with vendors for manpower replacement.
* Verify invoices against actual services delivered.
* Ensure statutory documents and licences are available where applicable.
* Escalate poor vendor performance to the Property Manager.
* Consumables \& Inventory Management


 The Soft Services Manager shall control the consumption of housekeeping materials.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Cleaning chemicals
* Garbage bags
* Tissue paper
* Handwash
* Mops
* Brushes
* Brooms
* Gloves
* PPE
* Cleaning equipment
* Other consumables.


 The manager shall:
   

  

* Maintain minimum and maximum stock levels.
* Monitor monthly consumption.
* Prevent unnecessary wastage.
* Maintain stock registers.
* Conduct periodic physical verification.
* Raise purchase requisitions in advance.
* Ensure materials are stored safely.
* Analyse consumption against occupancy and manpower.
* Health, Safety \& Environment


 The Soft Services Manager shall ensure that soft\-service activities are carried out safely.
   

  

 Key responsibilities:
   

  

* Ensure appropriate PPE is used.
* Ensure proper chemical handling and storage.
* Maintain Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS/SDS) for applicable chemicals.
* Ensure housekeeping machines are operated only by trained personnel.
* Report unsafe conditions immediately.
* Participate in safety inspections.
* Participate in fire and emergency drills.
* Ensure emergency exits and staircases are not obstructed.
* Ensure housekeeping activities do not create slip, trip or fall hazards.
* Support the Property Manager in EHS audits and corrective actions.
* Common\-Area Presentation


 For a premium residential building, the Soft Services Manager should take particular ownership of the
 **visual appearance and first impression of the property** 
 .
   

  

 Daily monitoring should include:
   

  

* Lobby presentation
* Lift lobby cleanliness
* Glass and mirror cleaning
* Furniture cleanliness
* Odour control
* Floor condition
* Wall and ceiling cleanliness
* Common toilet condition
* Parking cleanliness
* Signage
* Waste bins
* Landscaping
* Overall housekeeping standards.


 The manager should conduct
 **daily morning and evening inspections** 
 of critical areas.
   

  

* Event \& Special Activity Support


 The Soft Services Manager shall provide housekeeping support for:
   

  

* Society meetings
* AGM
* Festivals
* Resident events
* Clubhouse events
* VIP visits
* Fire drills
* Community activities
* Special functions.


 He/she shall ensure additional manpower, cleaning materials, waste bins and post\-event cleaning as required.
   

  

* Training \& Development


 The Soft Services Manager shall conduct regular training for housekeeping and support staff on:
   

  

* Cleaning techniques
* Chemical handling
* Machine operation
* Grooming
* Customer service
* Resident interaction
* Waste segregation
* Emergency response
* Fire safety
* First aid awareness
* PPE
* Workplace safety.


 Training attendance and records shall be maintained.
   

  

* Documentation \& MIS


 The Soft Services Manager shall maintain and submit appropriate reports, including:
   

  

 Daily
   

  

* Manpower deployment
* Attendance
* Cleaning inspection
* Critical observations
* Complaints
* Consumable requirements
* Pest\-control observations
* Incident/accident reports.


 Weekly
   

  

* Housekeeping performance
* Deep\-cleaning status
* Complaint analysis
* Manpower shortage
* Vendor performance
* Inventory status.


 Monthly
   

  

* Soft\-service MIS
* Manpower report
* Consumption report
* Vendor performance report
* Pest\-control report
* Waste\-management report
* Complaint analysis
* Training report
* Audit findings
* Corrective\-action status.
* Budget \& Cost Control


 The Soft Services Manager shall assist the Property Manager in controlling soft\-service expenditure.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Monitor consumable consumption.
* Prevent unnecessary wastage.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction.
* Compare actual consumption with budget.
* Monitor vendor billing.
* Verify additional manpower claims.
* Recommend alternative products/vendors where appropriate.
* Ensure cost\-saving measures do not compromise service quality.
* Coordination with Other Departments


 The Soft Services Manager shall closely coordinate with:
   

  

* Property Manager
* Engineering/Technical Team
* Security Team
* Helpdesk
* Resident Relations/CRE
* Finance Team
* Procurement Team
* EHS/Safety Team
* Vendors and contractors.


 Particular coordination is required during:
   

  

* Power failures
* Water shortages
* Fire emergencies
* Major leakage
* Pest infestation
* Events
* Resident complaints
* Maintenance activities
* Renovation/fit\-out activities.

title: Associate Project Manager, DMS East
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
We’re looking for an execution\-focused Associate Project Manager to manage creative and marketing projects across videos, animations, infographics, and design for scientific and academic clients. You’ll own projects from brief to delivery—translating requirements into actionable plans, coordinating creative teams and vendors, managing timelines and review cycles, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to quality expectations.
Job responsibilities:
* Own end\-to\-end project execution—translate client briefs into clear scope, deliverables, timelines, milestones, and review cycles.
* Plan and track projects through the CRM, maintaining accurate timelines, resource allocation, budgets, status, and project documentation.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams—assign and manage work across designers, animators, writers, freelancers, and vendors in collaboration with team leads.
* Drive client and stakeholder communication, acting as the central point of contact and ensuring requirements, feedback, and expectations are aligned.
* Manage project delivery and dependencies, proactively identifying bottlenecks, risks, delays, scope creep, and resource constraints and driving timely resolution.
* Manage review and revision cycles, ensuring feedback is consolidated, actioned, and delivered within agreed timelines.
* Track project commercials, including pricing, quotes, budgets, margins, and variances, with a focus on protecting project profitability.
* Run project check\-ins and maintain documentation, ensuring clear action items, ownership, and follow\-through.
* Capture project learnings and process improvements to strengthen execution and delivery efficiency.


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
* 1–2 years of experience in project coordination, project management, creative/agency operations, or client servicing.
* Strong project ownership, execution, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with strong stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, project trackers, CRMs, and project management tools such as Trello, Monday.com, or similar.
* Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to tracking and closing action items before they impact delivery.
* Exposure to video/design production, creative agencies, or Agile ways of working is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with the ability to make decisions and resolve execution challenges effectively.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, there will be a screening call followed by 2 technical round of interview and an HRBP culture fit round.

 **Equal Opportunity**

  

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 **Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


About Us:

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

Identifies and assigns appropriate resources to accomplish various project tasks; guides and coaches team members through various stages of the project; provides developmental feedback to team members.

Financial acumen \- Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.



Business insight \- Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.



Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.



Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.



Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.



Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.



Plans and aligns \- Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.



Project Issue and Risk Management \- Manages the process to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks using recommended tools and disciplines. Drives actions to minimize, monitor and control risks and issues and to maximize the most positive outcomes possible.

Project Schedule Management \- Manages the planned schedule using the recommended schedule management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.

Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

College, university, or equivalent degree required.



This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Intermediate level of experience required. 3\-5 years of relevant work experience preferred.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Anchanto \| Job Description**
**PBU Delivery \& Agile Operations Manager – OMS**
 Location: Pune, India \| Reports to: Product Business Unit Head \| Experience: 6\+ Years \| Type: Full time, Work from Office
   

  

**About The Role**
 Anchanto is a global enterprise\-grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, inventory, marketplaces, fulfilment, parcel tracking, and omnichannel commerce.
   

  

 As Anchanto evolves toward integrated Product Business Units (PBUs), we need a leader who can run the delivery operating system of a business unit. This role combines multi\-pod Scrum leadership, program delivery, resource and capacity planning, financial visibility, operational governance, and PBU administration.
   

  

 This is not a ceremony\-only Scrum Master role. The person is expected to independently create structure, maintain a single view of all commitments, challenge unrealistic plans, hold senior stakeholders accountable, and ensure work gets delivered with speed, predictability, and quality. The role requires a strong presence with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Customer Delivery, Support, and the PBU Head.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 The PBU model brings Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Implementation, and Support closer together around a single product outcome. To make this model work, the PBU needs one owner for delivery rhythm, portfolio visibility, resource loading, risk management, operational discipline, and leadership reporting. This role exists to ensure that the PBU does not depend on fragmented trackers, informal follow\-ups, or late escalations.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 The role owns nine areas. The expectation across all of them is the same: strong ownership, data over opinion, early visibility of risk, clear accountability, and reliable execution.
   

  

* Multi\-pod Scrum and Agile delivery management
* Manage approximately 6 to 10 active Scrum teams or delivery pods in parallel, with the ability to scale the operating cadence as the PBU grows.
* Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily Scrum, reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums without creating unnecessary ceremony.
* Ensure every pod has a clear sprint goal, ready backlog, acceptance criteria, realistic capacity plan, visible dependencies, and agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.
* Monitor and improve commitment reliability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, scope churn, spillover, defect leakage, escaped defects, and release predictability.
* Improve velocity and flow sustainably without compromising quality or using story points as an individual productivity measure.
* Coach teams toward self\-organisation while holding teams and leaders accountable for agreed process and delivery standards.
* Identify recurring blockers, late requirements, delayed QA, weak Jira hygiene, and process failures, and drive root\-cause corrective action.
* Integrated delivery and portfolio planning
* Maintain one consolidated delivery plan across product roadmap, customer projects and customisations, technical debt, innovation, compliance, production incidents, and L3 support.
* Translate PBU priorities into executable milestones, pod plans, owners, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Maintain visibility of planned versus actual progress, delivery confidence, critical path, scope changes, customer commitments, and roadmap displacement.
* Ensure customer\-specific work does not silently displace roadmap commitments without an explicit business decision.
* Classify work as reusable product capability, hybrid product/customer work, or customer\-specific customisation to support the right product and commercial decision.
* Support quarterly planning, monthly operating reviews, and major reprioritisation decisions with clear options and impacts.
* Maintain decision logs for material scope, priority, resource, budget, and date changes.
* Resource loading and capacity management
* Maintain a current capacity and allocation view across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Design, Implementation, and Support.
* Identify overload, underutilisation, shared\-resource conflicts, skill bottlenecks, and single points of failure before they affect delivery.
* Recommend pod composition based on work requirements, available skills, and delivery risk.
* Present practical trade\-off options when capacity is insufficient, including scope reduction, phased delivery, resequencing, date revision, temporary reallocation, hiring, or contracting.
* Prevent teams from accepting commitments without validated scope, dependencies, and confirmed capacity.
* Track planned versus actual utilisation and explain material variance.
* Delivery accountability and stakeholder leadership
* Act as the operating owner for PBU delivery and ensure commitments are converted into clear plans, owners, dates, and closure.
* Hold Product Managers, Engineering Managers, QA Leads, Architects, and other stakeholders accountable for agreed actions and standards.
* Conduct difficult delivery conversations when scope, dates, quality, resource availability, or process discipline are at risk.
* Challenge unrealistic commitments, incomplete requirements, unsupported dates, and unapproved customer promises with facts and alternatives.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Engineering Heads, the PBU Head, or leadership with impact, options, recommendation, and decision required.
* Maintain a visible and credible presence across the PBU; this role must not operate as a passive coordinator or status chaser.
* Financial and commercial governance
* Work with Finance and PBU leadership to track planned versus actual effort, budget consumption, forecast to complete, vendor or contractor cost, rework, and support cost.
* Maintain operational cost visibility for major roadmap initiatives and customer projects.
* Support customer\-project margin and cost\-to\-value discussions by providing reliable delivery, effort, and forecast data.
* Identify material variance early and recommend corrective action.
* Ensure scope changes are reflected in effort, schedule, resource, and commercial discussions.
* Distinguish clearly between effort, cost, budget, billing, revenue, and margin. Formal accounting remains with Finance; this role owns the reliability of delivery inputs.
* Quality, release, and production governance
* Create and maintain PBU\-level release\-readiness criteria covering functional completion, regression, integration, security, performance, open defects, rollback, monitoring, and support readiness.
* Facilitate go/no\-go discussions and provide a clear delivery recommendation based on risk and evidence.
* Track defect leakage, production incidents, rework, release failures, and recurring root causes.
* Ensure RCAs have clear owners, corrective actions, due dates, and verified closure.
* Include L3 support and production incidents in capacity plans so support demand is visible rather than treated as an unplanned interruption.
* Ensure delivery speed does not compromise quality, security, customer experience, or compliance.
* PBU administration and team operations
* Coordinate smooth onboarding for new PBU members, including access, tools, product orientation, process induction, stakeholder introductions, role clarity, and required training.
* Coordinate employee exits with HR, IT, Security, Finance, and functional managers, including access revocation, knowledge transfer, work reassignment, asset return, and documentation handover.
* Maintain the PBU roster, role map, allocation view, onboarding status, and critical knowledge coverage.
* Identify skill gaps and coordinate training, coaching, hiring, or external support.
* Ensure critical knowledge and delivery responsibility are not concentrated with one individual.
* Compliance and operational controls
* Track PBU obligations related to ISO, GDPR, information security, data retention, customer audits, internal controls, and market or regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with Security, Legal, Compliance, Product, and Engineering owners to ensure actions and evidence are completed on time.
* Maintain compliance actions, evidence, owners, and due dates, and escalate overdue or high\-risk items.
* Ensure compliance work is included in delivery plans and resource allocations rather than managed outside the operating plan.
* Support audit preparation and closure of observations for the PBU.
* Leadership reporting, systems, and continuous improvement
* Create a concise weekly PBU operating report covering delivery health, milestones, confidence, capacity, roadmap versus customer work, quality, production health, cost or effort variance, risks, recovery actions, and decisions required.
* Run weekly delivery reviews, cross\-pod dependency reviews, release\-readiness reviews, monthly leadership reviews, and quarterly planning retrospectives.
* Ensure Jira, Confluence, portfolio views, RAID logs, decision logs, and dashboards operate as trusted systems of record.
* Automate reporting, Jira hygiene, risk detection, meeting summaries, dependency tracking, and readiness checks wherever practical.
* Use AI and automation responsibly to improve delivery speed, data accuracy, and management visibility.
* Measure whether process changes improve predictability, quality, flow, and team effectiveness; remove governance that does not create value.


**Cross\-Functional Operating Model**
 Partner
   

  

 Primary partnership area
   

  

 PBU Head
   

  

 PBU priorities, investment choices, portfolio trade\-offs, budget, and final escalation decisions
   

  

 Product Management
   

  

 Roadmap, problem definition, business value, requirements readiness, and product\-versus\-custom decisions
   

  

 Engineering Managers / Engineering Head
   

  

 Technical execution, engineering capacity, architecture, quality practices, skill development, and people leadership
   

  

 QA, DevOps, Security, and Architecture
   

  

 Release readiness, test coverage, environments, production health, security, compliance, and technical dependencies
   

  

 Customer Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success
   

  

 Customer commitments, implementation milestones, scope changes, commercial assumptions, and escalation
   

  

 Finance
   

  

 Budget, cost rates, forecast, project financials, margin visibility, and reconciliation
   

  

 HR, IT, and Administration
   

  

 Onboarding, exits, access, assets, employee operations, and workforce records
   

  

**What Good Looks Like After 12 To 18 Months**
* The PBU has one trusted, current view of all roadmap, customer, technical, compliance, and support commitments.
* Six to ten parallel pods operate with predictable delivery rhythm, clear dependencies, and strong quality discipline.
* Leadership receives concise, decision\-ready visibility rather than manual status collection.
* Capacity conflicts, skill gaps, and delivery risks are identified early and resolved through explicit trade\-offs.
* Customer commitments do not silently displace roadmap work.
* Quality, security, release readiness, and production health are integrated into delivery planning.
* Budget, effort, and cost variance are visible and used in priority and investment decisions.
* Onboarding, exits, access, compliance, and audit actions are completed reliably and on time.
* The PBU operates proactively and independently, with fewer escalations caused by unclear ownership or missing information.
* The delivery operating model improves continuously through automation, AI, and measurable process improvement.


**Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years across software delivery, program management, project management, Agile delivery, product operations, or engineering operations.
* At least 5 years managing Agile software delivery teams, including demonstrated responsibility for multiple teams or workstreams in parallel.
* Experience managing at least 4 teams directly; experience with 6 or more parallel squads or pods is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in integrated delivery planning, resource loading, capacity management, risk and dependency management, and release governance.
* Experience challenging senior stakeholders and influencing Product, Engineering, QA, and customer\-facing teams without direct reporting authority.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, planned\-versus\-actual effort, forecast variance, vendor cost, and project financial health.
* Strong Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and executive reporting capability.
* Good understanding of software development, APIs, environments, CI/CD, testing, production support, and release management.
* Ability to create structure where information, ownership, and processes are fragmented.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to Engineering Heads, PBU Heads, and senior leadership.


**Preferred Experience**
* Enterprise SaaS, B2B software, e\-commerce, supply chain, OMS, WMS, logistics, or fulfilment domain exposure.
* Experience with OMS, order orchestration, e\-commerce, marketplace integrations, order lifecycle management, or omnichannel fulfilment is preferred.
* Experience with customer implementations, product customisation, and roadmap\-versus\-customer trade\-offs.
* Experience managing 30 or more people across virtual or cross\-functional pods.
* Experience with L3 support, production incidents, RCAs, and operational service levels.
* Exposure to ISO, GDPR, SOC 2, information security, or customer audit controls.
* Experience using Power BI, Jira Plans, Advanced Roadmaps, Aha!, or other portfolio\-management tools.
* Experience with AI\-enabled delivery, workflow automation, or reporting automation.
* CSM, PSM, SAFe, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification.


**Leadership Behaviours We Expect**
 Managers at Anchanto are expected to operate with high ownership, solve problems rather than escalate confusion, use systems and data over opinions, communicate clearly and directly, challenge constructively, build trust through reliability, improve processes continuously, collaborate without bureaucracy, and act with urgency and accountability.
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
* A ceremony\-only Scrum Master role.
* A Jira administrator or meeting coordinator.
* A passive follow\-up or status\-chasing role.
* A PMO reporting role that presents problems without recommendations.
* A substitute Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Finance partner, or Compliance specialist.
* A role that accepts every stakeholder commitment without validating scope, capacity, quality, and commercial impact.


**Success Measures**
 Indicative KPI
   

  

 What it measures
   

  

 Multi\-pod delivery predictability
   

  

 Commitment reliability, milestone adherence, and delivery confidence across parallel pods
   

  

 Delivery flow
   

  

 Cycle time, lead time, throughput, ageing work, and spillover trends
   

  

 Quality and release health
   

  

 Defect leakage, escaped defects, release failures, production incidents, and RCA closure
   

  

 Capacity effectiveness
   

  

 Resource conflicts, overload, underutilisation, single points of failure, and planned\-versus\-actual allocation
   

  

 Portfolio visibility
   

  

 Accuracy and completeness of the integrated PBU plan and decision log
   

  

 Customer commitment governance
   

  

 Customer work accepted with validated feasibility and no hidden roadmap displacement
   

  

 Financial visibility
   

  

 Planned\-versus\-actual effort, cost variance, forecast accuracy, and project financial inputs
   

  

 Risk and dependency management
   

  

 Critical risks identified early, owned, and closed within agreed timelines
   

  

 PBU administration
   

  

 Onboarding, access, exit, knowledge transfer, and roster accuracy against SLA
   

  

 Compliance readiness
   

  

 ISO, GDPR, security, audit, and regulatory actions closed on time with evidence
   

  

 Leadership reporting
   

  

 Accuracy, timeliness, clarity, and decision usefulness of weekly and monthly PBU reports
   

  

 Automation and improvement
   

  

 Reduction in manual reporting and measurable improvement from AI or workflow automation
   

  

**Closing**
 At Anchanto, faster delivery must come with stronger ownership, better quality, and clearer business visibility. This role builds and runs the operating system that enables a Product Business Unit to deliver as one accountable team. If you are comfortable managing multiple delivery pods, making difficult trade\-offs, challenging senior stakeholders, and creating structure in a fast\-moving environment, this is an opportunity to shape how Anchanto scales its product delivery model.

 We are looking for a
 **Project \& Account Coordinator** 
 who can manage multiple ongoing projects and act as the coordination point between clients and our internal production teams.
 



 The role is primarily focused on
 **project execution, client coordination, timely delivery, and managing repeat business from existing accounts** 
 .
 



 Most accounts handled under this role will have an established working relationship, predefined commercials, or an approved rate card. Therefore, this is
 **not a core sales role** 
 involving extensive lead generation, commercial negotiation, or complex proposal development.
 



 The ideal candidate should be highly organised, proactive with follow\-ups, comfortable communicating with clients, and capable of managing several projects simultaneously.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesProject Coordination
 * Coordinate multiple ongoing projects from initiation to final delivery.
* Understand the approved project scope, deliverables, timelines, and client expectations.
* Collect required inputs from clients such as CAD files, layouts, photographs, scripts, SOPs, branding material, references, and technical information.
* Ensure all required inputs are available before production begins.
* Coordinate internally with 3D artists, animators, VFX artists, editors, graphics teams, developers, and other production resources.
* Maintain project schedules and track milestones, review dates, feedback cycles, and delivery commitments.
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure activities are progressing as planned.
* Highlight delays, dependencies, or risks to the Project Manager / Operations Head in advance.
* Ensure projects are completed and delivered within committed timelines.


 Client Coordination \& Account Management
 * Act as the regular point of contact for assigned clients.
* Provide clients with periodic updates regarding project status and upcoming milestones.
* Coordinate client meetings, project reviews, approvals, and feedback discussions.
* Document and communicate client feedback clearly to internal production teams.
* Follow up with clients for pending feedback, approvals, or technical inputs.
* Maintain professional and long\-term relationships with existing clients.
* Understand recurring requirements from assigned accounts and ensure smooth execution.
* Maintain continuity and familiarity with each client's working style, expectations, and project history.


 Repeat Business Coordination
 * Handle standard repeat requirements from existing customers.
* Understand requirements sufficiently to initiate projects where scope and commercials are already predefined.
* Coordinate quotations based on approved rate cards or established commercial structures.
* Identify potential additional requirements from existing accounts and communicate them internally.
* Escalate opportunities requiring detailed technical evaluation, new scope development, proposal preparation, or commercial negotiation to the Business Development / Business Head team.
* Support smooth conversion of recurring client requirements into active projects.


 Project Documentation \& Tracking
 * Maintain accurate records of project scope, client inputs, approvals, revisions, and deliverables.
* Update project management systems, CRM, trackers, and project status reports regularly.
* Maintain clear documentation of client communication and important project decisions.
* Track pending activities from both the client and internal production teams.
* Ensure final files, approvals, and closure documentation are properly maintained.


 Key Performance Indicators – KPIs
 
 Performance will primarily be measured based on:
 


* Percentage of projects delivered within committed timelines.
* Number of projects successfully coordinated simultaneously.
* Timely collection of client inputs and approvals.
* Accuracy and completeness of client\-to\-production communication.
* Reduction in project delays caused by coordination gaps.
* Client satisfaction and responsiveness.
* Repeat business and continuity from assigned accounts.
* Timely follow\-up on feedback, approvals, and pending actions.
* Accuracy and regularity of CRM/project tracker updates.
* Proper project documentation and closure.
* Ability to proactively identify risks and escalate issues before they affect delivery.


 Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Mass Communication, Engineering, or a related field.
* **1–3 years of professional experience** 
 in project coordination, client servicing, account coordination, production coordination, or a similar role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office / Google Workspace.
* Comfortable working with CRM, project management tools, spreadsheets, and task trackers.
* Ability to understand basic technical and creative project requirements.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and clients simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up and organisational skills.


 Preferred Experience
 
 Candidates with previous experience in any of the following will have an advantage:
 


* Animation or visualization studios.
* Advertising / creative agencies.
* Video production companies.
* Digital marketing agencies.
* Engineering service companies.
* Industrial or manufacturing companies.
* Architecture / visualization firms.
* Software or interactive media companies.



 Technical expertise in 3D animation is
 **not mandatory** 
 , but the candidate should be comfortable learning terminology related to animation, visualization, video production, AR/VR, and industrial processes.
 


 Skills \& Competencies
 * Strong project coordination skills.
* Client communication and relationship management.
* Excellent follow\-up discipline.
* Time management and prioritisation.
* Ability to work with multiple internal teams.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to document requirements accurately.
* Problem\-solving attitude.
* Ability to identify project risks and escalate them at the right time.
* Professional email and verbal communication.
* Ability to work in a deadline\-driven environment.


 Reporting Structure
 
**Reports To:** 
 Operations Head / Business Head
 



 The Project \& Account Coordinator will work closely with:
 


* Project Managers
* Creative Head
* 3D / Animation Teams
* VFX \& Editing Teams
* Graphics Team
* Interactive / AR\-VR Development Teams
* Sales / Business Development Team



 The coordinator will primarily manage communication and execution for assigned client accounts, while production planning, technical estimation, resource allocation, and major commercial decisions will remain with the respective senior team members.
 


 Role Boundaries
 
 This role is primarily focused on
 **project execution and account coordination** 
 .
 



 The candidate will generally
 **not be responsible for:** 



* Cold calling or lead generation.
* New business acquisition targets.
* Complex project costing or technical estimation.
* Detailed proposal preparation for new or complex requirements.
* Major commercial negotiations.
* Independent manpower or resource allocation decisions.
* Such activities will be handled by the Business Development, Operations, or senior management teams.

title: Case Escalation Manager
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 The position is a strategic, high\-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation management for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Cohesity business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers. These issues typically have executive transparency and involve issues that span product, service, support and other business functions within Cohesity.
   

  

 The role requires both cross\-functional as well as external coordination with customers and partners, Sustaining and Development Engineers, Product Management, Site Reliability Engineers, and Account Teams in unison to resolve complex challenges. In this role, you will lead and manage the programmatic resolution of customers' critical issues by building and owning an interdepartmental, cross\-functional, and geographically\-located virtual team.

* Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
* Maintain and expand a solid understanding of current Cohesity products and their business applications
* Participate in weekly escalation review meetings between Sales, Customer Support, Product Management, and Engineering
* The escalation manager is an individual contributor role that reports to the program director and works seamlessly with Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support, Professional Services and customer\-facing teams to address and prevent critical issues


**WE'D LOVE TO TALK IF YOU HAVE ANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
* Capacity to work in a challenging environment with international clients
* Written and verbal communication skills; including the ability to clearly articulate technical issues to executive audiences as well technical and also explain the impact in business terms
* Strong analytical and end to end problem\-solving skills
* Solid Technical Knowledge, ability to articulate technical concepts clearly, good understanding of Data Center, Storage, Networking, Virtualization technologies.
* Capability to multitask and prioritize with a strong sense of getting to closure on behalf of the customer
* Be comfortable in a fast\-paced, demanding environment with global customers
* Have an excellent customer\-first demeanor and willingness to go beyond expectations to ensure customer success
* Demonstrated proficiencies to lead and motivate others through forming and executing resolution plans for complex issues

title: Engineering Manager - Virtual Appliance Platform
description:
**About SailPoint**




 SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility across their digital workforce and helping ensure that workers have the right access to do their jobs—no more, no less.
   





 Built on a foundation of AI and machine learning, SailPoint Identity Security delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time, matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud\-oriented modern enterprise.
   





**About the Role**




 As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and grow the software engineering team responsible for a critical virtual appliance that customers deploy within their private environments. The appliance provides a secure, reliable connection between customer\-managed systems and SailPoint Identity Security. You will own engineering execution, collaborate with Product Management on the roadmap, and help the team deliver meaningful customer outcomes with greater speed and predictability.
   





 In a typical day, you may coach an engineer, review an architectural proposal, refine sprint priorities, coordinate a release or incident follow\-up with a peer team, and communicate roadmap progress and risks. You will not be expected to write code routinely, but you will be technically engaged: able to read code, understand the systems your team owns, ask insightful questions, and guide sound decisions involving Linux, virtualization, containerization, and customer\-deployed software.
 



 You will continue developing the team’s Scrum practices around a predictable two\-week sprint cadence while preserving the flexibility to respond to urgent customer and operational needs. You will also champion responsible use of modern AI and LLM capabilities to improve engineering effectiveness, quality, decision\-making, and business outcomes.
   





 This role is based in India. Candidates may work remotely, in a hybrid arrangement, or from SailPoint’s Pune office. Substantial daily overlap with U.S. working hours is required. Periodic team gatherings in the United States provide optional opportunities for in\-person collaboration and travel.
 



**About the Team** 




  

 This distributed software engineering team owns the complete lifecycle of SailPoint’s customer\-deployed virtual appliance—from architecture and development through distribution, installation, upgrades, patching, compatibility, vulnerability remediation, diagnostics, reliability, and incident response. Engineers participate in an on\-call rotation for customer\-impacting issues.
 



 The team works closely with Product Management and with experts across security, vulnerability management, architecture, release engineering, support, and other engineering organizations. It is strengthening the platform’s foundations while pursuing an ambitious roadmap designed to make the appliance easier for customers to deploy, operate, and rely on.
   





**Roadmap for Success** 




  

 The following milestones describe how success in this role will be measured. Specific delivery and reliability targets will be established using current platform and team baselines.
 



**30 days** 



* Build trusted working relationships with every team member and key partners across Product Management, architecture, security, vulnerability management, release engineering, and support.
* Develop a working understanding of the platform architecture, codebase, roadmap, release lifecycle, customer experience, operational history, and major technical risks.
* Assess the team’s current delivery practices, staffing needs, and near\-term priorities, then share a focused 90\-day action plan with stakeholders.



**90 days** 



* Take full ownership of engineering execution, team development, delivery reporting, dependency management, and risk communication.
* Establish a consistent two\-week Scrum cadence with clear backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and visible progress against commitments.
* Agree with Product Management and technical partners on a prioritized stabilization plan, roadmap sequencing, and baseline measures for delivery predictability and platform reliability.
* Define and begin executing a hiring and team\-development plan aligned with the roadmap.



**6 months** 



* Demonstrate measurable improvement against the delivery and reliability baselines established during the first 90 days.
* Deliver the highest\-priority platform stabilization work while maintaining visible progress on customer\-focused roadmap commitments.
* Strengthen production ownership through effective incident response, learning reviews, vulnerability remediation, and follow\-through on reliability improvements.
* Introduce practical, responsible AI\-assisted workflows that produce demonstrable improvements in engineering quality, decision\-making, or delivery efficiency.
* Make measurable progress against the agreed hiring plan and ensure every engineer has clear expectations, feedback, and development goals.



**1 year** 



* Meet the platform stability, supportability, and delivery targets agreed with engineering and product stakeholders.
* Operate a mature, predictable Scrum model that consistently balances roadmap delivery with customer and operational priorities.
* Deliver meaningful roadmap milestones that improve how customers deploy, upgrade, operate, and rely on the virtual appliance.
* Establish and begin executing a multi\-quarter technical strategy for the platform’s continued modernization and architectural evolution.
* Build a stronger, appropriately staffed team with clear ownership, healthy collaboration, and demonstrated growth in both people and technical capability.



**Requirements** 



* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5\+ years managing and developing software engineers.
* Proven experience leading teams that build customer\-installed applications, virtual appliances, connectors, gateways, or comparable software deployed in customer\-managed environments.
* Experience building software that securely connects customer environments with cloud\-based SaaS services.
* Strong technical understanding of Linux, virtualization, and containerization, with the ability to read and understand code and contribute meaningfully to architecture and design discussions.
* Experience managing the lifecycle of customer\-deployed software, including distribution, upgrades, patching, compatibility, diagnostics, vulnerability remediation, and incident response.
* Demonstrated success implementing and refining Agile/Scrum practices to create predictable delivery while responding effectively to urgent needs.
* Experience hiring, mentoring, managing performance, and supporting the career development of engineers.
* Excellent planning, reporting, communication, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Experience leading distributed teams and collaborating effectively across time zones.
* Hands\-on fluency with modern AI and LLM tools, including experience using reusable skills and agents to achieve engineering and business outcomes and sound judgment about when an agent, skill, or conversational assistant is the right approach.
* A strong product, customer, security, and reliability mindset.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.



**The Tech Stack** 



* Go and systems\-oriented software development
* Linux\-based virtual appliances and multiple Linux distributions
* Virtualization and container technologies
* Modern AI and LLM tools, reusable skills, and agentic workflows

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Team Lead Electrical
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Team Lead – Electrical**
**Pune, India \| Hybrid \| Shift: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST**
**About Rockwell Automation**
 Rockwell Automation is the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation. We connect the imaginations of people with the potential of technology to expand what is humanly possible, making the world more productive and more sustainable. Our Global Engineering \& Business Services (GEBS) group in India partners with Rockwell Automation offices worldwide to deliver world\-class engineering.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Team Lead – Electrical** 
 you will be responsible to lead a team of designers and Sr. designers engaged in the engineering/development/maintenance of CAD based libraries of electrical products, developing the reusable circuits/layouts and creating productivity utilities leveraging AutoCAD\-Electrical and Eplan. This role reports to the Engineering Manager and is part of Global Engineering \& Business Services group in India, catering to regional Rockwell Automation offices across the globe. It's a hybrid work environment working in 12:00pm to 9:00 pm shift located in Pune/Noida \- India.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor and develop a team of Design Engineers – allocating and prioritizing work, managing workload and ensuring on\-time delivery, high quality engineering and customer satisfaction
* Manage day\-to\-day execution of CTO/ETO development within defined timelines, ensuring high quality engineering while leveraging standard and reusable engineering practices
* Serve as the technical escalation point and subject\-matter expert for CAD based tools and electrical switchgears/VFDs, providing robust technical solutions, addressing queries and resolving technical deficiencies
* Work closely with internal and external customers, and collaborate with global stakeholders across regions and time zones, to review requirements and deliver customized technical solutions that comply with electrical standards and Rockwell Automation's engineering practices
* Coordinate overall system integration activities, maintaining accurate documentation and fostering effective collaboration across teams and functions
* Drive capability development, continuous improvement and knowledge\-sharing within the team – coaching engineers, building technical depth and supporting other initiatives
* Monitor team performance, quality metrics, resource utilization and project KPIs, reporting progress and risks to the Engineering Manager
* Ensure strict adherence to international engineering standards (NEC, UL, CSA, IEC) by consistently applying them throughout order execution activities


**The Essentials – You Will Have**
* Bachelor's in Electrical / Electronics
* Relevant Experience of more than 8\-10 years in Hardware Designing, Switchgear, Electrical knowledge and Automation Engineering
* Minimum 3 years of experience in leading and managing an engineering team
* Exposure of working in a global setup – collaborating with global stakeholders, customers and cross\-functional teams across regions and time zones
* Strong domain expertise in Low Voltage Drives, PLC \& MCC System Designing
* Expertise of AutoCAD\-Electrical and Eplan software
* Thorough knowledge of DOL \& S/D Starters, VFDs, Soft\-Starters, Intelligent Motor Control, Safety Product's System Designing
* Knowledge of Electrical Components Selection, Busbar Calculation, Heat and Load Calculation
* In depth knowledge of International Standards used for Design and Manufacturing


**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**
* Field Installation \& Commissioning experience on VFDs, LV Switchgear, PCC's, MCC's, PLC's \& Instruments is preferrable
* Gone through complete project life cycle from design phase to commissioning
* Proven people\-leadership skills – team building, mentoring, performance management and workload planning
* Good Command on SAP Documentation and Part Management
* Industry and application Knowledge, training skills, and familiar with Lean Six Sigma and EHS (Environment, Health \& Safety) Principles.
* Experience with Creo software
* Experience on Panel Testing, I/O Testing and FAT
* Experience of managing or coordinating deliverables across a global / distributed engineering team is preferrable


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program

title: Product Lifecycle Management Consultant
description:
**PLM Services Professionals** 




  





 Softcell is looking for professionals across different experience levels and roles within its PLM Services team. The team is responsible for consulting, solution design, implementation, integration, migration, training and support for Product Lifecycle Management solutions, primarily based on the PTC Windchill suite.
 



  





 Selected candidates may work on assignments ranging from installations and upgrades to enterprise\-wide PLM implementations, business\-process transformation, data migration and integration with CAD, ERP, MRP and other enterprise systems. Depending on their experience and expertise, candidates may contribute as consultants, developers, solution architects, project leads or support professionals.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 Depending on the role and level of experience, responsibilities may include:
 


* Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business and technical requirements.
* Participate in discovery, blueprinting and process\-mapping workshops.
* Define functional and technical requirements for PDM, PLM, change management, migration and integration projects.
* Design, configure, customise, implement and support PLM solutions.
* Develop technical specifications for customisations, workflows, reports and integrations.
* Support installations, upgrades, system administration and performance optimisation.
* Plan and execute data migration and validation activities.
* Integrate PLM platforms with CAD, ERP, MRP and other enterprise applications.
* Contribute to solution proposals, project plans, effort estimates and statements of work.
* Work with project managers to monitor deliverables, timelines, dependencies and scope.
* Identify project risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Support user acceptance testing, deployment, documentation and end\-user training.
* Troubleshoot functional and technical issues and provide timely resolutions.
* Apply relevant implementation methodologies, quality standards and industry best practices.
* Collaborate with and mentor other members of the consulting and delivery teams.
* Support pre\-sales activities, demonstrations, solution workshops and proof\-of\-concept engagements, where required.
* Build strong customer relationships and contribute to successful project outcomes.



  





**Requirements** 




 Requirements will vary according to the role and level of seniority:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
* Relevant experience in PLM consulting, implementation, development, administration, integration, migration or support.
* Experience with PTC Windchill is preferred; exposure to other enterprise PLM or PDM platforms may also be considered.
* Understanding of one or more areas such as product data management, bill of materials, document management, change management, configuration management, workflows or manufacturing processes.
* Familiarity with CAD applications and integration between CAD, PLM and enterprise systems.
* Technical experience in Windchill configuration, customisation, upgrades, integrations or data migration will be advantageous for relevant roles.
* Experience in the discrete manufacturing sector is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across customer, functional and technical teams.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations when required.
* Relevant PTC or PLM certifications will be an advantage.



  





 The specific designation, responsibilities and experience requirements will be aligned with the candidate’s capabilities and the needs of the PLM Services team.

* Quickly acquire new technical and software knowledge and able to share this with others efficiently
* Proactive, creative and critical thinking. Possess analytical capabilities, customer orientation and team working, presentation and interpersonal skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Passionate about producing high\-quality and engaging learning content
* At least 2 years of project management experience

**Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, And Experience**
* Computer science/Mechanical engineering/Manufacturing engineering or equivalent degree, and ideally have previous experience in both technical and sales/consulting environments

description:
