As a global leader in logistics services, Maersk operates in more than 130 countries and employs over 100,000 people worldwide. Through integrated logistics solutions, digital services, and a world\-class delivery network, we enable our customers to trade and grow by transporting goods anywhere in the world.
   

  

**We Offer**
 Working at Maersk provides the opportunity to be part of a company with a rich heritage while contributing to a fast\-paced, customer\-centric logistics organization. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
   

  

 As a Team Leader – Import Customs Manifest (ICM), you will lead a team responsible for ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant customs manifest submissions across multiple countries while driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**People Leadership \& Team Management**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of ICM specialists to achieve operational excellence.
* Drive daily huddles, workflow planning, shift management, and resource allocation.
* Monitor team productivity, quality, accuracy, utilization, and SLA adherence.
* Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, and development conversations.
* Ensure successful onboarding, competency development, and cross\-training of team members.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.


**Import Customs Manifest Operations**
* Lead the execution of import customs manifest filing activities, ensuring compliance with country\-specific customs regulations and service commitments.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission, amendment, and cancellation of import manifests within regulatory timelines.
* Monitor daily vessel schedules, customs filing deadlines, and operational risks to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.
* Manage exceptions, customs rejections, system issues, and escalations to minimize customer and business impact.
* Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and regulatory requirements.


**Performance \& KPI Management**
* Monitor and drive key operational metrics, including productivity, accuracy, turnaround time (TAT), quality, and compliance.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly dashboards to identify trends and performance gaps.
* Conduct root cause analysis for operational issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Present operational performance updates to Execution Managers and Area stakeholders.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary operational contact for Area teams, Customer Experience (CX), Customs authorities, Global Service Centres, Product teams, and other internal stakeholders.
* Proactively communicate operational risks, service disruptions, and mitigation plans.
* Participate in governance meetings, operational reviews, and customer\-impact discussions.
* Build strong relationships with regional and global stakeholders to support seamless customs operations.


**Process Excellence \& Governance**
* Ensure compliance with customs regulations, internal policies, and global process standards.
* Drive standardization, process health checks, governance reviews, and compliance audits.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and operational excellence projects.
* Support implementation of new customs regulations, digital solutions, and process enhancements.
* Promote Lean methodologies, Visual Management Systems (VMS), and Maersk Operating System (MOS) practices.


**Risk Management \& Continuous Improvement**
* Identify operational risks and ensure timely escalation and resolution.
* Lead contingency planning during system outages, volume surges, and regulatory changes.
* Drive automation and simplification initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Share best practices across teams and contribute to global process improvement initiatives.


**We Are Looking For**
* Graduate or Postgraduate with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Minimum 5–7 years of experience in shipping, logistics, customs operations, or import documentation, including experience in people leadership.
* Strong understanding of import customs manifest filing processes, customs regulations, vessel operations, and documentation.
* Proven experience in leading operational teams and driving performance improvements.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in process improvement, Lean, Kaizen, or automation initiatives is preferred.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced global environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement.


**Success Measures**
 The successful candidate will consistently:
   

  

* Deliver high levels of customs compliance and regulatory adherence.
* Achieve operational KPIs for productivity, quality, accuracy, and turnaround time.
* Lead a highly engaged and high\-performing team.
* Strengthen stakeholder relationships across global and regional functions.

title: Project Lead Engineer
description:
**Snapshot of your day**


In our Business Unit Industrial Applications, we offer comprehensive digital portfolio solutions in the oil and gas sector and other process industries comprising rotating equipment, electrification and solutions for Subsea business.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Manage complete technical scope for supply of new packaged rotating equipment for onshore and offshore projects including gas turbine\-generators, gas turbine\-compressors, electric motor\-driven compressor trains, and extended plant scope.
* Good understanding of Gear Box, Coupling and systems
* Support Project Manager to address technical concerns with internal and external clients. Lead global technical project teams of multi\-discipline engineers, designers and suppliers
* Manage Engineering schedule, including on time release of equipment specifications, bills of material, and customer documentation
* Lead all technical contract requirements on assigned projects to deliver on targets and objectives, including certifications and compliance to all applicable standards
* Provide engineering support during proposal, manufacturing, testing, installation, commissioning and operation
* Support team with detailed design decisions to meet contract requirements, such as overall system control philosophies and main equipment specification
* Conduct detailed review of contract requirements and specifications and translate these to the project team.

**What you Bring**

* Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering with experience in packaging or operation of rotating equipment
* Relevant minimum experience of 10 years is expected in the field of Rotating Equipment for Oil \& Gas, Petrochemical, and other Process Industry applications, achieved through combination of positions in Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, Proposals, and/or Procurement.
* Ability to travel up to 20% of the time
* Ability to direct a small team and give general direction to others
* Experience with Engineering/PLM software Teamcenter, NX, E3, COMOS, and/or Jira
* Excellent computer skills (Pivot Tables, VBA or other programming language)
* Experience with SAP
* Prior knowledge of Siemens applications, customers, processes, and products

**About the Team**


Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Project Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 Role Title
 



**IT Project Manager – Office of the CDIO** 




 Role Summary
 



 The IT Project Manager – Office of the CDIO will drive execution excellence across the IT and Digital function by establishing strong project governance, tracking strategic initiatives, monitoring KPIs, managing budgets, and ensuring timely delivery of business\-critical technology programs.
 



 This role serves as the Program Management Office (PMO) for the CDIO, working closely with business leaders, project teams, technology partners, and vendors to ensure strategic initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Project \& Program Management
 


* Drive end\-to\-end execution of the organization's strategic IT and Digital transformation projects.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and proactively resolve issues.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
* Conduct periodic project governance reviews and prepare status reports for leadership.



 2\. CIO Office Governance
 


* Establish and operate the CDIO Project Management Office (PMO).
* Create standardized project management methodologies, templates, dashboards, and governance processes.
* Facilitate steering committee meetings and maintain action trackers.
* Drive cross\-functional coordination between IT, business teams, and external partners.



 3\. KPI \& Performance Management
 


* Define KPIs for IT functions and strategic initiatives.
* Develop executive dashboards to track project health, delivery performance, budgets, vendor performance, and operational metrics.
* Monitor progress against annual IT objectives and highlight risks or deviations.
* Publish monthly and quarterly performance reports for leadership.



 4\. Budget \& Financial Management
 


* Track IT budgets across projects and operational initiatives.
* Monitor project expenditures, forecasts, and variances.
* Support annual budgeting and periodic financial reviews.
* Ensure optimal utilization of project investments.



 5\. Strategic \& Special Projects
 


* Support the CDIO in driving enterprise\-wide strategic initiatives.
* Lead special assignments involving business transformation, process improvement, organizational initiatives, or technology evaluations.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external consulting partners for strategic programs.



 6\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
 


* Collaborate with business leaders to ensure project alignment with organizational priorities.
* Coordinate with implementation partners and technology vendors.
* Track contractual deliverables, milestones, and escalations.



 7\. Reporting \& Executive Communication
 


* Prepare high\-quality presentations, dashboards, executive summaries, and board\-ready reports.
* Provide concise updates on project health, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
* Maintain accurate documentation of key decisions and governance forums.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* MBA is preferred.
* .



 Experience
 


* 5–8 years of experience in IT Project Management, PMO, Digital Transformation, or Technology Consulting.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent technology projects.
* Exposure to ERP, CRM, Data \& Analytics, Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, or Enterprise Applications is preferred.



 Required Skills
 


* Strong project and program management capabilities.
* Budget planning and financial tracking.
* Executive reporting and presentation development.
* Vendor coordination and governance.
* Expertise in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar project management tools.

title: Associate Producer | Kids Essential D2C
description:
**Role TL;DR**
 Support the Creative Director by managing the execution engine behind Rabitat’s creative work: projects, timelines, agencies, budgets, shoots, approvals, files and production logistics. Help strong ideas move from brief to finished asset smoothly and on time.
   

  

**Function:** 
 Brand / Marketing
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Creative Director
   

  

**Works closely with:** 
 Creative Team, Agencies, Freelancers, Marketing and Performance Teams
   

  

**About The Role**
 This Associate Producer role is a mix of 30% Brand Management, 30% Creative Production and a 40% Project Management. This role acts as the Creative Director’s execution partner or deputy.
   

  

 You will bring structure, follow\-through and operational discipline to the creative pipeline. You will coordinate with agencies, freelancers, creators and internal teams so that production moves without avoidable delays or confusion.
   

  

 This can be a junior role. You do not need to be a fully formed creative producer. You do need to be highly organised, dependable, comfortable with creative work and willing to take ownership of the details that make production successful.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Project and production management**
* Maintain the master tracker for all campaigns, content, shoots and deliverables.
* Convert creative direction into clear tasks, timelines, owners and dependencies.
* Track briefs from initial request through approval and final delivery.
* Identify risks, delays and missing inputs early.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders and external partners respectfully and consistently.
* Maintain the content calendar and upcoming delivery schedule.
* Prepare status updates for the Creative Director and marketing team.


**Agency and partner coordination**
* Coordinate with creative agencies, production houses, photographers, videographers, editors, designers, creators and influencers.
* Share briefs, references, timelines and feedback with external partners.
* Collect estimates, proposals, schedules and deliverables.
* Maintain a clear record of feedback and approvals.
* Ensure that every partner is working from the latest brief and approved direction.
* Help the Creative Director maintain the required quality standard across external work.


**Shoot and production logistics**
* Support planning for shoots, including:
+ Product samples
+ Props and styling
+ Locations
+ Casting and talent coordination
+ Crew requirements
+ Equipment
+ Call sheets
+ Travel and production logistics

* Track shoot\-day requirements and support on\-set coordination.
* Coordinate post\-production schedules, rough cuts, feedback rounds and final exports.
* Ensure that products, samples and production materials are tracked and returned where required.


**Budgets and administration**
* Track project estimates, budgets, invoices and vendor documentation.
* Maintain records of approved costs and actual spends.
* Support purchase orders, payments and vendor coordination.
* Flag scope changes or budget risks before they become problems.


**Asset and quality management**
* Organise working files, final masters, versions, usage rights and approvals.
* Ensure that the right assets are delivered in the right formats and dimensions.
* Conduct first\-level checks for spelling, product details, links, aspect ratios, subtitles and platform requirements.
* Support adaptations for social, performance marketing, website, marketplaces and CRM.
* Keep the creative library clean, current and easy to use.


**Creative support**
* Assist with research into trends, references, competitors, creators and content formats.
* Support the Creative Director with briefs, mood boards, presentations, scripts and shot lists.
* Contribute ideas where relevant, while keeping executional ownership clear.
* Help maintain a strong feedback loop between the creative team, agencies and marketing stakeholders.


**Candidate Requirements**
**Must\-haves**
* 1\-3 years of experience in creative production, project coordination, agency account management, marketing operations or a similar role.
* Excellent organisation and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Comfort managing trackers, timelines, budgets, follow\-ups and multiple stakeholders.
* Experience coordinating agencies, vendors, freelancers or internal teams.
* Willingness to work on shoots and manage practical production details.
* Proficiency with Google Sheets, presentations and basic project\-management tools.
* Ability to communicate delays and risks early.
* A calm, proactive and solution\-oriented working style.
* High attention to detail across files, formats, timelines and approvals.


**Good\-to\-haves**
* Experience at a creative agency, production house, D2C brand, e\-commerce company or consumer brand.
* Familiarity with Notion, Asana, Trello, ClickUp or similar tools.
* Experience coordinating influencer, UGC or creator projects.
* Basic understanding of video production, editing, design or content creation.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and performance creative.
* Interest in kids, parenting, consumer brands and social media.
* Ability to contribute to briefs, captions, references or production notes.
* Experience tracking creative or marketing budgets.


**Non\-negotiables**
* You follow through without needing constant reminders.
* You keep trackers, files and communication organised.
* You are comfortable chasing people respectfully and persistently.
* You communicate delays early rather than hiding them.
* You are comfortable handling the practical details of production.
* You care about the quality of the final customer\-facing work.
* You can work with creative people without becoming intimidated by ambiguity.
* You are willing to take ownership of the operational details that allow great creative work to happen.
* You want to grow into a larger creative production, operations or project leadership role.

We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school.  Read more about our work here: www.centralsquarefoundation.org
   

  

**About High Potential Students Workstream At CSF**
 India’s school education system serves \~25 crore children. Many of these students come from underserved communities and face systemic gaps in identification and support. With most interventions beginning only after Grade 10, much of this potential remains untapped and underdeveloped.
   

  

 To bridge this gap, CSF introduced a new workstream in 2025, High Potential Students (HPS), to support India’s bright young minds from underprivileged backgrounds in becoming future innovators, researchers and leaders. By 2030, we aim to transform the learning journeys of 1 lakh students by equipping them with the skills, support and exposure needed to thrive in higher education and high\-growth careers. Through this work, we are committed to advancing equity and excellence, empowering young minds from every corner of India to realise their full potential.
   

  

 CSF is working with government model school systems to strengthen pathways for high\-potential students (HPS) from underserved communities. The work focuses on designing and implementing initiatives within government model schools to support students’ academic, socio\-emotional, and career development. Key areas include programme planning and implementation, partner and government coordination, field engagement, documentation, and evidence generation. The work also supports effective classroom practices, academic enrichment, structured advanced learning opportunities, career pathways, and overall student progression.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 CSF is seeking a Project Associate to join the High Potential Students workstream in Delhi and support the planning and implementation of HPS programme. The Project Associate will be responsible for supporting assigned programme priorities, managing day\-to\-day implementation, maintaining trackers and documentation, supporting review and reporting processes, conducting field visits, analysing implementation data, and identifying risks that require course correction. The role requires strong project management skills, comfort with data, clear written communication, field orientation, and the ability to work in a dynamic and evolving environment.
   

  

**The Core Areas Of Contribution Are**
**Programme Implementation and Coordination**
* Support the execution of key programme priorities under the High Potential Students workstream, especially across model schools.
* Build and manage working relationships with diverse stakeholders, including regional government teams, school leaders, programme partners, educational nonprofits, vendors and internal CSF teams.
* Coordinate with implementation partners to monitor and review programs across EdTech, assessments, academic enrichment, and career pathways, ensuring effective progress tracking, timely identification of gaps, and appropriate follow\-through on action items.
* Support stakeholder convenings, partner check\-ins, review meetings and government updates by collating data, preparing materials, documenting discussions and tracking next steps.


**Project Management, Reviews and Reporting**
* Maintain programme trackers, timelines, meeting notes, action\-item logs, data templates and other tools required for day\-to\-day monitoring and review.
* Manage timelines and deliverables for assigned workstreams to ensure that activities are on track and aligned with project objectives.
* Prepare clear written outputs, including field visit notes, meeting minutes, update emails, review notes, progress summaries, presentations, reports and internal briefing documents.
* Provide timely updates to internal teams and CSF leadership on implementation progress, key insights, risks, opportunities and areas for course correction.


**Data, Field Insights and Documentation**
* Support rigorous data cleaning, validation and analysis to identify trends, implementation gaps, inconsistencies and areas requiring follow\-up or course correction, while also supporting the development and maintenance of dashboards, trackers and other data platforms for programme monitoring and review.
* Conduct targeted field visits to schools and institutions to gather operational and academic insights, understand implementation realities and document observations.
* Document key learnings, field insights, implementation challenges and emerging practices to inform reviews, reporting, programme improvement and future scale\-up.


**Problem Solving and Agile Support**
* Identify, assess and escalate implementation risks and bottlenecks in partner delivery, school\-level execution, data availability or communication, while supporting proactive issue resolution.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth project delivery, timely communication of progress and follow\-through on agreed priorities.
* Support emerging priorities and time\-sensitive tasks that may arise from government stakeholders, programme partners or internal teams, with the ability to respond quickly, organise next steps and drive closure in a dynamic work environment.


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities**
 We are looking for a young professional who brings:
   

  

* 0 to 2 years of post\-qualification work experience for the Project Associate role, preferably in the education sector, development sector, programme management, EdTech implementation, assessments, school\-system reform, or government\-facing projects.
* Strong project management skills or demonstrated ability to manage timelines, trackers, follow\-ups, action items and multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good writing and oral communication skills, with proficiency and fluency in English and Hindi.
* Good project delivery skills, including the ability to coordinate with partners, schools, government teams and internal colleagues to drive execution and ensure closure on deliverables.
* Ability to work with student\-level, school\-level, assessment, platform usage or programme monitoring data to derive implementation insights and support reviews.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills, including the ability to prepare meeting notes, progress updates, field visit reports, review materials and concise internal briefs.
* Strong growth and learning mindset, with attention to detail, ownership of assigned tasks, problem\-solving orientation, agility to take up emerging priorities, and willingness to travel across implementation schools within/outside of Delhi NCR.

title: Consulting Sr Associate, Air quality
description:
**ERM** 
 is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
   

  

 Our
 **Consulting Delivery Hub** 
 (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high\-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
   

  

 As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
   

  

**Why this role matters?**
 As a
 **Consulting Senior Associate \- Air Quality** 
 , you will support ERM's North American Air Quality team by delivering high\-quality permitting, emissions inventory, and regulatory reporting services for industrial, energy, pharmaceutical, technology, and chemical sector clients. Working closely with ERM consultants, technical specialists, and client stakeholders across North America, you will help ensure regulatory compliance, data integrity, and timely delivery of regulator\-ready submissions. This role plays a key part in enabling scalable global project delivery by supporting complex environmental compliance programs with accurate technical analysis, streamlined documentation, and consistent quality standards.
   

  

**What your impact is?**
* Deliver accurate and regulator\-ready permitting and compliance documentation that supports clients in meeting federal, state, and local air quality requirements.
* Develop and maintain traceable emissions inventories, calculations, and reporting workpapers that improve data quality, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance.
* Support the preparation of environmental submissions including Title V permits, NSR/PSD applications, Annual Emissions Statements, EPCRA Tier II, and TRI reports across multiple North American jurisdictions.
* Apply structured QA/QC processes to enhance data integrity, reduce compliance risks, and ensure consistency across client deliverables.
* Collaborate with global ERM teams, client stakeholders, and technical specialists to maintain project schedules, resolve data issues, and drive efficient delivery outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned, enhancing templates and SOPs, and supporting knowledge development across the Air Quality practice.


**What will you bring?**
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Environmental, or Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Science, or Chemistry, with coursework or exposure in air regulations, mass balance, or environmental data analysis.
* 1–3 years in NA air permitting or regulatory reporting with exposure to CAA, state permitting programs, and EPCRA Tier II/TRI reporting fundamentals; internships and co\-ops in industrial EHS or consulting.
* Emissions estimation, factor selection, and activity data QA in Excel, with strong attention to traceability and unit conversions per NA program needs.
* Working knowledge of Title V, NSR/PSD basics, NSPS/NESHAP applicability concepts, AERR inputs, and state annual emission statements.
* EPCRA Tier II/TRI fundamentals: chemical thresholding, mixtures, de minimis, SDS interpretation, and calculation documentation.
* Clear written communication for technical narratives and regulator\-ready submissions, responsive coordination with clients, regulators, and subcontractors in a remote delivery model supporting.


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills \& Competencies**
* Experience supporting North American air permitting and regulatory reporting programs across multiple states or industries.
* Exposure to environmental compliance management systems such as Cority, ACTS, or similar platforms.
* Experience using Power BI, data visualization tools, or automation technologies to improve reporting and compliance workflows.
* Professional certifications, advanced coursework, or postgraduate qualifications related to Air Quality, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or Sustainability.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Permitting support**
* Draft permit application content for Title V operating permits, state construction permits, and minor/major NSR/PSD, including process/equipment descriptions, emissions calculations, monitoring and recordkeeping plans, and applicability matrices referencing NSPS and NESHAP/MACT where relevant, ensuring state\-specific forms and attachments are complete and aligned with guidance such as NJDEP requirements where applicable.
* Coordinate inputs for dispersion modeling with senior modelers, prepare input data packages (stack parameters, release types), and maintain crosswalks linking model assumptions to application narratives and response\-to\-comment drafts for reviewer use, ensuring NA regulatory scope.
* Conduct desktop control\-technology research from public determinations and vendor literature to support preliminary BACT/LAER writeups for junior and senior reviewer refinement, keeping citations and change logs up to date per team SOPs.


**Regulatory reporting**
* Build traceable emissions inventories and reporting workpapers using client activity data, approved emission factors, and calculation templates, producing state annual emission statements, AERR inputs, Title V compliance/periodic reports, MACT/NESHAP periodic reports, and deviation logs as required for NA programs, with clear QA/QC checks and version control.
* Support EPCRA Tier II and TRI Form R/NA preparation by performing chemical thresholding, de minimis and mixture evaluations, SDS data extraction, and unit/stoichiometry conversions with senior oversight, documenting assumptions and data lineage clearly for audit readiness as emphasized by the SME JD.
* Reconcile permit, criteria/HAP, and GHG datasets to ensure consistency across submissions and client internal records, preparing evidence folders suitable for agency or client audits within NA jurisdictions, and flagging inconsistencies early for senior review and resolution.


**Quality and delivery**
* Execute structured QA/QC using checklist\-based reviews, cell protection, traceability notes, and exception flags in standardized Excel templates; maintain issue and action logs to track corrections and regulator comments, reflecting the SME’s discipline on data integrity and auditability.
* Maintain document control with consistent filenames, versioning, hyperlinks to source evidence, and regulator\-ready PDF packages with bookmarks and indices, supporting efficient review cycles with clients, regulators, and subcontractors per SME practice.
* Coordinate with client technical contacts, NA regulators when requested by senior staff, and subcontractors for data validation or specialized analyses; schedule and document communications and follow\-ups to maintain submission timelines


**Collaboration and learning**
* Participate in internal trainings on Title V, NSR/PSD, MACT/NESHAP, EPCRA Tier II/TRI, and state annual emissions statements; apply learning to improve calculations and templates, in line with SME guidance about the practice scale and expectations.
* Share lessons learned and template improvements with peers, contribute to frequently asked questions and SOP updates, and support onboarding for junior colleagues.

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.

This team supports the lifecycle of the firm's global trading strategies and serves as a key link between the front office and operational teams. This project\-focused role offers the opportunity to lead middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies, while retaining hands\-on operational ownership. This position will initially be an individual contributor role, with the potential to assume people management responsibilities in the future based on business needs and the candidate's interest.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will lead and deliver middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies. You will act as a project manager across internal and external teams—scoping requirements, driving solutioning, coordinating testing, and owning sign\-off on product roadmaps. You will partner with trading desks, technology, operations, and vendors to convert operational pain points into durable solutions that reduce risk and manual effort. You will manually handle exceptions and edge cases that fall outside automated workflows, resolving them accurately and feeding insights back into process improvements. You will work across the full trade lifecycle and a range of hedge fund asset classes, designing corner cases and defining exception handling for post\-automation workflows. You will also build workflows, dashboards, and tooling that give the desk and management clear visibility into trading activity, operational health, and risk.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* A postgraduate degree and 5\+ years of relevant experience across the trade lifecycle, including time in or alongside middle office functions
* A robust understanding of trade lifecycle operations—trade capture, P\&L, security master, settlements, and corporate actions—and of how various hedge fund asset classes behave across their lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience managing projects end\-to\-end as a project manager across internal and external teams, including scoping, testing, sign\-off, and stakeholder coordination
* A risk\-first mindset, with the judgment to anticipate corner cases and design exception handling for post\-automation workflows
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to senior management, stakeholders, front office, and vendors
* The ability to design or contribute to dashboards, workflows, and analytics that surface operational insight


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with automation and hands\-on familiarity with emerging GenAI and LLM tooling, with the ability to identify and apply these pragmatically within middle office workflows

title: Senior Technical Lead-Generator Excitation Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
 You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning.
   

  

 Project Engineering:
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end project engineering for high\-current static generator excitation systems, from requirements review and concept development through detailed design, manufacturing support, FAT, site installation, and commissioning.
* Design excitation system electrical and mechanical layouts for high\-current applications, typically in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range, including cubicle arrangement, power circuit configuration, cooling provisions, and maintainability requirements.
* Perform sizing and selection of excitation system components, including transformers, rectifier bridges, thyristors/diodes, bus bars, disconnecting devices, breakers, protection devices, cooling equipment, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary power supplies.
* Develop and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, general arrangement drawings, BOMs, control logic, system architecture, and network topology documents.
* Engineer bus work and high\-current power connections, including routing, clearance, creepage, thermal performance, short\-circuit withstand, and manufacturability considerations.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and system integrators to ensure the excitation system design is practical, cost\-effective, manufacturable, and compliant with project specifications.
* Support manufacturing quality processes, including inspection plans, assembly reviews, test procedures, nonconformance resolution, and corrective actions for high\-current excitation equipment.
* Implement control logic from SAMA diagrams, functional descriptions, and project\-specific operating requirements.
* Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3, as applicable.
* Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, HSE, and regional grid code requirements.
* Manage complete project programs for high\-current excitation systems, including engineering deliverables, technical risk, schedule alignment, manufacturing readiness, customer reviews, and cross\-functional execution.


 Field Services:
   

  

* Prepare site execution and commissioning plans in coordination with project managers, engineering teams, customers, and installation contractors.
* Lead site teams during excitation system installation, panel power\-up, redundancy checks, I/O verification, loop checks, device checks, and system energization.
* Perform and support commissioning of high\-current excitation systems, including AVR/FCR control checks, limiters, protection functions, interface testing, and generator performance validation.
* Troubleshoot issues related to excitation controllers, power bridges, firing circuits, field flashing, cooling systems, communication interfaces, protection devices, and auxiliary systems.
* Review and resolve installation or wiring deviations, site constraints, and commissioning punch points while maintaining safety and quality requirements.
* Modify logic, graphics, databases, parameters, and test configurations as required to meet approved customer and site requirements.
* Prepare customer\-facing commissioning reports, test records, issue logs, and handover documentation, and coordinate with vendors and stakeholders for timely closure.


**Who You Are:**
 You should be able to assume responsibility for the outcomes of others . Promotes a sense of urgency and establishes and enforces individual accountability in the team. You should be able to deliver messages in a clear, compelling, and concise manner. Actively listens and checks for understanding. Sets aggressive goals and has high standards. You should be consistently one of the top performers. Pursues everything with energy, drive, and the need to finish as per business needs.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Control \& Instrumentation, or a related discipline.
* Eight (8\) to sixteen (16\) years of experience in generator excitation systems, power electronics, electrical panel engineering, or related power generation applications.
* Proven experience in designing excitation system electrical and mechanical layouts for medium\- to high\-current applications, preferably in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range.
* Ability to size and select excitation system components, including transformers, rectifiers, thyristors/diodes, bus bars, breakers, protection devices, cooling systems, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary equipment.
* Ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical schematics, general arrangement drawings, wiring diagrams, BOMs, technical specifications, and test procedures.
* Working knowledge of bus work design, high\-current power connections, thermal considerations, electrical clearances, and manufacturing practices for excitation equipment.
* Understanding of manufacturing quality processes, including inspection, assembly verification, FAT documentation, nonconformance handling, and corrective action follow\-up.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, teamwork, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, interface with vendors and subcontractors, and support complete project execution under schedule and quality commitments.
* Familiarity with industry standards such as IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, OSHA, and applicable regional grid code requirements.
* Willingness to work in manufacturing and industrial site environments while following all safety and quality protocols.


**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**
* Deep understanding of generator excitation principles, AVR/FCR operation, generator field forcing, reactive power control, limiters, protection functions, and generator/transformer protection schemes.
* Hands\-on experience designing and delivering high\-current excitation systems in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range, including component sizing, cabinet layout, power bridge arrangement, bus work design, cooling, wiring, and maintainability.
* Experience leading complete excitation system programs from proposal or kickoff through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality inspection, FAT, shipment, site commissioning, and customer handover.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing quality processes for high\-current electrical equipment, including assembly inspections, heat\-run or functional testing, punch\-list closure, and documentation control.
* Proficiency in electrical circuit design, control systems, automation tools, protection relays, AVRs, CTs, VTs, synchronizing systems, and substation or plant automation interfaces.
* Experience supporting FAT/SAT, generator first excitation, open\-circuit and short\-circuit testing, load testing, grid synchronization, and performance tuning.
* Exposure to retrofit, modernization, renewable integration, and grid compliance projects involving generator excitation or related power control systems.

title: Principal Engineer Roads
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP wishes to recruit an ambitious and dynamic Principal Highway Engineer to join ‘GCC Civils, Austrailia Minning’ team in Noida. The team provides detailed highway designs for both public and private infrastructure in Austrailia Minning. The role requires the incumbent to lead a team of highway design engineers and to work with design teams located across various offices in Austrailia Minning to deliver their projects. It requires the person to have sound technical knowledge, good project management training, people management skills and leadership qualities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* This role is for a Principal Engineering Designer in the GCC Civils, Australia Mining team based in Bengaluru. The position involves delivering design solutions and construction drawings for mining roads, junctions, and haul roads across a range of Australia Mining projects, including NPI and haul road schemes
* The incumbent will be expected to play a proactive part in the road and drainage design process and be active on a few projects at any given time.
* He will function as a technical and tool specialist who develops and apply advanced engineering concepts and approaches to unique engineering problems. Seek innovation in the delivery of schemes and techniques used to design them.
* The position will also involve internal client liaison, assisting in the preparation of fee proposals and financial control of projects when acting as a package project manager.
* The incumbent will be expected to mentor, support, train and encouraging the young engineers and technicians to manage their own learning to develop their skills and improve performance.
* As offshore technical lead he will be responsible for ensuring his projects are delivered to budget, program and technical standards and meet QA, CDM, Sustainability and HSE requirements
* The position reports to a Civil Head and will be supported by a team of technical staff of various grades.
* The role will also include day to day project management, resource management, carry out concept studies and strategies with hands on design, leading to planning applications or construction drawings.


 Key Competencies / Skills
   

  

 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Proven experience in highway and development infrastructure design (pavement, alignment, drainage, utilities)
* Strong proficiency in Bentley ORD for modelling, urban design, complex junction design, corridor design, earthwork and ditch grading, tailgate corridor modelling, parking design, road drainage design, layby design and production of deliverables
* Ability to lead technical delivery and manage multi\-project teams within a design consultancy environment
* Sound understanding of planning, design processes, technical approvals, and contract procedures
* Experience in reviewing design drawings/models and ensuring compliance with standards
* Hands\-on capability in MicroStation and MS Office tools (Word, Excel)
* Working knowledge of Common Data Environments (CDE) such as ProjectWise
* Exposure to digital workflows, automation, and advanced tools (e.g Civil cell, python) as added advantage
* Good understanding of project financials, bidding, and delivery management
* Strong communication, team collaboration, and leadership skills


**Desired Skills**
* Experience in Australian mining infrastructure projects, with knowledge of relevant design standards and codes (e.g., Austroads, Australia mining guidelines, along with DMRB / AASHTO exposure)
* Ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver designs across all project stages in line with Australian mining engineering practices
* Experience in directing and reviewing 3D design outputs using Bentley ORD (and/or exposure to 12D as an added advantage)
* Proven capability in delivering design solutions compliant with codes, standards, and specifications, with willingness to develop deeper understanding of Australian mining standards
* Strong problem\-solving mindset, with ability to think laterally and develop innovative engineering solutions
* Cultural awareness and experience working with or supporting Australian teams and clients
* Awareness of climate change, sustainability, and decarbonisation principles in infrastructure design (e.g., low\-carbon materials, efficient earthworks, PAS 2080 alignment)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or post graduate degree in Civil Engineering with at least 12 years of design experience in case of graduates (10 years in case of post graduates)
* Preference will be given to Chartered Engineer (or those nearing completion of their charter ship) with international professional institutions such as ICE, CIHT or have equivalent international professional qualification.
* You will have substantial post graduate (or equivalent) experience and either have been awarded Chartered status (CEng, MICE, MIHT or MCIWEM), have equivalent international qualification, or have equivalent commercial experience and responsibility.
* You should be able to demonstrate a comprehensive knowledge of and experience in highway and/or drainage design as well as a wide knowledge of the Development Industry.

title: International Academic Manager(MBA- Fresher) (CTC 3LPA - 4LPA)
description:
**Company Description** 
 EduSkills Foundation® is a non\-profit organization focused on building an Industry 4\.0\-ready digital workforce in India by bridging the gap between academia and industry. The foundation provides access to world\-class curricula for faculty members and students, aiming to transform teaching methodologies and ICT\-based education across the country. EduSkills works collaboratively with students, educators, institutions, and central and state governments through targeted skilling initiatives. Its three\-pronged approach addresses education, employment, and entrepreneurship to create both social and business impact. The organization offers a mission\-driven environment for professionals interested in advancing equitable and future\-ready education.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The International Academic Manager (MBA – Fresher) will be responsible for coordinating academic programs and partnerships with global institutions, aligning them with EduSkills’ objectives and standards. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Delhi, India, involving daily collaboration with academic coordinators, faculty, and institutional partners to design and implement program structures, schedules, and learning outcomes. The role includes supporting curriculum development for international academic initiatives, tracking program performance, preparing reports, and ensuring compliance with internal guidelines and partner requirements. The International Academic Manager will communicate regularly with stakeholders, assist in organizing academic events and workshops, and contribute to continuous improvement of teaching and learning processes. The position offers exposure to international education practices and the opportunity to contribute to large\-scale skilling and capacity\-building projects.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Educational management and education\-related skills, including the ability to coordinate academic programs and work effectively with institutions and faculty.
* Curriculum development skills to support the design, structure, and ongoing improvement of international academic and skilling initiatives.
* Strong communication skills for engaging with domestic and international stakeholders, preparing reports, and conducting presentations.
* Analytical skills to interpret academic performance data, monitor program impact, and recommend evidence\-based improvements.
* MBA degree (preferably with a focus on education management, international business, or related fields); fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Ability to work on\-site in Delhi, India, with a collaborative, organized, and detail\-oriented approach.
* Interest in non\-profit, education, or social impact sectors; prior internships or projects in education or academic administration are an advantage.
* Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets, presentation software); familiarity with digital learning platforms is beneficial.

title: Regional Procurement Lead
description:
Based in the British High Commission in New Delhi, as member of Regional Procurement Hub team, the Regional Procurement Lead will be responsible for delivery of regional procurement activities for Foreign, Commonwealth Offices (FCDO) across offices in South Asia region, which includes British High Commissions, Deputy High Commissions, Embassies and Consulates in Afghanistan, Bangladesh, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.
 



 The job holder will be responsible for handling procurement of Goods, Services and Works valued above £25,000, supporting the Head of Regional Procurement Hub and Regional Procurement Manager, as well as working with customers and stakeholders across the region, developing and co\-ordinating delivery of procurement solutions. The job holder will ensure procurement activities are in line with FCDO Global Category Strategies, are fully compliant with the UK’s Public Contracts Regulations 2015, meets customer requirement and achieve best Value for Money for the FCDO.
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities / what will the jobholder be expected to achieve:**




**1\. Delivery of Regional Procurement Projects with lifetime value exceeding £25,000 (70%)** 




 Managing the tender process of assigned procurements/contract\-related to goods, services or work projects, including sourcing of suppliers, input and agreement of specifications, preparation of tender documentation, deciding on and running the most appropriate route to market; i.e. Invitations to Tender (ITT), Request for Proposals (RFP), Request for Quotations (RFQ) and other suitable procurement routes, liaison and coordination with suppliers to clarify requirements, coordination and evaluation of bids, seek appropriate approval, agreement of contracts, management and closure of contracts, ensuring that they meet legal, audit, HM Treasury and Cabinet Office requirements.
 



 Where operational needs necessitate, the job holder may be required to run higher value procurements (exceeding £115,000\) where the UK’s Procurement Act 2023 regulations will apply.
 



**2\. Stakeholder / Account Management (10%)** 




 Act as Account Manager for procurement related activities for your assigned countries/Post/Teams. Stakeholder engagement and management is critical in order to draw out and develop procurement pipeline, specifications, procurement routes and evaluate bids in a collaborative manner
 



**3\. Identifying Regional Aggregation Opportunities (10%)** 




 To work closely with colleagues at the UK’s Embassies, High Commissions and Consulates in the region/overseas to deliver Procurement activity to a standardised process, proactively seeking opportunities to buy efficiently through common procurement routes or approaches to market and opportunities to aggregate requirements across Posts and other HM Government partners.
 



**4\. Supplier and Contract Management (10%)** 




 Where required, to act as the Supplier Relationship Manager for regional suppliers including being First Point of Contact (FPOC) for resolution of contractual disputes (regional or local) and taking appropriate action to protect the FCDO’s interest. Build contract management and other required commercial capability amongst stakeholders through training and guidance.
 



**Essential qualifications, skills and experience** 



* Excellent communication skills. Commercial acumen. Data analysis.
* Strategic Sourcing \& Tendering Experience; including end to end procurement and category management.
* Well versed in running RFQs and RFPs and in writing reports documenting the tender process and outcomes
* Customer Engagement / Dealing with Stakeholders at different levels within the organisation
* Bachelor's degree in business management/finance related course or equivalent experience
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience.



  





**We will accept only online applications by
 
 27 September 2026 (latest by 23:55 hours IST).**

title: MEP Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Building Performance Engineers Private Limited delivers comprehensive building performance and energy modeling services to clients in the UK, USA, and other regions. The company’s portfolio covers heating and cooling load analysis, thermal comfort assessments, Part L (Energy) compliance, daylight modeling, CFD studies, and thermal bridging analysis for UK projects. In the USA, the team supports load analysis, ASHRAE 90\.1 performance\-based compliance, building energy model calibration per ASHRAE Guideline 14 and TM63, decarbonization strategies, and LEED (Energy and Environment) rating services. The organization specializes in energy modeling using tools such as IESVE and eQuest, complemented by strong expertise in thermal performance and compliance services. Professionals join a multidisciplinary environment focused on high\-quality technical delivery and sustainable building solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The MEP Manager is a full\-time on\-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for overseeing Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) design, coordination, and implementation across multiple building performance projects. Daily activities include leading MEP design reviews, coordinating with internal engineering teams and external stakeholders, and ensuring integration of MEP systems with energy modeling and compliance requirements. The role involves supervising plumbing and other building services layouts, managing technical documentation, and supporting procurement decisions to align materials and systems with design specifications and project budgets. The MEP Manager monitors project progress, resolves design and site coordination issues, and maintains adherence to local and international standards. This position also contributes to process improvements, mentoring team members, and supporting quality assurance in project delivery.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong MEP Design and Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) skills, with experience in building services engineering.
* Candidates should possess MEP Coordination skills, including interdisciplinary coordination with architectural, structural, and energy modeling teams.
* Candidates should possess Plumbing design and layout skills, with familiarity in relevant standards and best practices.
* Candidates should possess Procurement\-related skills for MEP materials and equipment, including vendor evaluation and cost\-conscious selection.
* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Mechanical, Electrical, Building Services, or related engineering discipline.
* Experience managing MEP works for commercial, residential, or institutional buildings; exposure to international codes and standards is beneficial.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and modeling outputs; proficiency with common MEP and CAD/BIM tools is an advantage.
* Strong project management, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an on\-site team environment.

title: Plant Head
description:
**Role Purpose** 




 Lead the entire Ahmedabad sandwich panel plant from commissioning and stabilization through full\-scale production, owning safety, output, quality, cost, people and continuous improvement.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of plant operations: production, PPC, maintenance, quality, stores, dispatch, utilities and EHS coordination.
* Lead commissioning, trial production, SOP finalization and ramp\-up of the continuous PUR/PIR panel line.
* Set daily/weekly/monthly production plans aligned to sales orders, material availability and delivery commitments.
* Drive OEE, productivity, yield, line speed, changeover control, scrap reduction, energy efficiency and manpower optimization.
* Ensure stable control of foaming, profiling/forming, curing, cutting, packing and finished panel handling.
* Build preventive and predictive maintenance discipline to minimise breakdowns and downtime.
* Own incoming, in\-process and final quality: steel facings, chemicals, adhesives, insulation core, panel dimensions, finished performance.
* Develop SOPs, work instructions, skill matrices, shift structures, training and accountability systems.
* Coordinate with sales, purchase, finance and management on order priorities, inventory, cost, complaints and capacity planning.
* Lead RCA, CAPA, 5S and safety; recruit, mentor and evaluate key production and technical staff during start\-up.
* Present plant MIS on production, rejection, downtime, consumption, manpower, dispatch and risks.



**Commissioning \& Ramp\-Up Priorities** 



* Complete commissioning readiness, punch\-point closure and stable trial production with OEM teams.
* Recruit and stabilize the core production, quality, maintenance and shift team before commercial ramp\-up.
* Freeze SOPs, shift reporting, material consumption standards and daily management routines.
* Establish the preventive maintenance calendar, critical spares list and breakdown escalation matrix.
* Achieve repeatable panel quality across key thicknesses, profiles and PUR/PIR combinations.
* Build a 90/180\-day ramp\-up plan with measurable output, rejection, downtime and cost targets.



**KPIs** 




 Production plan adherence and OTIF dispatch \| OEE, line utilization, throughput \| Scrap, rejection, chemical and steel yield \| Breakdown hours and PM compliance \| Customer complaints and CAPA closure \| Conversion cost and energy consumption \| Safety, 5S and workforce discipline \| Successful commissioning and ramp\-up

 Land \& Estate Scope

 Technical Competencies
   

  

* Strong understanding of land acquisition, land aggregation, land revenue records, title due diligence, mutation, registration, stamp duty, and land conversion processes.

* Planning and Execution: Strong ability to track multiple workstreams, manage priorities, maintain documentation discipline, and drive closure across site and Head Office teams.
* Problem Solving: Able to handle ambiguity, regulatory complexity, site\-level resistance, documentation gaps, and operational bottlenecks with a solution\-oriented approach.
* Communication: Clear, structured, and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders, including preparation of status updates, review notes, trackers, and escalation summaries.


**Qualifications**
 Graduate in any discipline; qualification in Law, Civil Engineering, Land Management, Rural Management, or Business Administration will be preferred.

title: Account Manager
description:
**Account Manager** 




  





 Experience: 
 
 4–5\+ Years
 




 Location: 
 
 Remote
 





 Type: 
 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're hiring an Account Manager to sit between our team and our global agency clients. You'll own a set of accounts end to end: keeping the relationship healthy, making sure work goes out on time and on brief, and catching problems before the client ever sees them.
 



 This isn't a hands\-on media buying role, but you do need to know paid media and paid social well enough to have a real conversation about a campaign, and enough of an eye for creative to tell a solid ad from a weak one before it ships. Think of it as the person who makes sure the specialists' work actually lands well with the client ,not someone learning the platforms on the job.
 







**What Does the Role Involve?** 




  





 Client \& Account Ownership
 



  




* Be the main point of contact for a set of global agency accounts, day to day.
* Build relationships clients actually trust, not just ones that function.
* Set expectations clearly up front, so there are fewer surprises later.
* Handle escalations and pushback calmly, and know when to loop in the wider team.



  





 Campaign \& Creative Oversight
 



  




* Review paid media output and creative assets before they go to the client, checking they match the brief and the brand.
* Work closely with paid social, paid search and creative teams to keep everyone aligned on what the account actually needs.
* Push back on work that isn't ready, with specific, useful feedback rather than vague notes.
* Spot gaps between what was promised and what's being delivered, and close them early.



  





 Project \& Workflow Management
 



  




* Run several accounts in parallel without dropping deadlines.
* Keep timelines realistic and keep internal teams moving against them.
* Coordinate across time zones, since most of the clients aren't local.
* Flag resourcing or scope problems before they become account\-level issues.



  





 Reporting \& Communication
 



  




* Turn campaign performance into updates a client can actually act on, not just a data dump.
* Run regular check\-ins and reporting calls, and come prepared.
* Write and speak in clear, professional English, always.
* Keep internal stakeholders as informed as the client is.



  





**What Are We Looking For?** 




  





 Necessary
 



  




* 4–5\+ years in account management or client servicing, ideally inside a media or marketing agency.
* Solid working knowledge of Paid Media and Paid Social, enough to manage the work, question a strategy, or sense when something's off.
* A good eye for creative. Can review ad copy and social creative and give feedback that actually improves it.
* Experience managing agency or client relationships, ideally international or global ones.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Organised and dependable. Things don't slip through the cracks on your accounts.
* Comfortable holding several accounts and stakeholders at once without losing track of any of them.
* Can work independently and remotely, across time zones, without much oversight.



  





 Nice to Have
 



  




* Hands\-on paid media execution experience, even if that's not the current role.
* Experience briefing or working directly with creative/design teams on ad production.
* Familiarity with reporting tools like Looker Studio or Supermetrics.
* Some exposure to programmatic/DSP buying.



  





**Who Fits Well Here** 




  





 People who are calm under a client's pressure, not just polite about it. Who can tell a paid media specialist their targeting is off and tell a client their brief was unclear, in the same day, without either conversation going badly.
 



 If you've ever caught a mistake in someone else's work an hour before it went to a client, and you didn't make a big deal of it, you already know what this job needs.

**Job Title: Technical Project Manager**
**Location: Vadodara (Hybrid \- 2 days a week from office)**
**Experience: Min 8yrs**
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager with a strong engineering and technology delivery background to lead large, complex epics and engineering initiatives. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience managing engineering teams, driving end\-to\-end delivery, and coordinating across multiple technical and business stakeholders.
   

  

 This role requires exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, strong technical understanding, and the ability to bring structure, ownership, and predictability to complex delivery environments.
   

  

 Experience delivering AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or other AI\-enabled technology initiatives will be a significant advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of large and complex technical epics, from planning and estimation through execution, release, and closure. Manage delivery across engineering teams, ensuring commitments around scope, timelines, quality, and dependencies are effectively managed. Partner closely with Engineering Leads, Architects, Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, and other delivery teams. Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans. Drive engineering delivery by tracking progress, identifying bottlenecks, managing risks, and proactively resolving impediments. Manage cross\-team and cross\-functional dependencies, particularly for initiatives involving multiple engineering teams or systems. Facilitate technical and delivery discussions and ensure clear decisions, ownership, and follow\-through. Establish strong delivery governance, including status reporting, RAID management, milestone tracking, and executive\-level communication. Provide clear and concise updates to senior stakeholders, translating complex technical topics into meaningful business and delivery insights. Ensure engineering teams maintain a strong focus on delivery quality, predictability, and continuous improvement. Support Agile ceremonies and delivery practices while adapting the approach based on the complexity and needs of the programme. Create a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and timely escalation across delivery teams.
   

  

**Required Experience \& Skills**
 8–12 years of overall experience, with significant experience in technical project/program management and engineering delivery. Proven experience managing large, complex epics or technology programmes involving multiple teams and dependencies. Strong experience managing Engineering / Software Development teams and their end\-to\-end delivery. Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), modern engineering practices, release management, and technology delivery. Strong experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies, backlog management, sprint/release planning, and delivery tracking. Demonstrated ability to manage risks, issues, dependencies, competing priorities, and changing requirements. Brilliant written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate confidently with engineers, architects, product teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, influencing, and conflict\-resolution skills. Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, complex, and highly collaborative client environment. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive teams toward outcomes rather than simply tracking activities. Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Experience Prior experience delivering AI / Generative AI / Machine Learning projects or AI\-enabled products is a big plus. Understanding of AI/ML solution delivery lifecycle, including collaboration between engineering, data, AI/ML, platform, and product teams. Experience managing cloud, data, API, platform, or enterprise\-scale engineering initiatives. Experience working directly with clients and senior stakeholders in complex enterprise environments. PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum, SAFe, or similar project/program management certification is advantageous.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are particularly interested in someone who is technically credible, delivery\-focused, and an outstanding communicator. The person should be comfortable working with engineering teams at a detailed level while also being able to provide crisp, outcome\-focused communication to senior client stakeholders.
   

  

 The successful candidate should have a strong track record of taking ownership of complex engineering initiatives, bringing clarity to ambiguity, managing dependencies, and driving teams to successful delivery.
   

  

 Important: This role is based at the client office in Vadodara, and candidates should be comfortable working from the client location
   

  

***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***
