title: Academic Programs & Program Manager
description:
In the role of the
 
**Program Manager, FORT.Academy** 

 the person shall report to the CEO, Forge and engage in a scope of work spanning techno\-managerial, financial, operational and administrative aspects relating to the broad
 
***Key Result Areas (KRAs)* 
 covering
 *program management \& operations of various offerings, Training services, Innovation Project Management services for MSMEs \& Startups, Partner/Client Stakeholder Management \& Ecosystem Connect, and General Administration.***





  






 FORT.Academy shall partner with various knowledge/capability partners, higher technical institutions and Industry partners (MSMEs and Startups) to implement the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum as an adjunct process to the academic curriculum, and as the consolidated process for all innovation centered initiatives, policies and programs at a national scale. The Program Manager is the operational lead for the MTP(Manufacturing Technology Practicum), requiring a high degree of organisational skill, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of the program's practical components. The role is a blend of administration, coordination, and participant\-facing support, ensuring that all program activities run smoothly and effectively.
 




  





**Introduction: FORT.Academy within Forge Innovation \& Ventures** 





 Forge Innovation \& Ventures operates as a vertically integrated enterprise, fundamentally committed to establishing and managing a national\-scale Open Innovation Value Network. The core objective of this network is to catalyse talent, technology, and ventures, thereby powering India's innovation economy in the Industrial Intelligence Age. The strategic framework of the organisation is meticulously structured around six Strategic Program Verticals (SPVs), each aligned with one of three core thrust areas: Talent, Technology, and Ventures.
 





 Forge.Academy is positioned as a core Strategic Program Vertical (SPV) under Forge's overarching "Talent" thrust area. Its primary function is to cultivate an innovation\-capable industrial workforce and entrepreneurial talent pool achieved through a comprehensive portfolio of university\-accredited/affiliated graduate education programs and professional development courses focused on innovation and entrepreneurship.
 




  






 FORT.Academy accelerates the convergence of industrial manufacturing with cutting\-edge technology, serving as the framework under which the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum for Industrial Workforce are implemented. Innovation Practicum for Technical Education is a unique program designed to redefine the role of an engineer by equipping students with a potent blend of technology, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit necessary to tackle contemporary industry challenges. Manufacturing Technology Practicum operationalises the Manufacturing Technology Practicum as the cornerstone of the Career Advancement \& Capability Development (CACD) program, providing a structured pathway for the industrial workforce to evolve from being passive technology users to becoming active innovators, strategists, and leaders.
 




  





**Position \& Designation** 




**Grade \- Manager or Sr. Manager** 





 The
 
**Program Manager** 

 to be designated in Forge at the grade of Manager or Sr.Manager shall be considered for a promotion to the role of Business Manager after having delivered a commendable performance in the stated role for a minimum tenure of 24 months.
 




  





**Compensation** 





 Forge compensation is at par with the top end of the social enterprises sector in India and continuously benchmarked to be above the average compensation offered in the social (non\-commercial or development) sector in general but significantly above the average compensation offered by TBIs. The Total CTC will include 3 major components namely,
 
**Fixed Monthly Gross** 

 ,
 
**Fixed Quarterly Payout, and Annual Development Bonus** 

 (linked to demonstration of progress on developing and strengthening capabilities in alignment with the Career Advancement and Capabilities Development framework of Forge).
 




  





**Role \& Responsibilities \- Key Result Areas** 




  




1. **Program Delivery \& Operational Excellence**


* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of the MTP and all innovation programs, encompassing comprehensive logistical orchestration from inception to completion.
* Create and manage detailed course schedules while coordinating seamlessly with faculty, coaches, and external partners to guarantee timely availability of all facilities and resources.
* Ensure robust support for hands\-on lab sessions, practical exercises, and innovation projects, thereby elevating the quality of participant learning experiences and driving operational excellence
* Maintain a high degree of operational excellence directly correlates with participant satisfaction and successful learning outcomes.



**2\.Commercialisation, Revenue Scaling \& Innovation Leadership** 



* Support CEO and CPO Fort.Academy is actively prospecting, seeding, and nurturing opportunities for commercializing various knowledge products developed, standardized, and monetized under innovation programs.
* Support the CEO and CPO Fort.Academy, Fort.Academy to manage execution of initiatives or lead certain ones for scaling revenue generation from beneficiaries including industrial companies (corporates \& MSMEs), academia, industry professionals, and startups.
* Lead innovation skills training and competencies development programs, managing design, delivery, admissions, curriculum alignment, and operational aspects for future\-ready talent.
* Lead innovation projects and services, overseeing product innovations, structured processes, stakeholder management, trainee coaching, and outcome monitoring.



**3\.Participant Success \& Support** 



* Drive participant journeys from initial enrollment through career advancement, serving as the primary conduit for academic guidance while meticulously tracking progress against defined learning outcomes.
* Oversee comprehensive onboarding processes, infuse the human touch into addressing career goals, and nurture future\-ready talent in harmony with industrial digital transformation imperatives.innovation practicum got industrial innovation
* Act as a career advancement coach and innovation mentor for diverse trainees \- including students and professionals delivering personalized support on seamless program transitions, such as from GEC Level III to PGDTM, informed by individual performance and aspirations.
* Play a deeply personal role in guiding trainees through innovation lifecycles from challenge curation and solution exploration to product concept development and MUP design ensuring the tiered program structure empowers strategic missions with vital support.



**4\.Educational Infrastructure \& Resource Management** 



* Manage the  allocation, maintenance, and optimal utilization of all educational resources essential for the MTP and innovation programs.
* Ensure availability of lab equipment, software licenses for tools like CAD/CAM or PLC programming, classroom spaces, and inventory of consumables for uninterrupted hands\-on learning.
* Develop and manage necessary systems, processes, and tools to facilitate seamless knowledge sharing, program facilitation, and resource efficiency across physical, digital, and hybrid formats.
* Maintain all resources in prime working condition while working across Forge centers to support practice\-based, innovation\-centric learning models.



**5\.Team Staffing, Training \& Stakeholder Representation** 



* Staff, train, and manage a team of competent program leads and program associates apart from playing the role of the authorised representative of the company’s CEO to all external stakeholders in the respective program ecosystem.
* Foster internal and external stakeholder communication for streamlined project completion and ecosystem engagement.



**6\.Performance Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Diligently collect, analyse, and report on a broad set of key performance indicators (KPIs) spanning program effectiveness, participant enrollment, completion rates, satisfaction scores, and innovation outcomes.
* Gather feedback on courses, faculty performance, and specific initiatives, consolidating data for the Program Director to fuel strategic decisions and continuous improvements.
* Monitor and report product innovation impacts, ensuring timely deployment of projects while demonstrating program value through meticulous metrics.



**7\.Program Operations, MarComm \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Lead/support the effective planning and implementation of events, conferences, visits, startup demos, ecosystem meetups, and other forms of physical, digital or hybrid events required towards creating a strong pipeline of talent and industry partners for the various innovation programs implemented by Fort.Academy
* Anchor the implementation of various activities and deliverables coming under the purview of Marketing Communications relating to outreach campaigns, event collateral, social media promotions etc.

title: Manager III, Program Manager, Seller Economics & Fees
description:
**Description**
 The Manager III, Program Management role will lead the Fee Strategy Operations (FSO) team — Amazon's central execution and operations arm for fee strategy, seller incentive programs, and Go\-To\-Market (GTM) delivery across worldwide marketplaces. You will manage a team of program managers, business analysts, and operations specialists working at the intersection of Fee Strategy, Product, Tech, Operations, and cross\-functional stakeholder teams to drive execution across key workstreams including annual and peak fee changes, seller incentive programs (NSI, NSP, GSI), Gen AI–powered automation, and seller experience improvements.
   

  

 Our environment is fast\-paced and high\-impact — the team manages GTM execution across 19\+ marketplaces, coordinates with 40–50 cross\-functional POCs per launch, and drives programs projected to generate billions in incremental seller GMS. This role requires a self\-starter who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and comfortable leading through ambiguity while managing multiple concurrent programs, partners, and senior leadership stakeholders.
   

  

 The Fees Team is looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Manager who can deliver on complex cross\-functional programs while aligning with organizational goals and partnering across Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, Tax, Marketing, and Seller Support teams. You should understand business problems end\-to\-end and have the ability to prevent or mitigate consequences of poor business decisions. As the owner of the program, you should be able to look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and scale operations through automation and AI\-driven solutions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, analysts, and operations specialists responsible for worldwide fee strategy execution and incentive program management
* Own end\-to\-end GTM execution for annual fee changes, peak fee changes, and policy updates across US, CA, EU, JP, AU, and emerging marketplaces — managing 100\+ tasks, 20\+ milestones, and coordination across 15\+ teams per cycle
* Drive program management for seller incentive programs (New Seller Incentives, New Selection Program, Global Selling Incentives) including launch readiness, enrollment acceleration, credit utilization campaigns, and causal measurement
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Fee Strategy Product Managers, Tech, Legal, Tax, Finance, Marketing, and Seller Support to understand business requirements and deliver integrated execution plans
* Identify, quantify, and escalate technical issues across incentive programs — driving root cause analysis, impact assessment, reimbursement execution, and seller communications
* Champion Gen AI and automation initiatives to scale operations, including AI\-powered ticket resolution, content generation agents, and automated data quality auditing
* Communicate regularly with senior leadership and stakeholders; define and track relevant KPIs to report program health, seller impact, and operational performance
* Plan resourcing, analyze and report weekly and monthly metrics; identify trends and opportunities to improve processes and reduce seller friction
* Execute high\-priority, cross\-functional projects to improve operations performance and seller experience
* Design and implement automation solutions that remove manual processes and enable stakeholders to manage the business more effectively
* Build and maintain centralized data stores and reporting dashboards to enable self\-serve analytics for worldwide tenant and internal teams


 A day in the life
   

  

* Be a part of BRD review for an upcoming annual fee change, aligning GTM timelines and RACI ownership across 17 teams
* Review metrics on fee incentive programs (NSI, NSP, GSI) with business stakeholders — tracking enrollment, credit consumption, and iGMS impact
* Manage a seller escalation related to fee discrepancies, coordinating root cause analysis and reimbursement execution
* Develop a working backwards plan for seller communications related to a fee policy change across multiple worldwide marketplaces
* Review AI agent performance metrics — assessing auto\-resolution rates for the NSI/NSP Resolver Agent and identifying expansion opportunities
* Align with Product and Tech teams on upcoming incentive program launches, ensuring operational readiness and test order validation


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 6\+ years of team management experience
* 6\+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior management
* Experience driving GTM execution for fee changes, incentive programs, or seller/merchant\-facing initiatives across multiple marketplaces
* Experience operating in a WW (worldwide) program management capacity across multiple geographies and regulatory environments
* Familiarity with Gen AI tools and automation frameworks (e.g., AI agents, workflow automation) to scale operational processes

title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
description:
**Description**
 Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.
   

  

 Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision\-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re\-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever\-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well\-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.
   

  

 We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of \~200\+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10\+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.
   

  

 We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly\-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self\-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self\-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities \-
   

  

* Define and manage cross\-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
* Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade\-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross\-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
* Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

 TFS has over 200\+ engineers, and 20\+ product \& program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation \& management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with \~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end\-to\-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

title: Project Manager, PDS Projects
description:
Job Summary 
 Role Purpose: Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned capital projects, ensuring compliance with approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety and commercial requirements. The role supports the Client Project Executive and India PDS Director, serves as the primary client contact, manages the regional capital budget, and coordinates all internal and external project stakeholders. 
 
 Location 
 Bengaluru, KA 
 
 Reporting To 
 India Project Director - PDS and Client Project Executive 
 
 Preferred Background 
 MEP, with capability to manage CI projects 
 
 Project Exposure 
 Corporate interior fit-outs, Minor and Major Refurbishments, Retrofits 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own project delivery from initiation, planning and design through procurement, construction, commissioning, handover and closeout. Establish project objectives, execution plans, governance, roles, reporting lines, communication protocols, milestones and working procedures. Lead project meetings, track decisions and actions, manage priorities across multiple initiatives, and provide direction and coaching to project team members. Act as the single point of contact for the client and understand business objectives, requirements, constraints and expectations. Build effective relationships with senior leaders, consultants, architects, engineers, contractors, vendors and internal teams. Maintain stakeholder alignment, communicate project status clearly, and escalate critical issues with practical recommendations and resolution plans. Develop and maintain project schedules, milestone plans, procurement programmes and resource plans; monitor critical paths, approvals, long-lead items and material deliveries. Coordinate and review drawings, specifications and technical submissions for completeness, coordination, constructability and compliance; resolve design gaps and support value engineering. Manage pre-construction activities, tender documentation, bid evaluation, vendor selection, statutory approvals, permits and inspections. Administer consultant, contractor and vendor contracts, including obligations, notices, claims, variations, extensions of time, change orders and performance reviews. Manage budgets, cost plans, commitments, expenditures, accruals, invoices, forecasts, cash flows, payment cycles and revenue tracking in JLL and client systems. Prepare cost and variance reports, identify potential overruns, certify bills against verified progress, resolve financial discrepancies, and complete final reconciliation at closeout. Monitor construction through site visits, inspections, progress reviews and coordination meetings; verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications and contractual requirements. Coordinate site activities across design, procurement, construction and commissioning teams while monitoring workmanship, material quality, productivity and resource deployment. Implement QA/QC and health, safety, environmental and statutory controls; track observations, non-conformances, defects and corrective actions through closure. Maintain risk and issue registers, assign owners, develop mitigation and recovery plans, monitor residual exposure and escalate high-impact matters promptly. Prepare accurate daily, weekly and monthly reports covering progress, milestones, cost, cash flow, procurement, quality, safety, risks, issues and upcoming priorities. Maintain reliable project data in AdaptiveWork and other systems, including workplans, budgets, risks, actions, decisions, changes, approvals and meeting minutes. Maintain complete and auditable project records, including contracts, drawings, specifications, permits, correspondence, reports, checklists and approvals. Plan and coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, final acceptance and closure of all outstanding works. Manage submission and approval of as-built drawings, OM manuals, warranties, test certificates, training records, completion certificates and statutory documentation. Support final account settlement, financial reconciliation, contract closure, lessons learned and a structured transition to the client or operations team. 
 
 Required Qualifications and Experience 
 Graduate degree in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Architecture (B.Arch.), or a related discipline. 9-12 years of relevant experience in project management or project management consultancy, with strong end-to-end delivery experience. Experience in corporate interior fit-outs, commercial buildings or capital works; MEP experience is preferred, with the ability to manage CI projects. Demonstrated capability in planning, design coordination, procurement, tendering, contract administration, construction monitoring, cost control, risk management and closeout. Experience managing multiple projects, budgets, cash flows, invoices, commitments, consultants, contractors, subcontractors and vendors. Working knowledge of AdaptiveWork or comparable project management platforms, project reporting portals and Microsoft Office. 
 
 Core Competencies 
 Client Focus and Ownership: Prioritises client outcomes while protecting commercial and organisational interests. Communication and Influence: Communicates complex matters clearly and engages confidently with senior stakeholders. Planning and Organisation: Applies a structured, detail-oriented approach and manages competing priorities effectively. Leadership and Collaboration: Builds trust, promotes accountability, and mentors team members to achieve shared goals. Judgement and Problem Solving: Makes sound decisions, anticipates risks, and develops practical solutions under pressure. Adaptability and Initiative: Learns quickly and performs effectively in dynamic, ambiguous and deadline-driven environments. 
 
 Location 
 On-site Bengaluru, KA 
 
 Scheduled Weekly Hours 
 48

 monitoring

 prescription

 manufacturer protocol 
 ¢ Verify dialyzer details and complete related documentation 
 ¢ Discard used supplies and sanitize equipment as per manufacturer and unit protocol 
 ¢ Monitor RO (water treatment) readings to ensure safe limits and adequate water levels for subsequent shifts;

 2. Direct Patient Care 
 ¢ Record pre- and post-dialysis vital signs, weight, and temperature 
 
 
 
 ¢ Inspect the patient's dialysis access; administer local anesthesia where required and insert needles per protocol 
 and prescription 
 ¢ Document treatment parameters and promptly communicate any patient concerns to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Administer anticoagulants and adjust blood flow and fluid removal rates as per protocol and physician 
 prescription 
 ¢ Safely discontinue dialysis, establish hemostasis, and clean/dress the access site as per protocol 
 ¢ Continuously monitor patients and equipment, responding to alarms and adjusting treatment as required 
 ¢ Respond appropriately to dialysis-related emergencies hypotension, needle displacement, clotting, blood 
 leaks, or air embolism 
 ¢ Initiate CPR in the event of a cardiac emergency 
 ¢ Support patient education on nutrition, lifestyle, and treatment adherence, in collaboration with the Unit In- 
 Charge and Sr. Therapist 
 ¢ Communicate emotional, medical, psychosocial, and nutritional concerns of patients to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Maintain professional conduct, empathetic communication, and patient confidentiality at all times

 ¢ Ensure adherence to NABH standards and other applicable clinical quality protocols 
 ¢ Ensure reprocessing and dilution procedures are carried out strictly as per unit protocol 
 ¢ Maintain overall hygiene and support proper waste management within the dialysis unit 
 4. Team & Facility Support 
 ¢ Assist in preparing patient treatment schedules alongside the care team 
 ¢ Support training of new team members on dialysis machine preparation, monitoring, and maintenance 
 ¢ Report any protocol deviations observed among staff to the Unit In-Charge

title: Billing Engineer
description:
THE ROLE 
 We are looking for a rigorous Billing Engineer to independently verify contractor bills, measurements, quantities, rates, recoveries and supporting documentation across premium building projects. The role sits between the site team, contractors, procurement/contracts and finance and must protect accuracy without allowing bills to remain stuck in avoidable loops. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Check RA and final bills against approved BOQs, work orders, drawings, site measurements, joint measurement records and executed quantities. Verify rate applicability, extra items, deviations, deductions, advances, retention, taxes, free-issue materials, wastage and back-charges. Audit BBS and reinforcement reconciliation, concrete and major material consumption, contractor statements and scrap/debit records where applicable. Maintain package-wise bill registers showing submission, query, certification, approval and payment status with ageing and accountability. Return incomplete or incorrect bills with a single consolidated query list; track resolution and prevent repetitive back-and-forth. Coordinate with site engineers and project managers to validate physical progress and close measurement gaps promptly. Prepare certification/release sheets for management and finance, highlighting exceptions, risks and pending recoveries. Support quantity take-offs, tender BOQs, variation logs, reconciliation and cost-to-complete updates. Maintain a clear audit trail and ensure no certification occurs without required documentation and approvals. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 Complete bills are certified within agreed timelines, with transparent reasons for any hold. No duplicate quantity, incorrect rate or missed recovery passes through certification. Management can see billing ageing, cash requirement, variations and package exposure at a glance. Final accounts close with minimal unresolved measurements or documentation gaps. EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES 
 BE/BTech or Diploma in Civil Engineering with 5-8 years of contractor or developer-side billing experience. Strong knowledge of quantity surveying, IS measurement practices, BBS, BOQs, rate analysis, reconciliation, RA/final bills and work-order conditions. Advanced Excel capability; experience with AutoCAD quantity take-offs. ERP exposure is useful but not mandatory. Experience in high-rise residential, commercial or mixed-use construction; developer-side experience preferred. Candidates should be prepared for a practical assessment using a sample bill/BOQ. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES 
 Numerically precise and difficult to mislead. Firm, fair and responsive with contractors. Strong documentation discipline and integrity. Able to explain discrepancies simply and close them quickly.

 Amazon Application Security is looking for a security\-focused Technical Program Manager who wants to make a difference and support Amazon builders to ensure that protecting customer data is at the forefront of all development.
   

  

 Our team approaches security challenges with empathy and curiosity to help Amazon builders identify areas of improvement and learn how to navigate the highly dynamic space of application security. You’ll also find yourself challenged in unique ways when operating at the massive scale of Amazon, unique to a select few corporations in the world. * Use knowledge of software system design to scope architecture, review associated threat models, educate customers on potential severity of security findings and guide developer and security engineering teams through remediation.
* Define and implement best practice methods, processes, tools and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at scaling and increasing the efficiency of Amazon’s security guidance and builder support processes.
* Own the creation and delivery of business proposals (growth, new areas of focus, etc) and metrics to security leadership.
* Proactively identify and manage program risk, identifying paths to overcome risks, and escalating when necessary
* Work effectively and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Influence, negotiate, resolve conflicts and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
* Foster a positive work environment leveraging existing skills in active listening, encouraging diverse perspectives and adapting to a variety of personality types.

Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

title: Engineering Manager 2 (Timing IC-Validation)
description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.
   

  

 Requisition ID: 77636
   

  

**About Skyworks**
 If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high\-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.
   

  

 Skyworks offers the industry’s broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best\-in\-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick\-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The IC Validation team leads all post\-silicon activities, including chip bring\-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. In this management role, you will recruit and build a new team of validation and characterization engineers in Skyworks’ Bengaluru office to support local Timing Design teams. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre\-silicon design to post\-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world\-class products to our customers.
   

  

 We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
* Build and develop a new team of validation and characterization engineers to support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office. This team will:
+ Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs.
+ Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
+ Lead the design and development of high\-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization.
+ Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization.
+ Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts.
+ Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports.
+ Own post\-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams.

* Provide goals and conduct annual performance reviews of direct reports.
* Receive assignments in the form of objectives and determine how to use resources to meet schedules and goals.
* Establish and/or improve processes to streamline the characterization effort.


**Desired Experience And Skills**
* BS in Electrical Engineering with 12\+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 10 years of experience
* Proven track record of hiring, building, and leading high\-performing engineering teams
* Strong people management skills with emphasis on performance, accountability, and execution visibility
* Ability to operate autonomously and establish structure in a new site or team
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross\-functional teams and senior leadership
* Extensive hands\-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc.)
* Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure
* Solid background in validation, test, or characterization (leadership experience preferred)
* Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
* Proficiency in programming for test/automation (Python, .NET preferred, or similar)
* Experience with test frameworks and data analysis tools (JMP, MATLAB, or equivalent)


 Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**\- Cogentiq I2C (Invoice\-to\-Cash)**

 You own the technical success of Cogentiq I2C at a portfolio of strategic accounts. You take a business problem that arrives stated in finance terms, reduce our days sales outstanding, stop writing off small\-balance deductions, and turn it into a production AI system that the customer’s finance organisation actually uses.
   

  

 You lead a small deployment team. You make the architecture calls. You are the person the customer sponsor calls when something is wrong, and the person who tells them what we will not build. This is an engineering role. You will still be in the codebase. The difference from the first band is that you also carry the account, the design and the team.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Account technical ownership
   

  

* Own the technical outcome for a portfolio of accounts, from discovery through production rollout and scale.
* Set and defend the deployment KPI contract: accuracy, straight\-through processing rate, latency, cost per transaction, adoption and business impact.
* Hold the technical relationship with customer sponsors and IT leadership.


 Solution design and architecture
   

  

* Translate ambiguous goals into a solution design covering agent topology, retrieval strategy, human oversight boundaries, integration approach and data model.
* Make and document the build versus configure versus extend\-the\-product calls. Decline bespoke work that cannot be maintained across the customer base.
* Own the integration design against customer ERP, banking and document infrastructure.


 Delivery leadership
   

  

* Lead a deployment team of Forward Deployed Engineers and specialists. Scope the work, sequence it and unblock it.
* Own proof\-of\-value and pilot scoping, including effort estimates and success criteria that can be measured rather than asserted.
* Act as incident commander for production failures. Own the root cause analysis and the remediation plan.


 Advisory
   

  

* Explain to finance and IT leadership what the system can and cannot do and what residual risk remains after it is deployed.

title: Sr. Supplier Development Engineer (Injection Molding)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
   

  

**SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (INJECTION MOLDING)**
 SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
   

  

 SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. We are looking for talented, creative, and driven engineers to develop, drive, and maintain suppliers, from initial concept development to full scale production.
   

  

 This is a high\-profile, cross functional position that plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of the user terminal manufacturing at our global suppliers. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering and manufacturing departments as well as with global base of suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Improve quality, cost, delivery, and capacity metrics for injection molded parts used in the Starlink products
* Work on the development of new plastic injection tooling projects to meet a wide range of product performance and cosmetic requirements
* Research and identify new materials, manufacturing technologies, and finish options
* Review DFM from the supplier, including gating strategy, Moldflow, and Mold Warp analysis
* Review and approve prototype/development tool designs, and tooling maintenance procedures
* Direct tooling modifications while ultimately responsible for approving first article inspection (FAI) reports, and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) reports
* Collaborate with design, materials, and manufacturing engineers to gain an in\-depth knowledge of injection molded part, assembly, metrology, and/or sub\-system design intent
* Support the procurement team to strategically source parts matched with supplier competencies by reviewing and assessing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
* Create and define supplier technical and quality requirements based on customer and program requirements and expectations for NPI and production phases
* Lead resolution of supplier quality issues through root cause analysis, while functioning as liaison between purchasing, engineering, production, and suppliers
* Define product technical requirements, and ensure supplier compliance with these requirements
* Analyze supplier quality and delivery metrics to identify trends and pinpoint systemic performance gaps and root causes to drive supplier improvement plans
* Conduct independent research to identify potential new suppliers and capabilities in manufacturing and metrology for injection molded parts
* Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self\-direction, and courage


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering
* 5\+ years of experience in one of the following: injection molding process development, direct hands\-on injection mold design and/or injection mold construction, or Mold Master


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
* Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering
* 10\+ years of experience in one of the following: injection molding process development, direct hands\-on injection mold design and/or injection mold construction, or Mold Master
* Knowledge of metrology tools and techniques for measuring and characterizing injection molded parts
* Knowledge of statistical techniques and methods (design of experiments, Six Sigma, etc.). Experience with JMP plus.
* Proficiency in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GDT) principles and applications
* Exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, time management, and organizational skills
* Ability to act quickly in a fast\-moving and high\-stress environment.
* Experience with statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma certification, or Lean manufacturing principles applied
* Proven track record of production ramp\-up for high\-volume electronics manufacturing, preferably in consumer electronics
* Strong understanding of failure modes, defect analysis, and quality control methodologies (e.g., 8D, Fishbone, Pareto, PFMEA, DOE, SPC), with the ability to develop Product Quality Plans (PQP), implement FAI and Cp/Cpk reviews, and establish audit procedures tailored for high production volumes
* Hands\-on experience with failure analysis with prior experience in the consumer electronics industry, particularly with high volume hardware assembly, would be plus.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple suppliers and projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment


**Additional Requirements**
* Position is based in Bangalore, India and requires being onsite \- remote work not considered
* Must be willing to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
* Ability to travel: Up to 50% of work week travel may be required to suppliers in Southeast Asia


 SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Web (Ads Customer Interface)
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 



  





 What is the role?
 

 In this role you will work as a key member of the Roku Ads Engineering Customer Interface (ACI) team. You will hire and develop a team that will design, develop, and operate components of our best\-in\-class suite of customer\-facing web applications including Campaign Management, Demand Side Platform, Data Management Platform, Reporting and Forecasting toolsets. The customer interface team and the corresponding API services layer operate on a modern tech stack including React, Node.js and agentic AI technologies.
 



 How will I use AI at Roku?
 





 At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
 



 We value
 
 your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor,
 


 MCP
 


 servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.
 








 What are the responsibilities of the role?
 
* Lead and grow a high\-performing engineering team to execute ambitious product and technical roadmaps
* Hire quality software engineering professionals and build a high\-performance team to deliver Roku's business objectives
* Set clear objectives for the team and individuals that are measurable and attainable
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define goals, requirements and scope for the Roku business initiatives
* Provide technical guidance to the team and ensure that timely and informed decisions are made to remove the project impediments
* Ensure the delivery of high\-quality software deliverables with rigorous Validation and Verification testing cycles
* Manage the recruitment, onboarding and continuous training and improvement of engineering teams
* Communicate projects status, risks and outcomes to senior management, ensuring transparency and alignment with business objectives
* Foster an environment of continuous learning in the teams, including active adoption of AI tools and technologies in software engineering



 What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 
* Experience managing a team, including hiring, onboarding, and professional development
* Overall 16\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience with the past 5\+ years in leading and managing technology teams
* Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) with a proven ability to guide the team in the design, architecture, development, testing and deployment phases of the project
* Proven capability of making technical tradeoffs based on changing business priorities and technical roadmaps
* Proven record of implementing essential software engineering practices include code review, automated testing, CI/CD pipeline and performance optimizations
* Demonstrated team leadership in terms of hiring, training, retaining and mentoring highly performant engineering teams
* History of successful stakeholder collaboration with product managers, designers and senior leadership to align technical deliverables with business objectives






**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 



  
 


**What are some of the benefits?** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**What should I know about Roku's culture?** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Manager, Analog Design
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
   

  





 Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Looking for a 10\+ years experienced Engineering Manager with in\-depth understanding of Analog concepts, experience of design of complex Analog I/Ps \& sub\-blocks, integrating I/Ps and sub systems and ownership, experience of fully owning smaller ICs (Point of loads, Single Converters) and owning major I/Ps in large PMICs, to join the 2\.6B$ Power Business Unit. The candidate will get to work on a wide range of exciting products such as PMICs, Linear and Switching DC\-DC converters powering the next generation of Renesas processors. This is an early\-stage growth opportunity where in the candidate will get to learn, build and over time contribute and influence the charter for Renesas’s massive Power product portfolio.
   

  





 Essential Functions:
   

  




* Must be proficient in designing and owning complex I/Ps like \+ve/\-ve Charge Pumps, Buck Converters, Source\-Sink LDOs, Ultra\-low power Oscillators (including Relaxation type), Temperature Sensor, Current Sense, SAR ADCs, Protection (Thermal, Under\-Voltage, Over\-Voltage, Over Current etc) and analog blocks including Bandgap references, V2I, Analog Buffers, Op\-Amps, Comparators, High speed level shifters etc.


* Must have in\-depth Understanding of and should be able to implement \& compensate the Control Loops, Analog feedback loops and should know trade\-offs between various compensation strategies.


* Should be able to build/support Block level spec break down from Top level chip requirements and independently own, design complete switching converter e.g. Buck, Boost, Buck\-Boost etc and LDOs. Must be able to do block level error budgeting depending on the block requirements.


* Must be aware of relative differences of various control loop architectures (Constant Freq, Constant ON/OFF Time, Current mode etc) and decide/implement the best option to meet converter level performance specifications and other system requirements.


* Must be able to bring in innovative ideas to improve designs to meet challenging specifications.


* Should have in\-depth knowledge of Analog layouts and be able to work closely with layout lead from floor planning till Chip Top completion and verification and do trade\-offs based on desired performance


* Must be conversant with the standard design, extraction and simulation flows \& tools, speed, convergence, accuracy trade\-offs and should be able to optimize setups based on Pre/Post (with/without) Parasitic using simulator options, debug and navigate through tool related challenges.


* Should be able to setup design flows and methodologies including checklists, reviews to ensure quality designs and take them all the way to Silicon success.


* Should be able to mentor Freshers and Junior engineers for upscaling their technical skills as well as other skills needed for better efficacy.


* Should have experience of end\-to\-end IC development flow, Silicon debugs, and taking ICs to production


* Should be able to lead/manage a small group of Engineers and navigate through all stages of IC development while handling and mitigating challenges, ensuring high quality silicon while adhering to the schedules based on business needs.


* Should have in\-depth understanding of ESD, LU and other IC level issues and be able to define protection for the I/O ring for the IC


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering


* 10\+ years in Analog Circuit Design, minimum 2 years of managerial experience.


* Solid understanding and design experience of complex analog designs with full ownership.


* Chip design, Verification, Silicon validation, debugs, Qual support and taking ICs to production.


* Must be a technical leader and natural team player, mentor and should strive towards fostering a highly creative and productive working environment


**Additional Information**

 Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 .’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.
   

  

  

  

 With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 .’
   

  

  

  

 At Renesas, you can:
   

  




* **Launch and advance your career** 
 in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.


* **Make a real impact** 
 by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.


* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** 
 in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people\-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.



 Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?
   

  





 Join Renesas. Let’s
 **Shape the Future** 
 together.
   

  





 Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement.

title: Shipping Manager
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Centre (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a Shipping Manager to join the shipping team. This is a senior leadership role, reporting to the Director, Facilities Engineering \& Projects, based in Chevron’s ENGINE facility office in Bengaluru.
   

  

 The Marine capability within Chevron ENGINE in Bengaluru is a new, integrated function established to support Chevron’s global shipping organization by leveraging India\-based talent. It combines marine engineering, technical assurance, voyage operations, commercial support, and reliability expertise with a state\-of\-the\-art marine training centre with simulator capability also being commissioned. This setup allows ENGINE to act as an onshore extension of Chevrons global shipping capability, providing technical support and building workforce capability for its global fleet.
   

  

 Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 This is a senior leadership role that will lead and develop Chevron ENGINE’s shipping capability as a high\-performing, scalable extension of Chevron shipping company, with overall accountability for organizational effectiveness, capability development, operational excellence, workforce growth, and delivery performance. The role provides strategic direction and governance across all shipping activities within ENGINE and ensures alignment with Chevron shipping’s global priorities and standards.
   

  

**About You**
 We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.
   

  

**To Be Considered For This Role, Applicants Should Have**
**ENGINE Shipping organization leadership \& corporate liaison**
* Lead the ENGINE shipping organization, including direct and indirect resources, with single\-point accountability for delivery and full employee administrative requirements, including performance management, coaching, mentoring, and development of marine employees.
* Establish clear governance, decision\-making frameworks, and performance expectations.
* Serve as the primary interface with Chevron shipping company, aligning on:
+ Priorities and demand
+ Standards and policies
+ Operating model and ways of working
+ Ensure integration of global shipping workflows into ENGINE delivery.
+ Drive alignment with enterprise strategy, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.

**Capability building, workforce development \& organizational integration**+ Partner with functional supervisors in the sending business/function to align role requirements, work quality, and priorities.
+ Lead workforce planning, recruitment, and onboarding strategies and plans
+ Coordinate transition, onboarding, training, and parallel\-run activities for new resources, including training and travel budget setting and tracking.
+ Enable effective integration, mentoring, and deployment aligned to operational needs
+ Build sustainable in\-country capability, supporting long\-term growth, scalability, and efficiency.

**Operational excellence, governance \& high performance**+ Establish robust governance and reporting frameworks.
+ Partner with functional supervisors in the sending business/function to align on performance goals, metrics, and objectives.
+ Drive consistent delivery performance, role clarity, and accountability across teams.
+ Improve efficiency, cost discipline, and decision clarity in shipping operations.


* Monitor and deliver against key success metrics, including:
+ Capability ramp\-up and independent leadership progression
+ Increased proportion of locally executed shipping activities.
+ Cost efficiency improvements versus traditional models.

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, safety, and reliability.


**Key outcomes / Success measures**
* Stable, well\-governed shipping organization with clear accountability.
* Cost\-efficient delivery model focused on continuous improvement and competitive performance.
* Effective marine training centre delivering high\-quality, compliant training courses
* Strong alignment with shipping leadership and global stakeholders
* A scalable, repeatable, and cost\-competitive capability model supporting future ENGINE growth.


**Leadership expectations**
- Demonstrate Chevron’s high\-performance behaviours:

* Directness, accountability, and results focus
* Strong decision\-making and ownership mindset
* Build a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning
* Act as a visible leader and integrator across ENGINE and shipping’s global model
* Drive talent development, mentoring, and succession planning
* Lead through change, growth, and capability transformation


**Why this role matters**
* ENGINE Shipping has rapidly expanded in scope and complexity, requiring dedicated leadership to ensure effective governance, scalable delivery, and long\-term capability development for the marine function.
* This role establishes the foundation for a locally led, globally supported shipping capability, enabling sustainable growth and operational excellence.


**Required Qualifications**
**Experience \& capability**
* Extensive and broad experience across shipping, marine operations, and/or maritime training; with a target of more than 10 years in Chief Engineer / Master Engineer role.
* Proven leadership in complex, multi\-stakeholder, multi\-time\-zone organizations.
* Track record in building capability and scaling operations
* Strong understanding of training governance, compliance, and accreditation frameworks


**What We Can Offer You**
 Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
   

  

 Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
   

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well\-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well\-being, and work\-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.


 Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time\-limited Visa status for this position.
   

  

**Privacy and terms and conditions**
 We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.
   

  

 Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.
   

  

 Terms of Use
   

  

 “ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.

title: HEAD / SENIOR MANAGER – MECHANICAL ENGINEERING & TURNKEY PROJECTS
description:
**Experience: 15–20\+ years Industry: Industrial Automation \| Automotive \| Machine Building \| Engineering** 

**Travel: Willingness to travel across India and, when required, overseas** 

**Reporting To: Head of Engineering / Project Director**

**We are looking for an experienced Head / Senior Manager – Mechanical Engineering \& Turnkey Projects to establish and lead our mechanical engineering function. This is a senior technical leadership role for a mechanical engineering professional who can go beyond CAD and design execution and take ownership of the complete mechanical engineering lifecycle: Customer Requirement → Concept → Design → Engineering → Costing → BOM → Manufacturing/Fabrication → Assembly → FAT → Installation → Commissioning Support The successful candidate will also play a key role in building and developing Vedant Technologies’ mechanical engineering team as our turnkey business expands.**

**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Mechanical Engineering Leadership:** Establish and lead the mechanical engineering function; set design standards, documentation systems and reusable engineering practices; review designs and ensure quality, manufacturability and cost effectiveness.

**Turnkey Project Ownership:** Own the mechanical scope from RFQ and customer requirements through concept, layout, design, engineering, costing, BOM, fabrication, assembly, FAT, installation and commissioning support.

**Automation \& Automotive Execution:** Lead or support projects involving automotive/BIW automation, robotic cells, fixtures, SPMs, assembly and inspection systems, material handling, conveyors and turnkey automation.

**Design \& Technical Review:** Guide and review machine design, assemblies, manufacturing/fabrication drawings, jigs and fixtures, machine structures, conveyors, pneumatic/hydraulic mechanisms, servo and linear motion systems, grippers, guarding and safety provisions.

**Estimation \& Cost Control:** Prepare mechanical estimates for engineering hours, materials, fabrication, machining, bought\-outs, mechanisms, assembly and installation; monitor actual costs, rework, design changes, outsourcing and project margins.

**Sales \& Proposal Support:** Support RFQ review, technical feasibility, concept development, scope definition, assumptions, BOQ, man\-hour estimation, vendor estimates, technical proposals, risk identification and customer discussions.

**Vendor \& Manufacturing Coordination:** Coordinate with SCM and manufacturing partners for fabrication, machining, laser cutting, bending, welding, surface treatment, bought\-out components and assembly; monitor capability, quality, cost, delivery and inspection.

**Customer \& Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Interact with customer engineering, project, plant, manufacturing, automation and procurement teams; coordinate with Electrical \& Automation, Sales/BD, SCM, Project Management and Finance.

**Team Building \& Management:** Recruit, train, mentor and manage mechanical engineers, designers, project engineers and trainees; allocate work, manage performance, develop skills, plan resources and support succession planning.

**Project Delivery \& Improvement:** Ensure timely mechanical scope delivery, FAT readiness and commissioning support; improve drawing/BOM accuracy, engineering productivity and design quality; reduce delays, rework and cost overruns.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR MUST\-HAVE EXPERIENCE**

* 15–20\+ years of relevant experience in mechanical engineering, machine design, automation machinery or turnkey project execution. Strong mechanical machine design experience. Automation equipment / machinery experience. SPM / Special Machinery experience. Fixtures / Tooling experience. 3D CAD and manufacturing drawing experience. Engineering estimation and costing. Vendor / fabrication coordination. Turnkey project execution. Team leadership experience.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in: Automotive OEM projects / BIW / Body Shop / Robotic Automation / Assembly Lines / Inspection Systems / Material Handling / Machine Building / System Integration / Turnkey Automation.

Experience working with automotive OEMs / Tier\-1 organizations will be an advantage.

**ENGINEERING SOFTWARE \& KNOWLEDGE**

Strong working knowledge of one or more: SolidWorks \| Autodesk Inventor \| AutoCAD \| Creo / Pro\-E Experience with 3D modelling, assemblies and manufacturing drawings is essential. Knowledge of: GD\&T, Tolerance Stack\-up, DFM / DFA, Material Selection, Manufacturing Processes will be an advantage.

**ABOUT VEDANT TECHNOLOGIES**

Vedant Technologies is an Industrial Automation and Engineering Services company based in Bengaluru, providing engineering, automation and turnkey solutions to OEMs, machine builders, system integrators and manufacturing industries. Our capabilities include: Industrial Automation, Robotics \& Machine Vision, Mechanical Engineering, Special Purpose Machines (SPM), Electrical Engineering \& Control Panel Design, PLC / HMI / SCADA, EPLAN Engineering, Re\-engineering, Turnkey Automation Projects, Engineering Consulting \& Outsourcing. As we enter an important growth phase, we are expanding our capabilities in automotive, BIW, machine building and turnkey automation projects.

Pay: ₹125,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month
